## Chapter 8. Description of the Prominent Sargas

## \|\| 1.8.1 \|\|

*śrīkūrma uvāca*  
*evaṃ bhūtāni sṛṣṭāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca \|*  
*yadā cāsya prajāḥ sṛṣṭā na vyavardhanta dhīmataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Kurma said, “Thus the moveable and immoveable creatures were created. But the created beings of wise Prajapati, did not increase.

## \|\| 1.8.2 \|\|

*tamomātrāvṛto brahmā tadāśocata duḥ khitaḥ \|*

## \|\| 1.8.3 \|\|

*athātmani samadrākṣīt tamomātrāṃ niyāmikām \|*

3\. Thereafter he visualised Tamasa elements within himself as main caused controlling everything. Rajas and Sattva qualities also were present with their own functions enveloped by Tamas.

## \|\| 1.8.4-5 \|\|

*tamastad vyanudat paścāt rajaḥ sattvena saṃyutaḥ \|*

*adharmācaraṇo viprā hiṃsā cāśubhalakṣaṇā \|*  
*svāṃ tanuṃ sa tato brahmā tāmapohata bhāsvarām \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Then he discarded tamoguna and he was then united rajoguna with Sattva-guna. With the decline of tamas element, it appeared in the form of mithuna. О Brahmanas, she was the performer of violence following the path of adharma. Thereafter Brahma covered the shining body.

## \|\| 1.8.6 \|\|

*dvidhākarot punardehamardhena puruṣo 'bhavat \|*  
*ardhena nārī puruṣo virājamasṛjat prabhuḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Again he divided his body into two parts. Half the part of the body was male, while the other half of the body was that of a female. The lord in the form of Purusa, produced Virat}

## \|\| 1.8.7 \|\|

*nārīṃ ca śatarūpākhyāṃ yoginīṃ sasṛje śubhām \|*  
*sā divaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva mahamnā vyāpya saṃsthitā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The female YoginI, known by the name of SatarQpa1 2 having all the noble symptoms was produced. She stood there illumining the earth and the sky with her lustre.

## \|\| 1.8.8-10 \|\|

*yogaiśvaryabalopetā jñānavijñānasaṃyutā \|*  
*yo 'bhavat puruṣāt putro virāḍavyaktajanmanaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*svāyaṃbhuvo manurdevaḥ so 'bhavat puruṣo muniḥ \|*

*bhartāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ manumevānupadyata \|*

8-10. The female was possessing all the riches and prowess, besides the knowledge and spiritual enlightenment. The virat-son who was bom of the unborn Purusa, subsequently came to be known as Svayambhuva Manu. The female named Satampa performed hard tapas and achieved the glorious Manu as her husband. Two sons v/ere bom to Satarupa from Manu.

## \|\| 1.8.11-13 \|\|

*priyavratottānapādau kanyādvayamanuttamam \|*  
*tayoḥ prasūtiṃ dakṣāya manuḥ kanyāṃ dadau punaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*prajāpatirathākūtiṃ mānaso jagṛhe ruciḥ \|*  
*ākūtyāṃ mithunaṃ jajñe mānasasya ruceḥ śubham \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-13. Both of them were known as Priyavrata and Uttanapada. The best of two girls were also bom to her. Out of them, the girl named Prasuti, was given away to Daksa by Manu. Then Ruci the mind bom son of Prajapati, accepted the second daughter named Akuti. With the union of Ruci and Akuti, a mithuna with auspicious symbols was bom in the form of human creation. Both of them were known by the names of Yajna and Daksina and the entire universe developed out of them. By Yajna, Daksina gave birth to twelve sons. They all were Devas during the time of Svayambhava Manu and they came to be known by the name of Yama.

## \|\| 1.8.14-16 \|\|

*yāmā iti samākyatā devāḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare \|*  
*prasūtyāṃ ca tathā dakṣaścatastro viṃśatiṃ tathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sasarja kanyā nāmāni tāsāṃ samyam nibodhata \|*  
*śraddhā lakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*buddhirlajjāvapuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśī \|*  
*patnyarthaṃ pratijagrāha dharmo dākṣāyaṇīḥ śubhāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Similarly Daksa-prajapati, produced twenty four daughters from PrasQti. You attentively listen to the names of the twenty four daughters bom to Prastiti- Sraddha (faith), Lakshmi (riches), Dhrti (firmness), Tuti (satisfaction), Puti (nourishment), Medha (recollection), Kriya (action), Buddhi (intelligence), Lajja (bashfulness), Vapu (body), Santi (peace) Siddhi (accomplishment), and Klrti (fame) was the thirteenth. These auspicious daughters of Daksa were accepted by Dharma as his wives.

## \|\| 1.8.17 \|\|

*tābhyaḥ śiṣṭā yavīyasya ekādaśa sulocanāḥ \|*  
*khyātiḥ satyatha saṃbhūtiḥ smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The remaining eleven daughters had the beautiful eyes, and were known by the names of Khyati, Stiti, Sambhuti, Smrti, Prlti, Ksama, Santati, Anasuya, Uija, Svaha and Svadha.

## \|\| 1.8.18-20 \|\|

*saṃtatiścānasūyā ca ūrjā svāhā svadhā tathā \|*

*pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kratuḥ paramadharmavit \|*  
*atrirvasiṣṭho vahniśca pitaraśca yathākramam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*khyātyādyā jagṛhuḥ kanyā munayo munisattamāḥ \|*  
*śraddhāyā ātmajaḥ kāmo darpo lakṣmīsutaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. The eleven Rishis possessing the best of wisdom known as Bhrgu, Bhava, Marici, Angira,1 Muni, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu- The extremely religious one, Atri, Vasistha, Vanhi and Pitrs, accepted Khyati and other girls as their wives. Kama was the son of Sraddha and Darpa was the son of Lakshmi.

## \|\| 1.8.21 \|\|

*dhṛtyāstu niyamaḥ putrastuṣṭyāḥ saṃtoṣa ucyate \|*

21\. Niyama was the son of Dhrti, while Santosa was the son of Tusti. Labha was the son of Push and Sanaa was the son of Medha.

## \|\| 1.8.22 \|\|

*kriyāyāścābhavat putro daṇḍaḥ samaya eva ca \|*

22\. Danda and Nay a were other sons of Kriya. Pramada and Bodha was the sons of Buddhi.

## \|\| 1.8.23 \|\|

*lajjāyā vinayaḥ putro vapuṣo vyavasāyakaḥ \|*

23\. Vinaya was the son of Lajja, Vyavasaya (exertion) was the son of Vapu (body). Ksema (well-being) was the son of Santi (peace) and Siddha was the son of Siddhi.

## \|\| 1.8.24 \|\|

*yaśaḥ kīrtisutastadvadityete dharmasūnavaḥ \|*  
*kāmasya harṣaḥ putro 'bhūd devānando vyajāyata \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Yas'a (fame) was the son of Kirti. Thus all of them were the sons of Dharma. Harsa and Devananda were the sons of Kama.

## \|\| 1.8.25 \|\|

*ityeṣa vai sukhodarkaḥ sargo dharmasya kīrtitaḥ \|*  
*jajñe hiṃsā tvadharmād vai nikṛtiṃ cānṛtaṃ sutam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In this way, this is said to be the progeny of Dharma. Himsa (violence) produced the sons named Nikrti and Anrta (falsehood) from Adharma.

## \|\| 1.8.26 \|\|

*nikṛtyanṛtayorjajñe bhayaṃ naraka eva ca \|*  
*māyā ca vedanā caiva mithunaṃ tvidametayoḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Nikrti (Wickedness) had two twins known as Bhaya and Naraka, Maya and Vedana. Both were twins of them.

## \|\| 1.8.27 \|\|

*bhayājjajñe 'tha vai māyā mṛtyuṃ bhūtāpahāriṇam \|*  
*vedanā ca sutaṃ cāpi duḥ khaṃ jajñe 'tha rauravāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Maya in union with Bhaya produced Mrtyu who happened to be the killer of all. Naraka in union with Vedana produced a son named Duhkha.

## \|\| 1.8.28 \|\|

*mṛtyorvyādhijarāśokatṛṣṇākrodhāśca jajñire \|*  
*duḥ khottarāḥ smṛtā hyete sarve cādharmalakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Mrtyu had the wife named Vyadhi, who gave birth to Jara (old age), Soka (grief), Trsna (thirst), and Krodha (fury). All of them had the symbols of adhariva (evilness) and resulted in grief.

## \|\| 1.8.29-30 \|\|

*naiṣāṃ bhāryāsti putro vā sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ \|*  
*ityeṣa tāmasaḥ sargo jajñe dharmaniyāmakaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ityeṣa tāmasaḥ sargo jajñe dharmaniyāmakaḥ \|*  
*saṃkṣepeṇa mayā proktā visṛṣṭirmunipuṅgavā \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. They had neither wives nor the sons. All of them were Urdhvaretas (or Brahma-car ins)} This Tamasika creation was produced as controller of Dharma. О Best of the sages, I have described the creation of the universe in brief.

## Chapter 9. The Emergence of Brahma

## \|\| 1.9.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya varadaṃ viṣṇuṃ papracchuḥ saṃśayānvitā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said, “Listening to these words, Narada and other MahaRishis, becoming doubtful, offered their salutation to the lord- the pronouncer of the boons and asked him.

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*

*idānīṃ saṃśayaṃ cemamasmākaṃ chettumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The sages said, “O Janardana, you have spoken about the main Sarga. Now you kindly remove our doubt, because you are competent enough to do so.

## \|\| 1.9.3-4 \|\|

*kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśaḥ pūrvajo 'pi pinākadhṛk \|*

3-4. How could lord Shiva, the holder of the Pinaka-bow, though bom earlier than Brahma, become the son of Brahma whose birth was not manifest? How could Brahma, the lord of the universe, and also known as the grandsire, emerge out of the egg? You are the only person to speak on the subject.”

## \|\| 1.9.5 \|\|

*śrīkūrma uvāca*  
*śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ \|*  
*putratvaṃ brahmaṇastasya padmayonitvameva ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Kurma said, “О Rsis, Lord Siva, possessing the enormous lustre, to be the son of Brahma, and Brahma in turn to be bom of the lotus are mysterious. Still all of you should listen to me attentively.

## \|\| 1.9.6 \|\|

*atītakalpāvasāne tamobhūtaṃ jagat trayam \|*  
*āsīdekārṇavaṃ sarvaṃ na devādyā na carṣayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. At the end of the last kalpa, all the three lokas were filled with darkness. There was only terrible oceanic water. There were neither the gods, nor the sages.

## \|\| 1.9.7 \|\|

*tatra nārāyaṇo devo nirjane nirupaplave \|*  
*āśritya śeṣaśayanaṃ suṣvāpa puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. There in that lonely and undisturbed place, the Supreme person lord Narayana, reclining over the serpent bed was sleeping in the waters of the troubleless ocean.

## \|\| 1.9.8-9 \|\|

*sahastraśīrṣā bhūtvā sa sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt \|*  
*sahastrabāhuḥ sarvajñaścintyamāno manīṣibhiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pītavāsā viśālākṣo nīlajimūtasannibhaḥ \|*  
*mahāvibhūtiryogātmā yogināṃ hṛdayālayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. He had a thousand heads, a thousand feet, a thousand eyes and a thousand arms. He is an omniscient form is adored by the ascetics, clad in the yellow garments and vast eyes. He had the complexion of the blue clouds. He was quite merciful on Yogins, the great yogic soul of Super human power and pride.

## \|\| 1.9.10 \|\|

*kadācit tasya suptasya līlārthaṃ divyamadbhutam \|*  
*trailokyasāraṃ vimalaṃ nābhyāṃ paṅkajamudvabhau \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Once during his sleep, a spotless lotus of divine character emerged of its own accord from his navel which was quite astonishing and the essence of the three worlds.

## \|\| 1.9.11 \|\|

*śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ taruṇādityasannibham \|*  
*divyagandhamayaṃ puṇyaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The lotus was spread in an area of a thousand yojanas was quite fresh and had the lustre of the sun at noon. It has the divine fragrance, quite auspicious and endowed with the pericarp and saffron.

## \|\| 1.9.12 \|\|

*tasyaivaṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ vartamānasya śārṅgiṇaḥ \|*  
*hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāṃstaṃ deśamupacakrame \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In this way, when lord Visnu, the holder of the Sarnga bow, with sleeping there, lord Hiranyagarbha reached there.

## \|\| 1.9.13 \|\|

*sa taṃ kareṇa viśvātmā samutthāpya sanātanam \|*  
*provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ māyayā tasya mohitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The eternal soul of the universe then lifted up the eternal one, with his one hand. Then under the influence of his Maya, he spoke these sweet words.

## \|\| 1.9.14 \|\|

*asminnekārṇave ghore nirjane tamasāvṛte \|*  
*ekākī ko bhavāñchete brūhi me puruṣarṣabha \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. “Who are you in this lonely ocean which is the terrific one, living in a solitary condition? О Best of the human, you kindly enlighten me.

## \|\| 1.9.15 \|\|

*tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vihasya garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*uvāca devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Listening to the word of Brahma, the Garuda- bannered lord Visnu, smilingly spoke the words which were deep as the rumbling of a cloud.

## \|\| 1.9.16-17 \|\|

*bho bho nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayam \|*  
*mahāyogeśvaraṃ māṃ tvaṃ jānīhi puruṣottamam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*mayi paśya jagat kṛtsnaṃ tvāṃ ca lokapitāmaham \|*  
*saparvatamahādvīpaṃ samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. “О Brahman, you know me to be imperishable, a great person Narayana, the great lord of Yogins, the source of the birth of all the creatures. You are the grand-sire of the universe. You better visualise in me the entire world which is surrounded\\with the mountains and the seven oceans.”

## \|\| 1.9.18 \|\|

*evamābhāṣya viścātmā provāca puruṣaṃ hariḥ \|*

18\. Thus speaking, lord Hari, the soul of the universe, the great Yogin, asked Brahma, inspite of his being all knowledgeable, Who are you?

## \|\| 1.9.19 \|\|

*tataḥ prahasya bhagavān brahmā vedanidhiḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*pratyuvācāmbujābhākṣaṃ sasmitaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Then Brahma, the treasury of the Vedas, replied with a smile in sweet voice, to Vishnu, having the lustre of the lotus.

## \|\| 1.9.20 \|\|

*ahaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ \|*

20\. He said, “I am the creator and dispenser of destiny. I am self-bom and the great-grandsire. The entire universe is lodged in me. I happen to be Brahma having faces on all the sides.

## \|\| 1.9.21 \|\|

*śrutvā vācaṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ \|*  
*anujñāpyātha yogena praviṣṭo brahmaṇastanum \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Lord Visnu of true powerful one, hearing these words, with his permission, entered the body of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.9.22 \|\|

*tralokyametat sakalaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam \|*  
*udare tasya devasya dṛṣṭvā vismayamāgataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Lord Visnu, finding all the gods, asuras the humans, and the three worlds in the abdomen of that deity, felt surprised.

## \|\| 1.9.23 \|\|

*tadāsya vaktrānniṣkramya pannagendraniketanaḥ \|*  
*ajātaśatrurbhagavān pitāmahamathābravīt \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thereafter the lord Visnu, who was reclining over the serpent bed, coming out of his body said to Brahma.

## \|\| 1.9.24 \|\|

*bhavānapyevamevādya śāśvataṃ hi mamoharam \|*  
*praviśya lokān paśyaitān vicitrān puruṣarṣabha \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. “O best among the men, in this manner you also entere my womb today and witness the astonishing type of the universe.”

## \|\| 1.9.25 \|\|

*tataḥ prahlādanīṃ vāṇī śrutvā tasyābhinandya ca \|*  
*śrīpaterudaraṃ bhūyaḥ praviveśa kuśadhvajaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Then listening to the words which pleased the mind, and felicitating him, lord Kusadhvaja (Brahma), entered the belly of lord Visnu.

## \|\| 1.9.26 \|\|

*tāneva lokān garbhasthānapaśyat satyavikramaḥ \|*  
*paryaṭitvā tu devasya dadṛśe 'ntaṃ na vai hareḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The truthful Brahma observed all the Lokas established inside the belly of Visnu. Then wandering everywhere there, he was unable to find the end of lord Hari.

## \|\| 1.9.27-28 \|\|

*tato dvārāṇi sarvāṇi pihitāni mahātmanā \|*  
*janārdanena brahmāsau nābhyāṃ dvāramavindata \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tatra yogabalenāsau praviśya kanakāṇḍajaḥ \|*  
*ujjahārātmano rūpaṃ puṣkarāccaturānanaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Thereafter great-souled Janardana, closed all the exit points. Then Brahma found an exits through the navel. Then the four faced Brahma, on the strength of his yogic practices, got himself out in the form of a lotus.

## \|\| 1.9.29 \|\|

*virarājāravindasthaḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ \|*  
*brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavān jagadyoniḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. At that point of time Brahma- born of lotus or self bom one. Looked graceful like the lustre of the inner lotus.

## \|\| 1.9.30 \|\|

*samanyamāno viśveśamātmānaṃ paramaṃ padam \|*  
*provāca puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ meghagambhīrayā girā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Then Brahma describing himself to be the soul of the universe, spoke in the words which were as deep as the sound of the clouds, to lord Visnu.

## \|\| 1.9.31 \|\|

*kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatedānīmātmano jayakāṅkṣayā \|*  
*eko 'haṃ prabalo nānyo māṃ vai ko 'bibhaviṣyati \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. “What have you done with the intention of your victory? I alone am all powerful. There would be none else comparable with me.”

## \|\| 1.9.32-34 \|\|

*śrutvā nārāyaṇo vākyaṃ brahmaṇo lokatantriṇaḥ \|*  
*sāntvapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ babhāṣe madhuraṃ hariḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*bhavān dhātā vidhātā ca svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*na mātsaryābhiyogena dvārāṇi pihitāni me \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kintu līlārthamevaitanna tvāṃ bādhitumicchayā \|*  
*ko hi bādhitumanvicched devadevaṃ pitāmaham \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Listening to the words so spoken by Brahma, becoming alert, lord Narayana Hari, assuring him, spoke the sweet words, “You are Dhata (creator), Vidhata (protector), self born and the great grand-sire. I never closed the exit passages out of jealousy. I did so only sportingly. Who would have intention to obstruct you, the grandfather, lord of Devas.

## \|\| 1.9.35 \|\|

*na te 'nyathāvagantavyaṃ mānyo me sarvathā bhavān \|*

35\. О Brahman, there is no obstruction for you. You are always adorable for me. О Bestower of welfare in case I have done any harm to you, you kindly forgive me for the same.

## \|\| 1.9.36 \|\|

*asmācca kāraṇād brahman putro bhavatu me bhavān \|*  
*padmayoniriti khyāto matpriyārthaṃ jaganmaya \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О Brahman, because of the same reason, you shall be my son. О the image of the universe, in order to perform my pleasant task, you will be known by the name of Padmayoni.

## \|\| 1.9.37 \|\|

*tataḥ sa bhagavān devo varaṃ dattvā kirīṭine \|*  
*praharṣamatulaṃ gatvā punarviṣṇumabhāṣata \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Thereafter lord Brahma, bestowing a boon on Visnu, the holder of a crown on the head, feeling extremely delighted spoke to Visnu again.

## \|\| 1.9.38 \|\|

*bhavān sarvātmako 'nantaḥ sarveṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*sarvabhūtāntarātmā vai paraṃ bahma sanātanam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. You are the soul pervading in all the living beings and are beyond measure, greay lord, the soul of all the living beings and are the eternal Supreme Brahman.

## \|\| 1.9.39 \|\|

*ahaṃ vai sarvalokānāmātmā lokamaheśvaraḥ \|*  
*manmayaṃ sarvamevedaṃ brahmāhaṃ puruṣaḥ paraḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. I am the great lord, pervading all the living beings in the form of light. All the mobiles and immobiles are my own. I happen to be Brahman-the Supreme Person.

## \|\| 1.9.40 \|\|

*nāvābhyāṃ vidyate hyanyo lokānāṃ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*ekā mūrtirdvidhā bhinnā nārāyaṇapitāmahau \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. There is no other Supreme lord except the two of us. Narayana and the grand-sire, are of one and the same form.”

## \|\| 1.9.41 \|\|

*tenaivamukto brahmāṇaṃ vāsudevo 'bravīdidam \|*  
*iyaṃ pratijñā bhavato vināśāya bhaviṣyati \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. At these words of Brahma, Vasudeva, then spoke to Brahma. This resolve of yours, shall be for the destruction alone.

## \|\| 1.9.42 \|\|

*kiṃ na paśyasi yogeśaṃ brahmādhipatimavyayam \|*  
*pradhānapuruṣeśānaṃ vedāhaṃ parameśvaram \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Do you not visualise by means of yoga, the indestructible lord Brahma? I am aware of Parames'vara, who happens to be the lord of Pradhana and Purusa. I know him as Supreme Spirit.

## \|\| 1.9.43 \|\|

*yaṃ na paśyanti yogīndrāḥ sāṃkhyā api maheśvaram \|*

43\. Lord Mahesvara who is invisible from the great Yogins and those well-versed in the Samkhya philosophy. You should take refuge with the Brahman who is beyond the birth and death.”

## \|\| 1.9.44-45 \|\|

*tataḥ kruddho 'mbujābhākṣaṃ brahmā provāca keśavam \|*  
*bhavān na nūnamātmānaṃ vetti tat paramakṣaram \|\| 44 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ jagatāmekamātmānaṃ paramaṃ padam \|*  
*nāvābhyāṃ vidyate hyanyo lokānāṃ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Listening to these words, enraged Brahma said to Kesava, having the eyes resembling the lotus flowers, “O Lord, I am surely aware of the indestructible Atman, the eternal one, who resembles the form of Brahman, the soul of the universe and enjoys the supreme position. There is no other lord of the universe, except the both of us.

## \|\| 1.9.46 \|\|

*saṃtyajya nidrāṃ vipulāṃ svamātmānaṃ vilokaya \|*  
*tasya tat krodhajaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurabhāṣata \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Discarding the prolonged Yoga-nidra, you better peep into your soul.” Thus listening to his enraged words, the lord spoke at that time.

## \|\| 1.9.47 \|\|

*mā maivaṃ vada kalyāṇa parivādaṃ mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*na me 'styaviditaṃ brahman nānyathāhaṃ vadāmite \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. “О Bestower of welfare, don't speak the words of denouncement about the great soul, to me, О Brahman, Nothing is unknown to me and I do not speak the falsehood.

## \|\| 1.9.48 \|\|

*kintu mohayati brahman bhavantaṃ pārameśvarī \|*  
*māyāśeṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ heturātmasamudbhāvā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. But О Brahma, the endless Maya of the lord, which is cause of all beings, emerges from Atman, that deludes all.”

## \|\| 1.9.49 \|\|

*etāvaduktvā bhagavān viṣṇustūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha \|*  
*jñātvā tat paramaṃ tattvaṃ svamātmānaṃ maheśvaram \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Thus speaking, Visnu kept quiet. Visnu the lord of all the gods, had spoken those words after knowing well the supreme tattva, in his mind.

## \|\| 1.9.50 \|\|

*kuto 'pyaparimeyātmā bhūtānāṃ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*prasādaṃ brahmaṇe kartuṃ prādurāsīt tato haraḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Thereafter, lord Shiva, the soul beyond measure, lord of the bhutas, for bestowing welfare on Brahma, suddenly emerged from somewhere.

## \|\| 1.9.51 \|\|

*lalāṭanayano 'nanto jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*triśūlapāṇirbhagavāṃstejasāṃ paramo nidhiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Lord Shiva had the metted locks of hair over his head, and a third eye over the forehead, he held a trident in his hand besides being the treasure of the lustre.

## \|\| 1.9.52 \|\|

*divyāṃ viśālāṃ grathitāṃ grahaiḥ sārkendutārakaiḥ \|*  
*mālāmatyadbhutākārāṃ dhārayan pādalambinīm \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. He was adorned with a long garland comprising of the sun, the moon, the constellations which fell upto the feet.

## \|\| 1.9.53 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamīśānaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*mohito māyayātyarthaṃ pītavāsasamabvīt \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Linder the influence of Maya, Brahma- the grand sire of the universe, at the sight of Isanadeva, spoke to Visnu, who was clad in pitambara- the yellow lower costume.

## \|\| 1.9.54 \|\|

*ka eṣa puruṣo 'nantaḥ śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ \|*  
*tejorāśirameyātmā samāyāti janārdana \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. He said, “O Janardana, who is this person of blue complexion, holder of the trident, having three eyes and possessing the enormous lustre?”

## \|\| 1.9.55 \|\|

*tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurdānavamardanaḥ \|*  
*apaśyadīśvaraṃ devaṃ jvalantaṃ vimale 'mbhasi \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Listening to these words Visnu, the destroyer of the demons, also spotted the illustrious Devesvara in the sky.

## \|\| 1.9.56 \|\|

*jñātvā tatparamaṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ brahmabhāvanam \|*  
*provācotthāya bhagavān devadevaṃ pitāmaham \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Realising about the Ishvara the form of Supreme being, Visnu got up and spoke to Brahma-the god of gods and said.

## \|\| 1.9.57-59 \|\|

*ayaṃ devo mahādevaḥ svayañjyotiḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*anādinidhano 'cintyo lokānāmīśvaro mahān \|\| 57 \|\|*

*śaṅkaraḥ śaṃbhurīśānaḥ sarvātmā parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*bhūtānāmadhipo yogī maheśo vimalaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ \|*  
*yaṃ prapaśyanti yatayo brahmabhāvena bhāvitāḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

57-59. “He is the lord Mahadeva, who is self illumining ancient, beyond birth and death, unthinkable, and is the lord of all the lokas. He is Sambhu, Isana, the soui of all, Paramesvara, lord of the bhutas, yogi, Mahesa, spotless and known as Shiva. He is Dhata, Vidhata, and indestructible. Only those ascetics who meditate upon him as Brahman, can perceive him.

## \|\| 1.9.60 \|\|

*sṛjatyeṣa jagat kṛtsnaṃ pāti saṃharate tathā \|*  
*kālo bhūtvā mahādevaḥ kevalo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. It is he, the great lord, becoming Kala creates the entire universe. He preserves the same and destroys it in due course of time. He is spotless, besides being the bestower of welfare.

## \|\| 1.9.61 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ vidadhe pūrvaṃ bhavantaṃ yaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*vedāṃśca pradadau tubhyaṃ so 'yamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. He is the one who initially created Brahma, who is the ancient one, who bestowed Vedas on you, the same Shiva is arriving.

## \|\| 1.9.62 \|\|

*asyaiva cāparāṃ mūrti viśvayoniṃ sanātanīm \|*  
*vāsudevābhidhānāṃ māmavehi prapitāmaha \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О Grandsire, he is also known by the other name of Vasudeva. Understand me to be only another form of his, the form that is eternal and the source of the universe.

## \|\| 1.9.63 \|\|

*kiṃ na paśyasi yogeśaṃ brahmādhipatimavyayam \|*  
*divyaṃ bhavatu te cakṣuryena drakṣyasi tatparam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Are you not aware of the indestructible Yoges'vara, the lord of Brahman? You can only visualise him with the divine eyes.”

## \|\| 1.9.64 \|\|

*labdhvā śaivaṃ tadā cakṣurviṣṇorlokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*bubudhe parameśānaṃ purataḥ samavasthitam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Thereafter Brahma, the grandsire of the universe, receiving the divine sight from Visnu, realized that highest knowledge present before him.

## \|\| 1.9.65 \|\|

*sa labdhvā paramaṃ jñānamaiśvaraṃ prapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*prapede śaraṇaṃ devaṃ tameva pitaraṃ śivam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Brahma- the grand-sire, after receiving the divine knowledge from Visnu, took refuge in lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.9.66 \|\|

*oṅkāraṃ samanusmṛtya saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā \|*  
*atharvaśirasā devaṃ tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Having been reminded of Othkara, he established himself with his own soul.

## \|\| 1.9.67 \|\|

*saṃstutastena bhagavān brahmaṇā parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*avāpa paramāṃ prītiṃ vyājahāra smayanniva \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Thereafter folding his hands, he adored the lord reciting the mantras from Atharvasiras upanisad.

## \|\| 1.9.68 \|\|

*matsamastvaṃ na saṃdeho madbhaktaśca yato bhavān \|*  
*mayaivotpāditaḥ pūrvaṃ lokasṛṣṭyarthamavyayam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. At the prayer so offered by Brahma, lord Parames'vara, was immensely pleased with him and then spoke to him with a serene smile on his face.

## \|\| 1.9.69 \|\|

*tvamātmā hyādipuruṣo mama dehasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*varaṃ varaya viśvātman varado 'haṃ tavānagha \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. “O Son, you are like me. There is no doubt about it. You happen to be my devotee as well. Initially, I had created you, the eternal being, for the creation of the universe.

## \|\| 1.9.70 \|\|

*sa devadevavacanaṃ niśamya kamalodbhavaḥ \|*  
*nirīkṣya viṣṇuṃ puruṣaṃ praṇamyāha vṛṣadhvajam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. You are the soul, the first person (Adi Purusa), and bom out of my body. О Soul of the universe, I bestow a boon on you which should be received by you, which is quite an excellent one.”

## \|\| 1.9.71 \|\|

*bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa mahādevāmbikāpate \|*  
*tvāmeva putramicchāmi tvayā vā sadṛśaṃ satam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The lotus-bom one, listening to the words of lord Shiva, the god of gods, looking at Visnu attentively, spoke to Lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.9.72 \|\|

*mohito 'smi mahādeva māyayā sūkṣmayā tvayā \|*  
*na jāne paramaṃ bhāvaṃ yāthātathyena te śiva \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. О Bhagavan, О Lord of the past and future, О Mahadeva, О Lord of Ambika, I desire you as my son or a son like you.

## \|\| 1.9.73 \|\|

*tvameva deva bhaktānāṃ bhrātā mātā pitā suhṛt \|*  
*prasīda tava pādābjaṃ namāmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О Mahadeva, I have been confused with your subtle Maya, О Shiva, I have not understood your ideas completely.

## \|\| 1.9.74 \|\|

*sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jagannātho vṛṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*vyājahāra tadā putraṃ samālokya janārdanam \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. You are the god of the devotees, the mother, the brother, the father and the friend. 1 take refuge in you. I offer my salutation at your feet. Kindly be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 1.9.75 \|\|

*yadarthitaṃ bhagavatā tat kariṣyāmi putraka \|*  
*vijñānamaiśvaraṃ divyamutpatsyati tavānagha \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The bull-bannered Lord Shiva, listening to the words of Brahma, and looking at the son Janardana, thus spoke.

## \|\| 1.9.76 \|\|

*tvameva sarvabhūtānāmādikartā niyojitaḥ \|*  
*tathā kuruṣva deveśa mayā lokapitāmaha \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. “О Son, I shall do whatever is desired by you. You will soon be bestowed with the divine knowledge concerning Ishvara.

## \|\| 1.9.77 \|\|

*eṣa nārāyaṇo 'nanto mamaiva paramā tanuḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati taveśāno yogakṣemavaho hariḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. You are established as the creator of all the beings. О Lord of the gods, О grand-sire of the universe, you establish your Maya in them.

## \|\| 1.9.78 \|\|

*evaṃ vyāhṛtya hastābhyāṃ prītātmā parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*saṃspṛśya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ hariṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. This Narayana has also emerged out of me. He is the Supreme form of mine alone. Hari takes care of your sustenance and welfare.” Saying thus Lord Parames'vara, with great pleasure, touching Brahma with both the hands, spoke to Hari.

## \|\| 1.9.79 \|\|

*tṛṣṭo 'smi sarvathāhante bhaktyā tava jaganmaya \|*  
*varaṃ vṛṇīṣvaṃ nahyāvāṃ vibhinnau paramārthataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. “I am always pleased with you and you happen to be my devotee. Therefore you receive the boon. In reality, there is none else in the world, except both of us.”

## \|\| 1.9.80 \|\|

*śrutvātha devavacanaṃ viṣṇurviśvajaganmayaḥ \|*  
*prāha prasannayā vācā samālokya caturmukham \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Then listening to the words of Mahadeva, lord Visnu, the soul of the universe, looking at his face delightfully spoke these words.

## \|\| 1.9.81 \|\|

*eṣa eva varaḥ śloghyo yadahaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*paśyāmi paramātmānaṃ bhaktirbhavatu me tvayi \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. “The only praise-worthy boon for me would be that I should always remain looking at you. I should always remain devoted to you.”

## \|\| 1.9.82 \|\|

*tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ punarviṣṇumabhāṣata \|*  
*bhavān sarvasya kāryasya kartāha'madhidaivatam \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Lord Shiva, “Be it so.” Then he again said to Visnu, “You are the performer of all the tasks, and I happen to be the established god.

## \|\| 1.9.83 \|\|

*manmayaṃ tvanmayaṃ caiva sarvametanna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*bhavān somastvahaṃ sūryo bhavān rātrirahaṃ dinam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Everything is enshrined in you and in me. There is no doubt it. In case you are the moon, then I am the sun. In case you are the night then I am the day.

## \|\| 1.9.84 \|\|

*bhavān prakṛtiravyaktamahaṃ puruṣa eva ca \|*  
*bhavān jñānamahaṃ jñātā bhavān māyāhamīśvaraḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. In case you are invisible, Prakrti then I am the Purusa. In case you are the knowledge then I am the one who knows the knowledge. In case you are Maya then I am Ishvara.

## \|\| 1.9.85 \|\|

*bhavān vidyātmikā śaktiḥ śaktimānahamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*yo 'haṃ suniṣkalo devaḥ so 'pi nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Incase, you are power bom of knowledge, then I happen to be the master of that power. Incase I am the invisible god then you are lord Narayana.

## \|\| 1.9.86 \|\|

*ekībhāvena paśyanti yogino brahmavādinaḥ \|*  
*tvāmanāśritya viśvātman na yogī māmupaiṣyati \|*  
*pālayaitajjagat kṛtsnaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. The yogis well-versed in the Brahman, visualise everything without any differentiation. О Soul of the universe, the Yogins cannot achieve me without taking refuge in you. Therefore you preserve the entire universe comprising of the gods, asuras and humans.”

## \|\| 1.9.87 \|\|

*itīdamuktvā bhagavānanādiḥ*  
*svamāyayā mohitabhūtabhedaḥ \|*  
*jagāma janmardhivināśahīnaṃ*  
*dhāmaikamavyaktamanantaśaktiḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Thus speaking, Eternal lord Shiva, possessing the enormous prowess and free from birth, death and old age, retired to his one and only abode.

## Chapter 10. Description of Rudra's Creation

## \|\| 1.10.1 \|\|

*śrīkūrma uvāca*  
*gate maheśvare deve svādhivāsaṃ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tadeva sumahat padmaṃ bheje nābhisamutthitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lord Kurma said, “After the departure of Lord Mahadeva, Brahma, the grand-sire, took refuge over the vast lotus flower, which had emerged out of the navel.

## \|\| 1.10.2 \|\|

*atha dīrgheṇa kālena tatrāpratimapauruṣau \|*  
*mahāsurau samāyātau bhrātarau madhukaiṭabhau \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. After a long time two demons possessing the enormous strength and known by the names of Madhu and Kaitabha arrived there.

## \|\| 1.10.3 \|\|

*krodhena mahatāviṣṭau mahāparvatavigrahau \|*  
*karṇāntarasamudbhūtau devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Both of them were filled with rage. They were bom out of the ears of Vishnu, each holding a Sartiga bow.

## \|\| 1.10.4 \|\|

*tāvāgatau samīkṣyāha nārāyaṇamajo vibhuḥ \|*  
*trailokyakaṇṭakāvetāvasurau hantumarhasi \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. At their arrival, Brahma, said to Narayana, “Both the demons are like the thorn for the three worlds. Therefore it would be quite proper to kill them.”

## \|\| 1.10.5 \|\|

*tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*ājñāpayāmāsa tayorvadhārthaṃ puruṣāvubhau \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Listening to the words of Brahma, lord Hari commanded two warriors to kill them.

## \|\| 1.10.6 \|\|

*tadājñayā mahadyuddhaṃ tayostābhyāmabhūd dvijāḥ \|*  
*vyanayat kaiṭabhaṃ viṣṇurjiṣṇuśca vyanayanmadhum \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Brahmanas, at the command of lord Vishnu, both the demons fought a great war with both the warriors. Visnu overpowered Kaitabha and Madhu.

## \|\| 1.10.7 \|\|

*tataḥ padmāsanāsīnaṃ jagannāthaṃ pitāmaham \|*  
*babhāṣe madhuraṃ vākyaṃ snehāviṣṭamanā hariḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then Hari, the lord of the universe, feeling delighted spoke sweet words to Brahma, seated over the lotus seat.

## \|\| 1.10.8 \|\|

*asmānmayocyamānastvaṃ padmādavatara prabho \|*  
*nāhaṃ bhavantaṃ śaknomi voḍhuṃ tejāmayaṃ gurum \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. “O Lord, you better get down from the lotus being carried by me. I am unable to carry you further, because you are quite heavy and illustrious.

## \|\| 1.10.9 \|\|

*tato 'vatīrya viśvātmā dehamāviśya cakriṇaḥ \|*  
*avāca vaiṣṇavīṃ nidrāmekībhūyātha viṣṇunā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Brahma got down and then entered in the body of Visnu and uniting with Visnu, he became one with him and was overpowered with the Vaisnavl sleep.

## \|\| 1.10.10 \|\|

*sahastraśīrṣanayanaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ \|*  
*brahmā nārāyaṇākhyo 'sau suṣvāpa salile tadā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then Narayana, the carrier of sankha, cakra, gada and the lotus went to sleep with Brahma.

## \|\| 1.10.11-12 \|\|

*so 'nubhūya ciraṃ kālamānandaṃ paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*anādyanantamadvaitaṃ svātmānaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhāte yogātmā bhūtvā devaścaturmukhaḥ \|*  
*sasarja sṛṣṭiṃ tadrūpāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Both of them slept there for a long time. Thereafter Yogatma, at dawn, turning as the four faced one, taking refuge under Vaisnavism, created being of the same type.

## \|\| 1.10.13-14 \|\|

*purastādasṛjad devaḥ sanandaṃ sanakaṃ tathā \|*  
*ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca purvajaṃ taṃ sanātanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*te dvandvamohanirmuktāḥ paraṃ vairāgyamāsthitāḥ \|*  
*viditvā paramaṃ bhāvaṃ na sṛṣṭau dadhire matim \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. The lord initially created Sanandana, and Sanaka, then Rbhu and Sanatkumara were created, who happen to be the ancient ancestors. All of them were free from heat and cold, disturbances and confusion and achieved the highest Vairagya (detachment). Realising the supreme knowledge by thus own efforts, and they established their wisdom accordingly .

## \|\| 1.10.15 \|\|

*teṣvevaṃ nirapekṣeṣu lokasṛṣṭau pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*babhūva naṣṭacetā vai māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Since finding them disinterested in creation, Brahma, under the influence of the Maya of Paramesthin, felt confused.

## \|\| 1.10.16-18 \|\|

*tataḥ purāṇapuruṣo jaganmūrtirjanārdanaḥ \|*  
*vyājahārātmanaḥ putraṃ mohanāśāya padmajam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*viṣṇuruvāca*  
*kaccinna vismṛto devaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*yaduktavānātmano 'sau putratve tava śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*prayuktavān mano yo'sau putratvena tu śaṅkaraḥ\|*  
*avāpya saṃjñāṃ govindāt padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Then lord Visnu, the form of the universe, the Purdna Purusa, in order to relieve his son of the confusion, spoke to Brahma. “Have you forgotten lord Shiva, the holder of the trident? You had prayed to Shiva, to come in the form of a son. Then lord Shiva had made up his mind to emerge as your son.” At these words of Lord Govinda, Brahma, the grand-sire, bom out of the lotus, felt enlightened.

## \|\| 1.10.19-20 \|\|

*prajāḥ straṣṭumanāstepe tapaḥ paramaduścaram \|*  
*tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya na kiñcit samavartata \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tato dīrgheṇa kālena duḥ khāt krodho 'bhyajāyata \|*  
*krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśrubindavaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. He then resolved, for the creation of the living beings, and performed severe tapas. While thus performing the tapas, he achieved nothing. At his failure, after a long time, he felt enraged with his eyes filled with anger, the tears started falling from his eyes.

## \|\| 1.10.21-22 \|\|

*tatastebhyo 'śrubindubhyo bhūtāḥ pretāstathābhavan \|*  
*sarvāṃstānaśrujān dṛṣṭvā brahmātmānamanindana \|\| 21 \|\|*

*jahau prāṇāṃśca bhagavān krodhāviṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*tadā prāṇamayo rudraḥ prādurasīt prabhīrmukhāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. From the drops of tears, several goblins and pretas were produced. Finding all the ugly creatures before him, Brahma was united with his soul ending his life at the same time. Thereafter Rudra was bom out of the enraged mouth of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.10.23 \|\|

*sahastrādityasaṃkāśo yugāntadahanopamaḥ \|*  
*ruroda susvaraṃ ghoraṃ devadevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Rudra was resplendent like a thousand suns and looked like the fire of the time of dissolution. Then Mahadeva started crying aloud.

## \|\| 1.10.24 \|\|

*rodamānaṃ tato brahmā mā rodīrityabhāṣata \|*  
*rodanād rudra ityevaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Then Brahma said to the crying Rudra, “Don't cry and in case you do so, you would be known in the world as Rudra.”

## \|\| 1.10.25 \|\|

*anyāni sapta nāmāni patnīḥ putrāṃścaśāśvatān \|*  
*sthānāni caiṣāmaṣṭānāṃ dadau lokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thereafter Pitamaha-Brahma, gave him seven more names, besides eight types of the everlasting wives besides the sons.

## \|\| 1.10.27 \|\|

*sūryo jalaṃ mahī vahnirvāyurākāśameva ca \|*  
*dīkṣito brāhmaṇaścandra ityetā aṣṭamūrtayaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The seven names are- Bhava, Sarva, Is'ana, Pasupati, Bhlma, Ugra and Mahadeva.

## \|\| 1.10.28 \|\|

*sthāneṣveteṣu ye rudraṃ dhyāyanti praṇamanti ca \|*  
*teṣāmaṣṭatanurdevo dadāti paramaṃ padam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Their eight images include- the sun, water, earth, the fire, Vayu, eather, the initiated Brahmana and the moon.

## \|\| 1.10.29 \|\|

*suvarcalā tathaivomā vikeśī ca tathā śivā \|*  
*svāhā diśaśca dīkṣā ca rohiṇī ceti patnayaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The people who meditate upon the Rudras in those pedicular places, the lord endowed with eight types of bodies make them achieve the salvation.

## \|\| 1.10.30 \|\|

*śanaiścarastathā śukro lohitāṅgo manojavaḥ \|*  
*skandaḥ sargo 'tha santāno budhaścaiṣāṃ sutāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The names of their eight wives are Suvarcala, Uma, Vikesi, Shiva, Svaha, Dig, Diksa and Rohini.

## \|\| 1.10.31 \|\|

*evaṃprakāro bhagavān devadevo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*prajādharmaṃ ca kāma ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāśritaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The names of their eight sons are: Sanaiscara, Sukra, Lohitanga, Manojava, Skanda, Sarga, Santana and Budha.

## \|\| 1.10.32 \|\|

*ātmanyādhya cātmānamaiśvaraṃ bhāvamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*pītvā tadakṣaraṃ brahma śāśvataṃ paramāmṛtam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The lord Mahesvara- the god of gods, who was the said nature, discarding the duty of procreation and desire, achieved Vairagya (renunciation).

## \|\| 1.10.33 \|\|

*prajāḥ sṛjeti cādiṣṭo brahmaṇā nīlalohitaḥ \|*  
*svātmanā sadṛśān rudrān sasarja manasā śivaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Не established his own soul in the soul and consuming the nectar like Brahman, achieved the position of Is'vara.

## \|\| 1.10.34 \|\|

*kapardino nirātaṅkān nīlakaṇṭhān pinākinaḥ \|*  
*triśūlahastānṛṣṭighnān mahānandāṃstrilocanān \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Again at the command of Brahma, Shiva of blue-complexion resorted to the creation of the subject. He created Rudras of his own mind, resembling himself.

## \|\| 1.10.35 \|\|

*jarāmaraṇanirmuktān mahāvṛṣabhavāhanān \|*  
*vītarāgāṃśca sarvajñān koṭikoṭiśatān prabhuḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. All of them had the locks of hair over the head, were carefree, blue throated, holding the Pinaka bow and trident in hands, blissful and had three eyes each.

## \|\| 1.10.36 \|\|

*tān dṛṣṭvā vividhān rudrāna nirmalān nīlalohitān \|*  
*jarāmaraṇanirmuktān vyājaharā haraṃ guruḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. All of them were beyond the birth and death, having the huge bulls as their vehicles, were unattached and omniscient. They were created by the lord in crores of numbers.

## \|\| 1.10.37 \|\|

*mā strākṣīrīdṛśīrdeva prajā mṛtyuvivarjitāḥ \|*  
*anyāḥ sṛjasva bhūteśa janmamṛtyusamanvitāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The spotless blue complexioned Rudras were free from birth and death, and were born from Shiva, observing whom, Brahma then spoke to Нага.

## \|\| 1.10.38 \|\|

*tatastamāha bhagavān kaparde kāmaśāsanaḥ \|*  
*nāsti me tādṛśaḥ sargaḥ sṛja tvamaśubhāḥ prajāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О Lord, do not create the people who are devoid of birth and death. You resort to some other creation who should face birth and death.

## \|\| 1.10.39 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhṛti devo 'sau na prasūte 'śubhāḥ prajāḥ \|*  
*svātmajaireva tai rudrairnivṛttātmā hyatiṣṭhata \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Then lord Shiva, clad in tiger skin, destroyer of Kama replied, “I do not have such type of creation, therefore, you resort to such a type of creation.

## \|\| 1.10.40-41 \|\|

*sthāṇutvaṃ tena tasyāsīd devadevasya śūlinaḥ \|*  
*jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*straṣṭṛtvamātmasaṃbodho hyadhiṣṭhātṛtvameva ca \|*  
*avyayāni daśaitāni nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti śaṅkare \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Since that time lord Shiva, does not indulge in creating auspicious beings. He accompanied with his mind bom sons, becoming detached, got himself established.

## \|\| 1.10.42-43 \|\|

*sa eva śaṅkaraḥ sākṣāt pinākī parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sa bhagavān brahmā vīkṣya devaṃ trilocanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraiḥ prītivisphārilocanaḥ \|*  
*jñātvā parataraṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. For the same reason lord Shiva, the holder of trident, came to be known as Sthanu. Then ten qualities of Jfiana, Vairagya, riches tapas, truthfulness, forgiveness, patience, self- realisation, and leadership always remain present with Shiva. Then lord Shiva, the holder of Pinaka-bow is Paramesvara-incarnate.

## \|\| 1.10.44-45 \|\|

*tuṣṭāva jagatāmekaṃ kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim \|*  
*brahmovāca namaste 'stu mahādeva namaste parameśvara \|\| 44 \|\|*

*namaḥ śivāya devāya namaste brahmarūpiṇe \|*  
*namo 'stu te maheśāya namaḥ śāntāya hetave \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Thereafter at the sight of the three eyed lord Mahadeva, with his sons, the eyes of Brahma, blossomed like the lotus flowers. Then realising the grandeur of lord Shiva. Brahma placing both his hands over the head in anjali pose, started praising Shiva, the lord of the universe.

## \|\| 1.10.46 \|\|

*pradhānapuruṣeśāya yogādhipataye namaḥ \|*  
*namaḥ kālāya rudrāya mahāgrāsāya śūline \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Brahma said, “O Mahadeva, salutation to the you. Salutation to you О Parames'vara, Salutation to god Shiva, who is the form of Brahman. Salutation to the form of Brahman. Salutation to Mahesa, who is peaceful.

## \|\| 1.10.47-48 \|\|

*namaḥ pinākahastāya trinetrāya namo namaḥ \|*  
*namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ brahmaṇo janakāya te \|\| 47 \|\|*

*brahmavidyādhipataye brahmavidyāpradāyine \|*  
*namo vedarahasyāya kālakālāya te namaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Salutation to the Supreme Purusa and the lord of the yoga. Salutation to Kala, Rudra, Mahagrasa and the carrier of Sula.

## \|\| 1.10.49-50 \|\|

*vedāntasārasārāya namo vedātmamūrtaye \|*  
*namo buddhāya śuddhāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*prahīṇaśokairvividhairbhūtaiḥ varivṛtāya te \|*  
*namo brahmaṇyadevāya brahmādhipataye namaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Salutation to the holder of the Pinaka bow. Salutation again and again to three eyed lord. Salutation to Trimurti and the producer of Brahma. He is the lord of Brahmavidya, besides being the bestower of Brahmavidya. You are the secrets of the Vedas and the lord of Kala, Salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.10.51-52 \|\|

*triyambakāya devāya namaste parameṣṭhine \|*  
*namo digvāsase tubhyaṃ namo muṇḍāyā daṇḍine \|\| 51 \|\|*

*anādimalahīnāya jñānagamyāya te namaḥ \|*  
*namastārāya tīrthāya namo yogardhihetave \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. You are the essence of Vedanta, the form of Vedatma. Salutation to you. Salutation to the enlightened Rudra. Salutation to the preceptor of the yogis. You are surrounded by the living beings who have been deprived of grief. You are Brahmanyadeva salutation to you. Salutation to Brahmadhipati.

## \|\| 1.10.53-54 \|\|

*namo dharmādhigamyāya yogagamyāya te namaḥ \|*  
*namaste niṣprapañcāya nirābhāsāya te namaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*brahmaṇe viśvarūpāya namaste paramātmane \|*  
*tvayaiva sṛṣṭamakhilaṃ tvayyeva sakalaṃ sthitam \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Salutation to Trayambaka, Adideva, Paramesthl. Salutation to the one having the body without robes, holder of the skulls and the danda.

## \|\| 1.10.55 \|\|

*tvayā saṃhriyate viśvaṃ pradhānādyaṃ jaganmaya \|*  
*tvamīśvaro mahādevaḥ paraṃ brahma maheśvaraḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Salutation to the one who could be achieved with the application of dharma. Salutation to you since you can be achieved by yogic practices, Salutation to you since you are free from delusion and are the invisible one. Salutation to Brahman- the form of the universe. Salutation to you possessing the form of the great soul. The universe has been created by you and everything is enshrined in you.

## \|\| 1.10.56 \|\|

*parameṣṭhī śivaḥ śāntaḥ puruṣo niṣkalo haraḥ \|*  
*tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ jyotistvaṃ kālaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. You destroy everything from Pradhana Prakrti to entire world. You are Ishvara, Mahadeva, Supreme Brahman, and Mahes'vara. You are Paramesthl, Shiva, Peaceful, Purusa, Omnipotent, Нага, indestmctible, the supreme flame and Paramesvara in the form of Kala.

## \|\| 1.10.57-58 \|\|

*tvameva puruṣo 'nantaḥ pradhānaṃ prakṛtistathā \|*  
*bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyurvyomāhaṅkāra eva ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yasya rūpaṃ namasyāmi bhavantaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam \|*  
*yasya dyaurabhavanmūrdhā pādau pṛthvī diśo bhujāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. You are beyond destinction, Pradhana and Prakrti. The earth, water, fire, wind, sky and Ahamkara are your forms. Therefore salutation to you since you are equated with Brahman. The one whose head is the sky and the earth represents his two feet, the directions are his arms, they sky is his belly, I offer my salutation to the same Virat-Purusa.

## \|\| 1.10.59-60 \|\|

*ākāśamudaraṃ tasmai virāje praṇamāmyaham \|*  
*saṃtāpayati yo viśvaṃ svabhābhirbhāsayan diśaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*brahmatejomayaṃ nityaṃ tasmai sūryātmane namaḥ \|*  
*havyaṃ vahati yo nityaṃ raudrī tejomayo tanuḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. The one who illumines the directions with his resplendence, the one who makes the world to suffer with his Brahmateja, I offer my salutation to such a soul of Stirya. The one who possesses the illustrious and terrific body, the one who carries the havya and kavya for the Pitrs, I offer my salutation to the same Purusa resembling the fire.

## \|\| 1.10.61-64 \|\|

*kavyaṃ pitṛgaṇānāṃ ca tasmai vahnyātmane namaḥ \|*  
*āpyāyati yo nityaṃ svadhāmnā sakalaṃ jagat \|\| 61 \|\|*

*pīyate devatāsaṅghaistasmai somātmane namaḥ \|*  
*vibhartyaśeṣabhūtāni yo 'ntaścarati sarvadā \|\| 62 \|\|*

*śaktirmāheścarī tubhyaṃ tasmai vāyvātmane namaḥ \|*  
*sṛjatyaśeṣamevedaṃ yaḥ svakarmānurūpataḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*ātmanyavasthitastasmai caturvaktrātmane namaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ śete śeṣaśayane viśvamāvṛtya māyayā \|\| 64 \|\|*

61-64. The one who makes the world shine with his lustre, whose rays are consumed by the groups of gods, I offer my salutation to the same moon. The Shakti1 of whom roaming inside, retains the rest of the bhutas, I offer my salutation to Purusa, having the form of the wind. The one who creates the universe according to the karmas of each one of them, I offer my salutation to the four faced lord who is established in the soul. The one who with his self experience, making use of the yoga, overshadowing the world with his Maya, and sleeps over the serpent bed, I offer my salutation to Visnu.

## \|\| 1.10.65-68 \|\|

*svātmanyavasthitastasmai caturvaktrātmane namaḥ \|*  
*vibharti śirasā nityaṃ dvisapbhuvanātmakam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*brahmāṇḍaṃ yo 'khilādhārastasmai śeṣātmane namaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ parānte parānandaṃ pītvā divyaikasākṣikam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*nṛtyatyanantamahimā tasmai rudrātmane namaḥ \|*  
*yo 'ntarā sarvabhūtānāṃ niyantā tiṣṭhatīśvaraḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*yasya keśeṣu jīmūtā nadyaḥ sarvādgasaciṣu \|*  
*kukṣau samudācatvārastasmai toyātmane namaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

65-68. The one who carries over his head the globe comprising of the fourteen bhuvanas, and the one who is the base of the entire world, salutation to him in the form of Sesa. The one who after the great dissolution feels blissful, performs the divine dance in ecstasy, the one who is the lone witness, and becomes glorious, I offer my salutation to lord Rudra. The one who is lodged in the heart of the living beings, as an Ishvara from whose locks of hair, flow the rivers and in whose belly all the four oceans aie lodged, I offer my salutation to the lord of waters.

## \|\| 1.10.69-72 \|\|

*taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ devaṃ namasye bhavatastanum \|*  
*yaṃ vinindrā jitaśvāsāḥ saṃtuṣṭāḥ samadarśinaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ \|*  
*yayā saṃtarate māyāṃ yogī saṃkṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*apārataraparyantāṃ tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ \|*  
*yasya bhāsā vibhātīdamadvayaṃ tamasaḥ param \|\| 71 \|\|*

*prapadye tat paraṃ tattvaṃ tadrūpaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*nityānandaṃ nirādhāraṃ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ śivam \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. The one who is witness of all and pervades in the world, salutation to you. The one who is without sleep, the one who has controlled his breath, content, impartial, engaged in yogic practices, salutation to you. By the grace of whom, the yogic, becoming sinless, cross the vast ocean of Мауй, I offer my salutation to Parames'vara who is the form of vidya. With whose lustre, the sun shines, who is beyond darkness, I take refuge with lord Parames'vara, who is the form of Advaita. The one who is always blissful, without any support, spotless, extremely beneficial, I take refuge with the great Shiva, the unsullied, the perfect eternal bliss.”

## \|\| 1.10.73-77 \|\|

*prapadye paramātmānaṃ bhavantaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ brahmā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*prāñjaliḥ praṇatastasthau gṛṇan brahma sanātanam \|*  
*tatastasmai mahādevo divyaṃ yogamanuttamam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*aiśvaryaṃ brahmasadbhāvaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca dadau haraḥ \|*  
*karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca saṃspṛśya praṇatārtihā \|\| 75 \|\|*

*vyājaharā svayaṃ devaḥ so 'nugṛhya pitāmaham \|*  
*yattvayābhyarthitaṃ brahman putratve bhavato mama \|\| 76 \|\|*

*kṛtaṃ mayā tat sakalaṃ sṛjasva vividhaṃ jagat \|*  
*tridhā bhinno 'smyahaṃ brahman brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā \|\| 77 \|\|*

73-77. Thus eulogising Mahadeva, getting influenced with his grace, Brahma, offering prayer to ancient Brahman, stood there with folded hands. Thereafter, Mahadeva, oestowed on Brahma, the divine and the best Yoga and the divine state of being in communion with Brahman as well as the Vairagya. Shiva, who removes the pain of the devotees, touched Brahma with his soft hands and spoke to him with a smile and said, “O Brahma, you had desired me to be your son. I have granted the same. Therefore you better busy yourself in making various types of creations. О Brahma, I alone function myself as Brahma, Visnu and Shiva,- by these three names.

## \|\| 1.10.78 \|\|

*sargarakṣālayaguṇairniṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*sa tvaṃ mamāgrajaḥ putraḥ sṛṣṭihetorvinirmitaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Because of the qualities of creation, maintenance and destruction, I am Paramesvara, undivided. You are my son created simply for the creation of the universe.

## \|\| 1.10.79-80 \|\|

*mamaiva dakṣiṇādaṅgād vāmāṅgāt puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*tasya devādidevasya śaṃbhorhṛdayadeśataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*saṃbabhūvātha rudro 'sāvahaṃ tasyāparā tanuḥ \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivā brahman sargasthityantahetavaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. You have been bom of my right side while Visnu has been bom of my left side. From heart of Sambhu, Indra has emerged. Or otherwise, I happen to be his earlier body. О Brahman, Brahma, Visnu and Shiva are responsible for creation, preservation and destruction respectively.

## \|\| 1.10.81 \|\|

*vibhajyātmānameko 'pi svecchayā śaṅkaraḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*tathānyāni ca rūpāṇi mama māyākṛtāni tu \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Inspite of his being one, Sankara, as per his own will, lives dividing himself into three parts. Their other forms have been created by me due to my Maya.

## \|\| 1.10.82-83 \|\|

*nirūpaḥ kevalaḥ svaccho mahādevaḥ svabhāvataḥ \|*  
*ebhyaḥ parataro devastrimūrtiḥ paramā tanuḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*māheśvarī trinayanā yogināṃ śāntidā sadā \|*  
*tasyā eva parāṃ mūrti māmavehi pitāmaha \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. The said Mahadeva, is by nature formless, unparallel, and lodged in self. Beyond them is the form of Trimurti. His form of three eyed Mahes'vari, bestows peace on all the yogis. О Grand-sire, you take me to be the best form of Mahesvara.

## \|\| 1.10.84 \|\|

*śāśvataiśvaryavijñānatejoyogasamanvitām \|*  
*so 'haṃ grasāmi sakalamadhiṣṭhāya tamoguṇam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The form, which possessing all the fortunes, Vijnana, and tejas combined into one, takes the form Kala and then under the influence of temoguna, devours the entire universe. No one can read my mind even in dream.

## \|\| 1.10.85-90 \|\|

*kālo bhūtvā na tamasā māmanyo 'bhibhaviṣyati \|*  
*yadā yadā hi māṃ nityaṃ vicintayasi padmaja \|\| 85 \|\|*

*tadā tadā me sānnidhyaṃ bhaviṣyati tavānagha \|*  
*etāvaduktvā brahmāṇaṃ so 'bhivandya guruṃ haraḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraiḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata \|*  
*so 'pi yogaṃ samāsthāya sasarja vividhaṃ jagat \|\| 87 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇākhyo bhagavān yathāpūrvaṃ prijāpatiḥ \|*  
*marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum \|\| 88 \|\|*

*dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjad yogavidyayā \|*  
*nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*sarve te brahmaṇā tulyāḥ sādhakā brahmavādinaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*saṃkalpaṃ caiva dharmaṃ ca yugadharmāṃśca śāśvatān \|*  
*sthānābhimāninaḥ sarvān yathā te kathitaṃ purā \|\| 90 \|\|*

85-90. О Brahma, bom of lotus, when you adore me always, then О Sinless one, you shall achieve my closeness.” Thus speaking, Shiva, felicitating the preceptor Brahma, accompanied with his mind bom sons, disappeared in a moment. The lord Prajapati, also known as Narayana, depending on yoga, engaged himself in creating the universe as before. With the use of yoga- vidya, he created Marici, Bhrgu, Angira, Pulastya, Pulaka, Kratu, Dakra, Atri and Vasistha. These are the nine Brahmas (or nine sons of Brahma) who have been described. All of them inspite of being the Sadhakas, are comparable with Brahma, as exponents of the Vedas. Thus I have spoken to you the resolution (,Sankalpa), Dharma, various duties special to different Yugas and the deities identifying themselves with the abodes (sthanas).

## Chapter 11. Incarnation of the Goddes

## \|\| 1.11.1 \|\|

*śrīkūrma uvāca*  
*evaṃ sṛṣṭvā parīcyādīn devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraistatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lord Kurma said, “Thus creating Marichi and other Prajapatis, the grand-Sire-lord of gods, started performing tapas with his mind-bom sons.

## \|\| 1.11.2-3 \|\|

*tasyaivaṃ tapato vaktrād rudraḥ kālāgnisannibhaḥ \|*  
*triśūlapāṇirīśānaḥ pradurāsīt trilocanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ardhanārīnaravapuḥ duṣprekṣyo 'tibhayaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*vibhajātmānamityuktvā brahmā cāntardadhe bhayāt \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Thus performing the tapas, Rudra emerged from the mouth of Brahma, with the fire of the time of dissolution emerging out of him. He was holding a trident in his hand and had three eyes over the face. His body was half male and other half of a female. It was difficult to have a look at him. He was terrific in out look. Then Brahma, getting terrified, said, “Divide your soul” and thereafter he disappeared.

## \|\| 1.11.4 \|\|

*tathokto 'sau dvidhā strītvaṃ puruṣatvamathākarot \|*  
*bibheda puruṣatvaṃ ca daśadhā caikadhā punaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. At these words he divided himself in two parts of a male and a female. Thereafter he divided Purusa into eleven parts.

## \|\| 1.11.5 \|\|

*ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ \|*  
*kapālośādayo viprā devakārye niyojitāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Brahmanas, those eleven Rudras, were known as Ishvaras in the three worlds. They are the well-known as Kapall and others, and are engaged in the task of the gods.

## \|\| 1.11.6 \|\|

*saumyāsaumyaistathā śāntāśāntaiḥ strītvaṃ ca sa prabhuḥ \|*  
*bibheda bahudhā devaḥ svarūpairasitaiḥ sitaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Thereafter Rudradeva also divided the female part into, peaceful and unpeaceful (disturbed) white and non white, besides beautiful and ugly.

## \|\| 1.11.7 \|\|

*tā vai vibhūtayo viprā viśrutāḥ śaktayo bhuvi \|*  
*lakṣmyādayo yābhirīśā viśvaṃvyāpnoti śāṅkarī \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Brahmanas, all those vibhutis become well known Shaktis on earth like Laksmi and others. They pervade the worlds being the forms of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.11.8 \|\|

*vibhajya purarīśānī svātmānaṃ śaṅkarād vibhoḥ \|*  
*mahādevaniyogena pitāmahamupasthitā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О Brahmanas, then Is'ani-the Shakti of Shiva, at the command of Shiva, divided herself into two parts and then she went to the grand-sire.

## \|\| 1.11.9 \|\|

*tāmāha bhagavān brahmā dakṣasya duhitā bhava \|*  
*sāpi tasya niyogena prādurāsīt prajāpateḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Brahma then said to Isani-Shakti, “You become the daughter of Daksa-Prajapati.” Thus at the command of Prajapati, she appeared as the daughter of Daksa-Prajapati.

## \|\| 1.11.10 \|\|

*niyogād brahmaṇo devīṃ dadau rudrāya tāṃ satīm \|*  
*dakṣād rudro 'pi jagrāha svakīyāmeva śūlabhṛt \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then at the command of Brahma, Sati, who was the foremost of the daughters of Daksa was presented to lord Rudra. Rudra-the carrier of trident also accepted her as his wife.

## \|\| 1.11.11-12 \|\|

*prajāpatiṃ vinindyaiṣā kālena parameśvarī \|*  
*vibhajya punarīśānī ātmānaṃ srakarādvibhoḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*menāyāmabhavat putrī tadā himavataḥ satī \|*  
*sa cāpi parvatavaro dadau rudrāya pārvatīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. After sometime, the same Paramesvari Sati, at the command of Brahma, dividing her body in the yajna of Daksa, ended her life and was reborn as the daughter of Menaka. Then Himalaya, the best of the mountain, gave his daughter for the welfare of the gods as well as the three lokas to lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.11.13-16 \|\|

*hitāya sarvadevānāṃ trilokasyātmano 'pi ca \|*  
*saiṣā māheśvarī devī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śivā satī haimavatī surāsuranamaskṛtā \|*  
*tasyāḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vindanti munayo vetti śaṅkaro vā svayaṃ hariḥ \|*  
*etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ putratvaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*brahmaṇaḥ padmayonitvaṃ śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. The same goddess who held half of the body of Shiva, was known by the names of Mahes'vari, Shiva, Sati and Hemavatl and was adored by the gods and the asuras alike. The enormous influence of the goddess was well known to Indra and all the gods, the sages, lord Shiva himself and lord Hari as well. О Brahmanas, the way in which lord Rudra became the son of Brahma, and the event cf the birth of Brahma out of lotus, besides the enormous influence of lord Shiva, has been described by me.

## Chapter 12. Glory of the Goddes

## \|\| 1.12.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*ityākarṇyātha munayaḥ kūrmarūpeṇa bhāṣitam \|*  
*viṣṇunā punarevainaṃ praṇatā harim \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said, “Lord Visnu, who took to the form of Kurma when so narrated the story, the sages again offered their salutation to lord Visnu and asked.

## \|\| 1.12.2 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*kaiṣā bhagavatī devī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī \|*  
*śivā satī haimavatī yathāvad brūhi pṛcchatām \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The sages said, “Who is the goddess known as the batter half of the lord Shiva? Her names have been described as Shiva, Sati and Haimavatl. You speak out the truth about her at our request.”

## \|\| 1.12.3 \|\|

*teṣāṃ tad vacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca mahāyogī dhyātvā svaṃ paramaṃ padam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Listening to the words of those sages, Purusottama- the great Yogin, replied concentrating his mind over own highest region.

## \|\| 1.12.4 \|\|

*śrīkūrma uvāca*  
*purā pitāmahenoktaṃ merupṛṣṭhe suśobhanam \|*  
*rahasyametad vijñānaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Kurma said, “In earlier times, the grand-sire Brahma, lodged over the back of the Meru mountain, had narrated this mystrious secret knowledge which is to be protected perfectly.

## \|\| 1.12.5 \|\|

*sāṃkhyānāṃ paramaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ brahmavijñānamuttamam \|*  
*saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ jantūnāmekamocanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. This is the best of the Sankhya philosophy to the followers of Saihkhya-aoctrine. It is an excellent knowledge of Brahman. It rescues the people who are drowned in the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 1.12.6 \|\|

*yā sā māheśvarī śaktirjñānarūpātilālasā \|*  
*vyomasaṃjñā parā kāṣṭhā seyaṃ haimavatī matā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The Shakti of lord Mahesvara is the form of immense desire and the knowledge. She is Haimavatl, which is considered as highest point of perfection termed as Vyoman.

## \|\| 1.12.7 \|\|

*śivā sarvagatānāntā guṇātītā suniṣkalā \|*  
*ekānekavibhāgasthā jñānarūpātilālasā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. She is the one who bestows welfare, pervading all, beyond the gunas, and is undivided. She being one, appears in many forms, she is frill of enormous desires.

## \|\| 1.12.8 \|\|

*ananyā niṣkale tattve saṃsthitā tasya tejasā \|*  
*svābhāvikī ca tanmūlā prabhā bhānorivāmalā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Because of the splendour of Ishvara, she is enshrined in the undivided Reality, is endless and is spotless like the rays of the sun.

## \|\| 1.12.10 \|\|

*seyaṃ karoti sakalaṃ tasyāḥ kāryamidaṃ jagat \|*  
*na kāryaṃ nāpi karaṇamīśvarasyeti sūrayaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The Potency of lord Mahesvara is one (by herself), but due to conditioning factors, she assumes various greater and lesser forms and sports about in his presence.

## \|\| 1.12.11 \|\|

*catastraḥ śaktayo devyāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*adhiṣṭhānavaśāt tasyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The same Shakti is the performer of everything. The world happens to be the field of her activity. The people with wisdom know that Is'vara is neither a performer nor the cause.

## \|\| 1.12.12 \|\|

*śāntirvidyā pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiścetitāḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*caturvyūhastato devaḥ procyate parameśvaraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Best of the sages, the goddess has four Shaktis, who have been established in their own forms. You listen about them.

## \|\| 1.12.13 \|\|

*anayā parayā devaḥ svātmānandaṃ samaśnute \|*  
*caturṣvapi ca vedeṣu caturmūrtirmaheśvaraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. They are known by the names of Santi (peace), Vidya (knowledge), Pratistha (stability) and Nivrtti (renunciation). Because of this lord Mahadeva is known as Caturvyuha1 Paramesvra.

## \|\| 1.12.14 \|\|

*asyāstvanādisaṃsiddhamaiśvaryamatulaṃ mahat \|*  
*tatsambandhādanantāyā rudreṇa paramātmanā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Because of the same Supreme Shakti, the lord feels blissfulnees (communion with his Atman). The same Mahesvara is also lodged in the Vedas in the form of CatnrmQrti (four forms).

## \|\| 1.12.15 \|\|

*saiṣā sarveśvarī devī sarvabhūtapravartikā \|*  
*procyate bhagavān kālo hariḥ prāṇo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Her enormous fortunes have established from the ancient times. Because of her relation with lord Rudra, she is known as beyond measure.

## \|\| 1.12.16 \|\|

*tatra sarvamidaṃ protamotaṃ caivākhilaṃ jagat \|*  
*sa kālo 'gnirharo rudro gīyate vedavādibhiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. This Goddess is the sovereign ruler of all and makes all beings function. Lord Hari is called as Kala, Prana (vital airs) and Supreme Lord.

## \|\| 1.12.17 \|\|

*kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ \|*  
*sarve kālasya vaśagā na kālaḥ kasyacid vaśe \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The entire universe is absorbed in her. The people well-versed in the Vedas, offer prayer to lord Mahadeva being extolled as Kalagni (the destructive fire of the universe).

## \|\| 1.12.18 \|\|

*pradhānaṃ puruṣastattvaṃ mahānātmā tvahaṅkṛtiḥ \|*  
*kālenānyāni tattvāni samāviṣṭāni yoginā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Vail Actually it is Kala (Time), who creates all the living beings and it is Kala who destroys the subjects. All the mobiles and immobiles are under the control of Kala, but Kala is beyond the control of anyone.

## \|\| 1.12.19 \|\|

*tasya sarvajagatsūtiḥ śaktirmāyeti viśrutā \|*  
*tayedaṃ bhrāmayedīśo māyāvī puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. (ill Pradhana, Purusa, Mahat, Atman and Ahamkara, besides the other tattvas1 are pervaded by Kala, the Yogin.) The same goddess, which is the form of universe, is well known as Shakti or Maya. Isa, the wielder of Maya, the excellent Purusa deludes (whirls) this world by means of that Maya.

## \|\| 1.12.20 \|\|

*saiṣā māyātmikā śaktiḥ sarvākārā sanātanī \|*  
*vaiśvarūpyaṃ maheśasya sarvadā saṃprakāśayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The same ancient Shakti, the form of Maya and the performer of all the activities, illumines the universal form of lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.12.21 \|\|

*anyāśca śaktayo mukhyāstasya devasya nirmitāḥ \|*  
*jñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiḥ prāṇaśaktiriti trayam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Other prominent Shaktis were also created by him which are of three types, viz., Jhdna-Shakti (the power of knowledge), Kriya-Shakti (the power of activity) and Prana-Shakti (the power of vital airs).

## \|\| 1.12.22 \|\|

*sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ śaktimanto vinirmitāḥ \|*  
*māyayaivātha viprendrāḥ sā cānādiranantayā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Best of the Brahmanas, the lord of these Shaktis has also been created by means of Maya, who is eternal and indestructible.

## \|\| 1.12.23 \|\|

*sarvaśaktyātmikā māyā durnivārā duratyayā \|*  
*māyāvī sarvaśaktīśaḥ kālaḥ kālakāraḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The Maya is the form of the entire Shaktis, it cannot be averted and is unsurmountable one. Kala, the wielder of Maya, is the Lord of all these potencies, the lord of destruction and creation.

## \|\| 1.12.24 \|\|

*karoti kālaḥ sakalaṃ saṃharet kāla eva hi \|*  
*kālaḥ sthāpayate viśvaṃ kālādhīnamidaṃ jagat \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Kala on the other hand, creates all, destroys them as well. It is Kala which establishes the entire world. The universe is subservient to Kala.

## \|\| 1.12.25-26 \|\|

*labdhvā devādhidevasya sannidhiṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*anantasyākhileśasya śaṃbhoḥ kālātmanaḥ prabhoḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pradhānaṃ puruṣo māyā māyā caivaṃ prapadyate \|*  
*ekā sarvagatānantā kevalā niṣkalā śivā \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Paramesthin, the lord of the gods who is beyond measure, lord of the entire world, soul of Kala, achieving the closeness of lord Shiva, achieves the same Maya, who happens to be all pervading, beyond measure, unchangeable and Shiva.

## \|\| 1.12.27 \|\|

*ekā śaktiḥ śivaiko 'pi śaktimānucyate śivaḥ \|*  
*śaktayaḥ śaktimanto 'nye sarvaśaktisamudbhavāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The same Shakti is one and Shiva also is one. Shiva is known as Shaktiman (possessor of potency). All other minor Shaktis as well as the Shaktiman are connected with the same Shiva- Shakti.

## \|\| 1.12.28 \|\|

*śaktiśaktimatorbhedaṃ vadanti paramārthataḥ \|*  
*abhedaṃ cānupaśyanti yoginastattvacintakāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. As per the realistic point of view, there is a difference between Shakti and those endowed with them, but the yogis, meditating on Reality, find no difference between them.

## \|\| 1.12.29 \|\|

*śaktayo girajā devī śaktimanto 'tha śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*viśeṣaḥ kathyate cāyaṃ purāṇe brahmavādibhiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. All these Shaktis represent the goddess Parvati, while Shiva is Shaktiman (Lord of powers). In the Puranas, this special difference is mentioned by the expounders of Brahman or Veda.

## \|\| 1.12.30 \|\|

*bhogyā viśveśvarī devī maheśvarapativratā \|*  
*procyate bhagavān bhoktā kaparde nīlalohitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The chaste spouse of Mahesvara, the goddess of the universe, is the object which is to be enjoyed. While Shiva the Lord with matted locks of hair and red complexion is regarded as the enjoyer.

## \|\| 1.12.31 \|\|

*mantā viśveśvaro devaḥ śaṅkaro manmathāntakaḥ \|*  
*procyate matirīśānī mantavyā ca vicārataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Shiva, the Lord of the universe, also known as the killer of Kama (god of love), is the thinker (the subject), while goddess Is'anI (Parvati) is proclaimed by the knowers, to be the intellect (the object).

## \|\| 1.12.32 \|\|

*ityetadakhilaṃ viprāḥ śaktiśaktimadudbhavam \|*  
*procyate sarvavedeṣu munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О Brahmanas, the entire universe is produced by Shakti and Shaktiman and it has been so prescribed in the Vedas by the sages well-versed in the tattvas.

## \|\| 1.12.33 \|\|

*etat pradarśitaṃ divyaṃ devyā māhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*sarvavedāntavedeṣu niścitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Thus the best and the divine glory of the goddess has been narrated by me, which has been well prescribed by the knowers of Brahman on the basis of the scriptures on Vedanta Sastras.

## \|\| 1.12.34 \|\|

*ekaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam \|*  
*yoginastat prapaśyanti mahādevyāḥ paraṃ padam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In this way, the all pervading, subtle, dweller of the mountain, immobile, and eternal great goddess, and her place is visualised by Yogins.

## \|\| 1.12.35 \|\|

*ānandamakṣaraṃ brahma kevalaṃ niṣkalaṃ param \|*  
*yoginastat prapaśyanti mahādevyāḥ paraṃ padam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The one who is the form of bliss, form of indestructible Brahman, pure and perfect, the same place of the goddess is visualised by the great Yogins.

## \|\| 1.12.36 \|\|

*parātparataraṃ tattvaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam \|*  
*anantaprakṛtau līnaṃ devyāstat paramaṃ padam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. That great region of the goddess is greater than the greatest. It is the eternal Reality unswerving auspicious, merged within the infinite Prakrti.

## \|\| 1.12.37 \|\|

*śubhaṃ nirañjanaṃ śuddhaṃ nirguṇaṃ dvaitavarjitam \|*  
*ātmopalabdhiviṣayaṃ devyāstat paramaṃ padam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The Supreme abode of the goddess, is auspicious, spotless, pure, absolute, without any differentiation, and is the subject of self- realisation.

## \|\| 1.12.38 \|\|

*saiṣā dhātrī vidhātrī ca paramānandamicchatām \|*  
*saṃsāratāpānakhilān nihantīśvarasaṃśrayā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. She happens to be the creator, as well as the dispenser of destiny. She in combination with Ishvara, removes all the sufferings of the universe.

## \|\| 1.12.39 \|\|

*tasmād vimuktimanvicchan pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm \|*  
*āśrayet sarvabhāvānāmātmabhūtāṃ śivātmikām \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Therefore getting desirous of salvation, one should take refuge in her, the supreme Goddess, the Atman of all beings and of the nature of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.12.40 \|\|

*labdhvā ca putrīṃ śarvāṇīṃ tapastaptvā suduścaram \|*  
*sabhāryaḥ śaraṃ yātaḥ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Achieving SarvanI as his daughter after performing severe penance, Himavan, should sought refuge in the great goddess Parvati, with his wife.

## \|\| 1.12.41 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jāyamānāṃ ca svecchayaiva varānanām \|*  
*menā himavataḥ patnī prāhedaṃ parvateśvaram \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On seeing the noble-faced Parvati, who was bom out of her own free will, Mena, the wife of Himavan, said to the king of mountains.

## \|\| 1.12.42 \|\|

*menovāca*  
*paśya bālāmimāṃ rājan rājīvasadṛśānanām \|*  
*hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ jātā ca tapasāvayoḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Mena said, О King, look at this girl, who has the face like a lotus. She has been bom as a result of the performing of penance by both of us for the welfare of the living beings.

## \|\| 1.12.43-45 \|\|

*so 'pi dṛṣṭvā tataḥ putrīṃ taruṇādityasannibhām \|*  
*kapardinīṃ caturvaktrāṃ trinetrāmatilālasām \|\| 43 \|\|*

*aṣṭahastāṃ viśālākṣīṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇām \|*  
*nirguṇāṃ saguṇāṃ sākṣāt sadasadvyaktivarjitām \|\| 44 \|\|*

*praṇamya śirasā bhūmau tejasā cātivihvalaḥ \|*  
*bhītaḥ kṛtāñjalistasyāḥ provāca parameśvarīm \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Listening to the words of Mena, Himalaya too glanced at the goddess. She had the lustre of the rising sun, had matted locks of hair over the head, having four faces and three eyes, with mind filled with affection. She had eight arms, wide eyes, ornamented with the crescent of the moon, absolute, devoid of the manifestation of both Sat and Asat, endowed with and devoid of gunas. He bowed down to her and spoke to that supreme goddess with his palm joined in reverence.

## \|\| 1.12.46 \|\|

*hīmavānuvāca*  
*kā tvaṃ devi viśālākṣi śaśāṅkāvayavāṅkite \|*  
*na jāne tvāmahaṃ vatse yathāvad brūhi pṛcchate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Himalaya said, “O Goddess with wide eyes, who are you? Who are you, ornamented with the moon crescents. О daughter, I do not know you well and because of that, I ask you.”

## \|\| 1.12.47 \|\|

*girīndravacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ sā parameśvarī \|*  
*vyājahāra mahāśailaṃ yogināmabhayapradā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Then listening to the words of the lord of mountains, Paramesvarl, the bestower of fearlessness unto the Yogins, said to Himalaya.

## \|\| 1.12.48-49 \|\|

*devyuvāca*  
*māṃ viddha paramāṃ śaktiṃ parameśvarasamāśrayām \|\| 48 \|\|*

*ananyāmavyayāmekāṃ yāṃ paśyanti mumukṣavaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ vai sarvabhāvānātmā sarvāntarā śivā \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. The goddess said, You should recognize me as the Supreme Shakti of lord Mahesvara and I am non-different from him, unchanging and absolute, who is adored by the people desirous of moksa. I happen to be the soul of all conceived beings, besides being the bestower of welfare.

## \|\| 1.12.50 \|\|

*śāśvataiśvaryavijñānamūrtiḥ sarvapravartikā \|*  
*anantānantamahimā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. I am the form of eternal fortunes and perfect knowledge, and am the source behind the movement of all. I am beyond measure and make the people to cross through the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 1.12.51 \|\|

*divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram \|*  
*etāvaduktvā vijñānaṃ dattvā himavate svayam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. I bestow on you the divine eyes with which you can visualise my divine form. Thus speaking, she bestowed on Himalaya, the special type of knowledge, exhibiting at the same time, her divine form.

## \|\| 1.12.52-59 \|\|

*svaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ tat pārameśvaram \|*  
*koṭisūryapritīkāśaṃ tejobimbaṃ nirākulam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*jvālāmālāsahastrāḍhyaṃ kālānalaśatopamam \|*  
*daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣa jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kirīṭinaṃ gadāhastaṃ śkucakradharaṃ tathā \|*  
*triśūlavarahastaṃ ca ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*praśāntaṃ saumyavadanamanantāścaryasaṃyutam \|*  
*candrāvayavalakṣmāṇaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabham \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kirīṭinaṃ gadāhastaṃ nūpurairupaśobhitam \|*  
*divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*śaṅkhacakradharaṃ kāmyaṃ trinetraṃ kṛttivāsasam \|*  
*aṇḍasthaṃ cāṇḍabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ param \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sarvaśaktimayaṃ śubhraṃ sarvākāraṃ sanātanam \|*  
*brahmondropendrayogīndrairvandyamānapadāmbujam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham \|*  
*sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhantaṃ dadarśa parameśvaram \|\| 59 \|\|*

52-59. Her form was resplendent with the lustre of crores of suns, with illustrious body, unperturbed, adorned with thousand garlands of flames, resembling lakhs of kalagnis (world- destructive conflagrations), terrific with fangs wearing the muhita of the matted locks of hair, holding a club, conch, discus and trident. She had the awful form, horrible to look at, simultaneously, completely peaceful form too, having beautiful face with utmost surprise, having the head adorned with the moon digit, having the lustre of crores of suns, wearing the kirita crown, holding a club in hand, decorated with anklets adorned with a divine garland and clad in the divine garments, besmeared with the divine fragrance. She was quite attractive, having three eyes, clad in tiger skin, spread inside and outside the globe, pervading inside and outside of all the living beings, omnipotent, having pleasant complexion, the ancient one and the form of all, adored by Brahma, Indra, Upendra and the Yogins at her lotus like feet, having the hands, feet, the eyes and the heads on all the sides. Having such a type of form, and the one who covered all, such a goddess Parmesvari, was seen by Himalaya.

## \|\| 1.12.60 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tadīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ devyā māheśvaraṃ param \|*  
*bhayena ca samāviṣṭaḥ sa rājā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Looking at the best form of Mahesvarl, the mountain king, feeling panicky, felt delighted at the same time.

## \|\| 1.12.61 \|\|

*ātmanyādhāya cātmānamoṅkāraṃ samanusmaran \|*  
*nāmnāmaṣṭasahastreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Then he concentrating his mind in his own soul and reciting the Откат mantra, quite loudly, he started eulogising Paramesvarl with a thousand and eight epithets.

## \|\| 1.12.62-63 \|\|

*hīmavānuvāca*  
*śivomā paramā śaktiranantā niṣkalāmalā \|*  
*śāntā māheśvarī nityā śāśvatī paramākṣarā \|\| 62 \|\|*

*acintyā kevalānantyā śivātmā paramātmikā \|*  
*anādiravyayā śuddhā devātmā sarvagācalā \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. Himavan said, You are Shiva, Uma, and the Supreme Shakti, beyond measure, beyond change and spotless. You are peaceful, Mahesvarl, everlasting, Sas'vati (permanent) and Paramaksara (the supreme imperishable). You are beyond comprehension, absolute, beyond measure, the soul of Shiva, the Supreme soul, without beginning, the one without decline, the spotless one, the divine soul, all pervading and the immobile one.

## \|\| 1.12.64-67 \|\|

*ekānekavibhāgasthā māyātītā sunirmalā \|*  
*mahāmāheśvarī satyā mahādevī nirañjanā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kāṣṭhā sarvāntarasthā ca cicchaktiratilālasā \|*  
*nandā sarvātmikā vidyā jyotīrūpāmṛtākṣarā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*śāntiḥ pratiṣṭhā sarveṣāṃ nivṛttiramṛtapradā \|*  
*vyomamūrtirvyomalayā vyomādhārācyutāmarā \|\| 66 \|\|*

*anādinidhanāmoghā kāraṇātmā kalākalā \|*

Please you take to another form.” At these words of the king of the mountain, Parvati, winding up her awful form, atonce appeared in another form, which resembled the blue lotus and having the fragrance of the same.

203-206. She had two eyes and two arms, she was immensely beautiful decorated with black hair over the head. Her soles were red like the lotus and her palms were also red. She was quite graceful, sportive and with noble intentions. She had a bright tilakam over the forehead. Her tender body was adorned with various types of beautiful ornaments. A beautiful long garland of beads was falling over her breasts. Her face bore the serene smile. Her lips resembled the ripe wood apple fmit. Her anklets issued the giggling sound. Her face was delightful, as well as glorious. Finding her in this form, the lord of mountains, getting panicky, spoke to Paramesvarl (the Supreme Goddess).

## \|\| 1.12.207-210 \|\|
