207-210. Himavan said, Му life has become successful today. My penance too has become successful because, you, the invisible one, have appeared before me. You have created the entire universe. The world of which Pradhana is the first principal, is stationed in you. The entire world gets absorbed in you. You are the supreme position, some of the people call you Prakrti, and some consider you to be beyond Prakrti. Some of the people call you Shiva, since you are related to Shiva. The Prakrti, Purusa, Mahat, Brahma and Ishvara are all lodged in you.

## \|\| 1.12.211-213 \|\|

*avidyā niyatirmāyā kalādyāḥ śataśo 'bhavan \|*

211-213. Several of the Padarthas, like Avidya, Niyati (destiny), Maya, Кй1а and others have emerged from you. You are Ananta, the Supreme Shakti as well as ParamesthinI, you know all the secrets, and you are the refuge of all the secrets. О Yogesvari, after establishing you, lord Mahadeva, lord Mahesvara creates the entire universe beginning with Pradhana and dissolves it. By combining with you, lord Mahadeva enjoys the self-pleasure.

214-217. You alone are blissful, bestower of greatest bliss, besides being indestructible, Mahdkosa (the imperishable firmament), form of Mahajyoti (the unsullied ethereal light), and without blemish. You are the form of Shiva, pervading in all the padarthas, subtle, Sanatana, and the form of Supreme Brahman. You are like Indra among the gods, besides being Brahma, among those well-versed in Brahman. О Goddess, you are the wind among the forceful ones, Sanatkumara among the yogis, Vasistha among the Rishis, Vyasa among those well-versed in the Vedas, Kapila among those well-versed in Samkhya philosophy and Shiva among the Rudras. You are Upendra (Visnu) among the Adityas,1 while Pavaka among the Vasus.

## \|\| 1.12.218-221 \|\|

218-221. You are Samaveda among the Vedas, Gayatrl among the metres, Adhyatmavidya (spiritual science) among the lores, Paramagati (salvation) among the gatis\\ you are Maya of all the Shaktis, and Kalarupa among the destroyers; you are Orinkara among the secret padarthas. Brahmana among the castes, Grhasthasrama among the asramas and Mahesvara among the gods. You are the unique Purusa among all the living beings. You are, О Goddess, Guhyopanisad among the Upanisads, you are Is'ana-kalpa among the kalpas, while you are Krta Yuga, among the yugas.

Among the Satis (chaste woman), you are Arundhati, and Garuda among the birds; you are Purusha-Sukta among the Suktas, and you are the Jyestha Saman among the Samans; You are Savitri among the recitable mantras and are Satarudriya among the yajnas. You are Mahameru among the mountains, and Anantanaga among the serpents. You are the form of Supreme Brahman among all objects, and everything is pervaded by you.

226-228. О Goddess, your form is free from all the blemishes. You are imperceivable, spotless, having a single form, free from the beginning, middle or end. You are infinite, darkness, and are truthful in form. I offer my salutation to you. The people who can well interpret the provisions of Vedanta, conceive you as the creator of the universe, I take refuge with Pranava (От) the bestower of bliss. You pervade in all the living beings, being the cause of the union and separation of Prakrti and Purusa, illustrious, beyond the birth and death, I therefore offer my salutation to the form of Prana (vital breath).

229-231. You are beyond beginning or end, you are the form of the soul of the earth, you have many forms, beyond Prakrti, and invisible body, have the name of Purusa. Therefore salutation to you. You are the refuge of all, organiser of the entire universe, all pervading, beyond birth and death, subtle, astonishing, Triguna, Pradhana, and devoid of the difference in forms. I offer my salutation to your form. You are primordial, Mahat, form of Purusa, established in Prakrti, Sattva, Rajas and Tamas and their seeds, the fortunes, besides being the coordinator of the opposite Dharmas, salutation to you.

232-235. I offer my salutation to your form with the astonishing secrets with fourteen Bhuvanas lodged in the water and are controlled by a single master, which inspite of its various divisions is given the name of the cosmic egg. You have the forms of all the Vedas, who illumines the universe with her own lustre, I offer my salutation to you. You have the form of all the Vedas, lodged in the solar region, I offer my salutation to your form. You have a thousand heads, you fill in the world with your lustre and are lonely, eternal, the cause of the three units of time (past, present and future) and known as ParamesthI, I offer my salutation to you. You possess unlimited prowess, possessing thousands of arms and heads of infinite power, You are Purana Purusa, well known as Narayana sleeping in the oceanic waters. I offer my salutation to you. You are awful with your fangs, adorable by the gods, you are fire of the time of dissolution. Salutation to you. The one who destroys the egg of all the living beings, I offer my salutation to such form of Kala.

236-239. You are adored by the great serpents each possessing thousand hoods, on whose body rides Janardana, I offer my salutation to such a deity known by the name of Sesa. I bow in reverence before your form. You possess enormous fortunes, have three eyes, you remain alive even at the end of the yuga and are well aware of the nectar of the bliss of Brahman. You are the form of Rudra, dancing in the space, I offer my salutation to you. О Goddess, О Bhavanl, I offer my salutation to your present form, which is devoid of grief, is formless, whose lotus like feet are adored by the gods and demons. О MahadevI, salutation to you, О Paramesvarl, I offer my salutation to you, О Bhagavatl, О IsanI, О Shiva, salutation to you again and again.

## \|\| 1.12.240-242 \|\|

*tvanmayo 'haṃ tvadādhārastvameva ca gatirmama \|*

*eṣā tavāmbikā devi kilābhūta pitṛkanyakā \|*  
*menāśeṣajaganmāturaho vuṇyasya gauravam \|\| 242 \|\|*

240-242. I am complete with your form alone, and you alone happen to be my base. О Paramesvarl, be pleased with me. I take refuge in you. There is no God or Demon comparable with me in this world, because, it is with the influence of my tapas (penances), that you are known as the universal mother and have been bom to me as my daughter. О Ambika, О Goddess, your mother Mena, the daughter of the Pitrs, has become the mother of the rest of the world. This is due to the grace of my merits.

## \|\| 1.12.243 \|\|

*pāhi māmamareśāni menayā saha sarvadā \|*  
*namāmi tava pādābjaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ śivām \|\| 243 \|\|*

243\. О mistress of the gods, both Mena and you should always protect me. I offer my salutation at your feet and also seek refuge in Shiva.

## \|\| 1.12.244 \|\|

*aho me sumahad bhāgyaṃ mahādevīsamāgamāt \|*  
*ājñāpaya mahādevi kiṃ kariṣyāmi śaṅkari \|\| 244 \|\|*

244\. It is a matter of great fortune for me, that I could have an audience with you. О MahadevI, О Parvati, get me a command, what should I do?

## \|\| 1.12.245 \|\|

*etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tadā himagirīśvaraḥ \|*  
*saṃprekṣaṇamāṇo girijāṃ prāñjaliḥ pārśvato 'bhavat \|\| 245 \|\|*

245\. Speaking these words, the Lord of mountains, Himalaya, with folded hands, reached before Parvati.

## \|\| 1.12.246 \|\|

*atha sā tasya vacanaṃ niśamya jagato 'raṇiḥ \|*  
*sasmitaṃ prāha pitaraṃ smṛtvā paśupatiṃ patim \|\| 246 \|\|*

246\. Thereafter, listening to his words, Parvati, resembling the fire of the universe and remembering Pasupati (Shiva), her husband in her mind, smilingly spoke to her father.

## \|\| 1.12.247-249 \|\|

*devyuvāca*  
*śṛṇuṣva caitat paramaṃ guhyamīśvaragocaram \|*  
*upadeśaṃ giriśreṣṭha sevitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ \|\| 247 \|\|*

*yanme sākṣāt paraṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ dṛṣṭamadbhutam \|*  
*sarvaśaktisamāyuktamanantaṃ prerakaṃ param \|\| 248 \|\|*

*śāntaḥ samāhitamanā dambhāhaṅkāravarjitaḥ \|*  
*tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadeva śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 249 \|\|*

247-249. SridevI, said, О Best of the mountains, you listen to my message, which is secret, known to Is'varl, and served by the people well-versed in Brahman. My form is all powerful, beyond measure, extremely surprising, and the best, therefore, you listen to my message, you should have complete faith in the above form, with a peaceful mind, concentrating on the same. Getting relieved of pride, having full faith in me, you should take refuge in me.

## \|\| 1.12.250 \|\|

*bhaktyā tvananyayā tāta padbhāvaṃ paramāśritaḥ \|*  
*sarvayajñatapodānaistadevārcaya sarvadā \|\| 250 \|\|*

250\. O Father, with utmost devotion, having full faith in me, you should adore that form by means of performing yajnas, tapas, besides the charities.

## \|\| 1.12.251-252 \|\|

*tadeva manasā paśya tad dhyāyasva japasva ca \|*  
*mamopadeśāt saṃsāraṃ nāśayāmi tavānagha \|\| 251 \|\|*

*ahaṃ vai matparān bhaktānaiśvaraṃ yogamāsthitān \|*  
*saṃsārasāgarādasmāduddharāmyacireṇa tu \|\| 252 \|\|*

251-252. You visualise that form with your mind, meditate on the same, besides eulogising it. О sinless one, with my advice, I shall divert your worldly intelligence from the worldly affairs. Because of your utmost devotion, I shall make you cross the ocean of the universe with your mind absorbed in yoga.

## \|\| 1.12.253 \|\|

*dhyānena karmayogena bhaktyā jñānena caiva hi \|*  
*prāpyāhaṃ te giriśreṣṭha nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ \|\| 253 \|\|*

253\. O Best of the mountains by means of meditation, karmayoga devotion (the path of desireless action) and jhana, I can easily be achieved, and not by performing of the crores of ritualistic acts.

## \|\| 1.12.254 \|\|

*śrutismṛtyuditaṃ samyak karma varṇāśramātmakam \|*  
*adhyātmajñānasahitaṃ muktaye satataṃ kuru \|\| 254 \|\|*

254\. The best of dharmas enshrined in the Srutis and Smrtis, are also meant for salvation. All of them should be followed with the divine knowledge of self.

## \|\| 1.12.255 \|\|

*dharmāt saṃjāyate bhaktirbhaktyā saṃprāpyate param \|*  
*śrutismṛtibhyāmudito dharmo yajñādiko mataḥ \|\| 255 \|\|*

255\. It is from Dharrna, the devotion develops,and with the devotion, one achieves the Supreme goal viz. Brahman as well as the moksa. The dharma defined in the Srutis and Smrtis, has been equated with the yajha.

## \|\| 1.12.256 \|\|

*nānyato jāyate dharmo vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau \|*  
*tasmānmumukṣurdharmārtho madrūpaṃ vedamāśrayet \|\| 256 \|\|*

256\. One cannot achieve dharma by any other means. The following of the Vedas develops dharma. Therefore those desirous of moksa (ultimate liberation) and dharma should resort to the Vedas which are my embodiment.

## \|\| 1.12.257 \|\|

*mamaivaiṣā parā śaktirvedasaṃjñā purātanī \|*  
*ṛgyajuḥ sāmarūpeṇa sargādau saṃpravartate \|\| 257 \|\|*

257\. It is my own ancient and supreme potency that is termed as the Vedas. The same takes to the form of Rgveda, Yajurveda, and Samaveda at the start of the creation.

## \|\| 1.12.258 \|\|

*teṣāmeva ca guptyarthaṃ vedānāṃ bhagavānajaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇādīn sasarjātha sve sve karmaṇyayojayat \|\| 258 \|\|*

258\. For the protection of the same Vedas, Lord Brahma, created the Brahmanas and established them in their respective activities.

## \|\| 1.12.259 \|\|

*ye na kurvanti tad dharmaṃ tadarthaṃ brahmanirmitam \|*  
*teṣāmadhastād narakāṃstāmistrādīnakalpayat \|\| 259 \|\|*

259\. The one who does not recite my dharma, the Tamisra hells of the lower regions has been made for them by Brahma.

## \|\| 1.12.260 \|\|

*na ca vedād ṛte kiñcicchāstradharmābhidhāyakam \|*  
*yo 'nyatraramateso 'saunasaṃbhāṣyo dvijātibhiḥ \|\| 260 \|\|*

260\. There is no other scripture, except the Vedas in this world which could establish dharma. A person who devotes to the other scriptures, discarding the Vedas, the Brahmanas should have no talk with such people.

## \|\| 1.12.261 \|\|

*yāni śāstrāṇi dṛśyante loke 'smin vividhānitu \|*  
*śrutismṛtiviruddhāni niṣṭhā teṣāṃ hi tāmasī \|\| 261 \|\|*

261\. Those various scriptures which are against the Srutis and Smrtis seen in this y/qrid, are based on Tamo-guna or ignorance and belief or devotion in them is of tamasika nature.

## \|\| 1.12.262 \|\|

*kāpālaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca yāmalaṃ vāmamārhatam \|*  
*evaṃvidhāni cānyāni mohanārthāni tāni tu \|\| 262 \|\|*

262\. All other Sastras like Kapalas, Bhairavas, Yamalas, Vama, Arhata-Bauddha and Jaina,\* 1 are simply to create confusion.

## \|\| 1.12.263 \|\|

*ye kuśāstrābhiyogena mohayantīha mānavān \|*  
*mayā sṛṣṭāni śāstrāṇi mohāyaiṣāṃ bhavāntare \|\| 263 \|\|*

263\. Such of the people who try to mislead the public by means of the denounced Sastras, I have created my own Sastras in order to confuse them in the next birth.

## \|\| 1.12.264 \|\|

*vedārthavittamaiḥ kāryaṃ yat smṛtaṃ karma vaidikam \|*  
*tat prayatnena kurvanti matpriyāste hi ye narāḥ \|\| 264 \|\|*

264\. The people who have well interpreted the Smrtis as activity belonging to the Vedas, have prescribed some karmas to be performed by the people, and the people who perform them, they are extremely dear to me.

## \|\| 1.12.265 \|\|

*varṇānāmanukampārthaṃ manniyogād virāṭ svayam \|*  
*svāyaṃbhuvo manurdhārmān munīnāṃ pūrvamuktavānā \|\| 265 \|\|*

265\. In order to shower grace on the people of all the Varnas, the Virat Purusa (great personality), Svayambhuva Manu himself formerly promulgated the Code of Dharma to the sages, at my behest.

## \|\| 1.12.266 \|\|

*śrutvā cānye 'pi munayastanmukhād dharmamuttamam \|*  
*cakrurdharmapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi caiva hi \|\| 266 \|\|*

266\. The other ascetics also listening to the same dharma from his mouth, further created the Sastras (codes of Dharmas) for the establishment of dharma.

## \|\| 1.12.267 \|\|

*teṣu cāntarhiteṣvevaṃ yugānteṣu maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇo vacanāt tāni kariṣyanti yuge yuge \|\| 267 \|\|*

267\. At the time of the end of the yuga, with the disappearing of the those Sastras, at the command of Brahma, those MahaRishis, continued to compose Sastras in each one of the yugas.

## \|\| 1.12.268 \|\|

*aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni vyāsena kathitāni tu \|*  
*niyogād brahmaṇo rājaṃsteṣu dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 268 \|\|*

268\. О King, eighteen major Puranas were composed by the sage Vyasa, at the command of Brahma, in which the Dharma had been enshrined.

## \|\| 1.12.269 \|\|

*anyānyupapurāṇāni tacchiṣyaiḥ kathitāni tu \|*  
*yuge yuge 'tra sarveṣāṃ kartā vai dharmaśāstravit \|\| 269 \|\|*

269\. His disciples composed the Upa-Puranas. In each and every yuga, those well-versed in the Dharma-Sastras, composed these upa-Puranas, in every yuga.

## \|\| 1.12.270-271 \|\|

*śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chanda eva ca \|*  
*jyotiḥ śāstraṃ nyāyavidyā mīmāṃsā copabṛṃhaṇam \|\| 270 \|\|*

*evaṃ caturdaśaitāni vidyāsthānāni sattama \|*  
*caturvedaiḥ sahoktāni dharmo nānyatra vidyate \|\| 271 \|\|*

270-271. These Sastras are supportive of s'iksiJ (phonetics), kalpa (the rules regarding holy rites), Vyakarana (Grammar), Nirukta (Etymology), C handas (Prosody), Jyotisa (Astrology) and n yaya-vidya (Logic),2 besides expanding them. Thus, О Best of the Brahmanas, these fourteen Sastras are appended and are linked with the Vedas. Dharma is enshrined in these Sastras and no where else.

## \|\| 1.12.272 \|\|

*evaṃ paitāmahaṃ dharmaṃ manuvyāsādayaḥ param \|*  
*sthāpayanti mamādeśād yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 272 \|\|*

272\. Thus the dharma as established by the grand sire, is continued to be further established by Manu, Vyasa and others, till the end of the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 1.12.273 \|\|

*brahmaṇā saha te sarve saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare \|*  
*parasyānte kṛtātmānaḥ praviśanti paraṃ padam \|\| 273 \|\|*

273\. All these sages, on the arrival of Pratisah- carapralaya (the time of the dissolution of the world), after attaining realization of the Atman, enter the great region together with Brahma.

## \|\| 1.12.274 \|\|

*tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dharmārthaṃ vedamāśrayet \|*  
*dharmeṇa sahitaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ brahma prakāśayet \|\| 274 \|\|*

274\. Therefore making all the efforts, one should take refuge with the Vedas for the following of the dharma, because the knowledge with Dharma illumines the Parabrahman.

## \|\| 1.12.275-278 \|\|

*ye tu saṅgān parityajya māmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*upāsate sadā bhaktyā yogamaiśvaramāsthitāḥ \|\| 275 \|\|*

*sarvabhūtadayāvantaḥ śāntā dāntā vimatsarāḥ \|*  
*amānino buddhimantastāpasāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ \|\| 276 \|\|*

*maccittā madgataprāṇā majjñānakathane ratāḥ \|*  
*saṃnyāsino gṛhasthāśca vanasthā brahmacāriṇaḥ \|\| 277 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ māyātattvasamutthitam \|*  
*nāśayāmi tamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ jñānadīpane mā cirāt \|\| 278 \|\|*

275-278. A person, who discarding the attraction, takes refuge with me, and getting established in the divine yoga of Ishvara, always adores me with devotion, and remains compassionate on all the living beings, besides being peaceful, merciful, devoid of jealousy, devoid of pride, wise, perform penances and vows, and devote his mind and the life in me, engaged in the spreading of the knowledge about me, becomes either recluse, Vanaprasthin (forest-hermit) or Brahmacarin, for all such people who are devoted to dharma, I remove their darkness with the lamp of divine knowledge and destroy the delusion that rises up in them, without any delay as they are intelligent and persevering,

## \|\| 1.12.279 \|\|

*te sunirdhūtatamaso jñānenaikena manmayāḥ \|*  
*sadānandāstu saṃsāre na jāyante punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 279 \|\|*

279\. When the darkness of their ignorance is removed, then with achieving of the Kevala- juana (perfect knowledge), they become like me. They transforming themselves in blissful form, are never bom in the world again and again.

## \|\| 1.12.280 \|\|

*tasmāt sarvaprakāreṇa madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*māmevārcaya sarvatra menayā saha saṃgataḥ \|\| 280 \|\|*

280\. Therefore devoting yourself to me in every way and being fully absorbed in me, worship me exclusively, seeking me mentally as your refuge.

## \|\| 1.12.281 \|\|

*aśakto yadi me dhyātumaiśvaraṃ rūpamavyayam \|*  
*tato me sakalaṃ rūpaṃ kālādyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 281 \|\|*

281\. In case one is unable to concentrate on this form of mine which is eternal, then one should take refuge in my supreme form beginning with Kala (time).

## \|\| 1.12.282 \|\|

*yad yat svarūpaṃ me tāta manaso gocaraṃ bhavet \|*  
*tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadarcanaparo bhava \|\| 282 \|\|*

282\. Therefore, О Father, whatever form of mine is enshrined in your mind, then getting devoted to the same form, you should serve the same.

## \|\| 1.12.283-285 \|\|

*yattu me niṣkalaṃ rūpaṃ cinmātraṃ kevalaṃ śivam \|*  
*sarvopādhivinirmuktamanantamamṛtaṃ param \|\| 283 \|\|*

*jñānenaikena tallabhyaṃ kleśena paramaṃ padam \|*  
*jñānameva prapaśyanto māmeva praviśanti te \|\| 284 \|\|*

*tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ \|\| 285 \|\|*

283-285. My perfect form which is pure consciousness, entire auspiciousness, devoid of all conditioning factors, the imperishable, the supreme goal, that supreme position could be achieved by with difficulty, by making the best of efforts for spiritual knowledge. Those who comprehend that spiritual knowledge can enter into me, because in that same form, they are filled with intelligence, Atman dwelling on it and stabilised therein, and having that as the ultimate resort, they washing away their sins with jnana, never return to the world.

## \|\| 1.12.286 \|\|

*māmanāśritya paramaṃ nirvāṇamamalaṃ padam \|*  
*prāpyate na hi rājendra tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 286 \|\|*

286\. О Rajendra, without having refuge in me, one cannot achieve that great state of bliss, the region devoid of impurities. Therefore you should take refuge in me.

## \|\| 1.12.287 \|\|

*ekatvena pṛthaktvena tathā cobhayato 'pi vā \|*  
*māmupāsya mahārāja tato yāsyāsi tatpadam \|\| 287 \|\|*

287\. О King, with the adoring of a single form of mine or by different forms or in both ways, you would be able to achieve moksa.

## \|\| 1.12.288 \|\|

*māmanāśritya tat tattvaṃ svabhāvavimalaṃ śivam \|*  
*jñāyate na hi rājendra tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 288 \|\|*

288\. О King, without taking refuge in me, you cannot know about the spotless Shivatattva (the ultimate Reality which is pure by nature and auspicious). Therefore, you take refuge in me.

## \|\| 1.12.289 \|\|

*tasmāt tvamakṣaraṃ rūpaṃ nityaṃ cārūpamaiśvaram \|*  
*ārādhaya prayatnena tato bandhaṃ prahāsyasi \|\| 289 \|\|*

289\. Therefore, you, making all the efforts, should adore the form of Ishvara, and by so doing, you shall be relieved of the darkness of ignorance.

## \|\| 1.12.290 \|\|

*karmaṇā manasā vācā śivaṃ sarvatra sarvadā \|*  
*samārādhaya bhāvena tato yāsyasi tatpadam \|\| 290 \|\|*

290\. By your action, thought or speech, you should always adore Shiva who will make you achieve moksa.

## \|\| 1.12.291-293 \|\|

*na vai paśyanti tat tattvaṃ mohitā mama māyayā \|*  
*anādyanantaṃ paramaṃ maheśvaramajaṃ śivam \|\| 291 \|\|*

*sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ sarvādhāraṃ nirañjanam \|*  
*nityānandaṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirguṇaṃ tamasaḥ param \|\| 292 \|\|*

*advaitamacalaṃ brahma niṣkalaṃ niṣprapañcakam \|*  
*svasaṃvedyamavedyaṃ tat pare vyomni vyavasthitam \|\| 293 \|\|*

291-293. Those who are deluded by my Maya, do not attain that lord Mahadeva, who is eternal, beyond measure, the Supreme Paramesvara, and beyond birth. The same Shiva is lodged in all the living beings in the form of the soul. He is the support of all, unblemished, always blissful, invisible, Nirguna (transcendent), devoid of tamoguna, not dualistic, unshakable, devoid of deceitfulness, self-known, beyond knowledge, and is lodged in the space.

## \|\| 1.12.294 \|\|

*sūkṣmeṇa tamasā nityaṃ veṣṭitā mama māyayā \|*  
*saṃsārasāgare ghore jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 294 \|\|*

294\. The people having been overpowered with my everlasting subtle, Maya of ignorance, are bom again and again in the ocean of the world.

## \|\| 1.12.295 \|\|

*bhaktyā tvananyayā rājan samyag jñānena caiva hi \|*  
*anveṣṭavyaṃ hi tad brahma janmabandhanivṛttaye \|\| 295 \|\|*

295\. О King, by means of the utmost devotion and adequate knowledge for getting free from the bondage of birth and death, one should devote himself for the search of the Brahman.

## \|\| 1.12.296 \|\|

*ahaṅkāraṃ ca mātsaryaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham \|*  
*adharmābhiniveśaṃ ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāsthitaḥ \|\| 296 \|\|*

296\. Therefore, discarding involvement in pride, jealousy, passions, anger, attraction and adharma, one should take refuge with vairagya or detachment.

## \|\| 1.12.297 \|\|

*sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani \|*  
*anvīkṣya cātmanātmānaṃ brahmabhūyāya kalpate \|\| 297 \|\|*

297\. One should visualise all the living beings in his own soul and his own soul in all the living beings. In this way the soul be visualised by means of the soul and by so doing, one becomes the form of Brahman.

## \|\| 1.12.298 \|\|

*brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ \|*  
*aiśvarīṃ paramāṃ bhaktiṃ vindetānanyagāminīm \|\| 298 \|\|*

298\. Turning himself as Brahman he becomes a delightful soul, and provides protection to all. Such a person ultimately achieves, the utmost devotion of the lord.

## \|\| 1.12.299 \|\|

*vīkṣate tat paraṃ tattvamaiśvaraṃ brahmaniṣkalam \|*  
*sarvasaṃsāranirmukto brahmaṇeyavāvatiṣṭhate \|\| 299 \|\|*

299\. He gets an audience with unchanging, lordly, unsullied, supreme tattva of Brahman and becoming free from the entire world he gets absorbed in Brahman.

## \|\| 1.12.300 \|\|

*brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāyaṃ parasya paramaḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*anantasyāvyayasyaikaḥ svātmādhāro maheśvaraḥ \|\| 300 \|\|*

300\. Lord Shiva himself is the one who establishes the supreme Brahman himself. He is Mahesvara, beyond destruction, unparallel and the foundation of all the bMtas.

## \|\| 1.12.301 \|\|

*jñānena karmayogena bhaktiyogena vā nṛpa \|*  
*sarvasaṃsāramuktyarthamīśvaraṃ satataṃ śraya \|\| 301 \|\|*

301\. О King, for the achieving of the salvation in the universe, you take refuge with Ishvara, by means of jnanayoga (the path of perfect knowledge), bhaktiyoga (path of devotion) and karmayoga (path of action).

## \|\| 1.12.302 \|\|

*eṣa guhyopadeśaste mayā datto girīśvara \|*  
*anvīkṣya caitadakhilaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 302 \|\|*

302\. О Lord of the mountains, I have delivered this secret advice to you. Now you should act as you please.

## \|\| 1.12.303-305 \|\|

*ahaṃ vai yācitā devaiḥ saṃjātā parameśvarāt \|*  
*vinindya dakṣaṃ pitaraṃ maheśvaravinindakam \|\| 303 \|\|*

*dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya tavārādhanakāraṇāt \|*  
*menādehasamutpannā tvāmeva pitaraṃ śritā \|\| 304 \|\|*

*sa tvaṃ niyogād devasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*pridāsyase māṃ rudrāya svayaṃvarasamāgame \|\| 305 \|\|*

303-305. At the demand of the gods, I become, all powerful, emerging from Paramesvara, I had denounced Daksa Prajapati, my own father who had denounced Mahesvara and for the establishment of dharma, and because of your devotion for me, I have been bom out of the body of Mena. I am now dependent on you as my father. You at the inspiration or the command of Brahmadeva, should hand me over to Rudradeva, in svayamvara.1

## \|\| 1.12.306-307 \|\|

*tatsaṃbandhācca te rājan sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|*  
*tvāṃ namasyanti vai tāta prasīdati ca śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 306 \|\|*

*tasmāt sarvaprayatnena māṃ viddhīśvaragocarām \|*  
*saṃpūjya devamīśānaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja \|\| 307 \|\|*

306-307. Because of the relationship of Mahesvara with me and yourself, Indra and all other gods shall bow in reverence to you. On the other hand, lord Shiva shall also feel pleased. Therefore you take me to be the form of Is /ага by all the means. Adoring lord Shiva, you should go and take refuge with him.

## \|\| 1.12.308 \|\|

*sa evamukto bhagavān devadevyā girīśvaraḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā devīṃ prāñjaliḥ punarabravīt \|\| 308 \|\|*

308\. Thus Parvati, the goddess of the gods, spoke to Himachala, the lord of the mountains. He then offered his salutation with folded hands and spoke to the goddess.

## \|\| 1.12.309-310 \|\|

*vistareṇa maheśāni yogaṃ māheśvaraṃ param \|*  
*jñānaṃ caivātmano yogaṃ sādhanāni pracakṣva me \|\| 309 \|\|*

*tasyaitat paramaṃ jñānamātmayogamanuttamam \|*  
*yathāvad vyājahāreśāsādhanānica vistarāt \|\| 310 \|\|*

309-310. “O Spouse of lord Mahesa, you enlighten me on yoga, knowledge about self, the Yoga and the means for the same.” Thereafter, Ishvara spoke on the supreme knowledge, the best of yoga, and the means for the same in detail.

## \|\| 1.12.311 \|\|

*niśamya vadanāmbhojād girīndro lokapūjitaḥ \|*  
*lokamātuḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ yogāsakto 'bhavatpunaḥ \|\| 311 \|\|*

311\. Himavan, the lord of mountains, listening to the supreme jnana from the mouth of the Goddess Parvati, felt attracted towards yoga.

## \|\| 1.12.312 \|\|

*pradadau ca maheśāya pārvatīṃ bhāgyagauravāt \|*  
*niyogād brahmaṇaḥ sādhvīṃ devānāṃ caiva saṃnidhau \|\| 312 \|\|*

312\. Because of the height of the good fortune and at the command of Brahma, Himalaya in association with the gods, gave over Parvati to Mahesa.

## \|\| 1.12.313-314 \|\|

*ya imaṃ paṭhate 'dhyāyaṃ devyā māhātmyakīrtanam \|*  
*śivasya saṃnidhau bhaktyā sucistadbhāvabhāvitaḥ \|\| 313 \|\|*

*sarvapāpavinirmukto divyayogasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*ullaṅghya brahmaṇo lokandevyāḥ sthānamavāpnuyāt \|\| 314 \|\|*

313-314. He who with devotion reads this chapter recounting the greatness of goddess Parvati in the presence of Shiva, becomes pure by the merger of his heart in the goddess and shall be free from all sins. He will be endowed with divine Yoga and will go beyond the world of Brahma and shall attain the abode of the goddess.

## \|\| 1.12.315 \|\|

*yaścaitat paṭhate stotraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ \|*  
*devyāḥ samāhitamanāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 315 \|\|*

315\. A person who, with a concentrated mind shall reads this stotra in the presence of Brahmanas, he shall be relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.12.316-319 \|\|

*nāmnāmaṣṭasahastraṃ tu devyā yat samudīritam \|*  
*jñātvār'kamaṇḍalagatāṃ saṃbhāvya parameśvarīm \|\| 316 \|\|*

*abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairbhaktiyogasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*saṃsmaran paramaṃ bhāvaṃ devyā māheśvaraṃ param \|\| 317 \|\|*

*ananyamānaso nityaṃ japedāmaraṇād dvijaḥ \|*  
*so 'ntakāle smṛtiṃ labdhvāparaṃ brahmādhigacchati \|\| 318 \|\|*

*athavā jāyate vipro brāhmaṇānāṃ kule śucau \|*  
*pūrvasaṃskāramāhātmyād brahmavidyāmavāpya saḥ \|\| 319 \|\|*

316-319. A thousand and eight names of the goddess have been highlighted in this chapter, well- realising which, a person, contemplating her in the sphere of the sun, endowed with devotion, should adore the goddess with sandal-paste, fragrance and then remembering lord Mahes'vara as well, should recite the hymn regularly. Such a Brahmana, by so doing, achieves the supreme Brahman at the end. Or otherwise he is reborn in the best of the Brahmana family and because of his earlier noble deeds, he achieves Brahmavidya well.

## \|\| 1.12.320 \|\|

*saṃprāpya yogaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ tat pārameśvaram \|*  
*śāntaḥ sarvagāto bhūtvā śivasāyujyamānapnuyāt \|\| 320 \|\|*

320\. Such a person by achieving the extremely divine Yoga concerning Paramesvara, concentrating his mind, achieves Sayujya (identity) with lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.12.321 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ cātha nāmāni juhuyāt savanatrayam \|*  
*pūtanādikṛtairdeṣairgrahadoṣaiśca mucyate \|\| 321 \|\|*

321\. A person, who reciting (the thousand and eight names), thrice a day, performing the Нота, shall be relieved from all the evil effects of epidemics and malefic planets.

## \|\| 1.12.322-323 \|\|

*japed vāharaharnityaṃ saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ \|*  
*śrīkāmaḥ pārvatīṃ devīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|\| 322 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya pārśvataḥ śaṃbhuṃ trinetraṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*labhate mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ \|\| 323 \|\|*

322-323. A person desirous of fortunes, who adoring the goddess Parvati and the three-eyed Shiva, performs the japam regularly for a year, he achieves enormous riches by the grace of lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.12.324 \|\|

*tasmāt sarvaprayatnena japtavyaṃ hi dvijātibhiḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpānodārthaṃ devyā nāma sahastrakam \|\| 324 \|\|*

324\. Therefore, the Brahmanas, making all the efforts, for the removal of all the sins, should recite the thousand names stotra of the goddess.

## \|\| 1.12.325 \|\|

*prasaṅgāt kathitaṃ viprā devyā māhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ prajāsargaṃ bhṛgvādīnāṃ nibodhata \|\| 325 \|\|*

325\. Suta said, “O Brahmanas, I have narrated the excellent glory of the goddess, in this context. After this, you listen attentively, the creation of Bhrgu and others.”

## Chapter 13. Genealogy of the daughter of Daksa

## \|\| 1.13.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇapriyā \|*  
*devau dhātāvidhātārau merorjāmātarau tathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said, Lakshmi, the beloved of Narayana, was born as a daughter of Khyati, the wife of Bhrgu. There were two sons-in-law of Mem known as Dhata and Vidhata.

## \|\| 1.13.2-3 \|\|

*āyatirniyatirmeroḥ kanye caiva mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*dhātāvidhātroste bhārye tayorjātau sutāvubhau \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prāṇaścaiva mṛkaṇḍuśca mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍutaḥ \|*  
*tathā vedaśirā nāma prāṇasya dyutimān sutaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. The noble souled Mem had two daughters known as Ayati and Niyati whose husbands were Dhata and Vidhata. Both of them had two sons known as Prana and Mrkandu. Markandeya was bom of Mrkandu, while Vedasiras was bom to Prana as a son, who was extremely illustrious.

## \|\| 1.13.4-5 \|\|

*marīcerapi saṃbhūtiḥ paurṇamāsamasūyata \|*  
*kanyācatuṣṭayaṃ caiva sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tuṣṭirjyeṣṭhā tathā vṛṣṭiḥ kṛṣṭiścāpacitistathā \|*  
*virajāḥ parvaścaiva paurṇamāsasya tau sutau \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Sambhuti, the daughter of Marichi, gave birth to a son named Pumamasa, besides four daughters possessing all the noble symptoms. Tusti was the eldest of all. The remaining three were known by the names of Vrsti, Krsti and Apaciti. Pumamasa had two sons known by the names of Virajas and Parvata.

## \|\| 1.13.6-8 \|\|

*kṣamā tu suṣuve putrān pulahasya prajāpateḥ \|*  
*kardamaṃ ca varīyāṃsaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ munisattamam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tathaiva ca kanīyāsaṃ taponirdhūtakalpaṣam \|*  
*anasūyā tathaivātrerjajñe putrānakalpaṣān \|\| 7 \|\|*

*somaṃ durvāsasaṃ caiva dattātreyaṃ ca yoginam \|*  
*smṛtiścāṅgirasaḥ putrīrjajñe lakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Kshama- the wife of Prajapati Pulaha, gave birth to many sons and Kardama was the greatest of them all. Sahisnu was an excellent sage, the younger of them was also an ascetic who wiped off all sins through penance. Anasuya gave birth to the sinless sons of Atri, who were known as Soma, Durvasas1 and Dattatreya, the great Yogi. A daughter named Smrti, possessing all the noble symptoms, was bom to Angiras.

## \|\| 1.13.9 \|\|

*sinīvālīṃ kuhūṃ caiva rākāmanumatiṃ tathā \|*  
*prītyāṃ pulastyo bhagavān dattātrimasṛjat prabhuḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Lord Pulastya, produced from his wife Prlti, daughters known as Sinlvali,2 Kuhu, Raka and Anumati, besides a son named Dambhoji.

## \|\| 1.13.10 \|\|

*pūrvajanmani so 'gastyaḥ smṛtaḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare \|*  
*vedabāhuṃ tathā kanyāṃ sannatiṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In the previous birth, during the Svayambhuva Manvantara, he came to be known as the sage Agastya, as well as another son Devabahu. He had a daughter named Dvitlya.

## \|\| 1.13.11 \|\|

*putrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhastraṃ saṃtatiḥ suṣuve kratoḥ \|*  
*te cordhvaretasaḥ sarve bālakhilyā iti smṛtāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Prajapati Kratu had sixty thousand sons from Santati (Dvitlya), who were all Brahmacaris and were known as Balakhilyas.

## \|\| 1.13.12 \|\|

*vasiṣṭhaśca tathorjāyāṃ saptaputrānajījanat \|*  
*kanyāṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣāṃ sarveśobhāsamanvitām \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Vasistha on the other hand, produced seven sons and a beautiful daughter known as Pundarlkaksa.

## \|\| 1.13.13 \|\|

*rajohaścordhvabāhuśca savanaścānaghastathā \|*  
*sutapāḥ śukra ityete sapta putrā mahaujasaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The seven sons of great prowess were named as Rajas, Matra, Urdhvabahu, Savana, Anariga, Sutapas and Sukra.

## \|\| 1.13.14-16 \|\|

*yo 'sau rudrātmako vahnirbrahmaṇastanayo dvijāḥ \|*  
*svāhā tasmāt sutān lebhe trīnudārān mahaujasaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śuciragniśca te trayaḥ \|*  
*nirmathyaḥ pavamānaḥ syād vaidyutaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yaścāsau tapate sūryaḥ śuciragnistvasau smṛtaḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ tu saṃtatāvanye catvāriṃśca pañca ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. О Brahmanas, Vahni, of the form of Rudra, was the son of Brahma. He produced from Svaha three large-hearted and immensely illustrious sons- named Pavaka, Pavamana and Suciragni. They were resembling the fire in form. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; while the fire produced from lightening is called Pavaka. The one which bums while remaining in the sun is called Suci. Their further progeny were forty-five in number.

## \|\| 1.13.17 \|\|

*pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śucisteṣāṃ pitā ca yaḥ \|*  
*ete caikonapañcāśad vahnayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Pavamana, Pavaka, Suci and their father are all known as the ‘Forty-nine’ fires.

## \|\| 1.13.18 \|\|

*sarve tapasvinaḥ proktāḥ sarve yajñeṣu bhāginaḥ \|*  
*rudrātmakāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve tripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. All of them are said to be ascetics. These ascetics are said to be participating in all the yajnas and are the forms of Rudras. Because of this, their foreheads are marked with Tripundra lines.

## \|\| 1.13.19-20 \|\|

*ayajvānaśca yajvānaḥ pitaro brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*agniṣvāttā barhiṣado dvidhā teṣāṃ vyavasthitiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tebhyaḥ svadhā sutāṃ jajñe menāṃ vaitaraṇīṃ tathā \|*  
*te ubhe brahmavādinyau yoginyau munisattamāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. The Pitrs known by the names of Ayajvana (non-performers of sacrifices) and Yajvana (performers of sacrifices) are said to be the sons of Brahma. They are of respectively classed as- Agnisvattas (non-possessors of fire) and Barhisads (possessors of fire). Svadha produced two daughters named Mena and DharinI from them. О best of the sages, both of them came to be known as the Yoginls.

## \|\| 1.13.21 \|\|

*asūta menā mainākaṃ krauñcaṃ tasyānujaṃ tathā \|*  
*gaṅgā himavato jajñe sarvalokaikapāvanī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Mena gave birth to Mainaka and Kraunca his younger brother. Ganga, the purifier of the universe, was bom out of Himalaya.

## \|\| 1.13.22 \|\|

*svayogāgnibalād devīṃ lebhe putrīṃ maheśvarīṃ \|*  
*yathāvat kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ devyā māhātmyamuttamam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Himalaya with the strength of the fire of his yoga, achieved MahesVari as his daughter. I have already narrated the excellent glory of the goddess.

## \|\| 1.13.23 \|\|

*dhāriṇī merurājasya patnī padaramasamānanā \|*  
*devau dhātāvidhātārau merorjāmātārātubhau \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The lotus faced DharinI was the wife of king Meru. The two gods Dhata and Vidhata were the sons-in-law of Meru.

## \|\| 1.13.24 \|\|

*eṣā dakṣasya kanyānāṃ mayāpatyānusaṃtatiḥ \|*  
*vyākhyātā bhavatāmadya manoḥ sṛṣṭiṃ nibodhata \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Thus I have narrated before you the facts about the daughters of Daksa and their progeny. Now you listen to the creation of Manu, shortly.

## Chapter 14. Progeny of Svayambhuva Manu

## \|\| 1.14.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*priyavratottānapādau manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu \|*  
*dharmajñau sumahāvīryau śatarūpā vyajījanat \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said, The queen Satarilpa of Svayambhuva Manu, gave birth to Priyavrata and Uttanapada, who were quite religious ones and immensely valorous.

## \|\| 1.14.2-3 \|\|

*tatastūttānapādasya dhruvo nāma suto 'bhavat \|*  
*bhakto nārāyaṇe deve prāptavān sthānamuttamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dhruvāt śliṣṭiñca bhavyaṃ ca bhāryā śambhurvyajāyata \|*  
*śliṣṭerādhatta succhāyā pañca putrānakalpaṣān \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Thereafter Uttanapada had a son named Dhruva, who attained the excellent region because of his devotion towards lord Narayana. Dhruva had two sons named Sisti and Bhavya. The latter had a son named Sambhu. Suchhaya gave five sinless sons, in union with Sisti.

## \|\| 1.14.4-5 \|\|

*vasiṣṭhavacanād devī tapastaptvā suduścaram \|*  
*ārādhya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ śālagrāme janārdanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ripuṃ ripuñjayaṃ vipraṃ vṛkalaṃ vṛṣatejasam \|*  
*nārāyaṇaparān śuddhān svadharmaparipālakān \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Then Succhaya at the advice of the sage Vasistha performed extremely difficult tapas adoring lord Visnu the supreme Purusa. The five sons named Ripu, Ripunjaya, Vipra, Kapila and Vrsateja were bom to her. All of them were engaged in the devotion of Narayana and were spotless, and the protectors of their own religion.

## \|\| 1.14.6-10 \|\|

*riporādhatta bṛhatī cakṣuṣaṃ sarvatejasam \|*  
*so 'jījanat puṣkariṇyāṃ vairaṇyāṃ cākṣuṣaṃ manum \|\| 6 \|\|*

*prajāpaterātmajāyāṃ vīraṇasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kanyāyāṃ sumahāvīryā vairājasya prajāpateḥ \|*  
*ūruḥ pūruḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavāk śuciḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaścābhimanyukaḥ \|*  
*ūrorajanayat putrān ṣaḍāgneyī mahābalān \|\| 9 \|\|*

*aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ svātiṃ kratumaṅgirasaṃ śivam \|*  
*aṅgād veno 'bhavat paścād bainyo venādajāyata \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. The queen of Ripu, gave birth to the illustrious Caksus as the son, while Caksus produced from Pushkarinl, the daughter of Vlrana Prajapati, a beautiful son Caksusha Manu. The valorous Caksus Manu produced from the daughter of Vairaja Prajapati, ten illustrious sons, known as Uru, Ptim, Satadyumna, Tapasvl, Satyavak, Suci, Agnistuta, Atiraja, Sudyumna and Abhimanyu. Uru on the other hand, produced from his wife named Agneyl, Anga, Sumanas, Khyati, Kratu, Angirasa, and Shiva as valorous sons. Then Vena was bom of Anga while Venya (Prthu) was bom of Vena.

## \|\| 1.14.11 \|\|

*yo 'sau pṛthuriti khyātaḥ prajāpālo mahābalaḥ \|*  
*yena dugdhā mahī pūrvaṃ prājānāṃ hitakāraṇāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The same Vainya, who was quite powerful and the well-wisher of his people, subsequently came to be known as Prthu, who in the earlier times, at the command of Brahma, for the welfare of the people, milked the earth with Indra.1

## \|\| 1.14.12-13 \|\|

*niyogād brahmaṇaḥ sārdhaṃ devendreṇa mahaujasā \|*  
*venaputrasya vitate purā paitāmahe makhe \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sūtaḥ paurāṇiko jajñe māyārūpaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ \|*  
*pravaktā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ dharmajño guṇavatsalaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. In earlier times, in the vast Paitamaha sacrifice (pertaining to Brahma sacrifice) of Vena’s son, Hari took to an illusory form and took birth in the form of Suta, the knower of Puranas. He had been the orator of all the sastras, devoted to dharma, and respectful to his preceptor.

## \|\| 1.14.14-15 \|\|

*taṃ māṃ nitta muniśreṣṭhāḥ pūrvodbhūtaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*asmin manvantare vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śrāvayāmāsa māṃ prītyā purāṇaṃ puruṣo hariḥ \|*  
*madanvaye tu ye sūtāḥ saṃbhūtā vedavarjitāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. О Best of the sages, I happen to be the said Suta Pauranika. Since I had been bom in earlier times, therefore I am known as Sanatana. During this Manvantara, Krisna Dvaipayana who became Vyasa, the Purana Purusa, the form of Hari, showered his grace on me and lovingly made this Purana to be heard by me. All the Sutas who had been bom in my race without the knowledge of the Vedas, all of them at the command of lord Aja, earned their livelihood with the reciting of the Puranas.

## \|\| 1.14.16-17 \|\|

*teṣāṃ purāṇavaktṛtvaṃ vṛttirāsīdajājñayā \|*  
*sa tu vainyaḥ pṛthurdhomān satyasaṃdho jitendriyaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sārvabhaumo mahātejāḥ svadharmaparipālakaḥ \|*  
*tasya bālyāt prabhṛtyeva bhaktirnārāyaṇe 'bhavat \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Prthu, the son of Vena, was truthful, extremely wise, had controlled his sense organs, was universal monarch, extremely illustrious and follower of his dharma. Since his childhood, he was devoted to Narayana.

## \|\| 1.14.18 \|\|

*govardhanagiriṃ prāpya tapastepe jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*tapasā bhagavān prītaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He being the controller of the sense organs, went to the Govardhana mountain and started performing penance there. Lord Visnu, the holder of discus, conch and iron club was pleased with his penance.

## \|\| 1.14.19-20 \|\|

*āgatya devo rājānaṃ prāha dāmodaraḥ svayam \|*  
*dhramikau rūpasaṃpannau sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varau \|\| 19 \|\|*

*matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ putrau tava bhaviṣyataḥ \|*  
*ekamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ svakīyāṃ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Lord Damodara himself arrived there and spoke to the king, “You will surely have two sons by my grace who would be quite religious, beautiful and the best among the carriers of the weapons.” Thus speaking, the lord was absorbed in Prakrti (and disappeared).

## \|\| 1.14.21 \|\|

*vainyo 'pi vedavidhinā niścalāṃ bhaktimudvahan \|*  
*apālayat svakaṃ rājyaṃ nyāyena madhusūdane \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Prthu on the other hand, having his deep devotion in the lord, concentrating his mind at lord Madhusudana, kept on ruling his country.

## \|\| 1.14.22 \|\|

*acirādeva tanvaṅgo bhāryā tasya sucismitā \|*  
*khikhaṇḍanaṃ havirdhānamantardhānā vyajāyata \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In short time Sucismita, the lean and thin wife of Prthu, gave birth to Sikhandl and Havirdhana.

## \|\| 1.14.23 \|\|

*śikhaṇḍano 'bhavat putraḥ suśīla iti viśrutaḥ \|*  
*dhārmiko rūpasaṃpanno vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The son of Sikhandl, came to be known as Suslla who was quite a religious one, beautiful and well-versed in the Vedas and the post-Vedic literature.

## \|\| 1.14.24 \|\|

*so 'dhītya vidhivad vedān dharmeṇa tapasi sthitaḥ \|*  
*matiṃ cakre bhāgyayogāt saṃnyāṃ prati dharmavit \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He, after studying the Vedas appropriately was engaged in tapas. The religious-minded one was then attracted towards renunciation.

## \|\| 1.14.25 \|\|

*sa kṛtvā tīrthasaṃsevāṃ svādhyāye tapasi sthitaḥ \|*  
*jagāma himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ kadācit siddhasevitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. After going round all the holy places, he again concentrated on the study of the Vedas as well as the performing of the tapas. With the move of destiny, he went to the Himalaya served by the Siddhas.

## \|\| 1.14.26 \|\|

*tatra dharmapadaṃ nāma dharmasiddhipradaṃ vanam \|*  
*apaśyad yogināṃ gamyamagamyaṃ brahmavidviṣām \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Reaching there, he came across a forest known as Dharmavana, which bestowed the achievement of dharma. It was accessible to Yogins and inaccessible to the haters of Brahman.

## \|\| 1.14.27 \|\|

*tatra mandākinī nāma supuṇyā vimalā nadī \|*  
*padmotpalavanopetā siddhāśramavibhūṣitā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. There was a spotless and auspicious river known by the name of MandakinI flowing there, having the forest of red and blue lotus flowers, and a number of the hermitages of the Siddhas there.

## \|\| 1.14.28 \|\|

*sa tasyā dakṣiṇe tīre munīndrairyogibhirvṛtam \|*  
*supuṇyamāśramaṃ ramyamapaśyat prītisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. On the right bank of the river, he found a hermitage full of ascetics and the yogis. It was quite a pleasant one. Finding it, he loved the place.

## \|\| 1.14.29 \|\|

*mandākinījale strātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*arcayitvā mahādevaṃ puṣpaiḥ padmotpalādibhiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Then he took bath in the river MandakinI, offering oblations to the manes and the gods, he adored lord Mahadeva, with several types of the lotus flowers.

## \|\| 1.14.30-31 \|\|

*dhyātvārkaṃsaṃsthamīśānaṃ śirasyādhāya cāñjalim \|*  
*saṃprekṣamāṇo bhāsvantaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 30 \|\|*

*rudrādhyāyena giriśaṃ rudrasya caritena ca \|*  
*anyaiśca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śāṃbhavairvedasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Again concentrating his mind on Is'ana, he was lodged in the solar region, placing both the hands over the head in an ahjali posture, he offered his salutation to the sun and offered his prayer to the Shiva. He recited Rudradhydya, Rudracarita and other prayers of Shiva, as prescribed in the Vedas, adoring him at the same time.

## \|\| 1.14.32-33 \|\|

*athāsminnantare 'paśyat tamāyāntaṃ mahāmunim \|*  
*śvetāśvataranāmānaṃ mahāpāśupatottamam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*bhasmasaṃdigdhasavāṅgaṃ kaupīnācchādanānvitam \|*  
*tapasā karṣitātmānaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. In the meantime, he spotted the great sage Svetasvatara who was the best of Pasupatas (devotees of Shiva). The said ascetic had applied ashes all over his body. He wore Kaupin (loin cloth), having lean and thin body, because of his performing tapas. He was wearing a white sacred thread, yajnopavita.

## \|\| 1.14.34 \|\|

*samāpya saṃstavaṃ śaṃbhorānandāstrāvilekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*vavande śirasā pādau prāñjalirvākyamabravīt \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. After rendering his prayer to lord Shiva, his eyes were filled with blissful tears. He offered his salutation at the feet of the sage and spoke loving words with hands folded.

## \|\| 1.14.35 \|\|

*dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi yanme sākṣānmunīśvaraḥ \|*  
*yogīśvaro 'dya bhagavān dṛṣṭo yogavidāṃ varaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О Great sage, .1 feel beholden, to have an audience with you today. You are the best of all, full of fortunes and a great yogi.

## \|\| 1.14.36 \|\|

*aho me sumahadbhāgyaṃ tapāṃsi saphalāni me \|*  
*kiṃ kariṣyāmi śiṣyo 'haṃ tava māṃ pālayānagha \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. It is a matter of great fortune for me, that my penances has met with success. О Sinless one, what type of service can I render to you? I happen to be your disciple. You kindly look after me.

## \|\| 1.14.37 \|\|

*so 'nugṛhyātha rājānaṃ suśīlaṃ śīlasaṃyutam \|*  
*śiṣyatve parijagrāha tapasā kṣīṇakalpaṣam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The great sage, finding the noble king having become lean and thin due to his performing of the penances, accepted him as his disciple.

## \|\| 1.14.38 \|\|

*sāṃnyāsikaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kārayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*dadau tadaiśvaraṃ jñānaṃ svaśākhāvihitaṃ vratam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The astonishing saint made the king to perform the entire procedure for the embracing of Sannyasa and admitted him into his own branch of Sannyasa. Then he bestowed the divine knowledge to him.

## \|\| 1.14.39 \|\|

*aśeṣavedasāraṃ tat paśupāśavimocanam \|*  
*antyāśramamiti khyātaṃ brahmādibhiranuṣṭhitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. He enlightened him on the theory of Pas'u (Individual soul) and Pasa (the binding noose of Avidya), the essence of all the Vedas, known as Antyasrama and is established by Brahma and others.

## \|\| 1.14.40-41 \|\|

*uvāca śiṣyān saṃprekṣya ye tadāśramavāsinaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān brahmacaryaparāyaṇān \|\| 40 \|\|*

*mayā pravartitāṃ śākhāmadhītyaiveha yoginaḥ \|*  
*samāsate mahādevaṃ dhyāyanto niṣkalaṃ śivam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Observing all his disciples living in that dsrama, he said, Those of the disciples viz. Brahmanas, Ksatriyas and Vaisyas who are performers of Brahmacarya, should study the branch initiated by me to become the Yogins and attain lord Visvesvara Shiva after meditating on the universe as the creation of the Lord.

## \|\| 1.14.42 \|\|

*iha devo mahādevo ramamāṇaḥ sahomayā \|*  
*adhyāste bhagavānīśo bhaktānāmanukampayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. This is the place, where lord Mahadeva, the god of gods, sporting with his consort Uma, lives with a desire to bless the devotees.

## \|\| 1.14.43 \|\|

*ihāśeṣajagaddhātā purā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*ārādhayanmahādevaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. In earlier times, lord Narayana, the preserver of entire world, had adored lord Mahadeva for the welfare of the people.

## \|\| 1.14.44 \|\|

*ihaiva devamīśānaṃ devānāmapi daivatam \|*  
*ārādhya mahatīṃ siddhiṃ lebhire devadānavāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. This is the place where the gods as well as the demons, adoring lord Shiva had met with enormous powers.

## \|\| 1.14.45 \|\|

*ihaiva munayaḥ pūrvaṃ marīcyādyā maheśvaram \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tapobalājjñānaṃ lebhire sārvakālikam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. It is here, that Marici and other sages, had perceived lord 3iva by the strength of their penances and achieved the everlasting knowledge.

## \|\| 1.14.46 \|\|

*tasmāt tvamapi rājendra tapoyogasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tiṣṭha nityaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Therefore, О best of the kings, you too stay here practising Yoga and penance. You should live with me, only then you shall achieve success.

## \|\| 1.14.47-48 \|\|

*evamābhāṣya viprendro devaṃ dhyātvā pinākinam \|*  
*ācacakṣe mahāmantraṃ yathāvat svārthasiddhaye \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ vedasāraṃ vimuktidam \|*  
*agnirityādikaṃ puṇyamṛṣibhiḥ saṃpravartitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Thus speaking, the excellent Brahmana, devoting his mind towards lord Shiva, the carrier of the Pinaka bow, for the achievement of all the success, advised him on the Agnimantra, which happens to be the remover of all the sins, the essence of all the Vedas, bestower of moksa, auspicious and practiced by the Rishis. This was done by him appropriately.

## \|\| 1.14.49 \|\|

*so 'pi tadvacanād rājā suśīlaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*sākṣāt pāśupato bhūtvā vedābhyāsarato 'bhavat \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. On hearing his words, the noble king having been filled with devotion, turning himself to be a Pasupata, engaged himself in the study of the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.14.50 \|\|

*bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaḥ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ \|*  
*śānto dānto jitakrodhaḥ saṃnyāsavidhimāśritaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The king then applied sacred ashes over his body, consumed roots and fruits of the forest, remaining extremely peaceful, overpowering the anger, embraced sannydsa appropriately.

## \|\| 1.14.51 \|\|

*havirdhānastathāgneyyāṃ janayāmāsa satsutam \|*  
*prācīnabarhiṣaṃ nāmnā dhanurvedasya pāragam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Havirdhana, produced a son from Agneyl who was known as Praclnabarhis, and he become quite proficient in Dhanurveda (science of archery).

## \|\| 1.14.52 \|\|

*prācīnabarhirbhāgavān sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*samudratanayāyāṃ vai daśa putrānajījanat \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Lord Praclnabarhis was the best among the carriers of the weapons. He produced ten sons from his wife Samudratanaya.

## \|\| 1.14.53 \|\|

*pracetasaste vikhyātā rājānaḥ prathitaijasaḥ \|*  
*adhītavantaḥ svaṃ vedaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. All of Ahem were quite strong and were known by the name of Pracetasas. They getting devoted to lord Narayana, studied their respective Vedas.

## \|\| 1.14.54 \|\|

*daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*dakṣo jajñe mahābhāgo yaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. From the ten Pracetas, the great Daksa Prajapati was bom from Marisa. He happened to be the first son of Brahma as well.

## \|\| 1.14.55 \|\|

*sa tu dakṣo maheśena rudreṇa saha dhīmatā \|*  
*kṛtvā vivādaṃ rudreṇa śaptaḥ prācetaso 'bhavat \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The intelligent Daksa, developing a controversy with Rudra Mahadeva, was cursed by Rudra and thereby became the son of Pracetas.

## \|\| 1.14.56-57 \|\|

*samāyāntaṃ mahādevo dakṣaṃ devyā gṛhaṃ haraḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā yathocitāṃ pūjāṃ dakṣāya pradadau svayam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tadā vai tamasāviṣṭaḥ so 'dikāṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*pūjāmanarhāmanvicchan jagāma kupito gṛham \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. Lord Shiva, finding Daksa arriving in his abode, himself adored him appropriately, but Daksa, the son of Brahma, infested with Tamo- Guna, had been immensely enraged at that time. Therefore, he thinking his adoration by Shiva to be improper, left the place burning with rage.

## \|\| 1.14.58-59 \|\|

*kadācit svagṛhaṃ prāptāṃ satīṃ dakṣaḥ sudurmanāḥ \|*  
*bhartrā saha vinindyaināṃ bhartsayāmasā vai ruṣā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*anye jāmātaraḥ śreṣṭhā bhartustava pinākinaḥ \|*  
*tvamapyasatsutāsmākaṃ gṛhād gaccha yathāgatam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Once when Sati had arrived in the house of Daksa, he started denouncing Shiva, in presence of Satl, with a sad mind in great anger. He uttered that his other sons-in-law were far better than Shiva. “You too are my evil daughter. Therefore you return to you abode in the same way as you have arrived.

## \|\| 1.14.60-61 \|\|

*tasya tadvākyamākarṇya sā devī śaṅkarapriyā \|*  
*vinindya pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ dadāhātmānamātmanā \|\| 60 \|\|*

*praṇamya paśubhartāraṃ bhartāraṃ kṛttivāsasam \|*  
*himavadduhitā sābhūt tapasā tasya toṣitā \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. At these words of Daksa, his own father, concentrating her mind in Shiva, who was clad in tiger skin and known as Pas'upati, the preserver of all, offering her salutation to him, she then burned herself. Thereafter, she was pleased with the penances of Himalaya and the same goddess was bom as the daughter of Himalaya.

## \|\| 1.14.62-63 \|\|

*jñātvā tadbhāgavān rudraḥ prapannārtiharo haraḥ \|*  
*śaśāpa dakṣaṃ kupitaḥ samāgatyātha tadgṛham \|\| 62 \|\|*

*tyaktvā dehamimaṃ brahman kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulodbhavaḥ \|*  
*svasyāṃ sutāyāṃ mūḍhātmā putramutpādayiṣyasi \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. On coming to know about the burning of Satl, lord Rudra, who removes the miseries of his devotees, getting enraged, pronounced a curse on Daksa in his owti house itself, “You abandoning away this body, bom of Brahma, shall be bom in Ksatriya race and engrossed with foolishness, shall produce a son from your own daughter.”

## \|\| 1.14.64 \|\|

*evamuktvā mahādevo yayau kālāsaparvatam \|*  
*svāyaṃbhuvo 'pi kālena dakṣaḥ prācetaso 'bhavat \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Thus speaking lord Mahadeva, returned to his abode in Mount Kailas'a. Daksa Svayambhuva, inspite of his being the son of Brahma, in due course of time was bom as the son of the Pracetas.

## \|\| 1.14.65 \|\|

*etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu \|*  
*visargaṃ dakṣaparyantaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Thus I have narrated the details about the creation from Svayambhuva Manu to Daksa. This story removes all the sins of the listeners.

## Chapter 15. Destruction of Daksa's Sacrifice

## \|\| 1.15.1-2 \|\|

*naimiṣīyā ūcuḥ*  
*devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām \|*  
*utpattiṃ vistarāt sūta brūhi vaivasvate 'ntare \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sa śaptaḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso nṛpaḥ \|*  
*kimakārṣonmahābuddhe śrotumicchāma sāṃpratam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. The hermtis of Naimisaranya said, “O Suta, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara, you kindly speak out in detail about the creation of the gods, Gandharvas, serpents and the Raksasas. When so cursed by Shiva, what did Daksha, the son of Pracetas, do thereafter? О Immensely intelligent one, we intend to listen everything from your mouth presently.”

## \|\| 1.15.3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*vakṣye nārāyaṇenoktaṃ pūrvakalpānuṣaṅgikam \|*  
*trikālabaddhaṃ pāpaghnaṃ prajāsargasya vistaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Suta said, in the earlier kalpa, the creation of the people related to the same period, had been spoken by Narayana himself which I am going to repeat out. It relieves of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.15.4 \|\|

*sa śaptaḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso nṛpaḥ \|*  
*vinindya pūrvavaireṇa gaṅgādvare 'yajad bhavam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Daksa, the Royal son of Pracetas, having been cursed in the earlier birth, because of his earlier enmity denouncing Shiva, performed a yajna (sacrifice) at Gangadvara in which Vishnu was adored as chief God.

## \|\| 1.15.5 \|\|

*devāśca sarve bhāgārthamāhūtā viṣṇunā saha \|*  
*sahaiva munibhiḥ sarvairāgatā munipuṅgavāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. All the gods along with Visnu were invoked in the yajna, for receiving their respective shares of the sacrifice. All the best of the Rishis accompanied with other sages arrived there.

## \|\| 1.15.6 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā devakulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śaṅkareṇa vināgatam \|*  
*dadhīco nāma viprarṣiḥ prācetasamathābravīt \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Finding the arrival of all the Gods except lord Shiva, the Brahmana sage Dadhica spoke to Pracetas (Daksa).

## \|\| 1.15.7 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca*  
*brahmādayaḥ piśācāntā yasyājñānuvidhāyinaḥ \|*  
*sa devaḥ sāṃprataṃ rudro vidhinā kiṃ na pūjyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Dadhica said, “Right from Brahma to Pisaca, every one adores lord Shiva. Why is the same lord Shiva being neglected in this yajna?

## \|\| 1.15.8-9 \|\|

*dakṣa uvāca*  
*sarveṣveva hi yajñeṣu na bhāgaḥ parikalpitaḥ \|*  
*na mantrā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ śaṅkarasyeti nejyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vihasya dakṣaṃ kupito vacaḥ prāha mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvajñānamayaḥ svayam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Daksa said, “His part has not been conceived in all the yajnas. Moreover, there are no mantras of Shiva with his spouse. Therefore Shiva cannot be adored here.” Then the sage Dadhica, possessing all the knowledge, laughed and spoke in anger, to all the gods, who kept on listening to him.

## \|\| 1.15.10 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca*  
*yataḥ pravṛttirviśveṣāṃ yaścāsya parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjyate sarvayajñairviditvā kila śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Dadhica said, “The one who pervades the entire world, the one who happens to be the soul of the universe, besides being Paramesvara, and is adored in all the yajnas, he is none else than lord Sankara. This fact is well known. But inspite of the same, why is he being neglected?”

## \|\| 1.15.11 \|\|

*na hyaṃ śaṅkaro rudraḥ saṃhartā tāmaso haraḥ \|*  
*nagnaḥ kapālī vikṛto viśvātmā nopapadyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Daksa said, “Rudra Shiva is not auspicious, he is a Tamasika god concerned with the destruction. He moves holding a human skull and is well known in this respect. Therefore it would be improper to call him the soul of the universe.

## \|\| 1.15.12 \|\|

*īśvaro hi jagatstraṣṭā prabhurnārāyaṇaḥ svarāṭ \|*  
*sattvātmako 'sau bhagavānijyate sarvakarmasu \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The all competent Narayana-Visnu happens to be Tsvara indeed, besides being the creator of the universe. The said lord possessing sattvagunas is adored in all the holy rites.”

## \|\| 1.15.13 \|\|

*dadhīca uvāca*  
*kiṃ tvayā bhagavāneṣa sahastrāṃśurna dṛśyate \|*  
*sarvalokaikasaṃhartā kālātmā parameśvaraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Dadhica said, “Are you unable to see lord Surya having a thousand rays. He is the only destroyer of all the lokas besides being Paramesvara in the form of Kala?

## \|\| 1.15.14-15 \|\|

*yaṃ gṛṇantīha vidvāṃso dhārmikā brahmavādinaḥ \|*  
*so 'yaṃ sākṣī tīvrarociḥ kālātmā śāṅkarītanuḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*eṣa rudro mahādevaḥ kaparde ca ghṛṇī haraḥ \|*  
*ādityo bhagavān sūryo nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The people speaking on Brahman and the religious people of wisdom offer prayer to him. He is the witness of all, he is the form of Kala, having enormous lustre, the sun infact is the body of lord Shiva. He also happens to be lord Rudra. He is kind-hearted and he is lord Aditya, the destroyer of all. The same lord is Nllakantha (blue-necked) and Vilohita (very ruddy).

## \|\| 1.15.16 \|\|

*saṃstūyate sahastrāṃśuḥ sāmagādhvaryuhotṛbhiḥ \|*  
*paśyainaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ rudramūrti trayīmayam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The same sun with a thousand rays is offered prayer by Adhvaryus1 and singer of of the Samaveda. You conceive him as Rudramurti, who is the creator of the three worlds.”

## \|\| 1.15.17 \|\|

*dakṣa uvāca*  
*ya ete dvādaśādityā āgatā yajñabhāginaḥ \|*  
*sarve sūryā iti jñeyā na hyānyo vidyate raviḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Daksa said, “The twelve Adityas have arrived to participate in the yajna. All of them are known as Surya. There is no other sun except them all.”

## \|\| 1.15.18 \|\|

*evamukte tu munayaḥ samāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ \|*  
*bāḍhamityabruvan vākyaṃ tasya sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. At these words of Daksa, all the sages, who had arrived to participate in the yajna, spoke supporting Daksha. “This is the fact.”

## \|\| 1.15.19-20 \|\|

*tamasāviṣṭamanaso na paśyanti vṛṣadhvajam \|*  
*sahastraśo 'tha śataśo bhūya eva vinindyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

*nindanto vaidikān mantrān sarvabhūtapatiṃ haram \|*  
*apūjayan dakṣavākyaṃ mohitā viṣṇumāyayā \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. They were unable to visualise because of ignorance that lord Shiva is having the bull- banner. Because of this, they kept on denouncing hundreds and thousand times lord Shiva, or even more than that. They kept on denouncing Vedic Mantras and Shiva, the lord of all the bhutas. They were influenced with the Maya of Visnu, they kept on supporting the words of Daksa.

## \|\| 1.15.21 \|\|

*devāśca sarve bhāgārthamāgatā vāsavādayaḥ \|*  
*nāpaśyan devamīśānamṛte nārāyaṇaṃ harim \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. At the same time, Indra and other gods also arrived to participate in the yajha. No one could find lord Shiva, except lord Hari.

## \|\| 1.15.22 \|\|

*hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. At the same time, Brahma-the best among those who were well-aware of Brahman, being Hiranyagarbha, suddenly disappeared from the scene.

## \|\| 1.15.23 \|\|

*antarhite bhagavati dakṣo nārāyaṇaṃ harim \|*  
*rakṣakaṃ jagatāṃ devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ svayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. At the disappearing of Brahma, Daksa himself took refuge with Narayana, the preserver of the universe.

## \|\| 1.15.24 \|\|

*pravartayāmāsa ca taṃ yajñaṃ dakṣo 'tha nirbhayaḥ \|*  
*rakṣate bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Daksa started the yajna fearlessly. Lord Visnu, who was the protector of those who took refuge with him, was his protector.

## \|\| 1.15.25 \|\|

*punaḥ prāha ca taṃ dakṣaṃ dadhīco bhagavānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*saṃprekṣyarṣigaṇān devān sarvān vai brahmavidviṣaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Dadhica, finding the gods and the sages antagonistic to lord Rudra, said to Daksa.

## \|\| 1.15.26 \|\|

*apūjyapūjane caiva pūjyānāṃ cāpyapūjane \|*  
*naraḥ pāpamavāpnoti mahad vai nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. A person earns enormous sin by neglecting adoration of the adorable person and adoring of the undesirable deities. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.15.27 \|\|

*asatāṃ pragraho yatra satāṃ caiva vimānanā \|*  
*daṇḍo devakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Where the people with falsehood are respected and the noble people are humiliated, there the punishing rod of the destiny surely falls.”

## \|\| 1.15.28 \|\|

*evamuktvā tu viprarṣiḥ śaśāpeśvaravidviṣaḥ \|*  
*samāgatān brāhmaṇāṃstān dakṣasāhāyyakāriṇaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thus speaking, the said Rsi Dadhica, pronounced a curse on the Brahmanas, who had arrived there and were envious of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.15.29-31 \|\|

*yasmād bahiṣkṛtā vedā bhavadbhiḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*vinindito mahādevaḥ śaṅkaro lokavanditaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyadhvaṃ trayībāhyāḥ sarve 'pīśvaravidviṣaḥ \|*  
*nindanto hyaiśvaraṃ mārgaṃ kuśāstrāsaktamānasāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*mithyādhītasamācārā mithyājñānapralāpinaḥ \|*  
*prāpya ghoraṃ kaliyugaṃ kalijaiḥ kila pīḍitāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. “Because you have driven out Paramesvara from the prescribed Vedic practices and have particularly humiliated lord Shiva who is adored by the universe, therefore all of you shall fall from the Vedic path Trayi (three Vedas) prescribed by lord Shiva. Those of the people under the influence of the false scriptures, their studies as well as their conduct and human behaviour shall be falsified. Even otherwise those possessing the false knowledge, reaching the age of terrific Kaliyuga, shall have to suffer from all the sides.

## \|\| 1.15.32 \|\|

*tyaktvā tapobalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ gacchadhvaṃ narakān punaḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati hṛṣīkeśaḥ svāśrito 'pi parāṅmukhaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. All of you discarding your entire tapas, will fall again in hell. Lord Hrslkes'a, with whom you have taken refuge, shall also desert you.

## \|\| 1.15.33 \|\|

*evamuktvā tu viprarṣirvirarāma taponidhiḥ \|*  
*jagāma manasā rudramaśeṣāghavināśanam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Thus speaking, the great Rsi, the ocean of tapas, stopped, and he mentally took refuge with lord Shiva, the destroyer of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.15.34 \|\|

*etasminnantare devī mahādevaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*patiṃ paśupatiṃ devaṃ jñātvaitat prāha sarvadṛk \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In the mean time, learning all this, the omniscient goddess Satl went to lord Mahadeva and apprised him of the factual position.

## \|\| 1.15.35 \|\|

*devyuvāca*  
*dakṣo yajñena yajate pitā me pūrvajanmani \|*  
*vinindya bhavato bhāvamātmānaṃ cāpi śaṅkara \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. She said, “Daksa, the father of my earlier birth is denouncing you, glorifying himself while performing a yajna.

## \|\| 1.15.36 \|\|

*devāḥ saharṣibhiścāsaṃstatra sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ \|*  
*vināśayāśu taṃ yajñaṃ varamekaṃ vṛṇomyaham \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Several of the great Rishis and the gods have assembled there for his help. Therefore, you atonce destroy that yajna. This is the boon I seek from you.”

## \|\| 1.15.37 \|\|

*evaṃ vijñāpito devyā devo devavaraḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*sasarja sahasā rudraṃ dakṣayajñajighāṃsayā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. When Sati so spoke to Shiva, lord Mahadeva transformed himself as Rudra for the destruction of the yajna of Daksa.

## \|\| 1.15.38-39 \|\|

*sahastraśīrṣapādaṃ ca sahastrākṣaṃ mahābhujam \|*  
*sahastrapāṇiṃ durdharṣaṃ yugāntānalasannibham \|\| 38 \|\|*

*daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam \|*  
*daṇḍahastaṃ mahānādaṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. The said Rudra had thousand heads, a thousand eyes, and great arms. He was enraged, terrific and looked like the fire at the time of dissolution. He had awful fangs. He was difficult to look at, holding conch, discus and club, holder of staff, creating deafening sound, and had smeared his body with ashes.

## \|\| 1.15.40 \|\|

*vīrabhadra iti khyātaṃ devadevasamanvitam \|*  
*sa jātamātro deveśamupatasthe kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. He possessed the lustre of Mahadeva and was known by the name of Virabhadra. Soon after his birth, he stood before Shiva with folded hands.

## \|\| 1.15.41 \|\|

*tamāha dakṣasya makhaṃ vināśaya śivostviti \|*  
*vinindya māṃ sa yajate gaṅgādvāre gaṇeśvara \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Shiva said, “Let you meet with welfare. Then he commanded Virabhadra for the destruction of Daksa's sacrifice, who is performing the sacrifice at Gangadvara, denouncing me.

## \|\| 1.15.42 \|\|

*tato bandhuprayuktena siṃhenaikena līlayā \|*  
*vīrabhadreṇa dakṣasya vināśamagamat kratuḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Thereafter, like a lion released from captivity, Virabhadra, destroyed the yajna of Daksa without much effort.

## \|\| 1.15.43 \|\|

*manyunā comayā sṛṣṭā bhadrakālī maheśvarī \|*  
*tayā ca sārdhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ samāruhya yayau gaṇaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. At that point of time, the goddess Mahesvari created Bhadrakall. The said Gana (the attendant Virabhadra), mounted over a bull, reached there.

## \|\| 1.15.44 \|\|

*anye sahastraśo rudrā nisṛṣṭāstena dhīmatā \|*  
*romajā iti vikhyātāstasya sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The intelligent one then created thousands of Rudras, who subsequently came to be known as Romajas or those bom of the hairpits in order to assist him.

## \|\| 1.15.45 \|\|

*śūlaśaktigadāhastāṣṭaṅkopalakarāstathā \|*  
*kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśā nādayanto diśo daśa \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Each one of them held tridents, Shakti and iron clubs in their hands. Some of the Rudras had sticks, pebbles and stones in their hands. All of them resembled the fire at the time of dissolution and they created sound, which was spread in all the ten directions.

## \|\| 1.15.46 \|\|

*sarve vṛṣāsanārūḍhāḥ sabhāryāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*samāvṛtya gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ yayurdakṣamakhaṃ prati \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. All the Rudras were accompanied with their spouses, were mounted over the bulls and had awful appearance. All those ganas marched forward towards the sacrifice of Daksa.

## \|\| 1.15.47 \|\|

*sarve śaṃprāpya taṃ deśaṃ gaṅgādvāramiti śrutam \|*  
*dadṛśuryajñadeśaṃ taṃ dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Reaching Gangadvara, they spotted the illustrious place of Daksa's sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.15.48 \|\|

*devāṅganāsahastrāḍhyamapsarogītanāditam \|*  
*vīṇāveṇuninādāḍhyaṃ vedavādābhināditam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The place of sacrifice had thousands of damsels there, where the sound of the songs by the apsaras rented the sky. The sweat music of flutes and lutes was being heard there. The sound of the Vedic mantras echoed in the sky.

## \|\| 1.15.49-51 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā saharṣibhirdevaiḥ samāsīnaṃ prajāpatim \|\| 49 \|\|*

*uvāca bhadrayā rudrairvorabhadraḥ smayanniva \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vayaṃ hyanucarāḥ sarve śarvasyāmitatejasaḥ \|*  
*bhāgābhilapsayā prāptā bhāgān yacchadhvamīpsitān \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. Finding Daksa there with the gods and the Rishis, Virabhadra spoke to the other Rudras. “All of us are the ganas of Shiva, possessing enormous strength, and have arrived here to receive our shares in the yajna. Therefore you grant desired shares to us.

## \|\| 1.15.52 \|\|

*atha cet kasyacidiyamājñā munisurottamāḥ \|*  
*bhāgo bhavadbhyo deyastu nāsmabhyamiti kathyatām \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О Best of the sages, at whose command this is being done? That the entire share of the sacrifice goes to you and not to us? You kindly tell us.”

## \|\| 1.15.53 \|\|

*taṃ brūtājñāpayati yo vetsyāmo hi vayaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*evamuktā gaṇeśena prajāpatipuraḥ sarāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. You also tell us about the person who commands you, to enable us to take care of him. Thus the Ganesvara spoke to Prajapati and all others.

## \|\| 1.15.54-55 \|\|

*devā ūcuh*  
*pramāṇaṃ vo na jānīmo bhāge mrā iti prabhum \|*  
*mantrā ūcuḥ surān yūyaṃ tamopahatacetasaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*ye nādhvarasya rājānaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtatanurharaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. The gods said, “The mantras fall as your share of the yajna but we are unaware about the related evidence.” At these words of the gods, the Mantras retaliated, “All of you having been overpowered with darkness, are not adoring lord Mahesvara. He happens to be Tsvara of all the living beings. Lord Нага is the lord of all the gods, who is adored in all the yajfias and bestows all the prosperity and the siddhis.”

## \|\| 1.15.56-57 \|\|

*pūjyate sarvayajñeṣu sarvābhyudasiddhidaḥ \|*  
*evamuktā apīśānaṃ māyayā naṣṭacetasaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*na menire yayurmantrā devān muktvā svamālayam \|*  
*tataḥ sa rudro bhagavān sabhāryaḥ sagaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. At these words of the Mantras gods, all of them were by the deluding potency of great god Shiva, and they did not agree to the words of the Mantras. The Mantras then discarded the gods and returned to their abodes.

## \|\| 1.15.58-59 \|\|

*spṛśan karābhyāṃ brahmarṣi dadhīcaṃ prāha devatāḥ \|*  
*mantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*yasmāt prasahya tasmād vo nāśayāmyadya garvitam \|*  
*ityuktvā yajñaśālāṃ tāṃ dadāha gaṇapuṅgavaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Thereafter accompanied with the Ganes'varas and his spouse Bhadrakall, lord Virabhadra touching the sage Dadhica with his hands, spoke to him, “being proud of your strength, you have not cared for the Vedic Mantras recited by the Rishis, therefore, I shall forcibly destroy all of you.” Thus speaking Virabhadra, the best of the Shivaganas, burnt out the place of yajna.

## \|\| 1.15.60 \|\|

*gaṇeśvarāśca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ \|*  
*prastotrā saha hotrā ca aśvaṃ caiva gaṇeśvarāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The other Ganes'varas, getting enraged, uprooted the pillars of yajnasala (sacrificial hall). All the terrific Ganesvaras, caught hold of Prastotr, Hotr (the priests) and the sacrificial horse and hurled them to the waters of the Ganga.

## \|\| 1.15.61-62 \|\|

*gṛhītvā bhīṣaṇāḥ sarve gaṅgāstrotasi cikṣipuḥ \|*  
*vīrabhadro 'pi dīptātmā śakrasyodyacchataḥ karam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*vyaṣṭambhayadadīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām \|*  
*bhagasya netre cotpāṭya karajāgreṇa līlayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Then Virabhadra with an illustrious body, paralysed the hands of Indra as he raised it to strike and did the same with other gods. Sportively he plucked out the eyes of Bhaga by the tip of his finger nails.

## \|\| 1.15.63-64 \|\|

*nihatya muṣṭinā dantān pūṣṇaścaivamapātayat \|*  
*tathā candramasaṃ devaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*dharṣayāmāsa balavān smayamāno gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*vahnerhastadvayaṃ chittvā jihvāmutpāṭya līlayā \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. He also broke the teeth of Pusan with the administering of a fist, which fell on the ground. Similarly the great warrior Virabhadra, smilingly, with the striking of the big toe, kicked the lord Moon without much efforts.

## \|\| 1.15.65 \|\|

*jaghāna mūrdhni pādena munīnapi munīśvarāḥ \|*  
*tathā viṣṇuṃ saharuḍaṃ samāyāntaṃ mahābalaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. О Munlsvaras, cutting both the hands of Agni, his tongue too was removed without much efforts. The other sages were also kicked with the feet.

## \|\| 1.15.66-69 \|\|

*vivyādha niśetairbāṇaiḥ stambhayitvā sudarśanam \|*  
*samālokya mahābāhurāgatya garuḍo gaṇam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*jaghāna pakṣaiḥ sahasā nanādāmbunidhiryathā \|*  
*tataḥ sahastraśo bhadraḥ sasarja garuḍān svayam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*vainateyādabhyadhikān garuḍaṃ te pradudruvuḥ \|*  
*tān dṛṣṭvā garuḍo dhīmān palāyata mahājavaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*visṛjya mādhavaṃ vegāt tadadbhutamivābhavat \|*  
*antarhite vainateye bhagavān padmasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

66-69. The great warrior made the Sudarsana Cakra of lord Visnu, who was arriving mounted on Garuda, inactive. Then he made him also inactive with the shooting of many arrows. Then Garuda having large arms, attacked Virabhadra with his wings and then started thundering like the ocean. Thereafter Rudra himself created thousands of Garudas who were more powerful than Garuda, the son of Vinata. They attacked Garuda. Finding this, the wise Garuda, leaving Visnu there, fled away from that place with great speed. This indeed was a surprise.

## \|\| 1.15.70 \|\|

*āgatya vārayāmāsa vīrabhadraṃ ca keśavam \|*  
*prasādayāmāsa ca taṃ gauravāt parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. With the disappearing of Garuda, lord Brahma reached there. He stopped Virabhadra and Kes'ava from fighting. Thereafter, both of them honouring the presence of Brahma, started appeasing each other.

## \|\| 1.15.71-72 \|\|

*saṃstūya bhagavānīśaḥ sāmbastatrāgamat svayam \|*  
*vīkṣya devādhidevaṃ taṃ sāmbaṃ sarvagaṇairvṛtam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*tuṣṭāva bhagavān brahmā dakṣaḥ sarve divaukasaḥ \|*  
*viśeṣāt pārvatīṃ devīmīśvarārdhaśarīriṇīm \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. At the same time Lord Sambhu arrived there praising Virabhadra and Visnu both. At that point of time, the lord of gods, having a look at the all virtuous Uma, lord Brahma, Daksa and all the gods, offered prayers to them. All of them particularly eulogised the goddess who had been the better half of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.15.73-74 \|\|

*stotrairnānāvidhairdakṣaḥ praṇamya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ \|*  
*tato bhagavatī devī prahasantī maheśvaram \|\| 73 \|\|*

*prasannamānasā rudraṃ vacaḥ prāha ghṛṇānidhiḥ \|*  
*tvameva jagataḥ straṣṭā śāsitā caiva rakṣakaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. Daksa offered his salutation to them with folded hands reciting prayers at the same time. Then the goddess Bhagavatl spoke smilingly to lord Shiva, “O ocean of kindness, you happen to be the creator of the universe, you exercise your control over the same and also protect it.

## \|\| 1.15.75-76 \|\|

*anugrāhyo bhagavatā dakṣaścāpi divaukasaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prahasya bhagavān kaparde nīlalohitaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*uvāca praṇatān devān prācetasamatho haraḥ \|*  
*gacchadhvaṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ prasanno bhavatāmaham \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. You should shower your grace over Daksha as well as other gods.” At this, the lord with matted locks of hair and blue-red complexion, started smiling. Then lord Shiva, spoke to the bowing gods, and Pracetas, “O Gods, Now you can leave. I am pleased with you.

## \|\| 1.15.77 \|\|

*saṃpūjyaḥ sarvayajñeṣu na nindyo 'haṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ cāpi śṛṇu me dakṣa vacanaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. You should adore me in all the yajnas appropriately. More particularly, you should never denounce me. О Daksa, you also listen to my words, which provide protection to all.

## \|\| 1.15.78 \|\|

*tyaktvā lokaiṣaṇāmetāṃ madbhakto bhava yatnataḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyasi gaṇeśānaḥ kalpānte 'nugrahānmama \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Getting free from worldly illusion, you are devoted to me making all the efforts and by so doing at the end of the present kalpa, you shall become the lord of Ganas.

## \|\| 1.15.79-80 \|\|

*tāvat tiṣṭha mamādeśāt svādhikāreṣu nirvṛtaḥ \|*  
*evamuktvā sa bhagavān sapatnīkaḥ sahānugaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*adarśanamanuprāpto dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ \|*  
*antarhite mahādeve śaṅkare padmasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. Till then at my command, getting free from your rights, you should continue in what you are authorised.” Thus speaking, accompanied with his wife as well as the Garias, lord Shiva disappeared from the sight of the illustrious Daksa. At the disappearing of lord Shiva, lord Brahma, bom of lotus, then spoke words which were beneficial for for the entire universe.

## \|\| 1.15.81-82 \|\|

*vyājahāra svayaṃ dakṣamaśeṣajagato hitam \|*  
*brahmovāca kiṃ tavāpagato mohaḥ prasanne vṛṣabhadhvaje \|\| 81 \|\|*

*yadācaṣṭa svayaṃ devaḥ pālayaitadatandritaḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ hṛdyeṣa vasatīśvaraḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. Brahma said, “When the bull-bannered Shiva has been pleased, then what is your delusion? The lord Shiva, getting delighted himself is protecting you, then why should you be agitated? The same Paramesvara dwells in the hearts of all the living beings.

## \|\| 1.15.83 \|\|

*paśyantyenaṃ brahmabhūtā vidvāṃso vedavādinaḥ \|*  
*sa ātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sa bījaṃ paramā gatiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. The people who are well-versed in the Vedas and being orators, they always have an audience with him. He is the soul of all the living beings. He alone serves as the seed for all. He happens to be the final goal.

## \|\| 1.15.84 \|\|

*stūyate vaidikairmantrairdevadevo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*tamarcayati yo rudraṃ svātmanyekaṃ sanātanam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Lord Mahesvara, the lord of gods, is always eulogised with the reciting of the Vedic mantras. Such of the people who adore the eternal Rudra with utmost devotion, they surely achieve the supreme position.

## \|\| 1.15.85-86 \|\|
