*cetasā bhāvayuktena sa yāti paramaṃ padam \|*  
*tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ vijñāya parameśvaram \|\| 85 \|\|*

*karmaṇā manasā vācā samārādhaya yatnataḥ \|*  
*yatnāt parihareśasya nindāmātmavināśanīm \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. Therefore, well-realising the lord Paramesvara who is beyond beginning, middle or end, should be adored by action, thought and behaviour making all the efforts. You should get rid of the denouncement of Shiva, making all the efforts, which could result into the self- destruction.

## \|\| 1.15.87 \|\|

*bhavanti sarvadoṣāya nindakasya kriyā yataḥ \|*  
*yastavaiṣa mahāyogī rakṣako viṣṇuravyayaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. All the activities of a person who denounces Shiva, result in earning of blemishes. The eternal MahayogI Visnu, who provides protection to all, is nobody else than the glorious god Rudra himself. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.15.88-90 \|\|

*sa devadevo bhagavān mahādevo na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*manyante ye jagadyoniṃ vibhinnaṃ viṣṇumīśvarāt \|\| 88 \|\|*

*mohādavedaniṣṭhatvāt te yānti narakaṃ narāḥ \|*  
*vedānuvartino rudraṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tathā \|\| 89 \|\|*

*ekībhāvena paśyanti muktibhājo bhavanti te \|*  
*yo viṣṇuḥ sa svayaṃ rudro yo rudraḥ sa janārdanaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

88-90. Such of the people who treat Visnu, the source of the origin of the universe, as separate from Lord Shiva, it is all due to delusion alone. Such of the people being ignorant to the Vedas, ultimately fall in. the hell. The people who follow the Vedas, they do not differentiate between Shiva and Visnu and achieve moksa. Lord Visnu is himself Rudra, while Rudra is Janardana himself.

## \|\| 1.15.91 \|\|

*iti matvā yajed devaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|*  
*sṛjatyetajjagat sarvaṃ viṣṇustat paśyatīśvaraḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Believing them both to be one, those who adore them they achieve the highest position. Lord Visnu creates the entire universe and Ishvara (Shiva) surveys and protects it.

## \|\| 1.15.92 \|\|

*itthaṃ jagat sarvamidaṃ rudranārāyaṇodbhavam \|*  
*tasmāt tyaktvā harernindāṃ viṣṇāvapi samāhitaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Thus the entire universe emerges from Rudra and Narayana together. Therefore discarding the denouncing of Hari, adoring lord Shiva, one should take refuge with Shiva, in whom the Brahmavadins (the expounder os Brahman) take refuge.

## \|\| 1.15.93-95 \|\|

*samāśrayenmahādevaṃ śaraṇyaṃ brahmavādinām \|*  
*upaśrutyātha vacanaṃ viriñcasya prajāpatiḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ gopatiṃ kṛttivāsasam \|*  
*ye 'nye śāpāgninirdagdhā dadhīcasya maharṣayaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*dviṣanto mohitā devaṃ saṃbabhūvuḥ kaliṣvatha \|*  
*tyaktvā tapobalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viprāṇāṃ kulasaṃbhavāḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. Listening to the words of Brahma, Daksa- Prajapati, sought refuge in the lord of the earth, god Shiva, clad in elephant's hide. Great sages who were burnt down by the fire of Dadhica’s curse became haters of god Shiva due to delusion. In due course, in the Kali age, they, being entirely bereft of the power of their penance, came to be bom again in Brahmana families because of the impressions in their previous life and the command of god Brahma.

## \|\| 1.15.96-98 \|\|

*pūrvasaṃskāramahātmyād brahmaṇo vacanādiha \|*  
*muktaśāpāstataḥ sarve kalpānte rauravādiṣu \|\| 96 \|\|*

*nipātyamānāḥ kālena saṃprāpyādityavarcasam \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ jagatāmīśamanujñātāḥ svayaṃbhuvā \|\| 97 \|\|*

*samārādhya tapoyogādīśānaṃ tridaśādhipam \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti yathā pūrvaṃ śaṅkarasya prasādataḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

96-98. Because of their having been cursed by the sage, they were thrown in Raurava and other hells till the end of the kalpa. In due course of time, they reaching Brahma, who had been illustrious like the sun, and at his command again adored lord Isana (Shiva), performing hard penances and by the grace of lord Shiva, the controller of the universe, they shall regain their lost position.

## \|\| 1.15.99 \|\|

*etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dakṣayajñaniṣūdanam \|*  
*śṛṇudhvaṃ dakṣaputrīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ caiva saṃtatim \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Thus I have narrated the complete story of the destruction of the sacrifice of Daksa. Now you listen about the daughters of Daksa and their progeny.

## Chapter 16. Progeny of Daksha\`s Daughters

## \|\| 1.16.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayaṃbhuvā \|*  
*sasarja devān gandharvān ṛṣīṃścaivāsuroragān \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta-the great sage said, “At the command of Svayambhuva lord, for the start of the creation, Daksa Prajapati initially created the gods, Gandharvas, Rishis, asuras, and the serpents.

## \|\| 1.16.2 \|\|

*yadāsya sṛjamānasya na vyavardhanta tāḥ prajāḥ \|*  
*tadā sasarja bhūtāni maithunenaiva dharmataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. But, in earlier times the creation of Daksa Prajapati, could not expand, then the living being were created with the sexual intercourse.

## \|\| 1.16.3 \|\|

*asiknyāṃ janayāmāsa vīraṇasya prajāpateḥ \|*  
*sutāyāṃ dharmayuktāyāṃ putrāṇāṃ tu sahastrakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He produced from the immensely religious daughter of Vlrana, known as AsikinI, a thousand sons.

## \|\| 1.16.4 \|\|

*teṣu putreṣu naṣṭeṣu māyayā nāradasya saḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭiṃ dakṣo 'sṛjat kanyā vairaṇyāṃ vai prajāpatiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. When those sons were destroyed with the illusion of Narada, then Daksa Prajapati again produced sixty daughters of Vlrini.

## \|\| 1.16.5 \|\|

*dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa \|*  
*viṃśat sapta ca somāya catastro 'riṣṭanemine \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Out of those sixty daughters, Daksa gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kasyapa,1 twenty seven to the Soma and four to Aristhanemi.

## \|\| 1.16.6 \|\|

*dve caiva bahuputrāya dve kṛśāśvāya dhīmate \|*  
*dve caivāṅgirase tadvat tāsāṃ vakṣye 'tha nistaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Two of them were given to Bahuputra, and two to the intelligent Krsas'va. Two were given to the sage Angiras. Now I shall deal with the expansion of their progeny.

## \|\| 1.16.7-8 \|\|

*arundhatī vasurjāmī lambā bhānurmarutvatī \|*  
*saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā ca bhāminī \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dharmapatnyo daśa tvetāstāsāṃ putrān nibodhata \|*  
*viśvāyā viśvadevāstu sādhyā sādhyānajījanat \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The names of the ten wives of Dharma were- Marutvati, Vasu, YamI, Lamba, Bhanu, Arundhatl, Sarhkalpa, Muhurta, Sadhya and Visva. Now you know about their sons. Visvedevas were bom to Visva, while Sadhya gave birth to the Sadhyas.

## \|\| 1.16.9 \|\|

*marutvanto marutvatyāṃ vasavo 'ṣṭau vasoḥ sutāḥ \|*  
*bhānostu bhānavaścaiva muhūrtā vai muhūrtajāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Mamtvatl produced Mamtvants and Vasu produced the eight Vasus. The Bhanus (Adityas) were bom of Bhanu and Muhurta gave birth to sons named Muhurtas.

## \|\| 1.16.10 \|\|

*lambāyāścātha ghoṣo vai nāgavīthī tu jāmijā \|*  
*pṛthivīviṣayaṃ sarvamarundatyāmajāyata \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Ghosa was bom of Lamba, while YamI gave birth to Nagavlthas. All the objects of Earth were produced by Arundhati.

## \|\| 1.16.11 \|\|

*saṃkalpāyāstu saṃkalpo dharmaputrā daśa smṛtāḥ \|*  
*ye tvanekavasuprāṇā devā jyotiḥpurogamāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A son named Sarhkalpa was bom of Sarhkalpa. In this way, these ten sons are said to have been bom to Dharma. I shall recount to you the family extension of those well-known Vasu-gods whose very life is wealth and who are the foremnners of luminaries.

## \|\| 1.16.12-13 \|\|

*vasavo'ṣṭau samākhyātāsteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi vistaram \|*  
*āpo dhruvaśca somaśca dharaścaivānilo 'nalaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo 'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*āpasya putro vaitaṇḍyaḥ śramaḥ śrānto dhunistathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Vasus are said to be eight in number. Now I shall speak about them in detail. Their names are Apa, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anala, Anila, Pratyusa, and Prabhasa. They are believed to be the eight Vasus. The Vasu named Apa had the sons known as Vaitandya, Srama, Santa and Dhvani.

## \|\| 1.16.14 \|\|

*dhruvasya putro bhagavān kālo lokaprakālanaḥ \|*  
*somasya bhagavān varcā dharasya draviṇaḥ sutaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Dhmva’s son was lord Kala, the calculator of the worlds. Varcas was the son of Soma and Dravina was the son of the Vasu known as Dhara.

## \|\| 1.16.15 \|\|

*manojavonilasyāsīdavijñātagatistathā \|*  
*kumāro hyanalasyāsīt senāpatiriti smṛtaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Anala was the fifth Vasu whose sons were Manojava and Avijnatagati. The son of Anila was known as Kumara-the chief of the army.

## \|\| 1.16.16 \|\|

*devalo bhagavān yogī pratyūṣasyābhavat sutaḥ \|*  
*viśvakarmā prabhāsasya śilpakartā prajāpatiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Devala, the great Yogi, was the son of Pratyusa. Prabhasa was the eighth Vasu, whose son was Visvakarman, a Prajapati and well- versed in architecture.

## \|\| 1.16.17-21 \|\|

*aditirditirdanustadvadariṣṭā surasā tathā \|*  
*surabhirvinatā caiva tāmra krodhavaśā irā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kadrurmuniśca dharmajñā tatputrān vai nibodhata \|*  
*aṃśo dhātā bhagastvaṣṭā mitro 'tha varuṇor'yamā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vivasvān savitā pūṣā hyaṃśumān viṣṇureva ca \|*  
*tuṣitā nāma te pūrvaṃ cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*vaivasvate 'ntare proktā ādityāścāditeḥ sutāḥ \|*  
*ditiḥ putradvayaṃ lebhe kaśyapād balasaṃyutam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*hiraṇyakaśipuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathāparam \|*  
*hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo mahābalaparākramaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. Their daughters were known as Aditi, Diti, Danu, Arista, Surasa, Surabhi, Vinata, Tamra, Krodhavasa, Ira, Kadru, Muni and Dharmajna. You also know about their sons. The sons of Aditi were Amsa, Dhatr, Bhaga, Tvastr, Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman, Vivasvan, Savitr, Pusan, Amsuman and Visnu. They were known by the names of Tusitas and lived in the Caksusha Manvantara. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara, Ййу are called Adityas (as they were sons of Aditi). Diti in union with Kasyapa produced two valorous sons. The elder of them was known as Hiranyakasipu and the younger one was known as Hiranyaksa. The Daitya known as Hiranyakasipu possessed enormous prowess and was immensely strong.

## \|\| 1.16.22 \|\|

*ārādhya tapasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvālebhevarān divyān stutvāsau vividhaiḥ stavai \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Hiranyakasipu performing hard tapas pleased lord Brahma. He eulogised him reciting several stotras and was bestowed with the divine boons.

## \|\| 1.16.23-24 \|\|

*atha tasya balād devāḥ sarva eva surarṣayaḥ \|*  
*bādhitāstāḍitā jagmurdevadevaṃ pitāmaham \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sarvajaganmayam \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ lokakartāraṃ trātāraṃ puruṣaṃ param \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. In due course of time, all the ascetics started suffering from his prowess beyond measure. They then went to lord Brahma, who provides protection to all, besides being the protector god, creator of the lokas, the great being, the motionless unchangeable Supreme Soul and the sole Purusottama of the world.

## \|\| 1.16.25-27 \|\|

*kūṭasthaṃ jagatāmekaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam \|*  
*sa yācito devavarairmunibhiśca munīśvarāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sarvadevahitārthāya jagāma kamalāsanaḥ \|*  
*saṃstūyamānaḥ praṇatairmunīndrairamarairapi \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kṣīrodasyottaraṃ kūlaṃ yatrāste harirīśvaraḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā devaṃ jagadyoniṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaguruṃ śivam \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. When so prayed by the sages and the gods bowing in reverence, then lotus-seated Brahma for the welfare of all the gods, went to the northern shore of the ocean of milk, where lord Hari had been sleeping over the serpent bed. At the sight oflord Visnu, who provides welfare to all, Brahma bowed in reverence at his lotus like feet with both the hands folded.

## \|\| 1.16.28-29 \|\|

*vavande caraṇau mūrdhnā kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata \|*  
*brahmovāca tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāmananto 'syakhilātmakaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*vyāpī sarvāmaravapurmahāyogī sanātanaḥ \|*  
*tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ parā \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Brahma said, “O Lord you are the activity of all the living beings. You are endless, and are the form of the entire universe. You are omniscient, all the gods represent your body. You are a great yogi and eternal. You are the soul of all the bhutas. You are also the supreme Prakrti.

## \|\| 1.16.30 \|\|

*vairāgyaiśvaryanirato rāgātīto nirañjanaḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ kartā caiva bhartā ca nihantā suravidviṣām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. You are always engaged in detachment and prosperity. You are beyond speech. You are unblemished. You are the creator of the universe besides being its preserver. You are the destroyer of demons, the enemies of the gods.

## \|\| 1.16.31 \|\|

*trātumarhasyananteśa trātā hi parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*itthaṃ sa viṣṇurbhagavān brahmaṇā saṃprabodhitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О Endless one, О Isa, you can only protect at the moment. О Paramesvara, you are our protector.” In this way Brahma, prayed to Visnu appropriately.

## \|\| 1.16.32 \|\|

*provāconnidrapadmākṣaḥ pītavāsāsuradviṣaḥ \|*  
*kimarthaṃ sumahāvīryāḥ saprajāpatikāḥ surāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О Brahmanas, then lord Visnu, waking up, possessing the eyes like the fully blossomed lotus flowers, yellow-clothed, spoke to the gods, “O Valorous gods, what for have you arrived here in this country with Brahma, the Prajapati? or otherwise what should I do for you?”

## \|\| 1.16.33-34 \|\|

*imaṃ deśamanuprāptāḥ kiṃ vā kāryaṃ karomi vaḥ \|*  
*devā ūcuḥ hiraṇyakaśipurnāma brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*bādhate bhagavan daityo devān sarvān saharṣibhiḥ \|*  
*avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvāmṛte puruṣottama \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. The gods said, “Because of the boon from Brahma, Hiranyakasipu has become arrogant. О Lord, the said Daitya is causing pains to ascetics and the gods. He is invincible except from you.

## \|\| 1.16.35-39 \|\|

*hantumarhasi sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ trātāsi jaganmaya \|*  
*śrutvā taddaivatairuktaṃ sa viṣṇurlokabhāvanaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vadhāya daityamukhyasya so 'sṛjat puruṣaṃ svayam \|*  
*meruparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ taṃ prāha garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*hatvā taṃ daityarājaṃ tvaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ punaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*imaṃ deśaṃ samāgantuṃ kṣipramarhasi pauruṣāt \|*  
*niśamya vaiṣṇavaṃ vākyaṃ praṇamya puruṣottamam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*mahāpuruṣamavyaktaṃ yayau daityamahāpuram \|*  
*vimuñcan bhairavaṃ nādaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

35-39. О Universal lord, you are the protector of all. Therefore he has to be killed.” Listening to the words of the gods, Visnu, the protector of the universe, himself created a being, like himself, for the killing of the Daitya. His body resembled the Sumeru mountain, had a terrific form, and held in his hands, the conch, discus and iron- club. Then Lord Visnu said to him. “With your prowess, you kill Hiranyakasipu, the lord of the Daityas and then return to this country.” Listening to the words of lord Visnu, he offered his salutation to lord Visnu. Thereafter, holding the Sankha, Cakra and Gada and creating thundering sound, he moved towards the place of the Daitya.

## \|\| 1.16.40 \|\|

*āruhya garuḍaṃ devo mahāmerurivāparaḥ \|*  
*ākarṇya daityapravarā mahāmegharavopamam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. He mounted over Garuda, who appeared like another Sumeru mountain. Listening to thundering sound resembling the rumbling sound of a great cloud, even the great Daityas together with Hiranyakasipu, started creating their thundering sound simultaneously, feeling panicky.

## \|\| 1.16.41-43 \|\|

*samācacakṣire nādaṃ tadā daityapaterbhayāt \|*  
*asurā ūcuḥ kaścidāgacchati mahān puruṣo devacoditaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*vimuñcan bhairavaṃ nādaṃ taṃ jānīmo 'marārdana \|*  
*tataḥ sahāsuravarairhiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*saṃnaddhaiḥ sāyudhaiḥ putraiḥ prahrādādyaistadā yayau \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā taṃ garuḍāsīnaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. The asuras said, “Some great person is arriving at the inspiration of the gods and is thundering aloud. Therefore he appears as Janardana to us.” Thereafter the best of the asura and Hiranyakasipu became alert. They carried all the weapons with them. Prahlada also was associated with them. At the same time, Hiranyakas'ipu also arrived there with his sons and he spotted the lord Visnu having the lustre of crores of suns, mounted over Garuda.

## \|\| 1.16.44 \|\|

*puruṣaṃ parvatākāraṃ nārāyaṇamivāparam \|*  
*dudruvuḥ kecidanyonmamūcuḥ saṃbhrāntalocanāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The said person was of a gigantic size of a mountain. Finding him there many of the Daityas took to their heels getting frightened. The others started talking with one another in confusion.

## \|\| 1.16.45 \|\|

*ayaṃ sa devo devānāṃ goptā nārāyaṇo ripuḥ \|*  
*asmākamavyayo nūnaṃ tatsuto vā samāgataḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. He is the same Narayanadeva, who is the protector of the gods and our enemy. Surely he happens to be his son who has arrived here.

## \|\| 1.16.46 \|\|

*ityuktvā śastravarṣāṇi sasṛjuḥ puruṣāya te \|*  
*sa tāni cākṣato devo nāśayāmāsa līlayā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thus talking among themselves, they attacked that person with their arrows, but the imperishable God playfully destroyed those weapons.

## \|\| 1.16.47 \|\|

*hiraṇyakaśipo putraschatvarah prathitaujasaḥ \|*  
*putrā nārāyaṇodbhūtaṃ yuyudhurmeghaniḥ svanāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. At that point of time, the four illustrious sons of Hiranyakasipu, thundering like the clouds, started fighting.

## \|\| 1.16.48-49 \|\|

*prahrādaścāpyanuhrādaḥ saṃhrādo hrāda eva ca \|*  
*prahrādaḥ prāhiṇod brāhmamanuhrādo 'tha vaiṣṇavam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*saṃhrādaścāpi kaumāramāgneyaṃ hrāda eva ca \|*  
*tāni taṃ puruṣaṃ prāpya catvāryastrāṇi vaiṣṇavam \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. All the four of them, Prahrada, Anuhrada, Sarhhrada and Hrada arrived there. Out of them Prahrada held Brahmastra, Anuhrada held Vaisnavastra, Sarhhrada hurled the Kaumarastra and Hrada discharged the Agneyastra, which were shot by them. But those weapons, reaching that Purusa, could not frighten him even in a slightest way.

## \|\| 1.16.50-53 \|\|

*na śekurbādhituṃ viṣṇuṃ vāsudevaṃ yathā tathā \|*  
*athāsau caturaḥ putrān mahābāhurmahābalaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*pragṛhya pādeṣu karaiḥ saṃcikṣepa nanāda ca \|*  
*vimukteṣvatha putreṣu hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pādena tāḍayāmāsa vegenorasi taṃ balī \|*  
*sa tena pīḍito 'tyarthaṃ garuḍena tathā'śugaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*adṛśyaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ yatra nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa pravṛttamakhilaṃ tathā \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. Thereafter the immensely valorous Visnu- Purusa, caught hold of the legs of the four sons of Hiranyakasipu, threw them away and then thundered aloud. When the sons of the Daitya king were so thrown away, Hiranyakasipu himself arrived there and forcefully kicked the Visnu-Purusa over his chest. The said Purusa, together with Garuda and his other followers felt extremely painful and then disappeared to the place of Narayana. After going unto him, he narrated all the happenings to Narayana.

## \|\| 1.16.54 \|\|

*saṃcintya manasā devaḥ sarvajñānamayo 'malaḥ \|*  
*narasyārdhatanuṃ kṛtvā siṃhasyārdhatanuṃ tathā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Lord Visnu possessing all the knowledge thought with a spotless mind and turned himself in the form of half human and half lion.

## \|\| 1.16.55 \|\|

*nṛsiṃhavapuravyakto hiraṇyakaśipoḥ pure \|*  
*āvirbabhūva sahasā mohayan daityapuṅgavān \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Then taking to the form of Narasuhha, the lord reached the place of Hiranyakasipu. Then confusing the Daityas and Danavas, he suddenly appeared there.

## \|\| 1.16.56-57 \|\|

*daṃṣṭrākarālo yogātmā yugāntadahanopamaḥ \|*  
*samāruhyātmanaḥ śaktiṃ sarvasaṃhārakārikām \|\| 56 \|\|*

*bhāti nārāyaṇo 'nanto yathā madhyandine raviḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ prahrādaṃ jyeṣṭhaputrakam \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. Не had awful fangs, but still his form Yogic. He looked at that time like the fire at time of dissolution. Invoking his fully destructible Shakti, Narayana, the form of Ananta (infinite), appeared like the sun of the noon time.

## \|\| 1.16.58-59 \|\|

*vadhāya prerayāmāsa narasihasya so 'suraḥ \|*  
*imaṃ nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ pūrvasmād bahuśaktikam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sahaiva tvanujaiḥ sarvairnāśayāśu mayeritaḥ \|*  
*tatsaṃniyogādasuraḥ prahrādo viṣṇumavyayam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Finding Nrsimha Purusa there, Hiranyakasipu asked his elder son to face him. He said that Nrsimha is of less strength than the earlier one, therefore at my command all of you should face him and kill him at the same time.

## \|\| 1.16.60 \|\|

*yuyudhe sarvayatnena narasiṃhena nirjitaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ saṃcodito daityo hiraṇyākṣastadānujaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Then at the command of his father, Prahrada started fighting with Visnu, but was conquered by him. Then the daitya fainted. He then dispatched his younger brother, Hiranyaksa. At the same time the younger brother Hiranyaksa meditated and discharged the miraculous weapon Pasupati and started roaring aloud.

## \|\| 1.16.61-63 \|\|

*dhyātvā paśupaterastraṃ sasarja ca nanāda ca \|*  
*tasya devādidevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*na hānimakarodastraṃ yathā devasya śūlinaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā parāhataṃ tvastraṃ prahrādo bhāgyagauravāt \|\| 62 \|\|*

*mene sarvātmakaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*saṃtyajya sarvaśastrāṇi sattvayuktena cetasā \|\| 63 \|\|*

61-63. But the weapon of Shiva, the carrier of the trident, shot by him could do no harm to Visnu. Thus finding the weapon becoming infractuous, because of the glory of the destiny Prahrada realized that he is the eternal lord Vasudeva, the soul of all.

## \|\| 1.16.64 \|\|

*nanāma śirasā devaṃ yogināṃ hṛdayeśayam \|*  
*stutvā nārāyaṇaiḥ stotraiḥ ṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Then, he with the mind crowned with Sattva- guna, dropped all the weapons, and offered his salutation to lord Visnu, who dwells in the hearts of the Yogins. He praised lord Narayana with hymns of Rk, Yaju, and Sama.

## \|\| 1.16.65 \|\|

*nivārya pitaraṃ bhrātṛn hiraṇyākṣaṃ tadābravīt \|*  
*ayaṃ nārāyaṇo 'nantaḥ śāśvato bhagavānajaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. He prevented his father, brothers and Hiranyaksa, and said that He is Lord Narayana, the unborn and eternal one.

## \|\| 1.16.66 \|\|

*purāṇapuruṣo devo mahāyogī jaganmayaḥ \|*  
*ayaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca svayañjyotirnirañjanaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. He is the Lord, the ancient Person, great Yogin, the soul of the universe. He is creator and dispencer of the destiny and he himself is self illumining besides being spotless.

## \|\| 1.16.67 \|\|

*pradhānapuruṣastattvaṃ mūlaprakṛtiravyayaḥ \|*  
*īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmantaryāmī guṇātigaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. He is Pradhana, as well as Purusa, the ultimate Reality, the form of unchanging Mula- Prakrti, the lord of all the living beings, he moves in the minds of all, and is beyond the reach of gunas. Therefore, all of you should take refuge in invisible and indestructible Visnu.

## \|\| 1.16.68-69 \|\|

*gacchadhvamenaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumavyaktamavyayam \|*  
*evamukte sudurbuddhirhiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*provāca putramatyarthaṃ mohito viṣṇumāyayā \|*  
*ayaṃ sarvātmanā vadhyo nṛsiṃho 'lpaparākramaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. At these words of Prahlada, Hiranyakasipu- the evil minded one, having been influenced with the Maya of Visnu, said to his son- “This Nrsirhha, devoid of strength has to be killed on all accounts. He has arrived here at the instance of the god of death.”

## \|\| 1.16.70-71 \|\|

*samāgato 'smadbhavanamidānīṃ kālacoditaḥ \|*  
*vihasya pitaraṃ putro vacaḥ prāha mahāmatiḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*mā nindasvainamīśānaṃ bhūtānāmekamavyayam \|*  
*kathaṃ devo mahādevaḥ śāśvataḥ kālavarjitaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. The extremely wise son said to his father, smilingly. “Don't denounce him, He happens to be Is'vara of all the living beings, besides being indestructible. He is everlasting Mahadeva and is beyond time.

## \|\| 1.16.72-74 \|\|

*kālena hanyate viṣṇuḥ kālātmā kālarūpadhṛk \|*  
*tataḥ suvarṇakaśipurdurātmā vidhicoditaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*nivārito 'pi putreṇa yuyodha harimavyayam \|*  
*saṃraktanayano 'nto hiraṇyanayanāgrajam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*nakhairvidārayāmāsa prahrādasyaiva paśyataḥ \|*  
*hate hiraṇyakaśipau hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. He is Visnu, the form of Kala. Therefore Kala can do no harm to him. Thereafter, the wicked Hiranyakasipu, much against the advice of Prahlada under the influence of Kala, started fighting with the everlasting lord Visnu. Then lord Ananta, with red eyes tore out the elder brother of Hiranyaksa (i.e. Hiranyakas'ipu) with his nails.

## \|\| 1.16.75-76 \|\|

*visṛjya putraṃ prahrādaṃ dudruve bhayavihvalaḥ \|*  
*anuhrādādayaḥ putrā anye ca śataśo 'surāḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*nṛsiṃhadehasaṃbhūtaiḥ siṃhairnotā yamālayam \|*  
*tataḥ saṃhṛtya tadrūpaṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. At the death of Hiranyakas'ipu the immensely valorous Hiranyaksa, getting frightened, deserting his son (i.e. nephew) Prahlada fled away from the place. Then Anuhrada and other sons of the Daitya king were dispatched to the abode of Yama,1 by the lions, which emerged out of the body of Narasimha. Thereafter lord Visnu withdrew his Narasimha form.

## \|\| 1.16.77-78 \|\|

*svameva paramaṃ rūpaṃ yayau nārāyaṇāhvayam \|*  
*gate nārāyaṇe daityaḥ prahrādo 'surasattamaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*abhiṣekeṇa yuktena hiraṇyākṣamayojayat \|*  
*sa bādhayāmāsa surān raṇe jitvā munīnapi \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. Then he himself took again to his own real majestic form of Narayana. After the departure of Narayana, Prahlada then crowned Hiranyaksa as the king of the Daityas. He also harassed the sages and the gods conquering them.

## \|\| 1.16.79 \|\|

*labdhvāndhakaṃ mahāputraṃ tapasārādhya śaṅkaram \|*  
*devāñjitvā sadevendrān badhvāca dharaṇīmimām \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Не adored Shiva, performing severe tapas and got a great son named Andhaka, who conquering Indrajit and others, created agitation on the earth.

## \|\| 1.16.80 \|\|

*nītvā rasātalaṃ cakre vandīmindīvaraprabhām \|*  
*tataḥ sabrahmakā devāḥ parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Thereafter he carried the Vedas in the nether- worlds and made them infructuous. Consequently the faces of Brahma and all other gods faded out.

## \|\| 1.16.81 \|\|

*gatvā vijñāpayāmāsurviṣṇave harimandiram \|*  
*sa cintayitvā viśvātmā tadvadhopāyamavyayaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. All the gods then went to the abode of Vishnu and informed him about the painful situation. Then Visnu, the soul of the universe and the everlasting lord, thought about the means for the destruction of the demon.

## \|\| 1.16.82 \|\|

*sarvedevamayaṃ śubhraṃ vārāhaṃ vapurādadhe \|*  
*gatvā hiraṇyanayanaṃ hatvā taṃ puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. For that purpose, lord Purusottama (Visnu) took to the form of Sveta Varaha (white boar) embodying within it the power of all devas and killed Hiranyaksa.

## \|\| 1.16.83 \|\|

*daṃṣṭrayoddhārayāmāsa kalpādau dharaṇīmimām \|*  
*tyaktvā varāhasaṃsthānaṃ saṃsthāpya ca suradvijān svāmeva prakṛtiṃ divyāṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ paraṃ padam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Then at the beginning of the kalpa, he redeemed the earth, which had been submerged in water, carrying it over the tip of his tusk. Thereafter killing the enemies of the gods, he discarded his Varaha form.

## \|\| 1.16.84-85 \|\|

*tyaktvā varāhasaṃsthānaṃ saṃsthāpya ca suradvijān svāmeva prakṛtiṃ divyāṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ paraṃ padam \|*  
*tasmin hate 'mararipau prahrādau viṣṇutatparaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*apālayat svakaṃrājyaṃ bhāvaṃ tyaktvā tadā'suram \|*  
*iyāja vidhivad devān viṣṇorārādhane rataḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Then depending on his own divine Prakrti, lord Visnu reached his Supreme eternal abode. At the killing of Hiranyaksa, the enemy of the gods, Prahlada- the devotee of lord Visnu, discarded the demonic temperament and started serving the people as their ruler. Getting devoted to Visnu, he duly performed the yajnas quite appropriately.

## \|\| 1.16.86 \|\|

*niḥ sapatnaṃ tadā rājyaṃ tasyāsīd viṣṇuvaibhavāt \|*  
*tataḥ kadācidasuro brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhamāgatam \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. By the grace of lord Visnu, his kingdom was always without enemies. In due course of time, a Brahmana arrived in his abode.

## \|\| 1.16.87 \|\|

*tāpasaṃ nārcayāmāsa devānāṃ caiva māyayā \|*  
*sa tena tāpaso 'tyarthaṃ mohitenāvamānitaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. But influenced with the illusion of the gods, the Brahmana was not welcomed by Prahlada appropriately. Thus because of the arrogance of his being a ruler, the Brahmana was humiliated.

## \|\| 1.16.88-89 \|\|

*śaśāpāsurarājānaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ \|*  
*yattadvalaṃ samāśritya brāhmaṇānavamanyase \|\| 88 \|\|*

*sā bhaktirvaiṣṇavī divyā vināśaṃ te gamiṣyati \|*  
*ityuktvā prayayau tūrṇaṃ prahrādasya gṛhād dvijaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. Because of the insult, the Brahmana with his eyes red in anger pronounced a curse on the demon king. “You are disregarding and dishonouring the Brahmanas by resorting to your Vaisnavi Shakti. That power of yours will be destroyed.” Thus speaking, the Brahmana atonce left the place of Prahlada.

## \|\| 1.16.90-92 \|\|

*mumoha rājyasaṃsaktaḥ so 'pi śāpabalāt tataḥ \|*  
*bādhayāmāsa viprendrān na viveda janārdanam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*piturvadhamanusmṛtya krodhaṃ cakre hariṃ prati \|*  
*tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇasya devasya prahrādasyāmaradviṣaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā tu sumahad yuddhaṃ viṣṇunā tena nirjitaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

90-92. Because he was eagerly attached to the kingdom he was deluded due to the force of the curse. He began to harass the leading Brahmanas. He did not understand Visnu. Not only this, Prahlada getting reminded of the killing of his father, felt enraged. Because of this, a terrific war was fought between Narayana and Prahlada, the enemv of the gods. By waging such a great war he was defeated at the hands of Visnu.

## \|\| 1.16.93 \|\|

*purvasaṃskāramāhātmyāt parasmin puruṣe harau \|*  
*saṃjātaṃ tasya vijñānaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. At that point of time, because of the glory of his earlier samskaras, the divine knowledge about lord Hari dawned on him. Then he reached before Hari to take refuge with him.

## \|\| 1.16.94 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhṛti daityendro hyananyāṃ bhaktimudvahan \|*  
*nārāyaṇe mahāyogamavāpa puruṣottame \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Since that time, the king of the Daityas became immensely devoted to lord Hari, the most excellent of all Purusas and attained Yoga.

## \|\| 1.16.95 \|\|

*hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putre yogasaṃsaktacetasi \|*  
*avāpa tanmahad rājyamandhako 'surapuṅgavaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Thus when the mind of Prahlada, the son of Hiranyakas'ipu, was so devoted to Yoga, then Andhaka, the great demon, usurped his kingdom which was quite vast.

## \|\| 1.16.96 \|\|

*hiraṇyanetratanayaḥ śaṃbhordehasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*mandarasthāmumāṃ devīṃ cakame parvatātmajām \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Because of his birth from the body of Shiva, the son of Hiranyaksa, became desirous of Uma, the daughter of the mountain stationed at Mandracala mountain.

## \|\| 1.16.97 \|\|

*purā dāruvane puṇye munayo gṛhamedhinaḥ \|*  
*īśvarārādhanārthāya tapaśceruḥ sahastraśaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. In earlier times, thousands of house-holder sages were performing penance in order to propitiate Ishvara, in the auspicious Daruvana (pine forest).

## \|\| 1.16.98 \|\|

*tataḥ kadācinmahati kālayogena dustarā \|*  
*anāvṛṣṭiratīvogrā hyāsīd bhūtavināśinī \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Once a terrific draught which was destroyer of all the living beings occurred in that country. There were no rains at all for a long time.

## \|\| 1.16.99 \|\|

*sametya sarve munayo gautamaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim \|*  
*ayācanta kṣudhāviṣṭā āhāraṃ prāṇadhāraṇam \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Then the people of that place went to sage Gautama and demanded from him the food to maintain their lives.

## \|\| 1.16.100 \|\|

*sa tebhyaḥ pradadāvannaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bahutaraṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*sarve bubujire viprā nirviśaṅkena cetasā \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. The intelligent Gautama, served enough of food to all the people who had arrived there. All the Brahmanas took food with Gautama, without any doubt.

## \|\| 1.16.101 \|\|

*gate tu dvādaśe varṣe kalpānta iva śaṅkarī \|*  
*babhūva vṛṣṭirmahatī yathāpūrvamabhūjjagat \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. After the period of twelve years, which was like the time of dissolution, the rain of welfare was showered and the world was filled with grain as before.

## \|\| 1.16.102-103 \|\|

*tataḥ sarve munivarāḥ samāmantrya parasparam \|*  
*maharṣi gautamaṃ procurgacchāma iti vegataḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*nivārayāmāsa ca tān kañcit kālaṃ yathāsukham \|*  
*uṣitvā madgṛhe 'vaśyaṃ gacchadhvamiti paṇḍitāḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. All the sages then in consultations among themselves, said to the sage Gautama, “We intend to leave this place shortly.” Gautama then stopped the Brahmanas, saying, “You please continue to stay in my house comfortably for some time more, after which you can go.”

## \|\| 1.16.104 \|\|

*tato māyāmayīṃ sṛṣṭvā kṛśāṃ gāṃ sarva eva te \|*  
*samīpaṃ prāpayāmāsugautamasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. Then the Brahmanas created an illusory black cow and drove her near to the noble-souled sage Gautama.

## \|\| 1.16.105 \|\|

*so 'nuvīkṣya kṛpāviṣṭastasyāḥ saṃrakṣaṇotsukaḥ \|*  
*goṣṭhe tāṃ bandhayāmāsa spṛṣṭamātrā mamāra sā \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Looking at the cow, Gautama was filled with compassion and keeping in view her protection he lodged her in the cowpen. But because of her being an illusory one, she died with the simple touch.

## \|\| 1.16.106 \|\|

*sa śokenābhisaṃtaptaḥ kāryākāryaṃ mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*na paśyati sma sahasā tādṛśaṃ munayo 'bruvan \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Finding her to be dead, the great sage was filled with grief and feeling non-plussed, he was unable to take a decision. Then suddenly the sages spoke to the Rsi Gautama.

## \|\| 1.16.107 \|\|

*govadhyeyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha yāvat tava śarīragā \|*  
*tāvat te 'nnaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ gacchāmo vayameva hi \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. “You have attracted the sin of killing of a cow, therefore till such time this great sin continues to engulf you body, we shall not be able to take food from you. Therefore we are leaving this place.

## \|\| 1.16.108 \|\|

*tena te muditāḥ santo devadāruvanaṃ śubham \|*  
*jagmuḥ pāpavaśaṃ nītāstapaścartuṃ yathā purā \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. After getting permission from the sage Gautama, all the Brahmanas proceeded on to the auspicious Devadaru forest, in order to perform penance as before.

## \|\| 1.16.109 \|\|

*sa teṣāṃ māyayā jātāṃ govadhyāṃ gautamo muniḥ \|*  
*kenāpi hetunā jñātvā śaśāpātīvakopanaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. The sage Gautama some how came to know of the trick played by the Brahmanas with the creation of an illusory cow. He was filled with rage and pronounced a curse on them.

## \|\| 1.16.110 \|\|

*bhaviṣyanti trayībāhyā mahāpātakibhiḥ samāḥ \|*  
*babhūvuste tathā śāpājjāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. He declared, “You people shall be devoid of the three Vedas and shall become like the grave sinners.” Because of this curse, the Brahmanas, faced rebirth again and again.

## \|\| 1.16.111-112 \|\|

*sarve saṃprāpya deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇumavyayam \|*  
*astuvan laukikaiḥ stotrairucchiṣṭā iva sarvagau \|\| 111 \|\|*

*devadevau mahādevau bhaktānāmārtināśanau \|*  
*kāmavṛttyā mahāyogau pāpānnastrātumarhathaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

111-112. Then they having been ucchista (unacceptable like leavings of food after meals), adored Shiva, the Lord of gods as well as Visnu, the immutable deity with many stotras. They said, “Both of you are omniscient, and are great Yogis by your own sweat will. You are competent enough to free us from the sin.”

## \|\| 1.16.113 \|\|

*tadā pārśvasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃprekṣya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ \|*  
*kimeteṣāṃ bhavet kāryaṃ prāha puṇyaiṣiṇāmiti \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Then the bull-bannered lord Shiva, looking at Visnu who was standing nearby said, “How could the task of these Brahmanas be established who are desirous of merits?”

## \|\| 1.16.114 \|\|

*tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaraṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*gopatiṃ prāha viprendrānālokya praṇatān hariḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. Then lord Visnu, who is dear to the devotees, looking at the bowed down Brahmanas, spoke to lord Sankara-also known as Gopati.

## \|\| 1.16.115 \|\|

*na vedabāhye puruṣe puṇyaleśo 'pi śaṅkara \|*  
*saṃgacchate mahādeva dharmo vedād vinirbabhau \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. “О Lord, the one who is ex-communicated by the Vedas, even the slightest part of the merit is not left with him, because, О Lord Mahadeva, Dharma emerges from the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.16.116 \|\|

*tathāpi bhaktavātsalyād rakṣitavyā maheśvara \|*  
*asmābhiḥ sarva eveme gantāro narakānapi \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. О Mahes'vara, still because of your being compassionate on the devotees, we should protect all of them who are bound to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.16.117 \|\|

*tasmād vai vedabāhyānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya pāpinām \|*  
*vimohanāya śāstrāṇi kariṣyāmo vṛṣadhvaja \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Therefore, О bull-bannered lord, in order to delude the sinners, who have been discarded by the Vedas, we shall compose Sdstras (Scriptures) which could save them.

## \|\| 1.16.118-119 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃbodhito rudro mādhavena murāriṇā \|*  
*cakāra mohaśāstrāṇi keśavo 'pi śiveritaḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

*kāpālaṃ nākulaṃ vāmaṃ bhairavaṃ pūrvapaścimam \|*  
*pañcarātraṃ pāśupataṃ tathānyāni sahastraśaḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. Thus addressed by Visnu, the slayer of Mura, Rudradeva composed deluding Sdstras and Kes'ava too did the same, on being urged by Shiva. Those Scriptures were the treatises of the cults of Kdpala, Ndkula, Vdma, Bhairava, both of western and eastern variety, Pancaratra, Pasupata and thousands of other cults as well.

## \|\| 1.16.120-121 \|\|

*sṛṣṭvā tānūcaturdevau kurvāṇāḥ śāstracoditam \|*  
*patanto niraye ghore bahūn kalpān punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

*jāyanto mānuṣe loke kṣīṇapāpacayāstataḥ \|*  
*īśvarārādhanabalād gacchadhvaṃ sukṛtāṃ gatim \|\| 121 \|\|*

120-121. After creating such literatures, he said to the Brahmanas, “You having been out-caste from the Vedic religion, should, performing the deeds as prescribed in the Sdstras will keep on falling in the hell for many kalpas, again and again. You will then be bom as humans. Then after the decline of all your sins, you will achieve salvation by the adoration of the lord.

## \|\| 1.16.122-123 \|\|

*vartadhvaṃ matprasādena nānyathā niṣkṛtirhi vaḥ \|*  
*evamīśvaraviṣṇubhyāṃ coditāste maharṣayaḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*ādeśaṃ pratyapadyanta śirasāsuravidviṣoḥ \|*  
*cakruste 'nyāni śāstrāṇi tatra tatra ratāḥ punaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

122-123. Because of my grace, you will behave in this way, otherwise, there is no scope of your deliverance. Thus both Mahadeva and Visnu, inspired those sages accordingly. The sages who were inimical to the asuras, kept on following the command of Shiva and following the scriptures, they created other Sastras.

## \|\| 1.16.124-125 \|\|

*śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsurdarśayitvā phalāni tu \|*  
*mohayanta imaṃ lokamavatīrya mahītale \|\| 124 \|\|*

*cakāra śaṅkaro bhikṣāṃ hitāyaiṣāṃ dvijaiḥ saha \|*  
*kapālamālābharaṇaḥ pretabhasmāvaguṇṭhitaḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

124-125. Displaying the results achieved by them, they started teaching their pupils. On the other hand, lord Shiva, incarnating on earth, kept on begging for alms along with the Brahmanas. Shiva wore the garland of skulls and had applied the ashes of the cremation ground over his body. He kept on deluding the entire world, wearing the matted locks of hair over the head.

## \|\| 1.16.126-127 \|\|

*vimohayaṃllokamimaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*nikṣipya pārvatīṃ devīṃ viṣṇāvamitatejasi \|\| 126 \|\|*

*niyojyāṅgabhavaṃ rudraṃ bhairavaṃ duṣṭanigrahe \|*  
*dattvā nārāyaṇe devīṃ nandinaṃ kulanandinam \|\| 127 \|\|*

126-127. He left Parvati with the illustrious Visnu and deputed Bhairava for the subjugation of the wicked people. He entrusted the care of Parvati to Narayana.

## \|\| 1.16.128-129 \|\|

*saṃsthāpya tatra gaṇapān devānindrapurogamān \|*  
*prasthite 'tha mahādeve viṣṇurviśvatanuḥ svayam \|\| 128 \|\|*

*strīrūpadhārī niyataṃ sevate sma maheśvarīm \|*  
*brahmā hutāśanaḥ śakro yamo 'nye surapuṅgavāḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

128-129. Establishing his ganas as well as Indra there, Mahadeva left the place. Thereafter Visnu, the embodiment of the universe assumed the form of a woman and served Mahesvari. Brahma, Agni, Indra, Yama, and other best of the gods, taking to the form of damsels, kept on serving Parvati, the great goddess.

## \|\| 1.16.130-133 \|\|

*siṣevire mahādevīṃ strīveśaṃ śobhanaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*nandīśvaraśca bhagavān śaṃbhoratyantavallabhaḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

*dvāradeśe gaṇādhyakṣo yathāpūrvamatiṣṭhata \|*  
*etasminnantare daityo hyandhako nāma durmatiḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

*āhartukāmo girijāmājagāmātha mandaram \|*  
*saṃprāptamandhakaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkaraḥ kālabhairavaḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

*nyaṣedhayadameyātmā kālarūpadharo haraḥ \|*  
*tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam \|\| 133 \|\|*

130-133. Lord Nandlsvara, the dearest of the lord Shiva, stood guard at the entrance gate. At the same time, the evil-minded Andhakasura for kidnapping Parvati, arrived at Mandracala.

## \|\| 1.16.134 \|\|

*śūlenorasi taṃ daityamājaghāna vṛṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sahastraśo daityaḥ sasarjāndhakasaṃjñitān \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. Finding the arrival of Andhaka, Kalabhairava, the terrific form of Shiva, stopped him. A terrific battle that caused hairs to stand on their ends, started between the two of them.

## \|\| 1.16.135-139 \|\|

*nandiṣeṇādayo daityairandhakairabhinirjitāḥ \|*  
*ghaṇṭākarṇo meghanādaścaṇḍeśaścaṇḍatāpanaḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

*vināyako meghavāhaḥ somanandī ca vaidyutaḥ \|*  
*sarve 'ndhakaṃ daityavaraṃ saṃprāpyātibalānvitāḥ \|\| 136 \|\|*

*yuyudhuḥ śūlaśaktyṛṣṭigirikūṭaparaśvadhaiḥ \|*  
*bhrāmayitvātha hastābhyāṃ gṛhītacaraṇadvayāḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

*daityendreṇātibalinā kṣiptāste śatayojanam \|*  
*tato 'ndhakanisṛṣṭāste śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

*kālasūryapratīkāśā bhairavaṃ tvabhidudruvuḥ \|*  
*hā heti śabdaḥ sumahān babhūvātibhayaṅkaraḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

135-139. The bull-bannered Kalabhairava attacked over the chest of Andhaka with his trident. Thereafter, thousands of Daityas appeared there in the name of Sahasrandhakas.

## \|\| 1.16.140 \|\|

*yuyodha bhairavo rudraḥ śūlamādāya bhīṣaṇam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvāndhakānāṃ subalaṃ durjayaṃ tarjito haraḥ \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. Nandlsvara and others were defeated by those Andhakas. The extremely valorous eight ganas of Shiva known as Gantakarna, Meghanada, Candesa, Candatapana, Vinayaka, Meghavaha, Somanandi and Vaidyuta, started fighting with Andhakas with spears, saMis, double-edged swords, mountain peaks and battle-axes. Then the extremely valorous Daityaraja, Andhaka, caught hold of each one of them by the feet and threw them all at a distance of a hundred yojanas (1 Yojana = 12 Kms.). Then the horrible thousands of asuras, created by the demon attacked Bhairava simultaneously. There was commotion everywhere there and horrible sound was created.

## \|\| 1.16.141-142 \|\|

*jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum \|*  
*so 'sṛjad bhagavān viṣṇurdevīnāṃ śatamuttamam \|\| 141 \|\|*

*devīpārśvasthito devo vināśāyāmaradviṣām \|*  
*tathāndhakasahastraṃ tu devībhiryamasādanam \|\| 142 \|\|*

141-142. Bhairava started fighting carrying a trident with him, but he, the form of Shiva, was defeated at the hands of the invincible army of Andhaka.

## \|\| 1.16.143-144 \|\|

*nītaṃ keśavamāhātmyāllīlayaiva raṇājire \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā parāhataṃ sainyamandhako 'pi mahāsuraḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

*parāṅmukhoraṇāt tasmāt palāyata mahājavaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ krīḍāṃ mahādevaḥ kṛtvā dvādaśavārṣikīm \|\| 144 \|\|*

143-144. Thereafter, he went and took refuge with the unborn, all pervading Vasudeva. Lord yishnu on his part created hundreds of the best of the goddesses for the destruction of the demons. Lord Visnu them stood before the goddess Parvati. The goddesses so created by Visnu, on the other hand playfully killed thousands of Andhakas and sent them to the abode of Yama.

## \|\| 1.16.145-146 \|\|

*hitāya loke bhaktānāmājagāmātha mandaram \|*  
*saṃprāptamīśvaraṃ jñātvā sarva eva gaṇeśvarāḥ \|\| 145 \|\|*

*samāgamyopatasthustaṃ bhānumantamiva dvijāḥ \|*  
*praviśya bhavanaṃ puṇyamayuktānāṃ durāsadam \|\| 146 \|\|*

145-146. Finding his army having been shattered by the enemy, Andhaka fled awav from the battle ground, showing his back.

## \|\| 1.16.147 \|\|

*dadarśa nandinaṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ keśavaṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*praṇāmapravaṇaṃ devaṃ so 'nugṛhyātha nandinam \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. Then lord Mahadeva, completing his worldly sports of twelve years, for the benefit of devotees, reached back at the Mandaracala mountain. Learning about the arrival of the lord Shiva there, all the Shivaganas assembled there, as the Brahmanas assemble before the sun. Then Shiva entered his abode, which was beyond the reach of the people deprived of Yoga.

## \|\| 1.16.148 \|\|

*āghrāya mūrdhanīśānaḥ keśavaṃ pariṣasvaje \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā devī mahādevaṃ prītivisphāritekṣaṇā \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Shiva then spotted Nandi, Visnu and Bhairava. He graced Nandi, who was ready to offer his salutation to lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.16.149 \|\|

*nanāma śirasā tasya pādayorīśvarasya sā \|*  
*nivedya vijayaṃ tasmai śaṅkarāyātha śaṅkarī \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. Then lord Shiva embraced Kesava (Visnu) quite lovingly. Then he spotted Parvati, whose eyes started blossoming on the arrival of lord 3iva.

## \|\| 1.16.150-151 \|\|

*bhairavo viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ praṇataḥ pārśvago 'vadat \|*  
*śrutvā tadvijayaṃ śaṃbhurvikramaṃ keśavasya ca \|\| 150 \|\|*

*samāste bhagavānīśo devyā saha varāsane \|*  
*tato devagaṇāḥ sarve marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

150-151. Kalabhairava, bowing in reverence at the feet of Shiva and Parvati, informed Shiva about his victory. Then he reciting the glory of lord Visnu, stood before him.

## \|\| 1.16.152-154 \|\|

*ājagmurmandaraṃ druṣṭaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam \|*  
*yena tad vijitaṃ pūrvaṃ devīnāṃ śatamuttamam \|\| 152 \|\|*

*samāgataṃ daityasainyamīśdarśanavāñchayā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā varāsanāsīnaṃ devyā candravibhūṣaṇam \|\| 153 \|\|*

*praṇemurādarād devyo gāyanti smātilālasāḥ \|*  
*praṇemurgirijāṃ devīṃ vāmapārśve pinākinaḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

152-154. Learning about the victory and the prowess of lord Visnu, lord Shiva, seated himself on an excellent seat along with the goddess Parvati. Then all the gods and the Brahmanas like Marici and others, arrived at Mandracala to have an audience with lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.16.155 \|\|

*devāsanagataṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā siṃhāsanāsīnaṃ devyā nārāyaṇena ca \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. The hundred goddesses, who had earlier conquered the Daityas, also arrived there to have an audience with lord Shiva. Finding moon- bedecked Shiva seated over an excellent seat along with the goddess, all of them bowed down in reverence to him. Then they started singing with great eagerness and offered their salutation to Girija who was lodged to the left of Shiva. Then finding goddess identical with Narayana’s mind, occupying a throne of the lord and Narayana occupying a throne (like exalted seat), the goddesses bowed in reverence to him as well. Then the best of the damsels asked lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.16.156-158 \|\|

*praṇamya devamīśānaṃ pṛṣṭavatyo varāṅganāḥ \|*  
*kanyā ūcuḥ kastvaṃ vibhrājase kāntyā keyaṃ bālaraviprabhā \|\| 156 \|\|*

*ko 'nvayaṃ bhti vapuṣā paṅkajāyatalocanaḥ \|*  
*niśamya tāsāṃ vacanaṃ vṛṣendravaravāhanaḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

*vyājahāra mahāyogī bhūtādhipatiravyayaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ nārāyaṇo gaurī jaganmātā sanātanī \|\| 158 \|\|*

156-158. The damsels said, “Who are you illumining with your own lustre? Who is this damsel resembling the lustre of the sun? Who is this ри-son of eyes large like lotus, having a beautiful body?” Listening the words spoken by them, Shiva, the great yogi, lord of the BMtas and imperishable lord said, “He is Narayana, the eternal one and she is Gaurl, the mother of the universe.

## \|\| 1.16.159 \|\|

*vibhajya saṃsthito devaḥ svātmānaṃ bahudheśvaraḥ \|*  
*na me viduḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ devādyā na maharṣayaḥ \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. This lord of the gods is established here dividing himself in many ways. The great sages as well as Devas are unaware of the Supreme Reality about me as well that of goddess Parvati.

## \|\| 1.16.160 \|\|

*eko 'yaṃ veda viśvātmā bhavānī viṣṇureva ca \|*  
*ahaṃ hi niṣkriyaḥ śāntaḥ kevalo niṣparigrahaḥ \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. Only Vishnu-the soul of the universe as well as the goddess BhavanI know about the same. In reality, I am unattached, peaceful, absolute and am devoid of attractions.

## \|\| 1.16.161 \|\|

*māmeva keśavaṃ devamāhurdevīmathāmbikām \|*  
*eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca kāraṇaṃ kāryameva ca \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. The people with wisdom call me Kesava and goddess Ambika as Lakshml. He is the creator and the dispenser of destiny. He is the cause as well as the effect.

## \|\| 1.16.162 \|\|

*kartā kārayitā viṣṇurbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ \|*  
*bhoktā pumānaprameyaḥ saṃhartā kālarūpadhṛk \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. Lord Vishnu is the performer and the one who makes others to perform. He also bestows the pleasure as well as the moksa. In the form of Purusha, he is the one who enjoys all the pleasures, and is limitless. In the form of Kala, he is the destroyer as well.

## \|\| 1.16.163 \|\|

*straṣṭā pātā vāsudevo viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ \|*  
*kṛṭastho hyakṣaro vyāpī yogī nārāyaṇaḥ svayam \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. He is the creator, protector, one who makes others to perform, Vasudeva, the universal soul, having faces on all the sides, the immutable, imperishable, all pervading, a Yogi, Narayana and unblemished.

## \|\| 1.16.164 \|\|

*tārakaḥ puruṣo hyātmā kevalaṃ paramaṃ padam \|*  
*saiṣā māheśvarī gaurī mama śaktirnirañjanā \|\| 164 \|\|*

164\. He is the Purusa enabling all to cross the ocean of worldly existence. He is the Soul, the highest Supreme region. This Gauri is my spotless Shakti.

## \|\| 1.16.165 \|\|

*sāntā satyā sadānandā paraṃ padamiti śrutiḥ \|*  
*asyāḥ sarvamidaṃ jātamatraiva layameṣyati \|\| 165 \|\|*

165\. She is calm, truthful, blissful and enjoys the supreme position. This is what has been ordained by the Srutis. In fact, the entire universe has emerged out of her and everything gets dissolved in her. I She alone is the best refuge of all living beings. In union with her, I, the absolute, Supreme, unsullied Lord, perceive everything including the imperishable Soul.

## \|\| 1.16.166 \|\|

*eṣaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ gatīnāmuttamā gatiḥ \|*  
*tayāhaṃ saṃgato devyā kevalo niṣkalaḥ paraḥ \|\| 166 \|\|*

166\. Therefore, all of you should conceive the eternal, devoid of duality, Ishvara and form of self, known as Visnu, in a single form. Only them you will be able to achieve bliss. The one who, with utmost devotion, treats Vishnu as invisible and the form of soul, he is dear to me. But those who consider me to be separate from Vishnu and worship accordingly, they cannot be dear to me. Such of the people, who out of confusion are envious of Visnu, the creator of the universe, they fall in the terrific hells and they cannot be freed for crores of births. Therefore, Vishnu is the protector of all the living beings. Realising this pretty well, he should be remembered at the time of all the misfortunes.”

## \|\| 1.16.167-170 \|\|

*paśyāmyaśeṣamevedaṃ yastad veda sa mucyate \|*  
*tasmādanādimadvaitaṃ viṣṇumātmānamīśvaram \|\| 167 \|\|*

*ekameva vijānīdhvaṃ tato yāsyatha nirvṛtim \|*  
*manyante viṣṇumavyaktamātmānaṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

*ye bhinnadṛṣṭyāpīśānaṃ pūjayanto na me priyāḥ \|*  
*dviṣanti ye jagatsūtiṃ mohitā rauravādiṣu \|\| 169 \|\|*

*pacyamānā na mucyante kalpakoṭiśatairapi \|*  
*tasamādaśeṣabhūtānāṃ rakṣako viṣṇuravyayaḥ \|\| 170 \|\|*

167-170. Listening to the words of lord Shiva, all the gods and the Ganesvaras offered their salutation to Narayana and the goddess Parvati. They prayed for devotion towards Isana, the beloved of his devotees, and prayed at the lotus like feet of Narayana and Parvati.

## \|\| 1.16.171-172 \|\|

*yathāvadiha vijñāya dhyeyaḥ sarvāpadi prabhuḥ \|*  
*śrutvā bhagavato vākyaṃ devyaḥ sarvagaṇeśvarāḥ \|\| 171 \|\|*

*nemurnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ devīṃ ca himaśailajām \|*  
*prārthayāmāsurīśāne bhaktiṃ bhaktajanapriye \|\| 172 \|\|*

171-172. Then suddenly all the Matrikas and Ganesvaras, could not see the Lord Narayana, the source of origin of the universe. This was an astonishing event.

## \|\| 1.16.173 \|\|

*bhavānīpādayugale nārāyaṇapadāmbuje \|*  
*tato nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ gaṇeśā mātaro 'pi ca \|\| 173 \|\|*

173\. In the mean time, Andhaka, having been overpowered by the passions arrived at Mandaracala for abducting Parvati, forcibly.

## \|\| 1.16.174 \|\|

*na paśyanti jagatsūtiṃ tadbhutamivābhavat \|*  
*tadantare mahādaityo hyandhako manmathārditaḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

174\. Thereafter Purusottama-Narayana, having the spotless body, being a great Yogi, appeared there for fighting with the Daityas.

## \|\| 1.16.175 \|\|

*mohito girijāṃ devīmāhartuṃ girimāyayau \|*  
*athānantavapuḥ śrīmān yogī nārāyaṇo 'malaḥ \|*  
*tatraivāvirabhūd daityairyuddhāya puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 175 \|\|*

175\. At that point of time, lord Visnu by his side, accompanied with prominent Ganas, Silada's son Nandlsvara and the mothers, Lord Isa, Kala- Rudra marched on for the waging of the war.

## \|\| 1.16.176 \|\|

*kṛtvātha pārśve bhagavantamīśo yuddhāya viṣṇuṃ gaṇadevamukhyaiḥ \|*  
*śilādaputreṇa ca mātṛkābhiḥ sa kālarudro 'bhijagāma devaḥ \|\| 176 \|\|*

176\. Lord Mahadeva, holding a trident emitting fire flames, marched ahead. He was followed by the thousand-armed Visnu as well as his own Ganas.

## \|\| 1.16.177 \|\|

*triśūlamādāya kṛśānukalpaṃ sa devadevaḥ prayayau purastāt \|*  
*tamanvayurate gaṇarājavaryā jagāma devo'pi sahasravāhuḥ \|\| 177 \|\|*

177\. At that point of time, lord Vishnu having the complexion of a lotus flower, mounted over Garuda, appeared. Then the incomprehensible lord Shiva having a thousand shapes like the sungod viewing the three worlds from the top of the Sumeru mountain, manifested himself.

## \|\| 1.16.178 \|\|

*rarāja madhye bhagavān surāṇāṃ*  
*vivāhano vāridavarṇavarṇaḥ \|*  
*tadā sumeroḥ śikharādhirūḍha-*  
*strilokadṛṣṭirbhagavānivārkaḥ \|\| 178 \|\|*

178\. The victorious, eternal and beyond measure, lord Shiva, then took to thousands of forms holding a trident in his hand. He created thundering sound in the sky. The rain of flowers started falling over the gods at that time.

## \|\| 1.16.179 \|\|

*jagatyanādirbhagavānameyo*  
*haraḥ sahastrākṛtirāvirāsīt \|*  
*triśūlapāṇirgagane sughoṣaḥ*  
*papāta devopari puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ \|\| 179 \|\|*

179\. The demon Andhaka finding Shiva having been surrounded by his Ganas, started fighting with Indra, Matrkas (the ‘mothers’), the whole of the army of Ganas and other prominent gods.

## \|\| 1.16.180 \|\|

*samāgataṃ vīkṣya gaṇeśarājaṃ*  
*samāvṛtaṃ devaripurgaṇeśaiḥ \|*  
*yuyodha śakreṇa samātṛkābhi-*  
*r gaṇairaśeṣairamapapradhānaiḥ \|\| 180 \|\|*

180\. After defeating all by means of the prowess of his arms in the battle, Andhaka, riding his own aerial car, came to the place where Shiva of infinite splendour and Kalarudra who had lost his inherent strength was standing.

## \|\| 1.16.181 \|\|

*vijitya sarvānapi bāhuvīryāt*  
*sa saṃyuge śaṃbhumanantadhāma \|*  
*samāyayau yatra sa kālarudro*  
*vimānamāruhya vihīnasattvaḥ \|\| 181 \|\|*

181\. Finding Andhaka approaching him, the Garude-bannered lord Visnu, spoke to lord Shiva who had smeared ashes over his body.

## \|\| 1.16.182 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ samayāntaṃ bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*vyājahāra mahādevaṃ bhairavaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam \|\| 182 \|\|*

182\. “It is you alone who can destroy the Daitya king Andhaka, who is the thorn of the universe. Except you none else is strong enough to kill him.

## \|\| 1.16.183 \|\|

*hantumarhasi daityeśamandhakaṃ lokakaṇṭakam \|*  
*tvāmṛte bhagavān śakto hantā nānyo 'sya vidyate \|\| 183 \|\|*

183\. Because, it is you alone, who in the the illustrious Kala form, destroy the lokas. The learned people eulogise you appropriately reciting the Vedic mantras.

## \|\| 1.16.184 \|\|

*tvaṃ hartā sarvalokānāṃ kālātmā hyaiśvarī tanuḥ \|*  
*stūyate vividhairmantrarvedavidbhirvicakṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 184 \|\|*

184\. Listening to the words of Vasudeva, lord Shiva looked meaningfully at Visnu and decided to kill the Daityas.

## \|\| 1.16.185 \|\|

*sa vāsudevasya vaco niśamya bhagavān haraḥ \|*  
*nirīkṣya viṣṇuṃ hanane daityandrasya matiṃ dadhau \|\| 185 \|\|*

185\. Then he marched towards the army of the gods in order to increase delight of them. The dwellers of the space then started eulogising lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.16.186 \|\|

*jagāma devatānīkaṃ gaṇānāṃ harṣamuttamam \|*  
*stuvanti bhairavaṃ devamantarikṣacarā janāḥ \|\| 186 \|\|*

186\. They said, “О Limitless one, Victory to you, О Eternal form of Kala, you pervade everywhere and reside in the body of all in the foim of fire. You are the destroyer as well as the maker of all, you are the creator of the universe, besides being the sustainer. You are indestructible Hari. You are Brahma, Mahadeva, the illustrious Supreme place, and the final emancipation.

## \|\| 1.16.187-188 \|\|

*jayānanta mahādeva kālamūrte sanātana \|*  
*tvamagniḥ sarvabhūtānāmantaścarasi nityaśaḥ \|\| 187 \|\|*

*tvaṃ yatrajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ dhātā hariravyayaḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ mahādevastvaṃ dhāma paramaṃ padam \|\| 188 \|\|*

187-188. You are the form of Orhkara, Yogic soul, having three eyes representing the three Vedas, possessing enormous fortunes, besides being the lord of the universe. О Limitless one, victory to you.”

## \|\| 1.16.189 \|\|

*oṅkāramūrtiryogātmā trayīnetrastrilocanaḥ \|*  
*mahāvibhūtirdeveśo jayāśeṣajagatpate \|\| 189 \|\|*

189\. Thereafter, this controller of the world Kalagni-rudra, the goal of the good, caught hold of the Andhaka and pierced him with the tip of his trident and started dancing.

## \|\| 1.16.190 \|\|

*tataḥ kālāgnirudro 'sau gṛhītvāndhakamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*triśūlāgreṣu vinyasya prananarta satāṃ gatiḥ \|\| 190 \|\|*

190\. Thus finding that the trident has pierced the body of Andhaka, the gods along with Brahma, started offering their salutation to lord Bhairava, the releaser from worldy bondage.

## \|\| 1.16.191 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ devagaṇāḥ śūlaprotaṃ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*praṇemurīśvaraṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ bhavamocakam \|\| 191 \|\|*

191\. The sages and the siddhas also started praying. The Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang. The charming groups of celestial damsels danced in the sky.

## \|\| 1.16.192 \|\|

*astuvan munayaḥ siddhā jagurgandharvikiṃnarāḥ \|*  
*antarikṣe 'psaraḥ saṅghā nṛtyantisma manoramāḥ \|\| 192 \|\|*

192\. Therefore, Andhaka having been pierced at the tip of the trident, was freed of all the sins. All the type of perfect knowledge emerged in him and he started praying to Paramesvara (Shiva).

## \|\| 1.16.193 \|\|

*saṃsthāpito 'thaśūlāgre so 'ndhako dagdhakilbiṣaḥ \|*  
*utpannākhilavijñānastuṣṭāva parameśvaram \|\| 193 \|\|*

193\. Andhaka said, “I with a concentrated mind, offer my salutation to Shiva, bowing my head in reverence, who is known by the people as Ishvara, the form of merits, the ancient holy one, Kala, poet and is well-versed in the Yoga (union) and Viyoga (separation).

## \|\| 1.16.194 \|\|

*andhaka uvāca*  
*namāmi mūrdhnā bhagavantamekaṃ*  
*samāhitā yaṃ vidurīśatattvam \|*  
*purātanaṃ puṇyamanantarūpaṃ*  
*kālaṃ kaviṃ yogaviyogahetum \|\| 194 \|\|*

194\. You have the terrific fangs, the one who dance in the sky, having the face resembling the fire, resplendent, form of sun, having a thousand feet, eyes and heads, form of Rudra and the unique one, salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.16.195 \|\|

*daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ divi nṛtyamānaṃ*  
*hutāśavaktraṃ jvalanārkarūpam \|*  
*sahastrapādākṣiśirobhiyuktaṃ*  
*bhavantamekaṃ praṇamāmi rudram \|\| 195 \|\|*

195\. You are the one whose feet are adored by the gods, the indivisible one, the spotless one, the eternal lord, salutation to you. You are the one (sacrificial) fire worshipped in various ways; you abide in all souls through external differences.

## \|\| 1.16.196 \|\|

*jayādidevāmarapūjitāṅghre*  
*vibhāgahīnāmalatattvarūpa \|*  
*tvamagnireko bahudhābhipūjyase*  
*vāyvādibhedairakhilātmarūpa \|\| 196 \|\|*

196\. You are called the unique Puranapurusha. You have the complexion of the sun, you are beyond tamoguna and beyond darkness. You witness the world and protect it also. You happen to be its destroyer and are served by the Yogis.

## \|\| 1.16.197 \|\|

*tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ purāṇam*  
*ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt \|*  
*tvaṃ paśyasīdaṃ paripāsyajastraṃ*  
*tvamantako yogigaṇābhijuṣṭaḥ \|\| 197 \|\|*

197\. You happen to be the unique inner soul of all and enter into different bodies. But still you are bodyless. You are the universal soul known as Paramatma. You are called shiva by some people.

## \|\| 1.16.198 \|\|

*eko 'ntarātmā bahudhā niviṣṭo*  
*deheṣu dehādiviśeṣahīnaḥ \|*  
*tvamātmaśabdaṃ paramātmatattvaṃ*  
*bhavantamāhuḥ śivameva kecit \|\| 198 \|\|*

198\. You are imperishable and auspicious Brahman. You are blissful and are also known as orhkara. You are the well known self-bom Ishvara. You are the master of those who know Vedas, devoid of all special characteristics.

## \|\| 1.16.199 \|\|

*tvamakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ pavitra-*  
*mānandarūpaṃ praṇavābhidhānam \|*  
*tvamīśvaro vedapadeṣu siddhaḥ*  
*svayaṃ prabho 'śeṣaviśeṣahīnaḥ \|\| 199 \|\|*

199\. You are the form of Indra, Varuna, Agni, Harusa, Prana (the vital breath), Mrtyu, the end and the yajna. You are Prajapati, Ekarnpa, lord Nllagriva (blue-necked) and have several other names, reciting which the people well-versed in the Vedas, adore you.

## \|\| 1.16.200 \|\|

*tvamindrarūpo varuṇāgnirūpo*  
*haṃsaḥ prāṇo mṛtyurantāsi yajñaḥ \|*  
*prajāpatirbhagavānekarudro*  
*nīlagrīvaḥ stūyase vedavidbhiḥ \|\| 200 \|\|*

200\. You are the form of Narayana, eternal, Brahma, the grandfather, and are the great grand sire of all. You have been eulogised in the unpanisads, which are the secretive form of Vedanta. You are Sadas'iva and Paramesvara.

## \|\| 1.16.201 \|\|

*nārāyaṇastvaṃ jagatāmathādiḥ*  
*pitāmahastvaṃ prapitāmahaśca \|*  
*vedāntaguhyopaniṣatsu gītaḥ*  
*sadāśivastvaṃ parameśvaro 'si \|\| 201 \|\|*

201\. You are beyond tamoguna (ignorance), the supreme soul pervading the fourteen bhuvanas, beyond the three s'aktis, spotless, stationed over a seat with a thousand s'aktis. Salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.16.202 \|\|

*namaḥ parastāt tamasaḥ parasmai*  
*parātmane pañcapadāntarāya \|*  
*triśaktyatītāya nirañjanāya*  
*sahastraśaktyāsanasaṃsthitāya \|\| 202 \|\|*

202\. You are the form of Trimurti, beyond measure, the form of the supreme soul, dweller of the universe, lodged in the hearts of the people and you use the garland of serpent as necklace. Salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.16.203 \|\|

*trimūrtaye 'nandapadātmamūrte*  
*jagannivāsāya jaganmayāya \|*  
*namo lalāṭārpitalocanāya*  
*namo janānāṃ hṛdi saṃsthitāya \|\| 203 \|\|*

203\. You are the one whose lotus-like feet are adored by the siddhas and the sages. О Lord having the thousand forms, you are lodged over the seat of dharma and the fortunes, you are beyond the supreme one, and the source of the creation of the universe. Salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.16.204 \|\|

*phaṇīndrahārāya namo 'stu tubhyaṃ*  
*munīndrasiddhārcitapādayugma \|*  
*aiśvaryadharmāsanasaṃsthitāya*  
*namaḥ parāntāya bhavodbhavāya \|\| 204 \|\|*

204\. Salutation to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. О Lordi with gold like arms, obeisance to you. Salutation to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

## \|\| 1.16.205 \|\|

*sahastracandrārkavilocanāya*  
*namo 'stu te soma sumadhyamāya \|*  
*namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyabāho*  
*namo 'mbikāyāḥ pataye mṛḍāya \|\| 205 \|\|*

205\. You are secretive and are lodged in the inmost cavity of the heart, who can be known by the means of knowledge of Vedanta, salutation to you. You are devoid of three talas (times), having the spotless abode, known as Mahesa, salutation to you.”

## \|\| 1.16.206 \|\|

*namo 'tiguhyāya guhāntarāya*  
*vedāntavijñānasuniścitāya \|*  
*trikālahīnāmaladhāmadhāmne*  
*namo maheśāya namaḥ śivāya \|\| 206 \|\|*

206\. When so praised Andhaka, Paramesvara Shiva was pleased. Then he removed Andhaka from the tip of the trident and touching him with both the hands, Shiva said.

## \|\| 1.16.207 \|\|

*evaṃ stuvantaṃ bhagavān śūlāgrādavaropya tam \|*  
*tuṣṭaḥ provāca hastābhyāṃ spṛṣṭvātha parameśvaraḥ \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. “O Daitya, I am extremely pleased with the stotra recited by you. Therefore becoming the chief of my ganas, you always reside with me.

## \|\| 1.16.208 \|\|

*prīto 'haṃ sarvathā daitya stavenānena sāṃpratam \|*

208\. With your body having been shattered with the tip of the trident, you will be without ailments. You will be well adored by the gods and shall serve as an attendant to Nandi, and you shall be relived of all your sufferings.”

## \|\| 1.16.209 \|\|

*arogaśchinnasaṃdeho devairapi supūjitaḥ \|*  
*nandīśvarasyānucaraḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitaḥ \|\| 209 \|\|*

209\. At these words of lord Mahideva, the gods accepted Andhaka, the terrific Daitya, as Ganesvara of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.16.210 \|\|

*evaṃ vyāhṛtamātre tu devadevena devatāḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśvarā mahādevamandhakaṃ devasannidhau \|\| 210 \|\|*

210\. At that point of time he started, illumining with the lustre of a thousand suns, paving three eyes, with the moon digit over his head. He had blue throat, had the matted locks of hair over the head and holding a spear in his mighty arm. At the sight of the Daitya, the gods were surprised and started praising him. Then lord Visnu spoke to Shiva smilingly. “О Mahadevai your influence is like a great personality, you are unconcerned with the blemishes relating to the castes, but you recognize the qualities alone.”

## \|\| 1.16.211-212 \|\|

*sahastrasūryasaṃkāśaṃ trinetraṃ candracihnitam \|*  
*nīlakaṇṭhaṃ jaṭāmauliṃ śūlāsaktamahākaram \|\| 211 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā taṃ tuṣṭuvurdaityamāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*uvāca bhagavān viṣṇurdevadevaṃ smayanniva \|\| 212 \|\|*

211-212. At these. words of Visnu, Bhairava, the leading Deva, Chief of the Ganas, Andhaka together with Visnu reached before Shiva. At the arrival of Narayana, with Matrkas and Andhaka, lord Shiva felt extremely pleased.

## \|\| 1.16.213 \|\|

*sthāne tava mahādeva prabhāvaḥ puruṣo mahān \|*

213\. The Shiva holding Andhaka, the son of Hiranyaksa by the hand, went to the aerial chariot where Parvati, the daughter of mountain, had been seated. Finding her husband, the remover of all the obstructions of the world, accompanied with Andhaka, Parvati expressed happiness and pleasure on behalf of Andhaka. зтеггегай чфагЗг

## \|\| 1.16.214 \|\|

*itīrito 'tha bhairavo gaṇeśadevapuṅgavaiḥ \|*  
*sakeśavaḥ sahāndhako jagāma śaṅkarāntikam \|*  
*nirīkṣya devamāgataṃ saśaṅkaraḥ sahāndhakam \|*  
*samādhavaṃ samātṛkaṃ jagāma nirvṛtiṃ haraḥ \|\| 214 \|\|*

214\. Thereafter Andhaka, finding Parvati with Shiva, atonce prostrated on the ground. He said, “The one from whom Prakrti and Purusa are bom, the daughter of the mountain and the one who destroys the entire world, I offer my salutation to the same eternal beloved of Shiva with lotus-like feet.

## \|\| 1.16.215 \|\|

*pragṛhya pāṇineśvaro hiraṇyalocanātmajam \|*  
*jagāma yatra śailajā vimānamīśavallabhā \|*  
*vilokya sā samāgataṃ bhavaṃ bhavārtihāriṇam \|*  
*avāpa sāndhakaṃ sukhaṃ prasādamandhakaṃ prati \|\| 215 \|\|*

215\. The eternal one who is lodged over the beautiful golden throne with her lord Shiva, I bow in reverence to the same, the daughter of Himalaya. From whose body the entire universe emerges and is then absorbed in the same, I offer my salutation to the goddess Uma, devoid of all sins.

## \|\| 1.16.216 \|\|

*athāndhako maheśvarīṃ dadarśa devapārśvagām \|*  
*papāta daṇḍavatkṣitau nanāma pādapadmayoḥ \|*  
*namāmi devavallabhāmanādimadrijāmimām \|*  
*yataḥ pradhānapūruṣau nihanti yākhilaṃ jagat \|\| 216 \|\|*

216\. The one who is never bom, and also does not have to decline or expand, I offer my salutation to the daughter of Himalaya. О Daughter of the mountain, my past conduct had been due to some delusion, I beg forgiveness for the same. I bow at your lotus like feet which are worshipped by the gods as well as the demons.

## \|\| 1.16.217 \|\|

*vibhāti yā śivāsane śivena sākamavyayā \|*  
*hiraṇmaye 'tinirmale namāmi tāmimāmajām \|*  
*yadantarākhilaṃ jagajjaganti yānti saṃkṣayam \|*  
*namāmi yatra tāmumāmaśeṣabedavarjitām \|\| 217 \|\|*

217\. Thus bowing in humility with devotion, Andhaka offered prayer to the Goddess Parvati. Then Parvati accepted Andhaka as her own son.

## \|\| 1.16.218 \|\|

*na jāyate nahīyate na vardhate ca tāmumām \|*  
*namāmi yā guṇātigā girīśaputrikāmimām \|*  
*kṣamasva devi śailaje kṛtaṃ mayā vimāhataḥ \|*

218\. Then lord Bhairava having been bom out of Rudra, at the command of lord Shiva, proceeded on to the Patala with the Matrkas. It was here that the Tamasa form of Visnu, the cause of annihilation of the world existed. The unmanifest lord Hari remains there in the form ofNrsimha.

## \|\| 1.16.219 \|\|

*itthaṃ bhagavatī gaurī bhaktinamreṇa pārvatī \|*  
*saṃstutā daityapatinā putratve jagṛhe 'ndhakam \|\| 219 \|\|*

219\. Then Sesanaga also adored Shiva having the endless form. Lord Kalagni-Rudra, absorbed his own form in himself, winding up the Bhairava form.

## \|\| 1.16.220-221 \|\|

*tataḥ sa mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhairavo rudrasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*jagāmānujñayā śaṃbhoḥ pātālaṃ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 220 \|\|*

*yatra sā tāmasī viṣṇormūrtiḥ saṃhārakārikā \|*  
*samāste hariravyakto nṛsiṃhākṛtirīśvaraḥ \|\| 221 \|\|*

220-221. Even as the lord was in the Yogic' unison, the hungry Matrkas bowed down in reverence to the three-eyed Mahadeva, and said to him.

## \|\| 1.16.222 \|\|

*tato 'nantākṛtiḥ śaṃbhuḥ śeṣeṇāpi supūjitaḥ \|*  
*kālāgnirudro bhagavān yuyojātmānamātmani \|\| 222 \|\|*

222\. The mothers said, “O Mahadeva, we are hungry. At your command, we can consume the three worlds, otherwise our hunger cannot be subsided.”

## \|\| 1.16.223 \|\|

*yuñjatastasya devasya sarvā evātha mātaraḥ \|*  
*bubhukṣitā mahādevaṃ praṇamyāhustriśūlinam \|\| 223 \|\|*

223\. Thus speaking all the Matrkas who had emerged out of Visnu, started consuming the three worlds.

## \|\| 1.16.225 \|\|

*etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ mātaro viṣṇusaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*bhakṣayāñcakrire sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram \|\| 225 \|\|*

225\. Then Bhairava devoting his kind in Hari in the fonn of Narasirnha, offered his salutation to Narayana, with folded hands.

## \|\| 1.16.226 \|\|

*tataḥ sa bhairavo devo nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ harim \|*

226\. Knowing about the anxiety of Shiva, Hari atonce appeared on the scene, and said to Shiva, “The Matrkas, your own creations, are consuming the entire universe. You stop them atonce, О Lord.” Then at the instance of Hari in the form of Narasimha, the goddesses went to Mahadeva.

## \|\| 1.16.227-228 \|\|

*vijñāpayāmāsa ca taṃ bhakṣayantīha mātaraḥ \|*

*saṃsmṛtā viṣṇunā devyo nṛsiṃhavapuṣā punaḥ \|*  
*upatasthurmahādevaṃ narasiṃhākṛtiṃ ca tam \|\| 228 \|\|*

227-228. In the presence of Visnu, all the destroying goddesses transferred their prowess to Shiva, in the form of Bhairava.

## \|\| 1.16.229 \|\|

*saṃprāpya sannidhiṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvāḥ saṃhārakārikāḥ \|*

229\. At that point of time, all the three viz., Brahma, the creator of the universe, the terrific Narasimha and the serpent Sesa were absorbed into one single entity.

## \|\| 1.16.230 \|\|

*apaśyaṃstā jagatsūtiṃ nṛsiṃhamatha bhairavam \|*  
*kṣaṇādekatvamāpannaṃ śeṣāhiṃ cāpi mātaraḥ \|\| 230 \|\|*

230\. At that point of time lord Visnu had declared that, “those who are devoted to trident bearer Shiva, and those who are devoted to me, all of them are to be protected by us, making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.16.231 \|\|

*vyājahāra hṛṣīkeśo ye bhaktāḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ \|*  
*ye ca māṃ saṃsmarantīha pālanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ \|\| 231 \|\|*

231\. This unequalled form that destroys everything is my own, and is bom of Mahesvara’s person. The said form provides devotion and salvation to the devotees.

## \|\| 1.16.232 \|\|

*mamaiva mūrtiratulā sarvasaṃhārakārikā \|*  
*maheśvarāṃśasaṃbhūtā bhuktimuktipradā tviyam \|\| 232 \|\|*

232\. Thus both Kalabhairva, the infinite and the four-faced Brahma, the god of gods are my own forms. The former is my tamasic form, while the later is my Rajasic form.

## \|\| 1.16.233 \|\|

*ananto bhagavān kālo dvidhāvasthā mamaiva tu \|*  
*tāmasī rājasī mūrtirdevadevaścaturmukhaḥ \|\| 233 \|\|*

233\. It is I that utterly unthwartable god Kala, the calculator of the universe, who, at the end of the kalpa, taking to the terrific form of Rudra shall consume the entire world.

## \|\| 1.16.234 \|\|

*so 'yaṃ devo durādharṣaḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ \|*  
*bhakṣayiṣyati kalpānte rudrātmā nikhilaṃ jagat \|\| 234 \|\|*

234\. My pleasant form as Narayana, has the excess of sattvaguna. Therefore this form of mine, stabilises and protects the universe for ever.

## \|\| 1.16.236 \|\|

*sa hi viṣṇuḥ paraṃ brahma paramātmā parā gatiḥ \|*  
*mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā sadānandeti kathyate \|\| 236 \|\|*

236\. The same Visnu is the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme soul, the final goal, invisible Мй/а- prakrti (unmanifest primordial nature), and is known as all-blissful.

## \|\| 1.16.237 \|\|

*ityevaṃ bodhitā devyo viṣṇunā viśvamātaraḥ \|*  
*prapedire mahādevaṃ tameva śaraṇaṃ harim \|\| 237 \|\|*

237\. The goddesses, the Vaisnavite matriarchs who were thus enlightened by Visnu sought ultimate refuge in that great lord alone.

## \|\| 1.16.238 \|\|

*etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayāndhakanibarhaṇam \|*  
*māhātmyaṃ devadevasya bhairavasyāmitaujasaḥ \|\| 238 \|\|*

238\. Thus I have narrated he complete story of the destruction of Andhaka and the glory of the Bhairava form of Shiva to you.

## Chapter 17. Progeny of Daksa’s Daughters

## \|\| 1.17.1 \|\|

*śrīkūrma uvāca*

## \|\| 1.17.2-3 \|\|

2-3. Suta said, “Having punished Andhakasura thus, and at his taking command as the chief of Shivaganas, Virocana, the valorous son of Prahlada became the king.

## \|\| 1.17.4 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā sihāsanagato brahmaputraṃ mahāsuraḥ \|*

4\. Virocana-the great asura, conquered all the gods including Indra and righteously ruled the three worlds for a long time. During his performing as the ruler, Sanatkumara, the holy sage, once reached the capital of the asura at the instance of lord Visnu.

## \|\| 1.17.5 \|\|

*dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi saṃprāpto me purātanaḥ \|*  
*yogīśvaro 'dya bhagavān yato 'sau brahmavit svayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The great asura who was seated over his throne, got up atonce and welcomed the great sage, getting down from the throne. With folded hands he spoke to the sage.

## \|\| 1.17.6 \|\|

*kimarthamāgato brahman svayaṃ devaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|*

6\. He said, “I am quite graceful, and indebted to you that a great learned Brahmana, Lord of Yogins, had reached my place, by himself.

## \|\| 1.17.7 \|\|

*so 'bravīd bhagavān devo dharmayuktaṃ mahāsuram \|*  
*draṣṭumabhyāgato 'haṃ vai bhavantaṃ bhāgyavānasi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Brahmana, you yourself are Brahman; you kindly reveal to me the purpose of your arrival here? О Son of Brahma, you tell me, the particular task, which I can accomplish for you.”

## \|\| 1.17.8 \|\|

*sudurlabhā nītireṣā daityānāṃ daityasattama \|*  
*triloke dhārmiko nūnaṃ tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then lord Sanatkumara spoke the words which were quite religious, “O Mahasura, you are very fortunate and a lord in reality. I have arrived here, in order to have an audience with you,

## \|\| 1.17.9 \|\|

*ityukto 'surarājastaṃ punaḥ prāha mahāmunim \|*  
*dharmāṇāṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ brūhi me brahmavittama \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. О Best of the Daityas, such a type, of nice policy and temperament is difficult to be found among the asuras. Thefe is surely no more religious a person as comparable with you in the three worlds.”

## \|\| 1.17.10 \|\|

*so 'bravīd bhagavān yogī daityendrāya mahātmane \|*  
*sarvaguhyatamaṃ dharmamātmajñānamanuttamam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. At these words of the sage, the asura king again spoke, “O Best of those well-versed in Brahman, you kindly elucidate unto me the greatest of all virtues.”

## \|\| 1.17.11 \|\|

*sa labdhvā paramaṃ jñānaṃ dattvā ca gurudakṣiṇām \|*  
*nidhāya putre tadrājyaṃ yogābhyāsarato 'bhavat \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thereafter, the great yogi, spoke to the noble king of the Daityas, the most secret knowledge about the self-learning.

*sa tasya putro matimān balirnāma mahāsuraḥ \|*

12\. The Daitya king on the other hand, after receiving the best of knowledge, paid Gurudaksina (money by way of fees) unto the preceptor, and entrusting the care of his kingdom to his son, engaged himself in yogic practices.

## \|\| 1.17.13 \|\|

*kṛtvā tena mahad yuddhaṃ śakraḥ sarvāmarairvṛtaḥ \|*  
*jagāma nirjito viṣṇuṃ devaṃ śaraṇamacyutam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. His most intelligent son was known by the name of Bali. He was devoted to the Brahmanas, was extremely religious, and had conquered even Indra.

## \|\| 1.17.14-15 \|\|

*tadantare 'ditirdevī devamātā suduḥ khitā \|*
