*saṃpūjyamāno munibhiḥ sureśai-*  
*r jagāma kailāsagiriṃ girīśaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. At these words of the goddess Parvati, Sri Krisna, accepted her behest gracefully. Thereafter, lord Shiva bestowed his blessings on Krisna.” Lord Shiva, after holding the hand of Lord Krisna, getting adored by the gods and the sages, retreated to mount Kailasa accompanied by the goddess Parvati.

## Chapter 26. Performing of penances by Krisna

## \|\| 1.26.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*praviśya meruśikharaṃ kailāsaṃ kanakaprabham \|*  
*rarāma bhagavān somaḥ keśavena maheśvaraḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said, “Thereafter lord Shiva started sporting with Kesava over the mountain Kailasa, having the lustre of gold.

## \|\| 1.26.2 \|\|

*apaśyaṃstaṃ mahātmānaṃ kailāsagirivāsinaḥ \|*  
*pūjayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ devadevamathācyutam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Then the dwellers of Kailasa could have an audience with the infallible lord Krisna and they adored him like the lord of Devas.

## \|\| 1.26.3-5 \|\|

*caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ kālameghasamaprabham \|*  
*kirīṭinaṃ śārṅgapāṇi śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dīrghabāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam \|*  
*dadhānamurasā mālāṃ vaijayantīmanuttamām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhrājamānaṃ śriyā divyaṃ yuvānamatikomalam \|*  
*padmāṅghrinayanaṃ cāru susmitaṃ sugatipradam \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Lord Krisna had four arms, splendid limbs and lustre like a black cloud. He was wearing a coronet, holding a Sarnga bow in his hand, with his chest having been marked with the Srlvatsa mark. He had long aims, broad eyes, and was clad in yellow garments. He was wearing an excellent VaijayantI garland. He had an extremely soft body, youthful, and looked graceful with his divine lustre. His feet resembled the lotus flowers, while the eyes also resembled the lotus flowers. He was sweet- smiling and the bestower of liberation from the world.

## \|\| 1.26.6 \|\|

*kadācit tatra līlārthaṃ devakīnandavardhanaḥ \|*  
*bhrājamānaḥ śrīyā kṛṣṇaścacāra girikandare \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Lord Krisna, the increaser of the delight of DevakI, once for the enjoying of the bliss entered the mountain caves.

## \|\| 1.26.7-8 \|\|

*gandharvāpsarasāṃ mukhyā nāgakanyāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*siddhā yakṣāśca gandharvāstatra tatra jaganmayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatvā harṣādutphullocanāḥ \|*  
*mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi tasya mūrdhni mahātmanaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The prominent apsaras, the Gandharvas, all the naga girls, Siddhas, Yaksas, and the gods looked at Krisna with great surprise. With their eyes blooming like flowers out of great joy, they showered flowers on the head of that noble soul.

## \|\| 1.26.9 \|\|

*gandharvakanyakā divyāstadvadapsarasāṃ varāḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā cakamire kṛṣṇaṃ strastavastravibhūṣaṇāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The divine girls of Gandharvas, adorned with beautiful ornaments, besides the apsaras while offering prayers, were filled with passion at the sight of lord Krisna.

## \|\| 1.26.10 \|\|

*kāścid gāyanti vividhāṃ gītiṃ gītaviśāradāḥ \|*  
*saṃprekṣya devakīsūnuṃ sundaryaḥ kāmamohitāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Looking to the charming son of DevakI, having been infested with love, some of them started singing songs in various tunes.

## \|\| 1.26.11 \|\|

*kāścidvilāsabahulā nṛtyanti sma tadagrataḥ \|*  
*saṃprekṣya saṃsthitāḥ kāścit papustadvadanāmṛtam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Some of them feeling passionate, started dancing before Krisna. Some of them started imbibing the nectar-like beauty of his body with their eyes looking at his smiling face.

## \|\| 1.26.12 \|\|

*kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi svāṅgādādāya sādaram \|*  
*bhūṣayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ kāminyo lokabhūṣaṇam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Some of the girls removed the valuable ornaments from their bodies, and started decorating Krisna, the ornament of the world.

## \|\| 1.26.13 \|\|

*kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi samādāya tadaṅgataḥ \|*  
*svātmānaṃ būṣayāmāsuḥ svātmagairapi mādhavam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Some of them removing the ornaments from the body of Krisna started decorating themselves, and offering their own ornaments to Sri Krisna.

## \|\| 1.26.14 \|\|

*kāścidāgatya kṛṣṇasya samīpaṃ kāmamohitāḥ \|*  
*cucumburvadanāmbhojaṃ harermugdhamṛgekṣaṇāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Some of them having been infested with passion, having the deer like eyes, went to Krisna and started kissing his face.

## \|\| 1.26.15 \|\|

*pragṛhya kāścid govindaṃ kareṇa bhavanaṃ svakam \|*  
*prāpayāmāsurlokādiṃ māyayā tasya mohitāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Some of the girls having been deluded with the Maya of Krisna, holding his hand, tried to drag him to her own abode.

## \|\| 1.26.16 \|\|

*tāsāṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ kāmān kamalalocanaḥ \|*  
*bahūni kṛtvā rūpāṇi pūrayāmāsa līlayā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Then the lotus-eyed lord Krisna, took to many forms sportingly and fulfilled the desires of those damsels.

## \|\| 1.26.17 \|\|

*evaṃ vai suciraṃ kālaṃ devadevapure hariḥ \|*  
*reme nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān māyayā mohayañjagat \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thus, for a long time, the glorious Hari, Narayana sported in the city of the lord of Devas, fascinating the whole universe with his Maya.

## \|\| 1.26.18 \|\|

*gate bahutithe kāle dvāravatyāṃ nivāsinaḥ \|*  
*babhūvurvihvalā bhītā govindavirahe janāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. After the lapse of a long time, the dwellers of Dvaravati, were upset in the absence of Govinda, besides being frightened.

## \|\| 1.26.19 \|\|

*tataḥ suparṇo balavān pūrvameva visajitaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇena mārgamāṇastaṃ himavantaṃ yayau girim \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thereafter, the bird Garuda with beautiful wings, who had been released earlier, went there in search of Krisna at Himalaya.

## \|\| 1.26.20 \|\|

*adṛṣṭvā tatra govindaṃ praṇamya śirasā munim \|*  
*ājagāmopamanyuṃ taṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ punaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. When he could not find Krisna there, he bowed in reverence to the sage Upamanyu and returned back to Dvaravati.

## \|\| 1.26.21 \|\|

*tadantare mahādaityā rākṣasāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*ājagmurdvārakāṃ śubhrāṃ bhīṣayantaḥ sahastraśaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In the meantime, in the absence of Krisna, thousands of the terrific demons, reached the beautiful city of Dvaraka and started creating disturbances there.

## \|\| 1.26.22 \|\|

*sa tān suparṇo balavān kṛṣṇatulyaparākramaḥ \|*  
*hatvā yuddhena mahatā rakṣati sma purīṃ śubhām \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Then the beautiful Garuda, who was as valorous as Krisna himself, protected the city of Dvaraka, killing the demons in fight.

## \|\| 1.26.23 \|\|

*etasminneva kāle tu nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kailāsaśikhare kṛṣṇaṃ dvāravatīṃ gataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. At the same time, Narada, finding lord Krisna at the Kailas'a mountain, reached Dvaravati.

## \|\| 1.26.24 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradamṛṣiṃ sarve tatra nivāsinaḥ \|*  
*procurnārāyaṇo nāthaḥ kutrāste bhagavān hariḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The people of Dvaraka, finding the arrival of the sage Narada, asked him the whereabouts of Krisna.

## \|\| 1.26.25 \|\|

*sa tānuvāca bhagavān kailasaśikhare hariḥ \|*  
*ramate 'dya mahāyogīṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvāhamihāgataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Narada said, ‘"The great Yogin Krisna is sporting over the Kailasa mountain. Finding him there, I have arrived here.

## \|\| 1.26.26 \|\|

*tasyopaśrutya vacanaṃ suparṇaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*jagāmākāśago viprāḥ kailāsaṃ girimuttamam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О Brahmanas, on hearing the world of Narada, Garuda, the best among the birds, went to Kailas'a, by the sky way.

## \|\| 1.26.27 \|\|

*dadarśa devakīsūnuṃ bhavane ratnamaṇḍite \|*  
*varāsanasthaṃ govindaṃ devadevāntike harim \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. In a gem-studded palace there, he found Krisna, the son of DevakI, seated near lord Shiva, over a seat.

## \|\| 1.26.28 \|\|

*upāsyamānamamarairdivyastrībhiḥ samantataḥ \|*  
*mahādevagaṇaiḥ siddhairyogibhiḥ parivāritam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The divine damsels as well as the gods surrounding him from all sides, who were adoring him. He was also being adored by the Ganas of Mahadeva, the Siddhas and the Yogis.

## \|\| 1.26.29 \|\|

*praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau suparṇaḥ śaṅkaraṃ śivam \|*  
*nivedayāmāsa hareḥ pravṛttiṃ dvārake pure \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Garuda, prostrated before Shiva on earth like a staff and honouring him, narrated the happenings in Dvaraka.

## \|\| 1.26.30-31 \|\|

*tataḥ praṇamya śirasā śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam \|*  
*ājagāma purīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ so 'nujñāto hareṇa tu \|\| 30 \|\|*

*āruhya kaśyapasutaṃ strīgaṇairabhipūjitaḥ \|*  
*vacobhiramṛtāsvādairmānito madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Thereafter the brown-complexioned Shiva, was offered salutation quite humbly by Krisna, and seeking permission from him, riding over Garuda, the son of Kas'yapa, reached Dvaraka. At that point of time, Madhusfldana was worshipped by the crowed of damsels who honoured him speaking the nectar like words.

## \|\| 1.26.32 \|\|

*vīkṣya yāntamamitraghnaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ varāḥ \|*  
*anvagacchan mahoyogaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Looking at the departure of lord Krisna, the subjugator of the enemies, the divine Apsaras, and the Gandharvas, followed the MahdyogI holding conch, discus and club.

## \|\| 1.26.33 \|\|

*visarjayitvā viśvātmā sarvā evāṅganā hariḥ \|*  
*yayau sa tūrṇaṃ govindo divyāṃ dvāravatīṃ purīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Krisna, the universal soul, relieving all the damsels, then proceeded on to the heaven-like splendid city of Dvaravati.

## \|\| 1.26.34 \|\|

*gate muraripau naiva kāminyo munipuṅgavāḥ \|*  
*niśeva candrarahitā vinā tena cakāśire \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. With the departure of Krisna, the destroyer of the Danavas, the passionately loving women were faded out like the night without the moon.

## \|\| 1.26.35 \|\|

*śrutvā paurajanāstūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanamuttamam \|*  
*maṇḍayāñcakrire divyāṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Hearing the good news of arrival of lord Krisna, the people atonce decorated the beautiful city of Dvaravati.

## \|\| 1.26.36 \|\|

*patākābhirviśālābhirdhvajai ratnapariṣkṛtaiḥ \|*  
*lājādibhiḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣayāñcakrire tadā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The people hoisted flags and banners inside and outside Dvaraka and decorated the city with the garlands, fastoons etc.

## \|\| 1.26.37 \|\|

*avādayanta vividhān vāditrān madhurasvanān \|*  
*śaṅkhān sahastraśo dadhmurvoṇāvādān vitenire \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Several of the musical instruments started issuing sweet notes. The sound of thousands of conches, rented in the air and the sound for the playing on lute was spread everywhere.

## \|\| 1.26.38 \|\|

*praviṣṭamātre govinde purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām \|*  
*agāyan madhuraṃ gānaṃ striyo yauvanaśālinaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Lord Govinda, soon after his entry in the city of Dvaravati, the young charming women started singing sweet songs.

## \|\| 1.26.39 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā nanṛturīśānaṃ sthitāḥ prāsādamūrdhasu \|*  
*mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi vasudevasutopari \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. They started dancing at the sight of Krisna and reaching the top floors of the palaces, they started showering the flowers over Vasudeva Krisna.

## \|\| 1.26.40 \|\|

*praviśya bhavanaṃ kṛṣṇa āśīrvādābhivardhitaḥ \|*  
*varāsane mahāyogī bhāti devībhiranvitaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thus having been honoured with benedictions, lord Krisna entered the city of Dvaraka. He was then seated over an excellent seat, and looked graceful in the company of the ladies.

## \|\| 1.26.41-42 \|\|

*suramye maṇḍape śubhre śaṅkhādyaiḥ parivāritaḥ \|*  
*ātmajairabhito mukhyaiḥ strīsahastraiśca saṃvṛtaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tatrāsanavare ramye jāmbavatyā sahācyutaḥ \|*  
*bhrājate mālayā devo yathā devyā samanvitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. In the charming ceremonial hall, he was surrounded by the musicians playing musical instalments including-the Samkha. All the close relatives surrounded him besides thousands of damsels. Seated with Jambavati, Krisna, appeared so beautiful as Parvati looked graceful with Shiva.

## \|\| 1.26.43 \|\|

*ājagmurdevagandharvā draṣṭuṃ lokādimavyayam \|*  
*maharṣayaḥ pūrvajātā mārkaṇḍeyādayo dvijāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О Brahmanas, at that point of time, the Gods, Gandharvas, elderly sage Markandeya and other Rishis, and other people arrived there to have a look at the undecaying lord.

## \|\| 1.26.44 \|\|

*tataḥ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo mārkaṇḍeyaṃ samāgatam \|*  
*nanāmotthāya śirasā svāsanaṃ ca dadau hariḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Lord Krisna then offered his salutation to the sage Markandeya, lowering his head and offered him his own seat.

## \|\| 1.26.45 \|\|

*saṃpūjya tānṛṣigaṇān praṇāmena mahābhujaḥ \|*  
*visarjayāmāsa harirdattvā tadabhivāñchitān \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Lord Hari bowing in reverence adored all the sages, and bestowed the desired boons to them and bid them farewell.

## \|\| 1.26.46 \|\|

*tadā madhyāhnasamaye devadevaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ \|*  
*snātvā śuklāmbaro bhānumupatiṣṭhat kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Then Hari-the god of gods, took his bath and was clad in white garments. Then he adored the sun with folded hands.

## \|\| 1.26.47 \|\|

*jajāpa jāpyaṃ vidhivat prekṣamāṇo divākaram \|*  
*tarpayāmāsa deveśo deveśo devān munigaṇān pitṝn \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Looking at the sun, Krisna recited the mantras appropriately and offered oblations to the gods, Pitrs, and the Rishis.

## \|\| 1.26.48 \|\|

*praviśya devabhavanaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena caiva hi \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa liṅgasthaṃ bhūteśaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Entering the temple of the lord in the company of sage Markandeya, he adored lord of Bhutas (Shiva) adorned with the ashes, embodied in the Linga.

## \|\| 1.26.49-50 \|\|

*samāpya niyamaṃ sarvaṃ niyantāsau nṛṇāṃ svayam \|*  
*bhojayitvā munivaraṃ brāhmaṇānabhipūjya ca \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kṛtvātmayogaṃ viprendrā mārkaṇḍeyena cācyutaḥ \|*  
*kathāḥ paurāṇikīḥ puṇyāścakre putrādibhirvṛtaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. О Brahmanas, then the lord who controls the universe, performed all the religious activities appropriately. Then he served food to the ascetics, honoured the Brahmanas, performing his Atmayoga. Acyuta, surrounded by his sons and others discussed the holy Pauranic stories, with sage Markandeya.

## \|\| 1.26.51 \|\|

*athaitat sarvamakhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā karma mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*mārkaṇḍeyo hasan kṛṣṇaṃ babhāṣe madhuraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thereafter, Markandeya, the grdat sage, observing all the activities, smilingly spoke the sweet words to Krisna.

## \|\| 1.26.52-53 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca*  
*kaḥ samārādhyate devo bhavatā karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*brūhi tvaṃ karmabhiḥ pūjyo yogināṃ dhyeya eva ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tvaṃ hi tat paramaṃ brahma nirvāṇamamalaṃ padam \|*  
*bhārāvataraṇārthāya jāto vṛṣṇikule prabhuḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Markandeya said “Who is the god being adored by you with these auspicious deeds, when you yourself are worthy of being worshipped by means of holy rites, and deserve to be meditated upon by Yogins? You are the Supreme Brahman, the final liberation. You are the lord having been bom on the earth in the family of Vrsnis to relieve the burden of the earth.

## \|\| 1.26.54 \|\|

*tamabravīnmahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇo brahmavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*śṛṇvatāmeva putrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prahasanniva \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Then Krisna, the long-armed one, the best among those who are well-versed in Brahman, spoke smilingly to him even as all his sons were listening.

## \|\| 1.26.55 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca*  
*bhavatā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tathyameva na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tathāpi devamīśānaṃ pūjayāmi sanātanam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Sri Krisna said, “Whatever has been spoken by you is the truth. There is no doubt about it. But still I may tell you that I am adoring Isana (lord Shiva).

## \|\| 1.26.56 \|\|

*na me viprāsti kartavyaṃ nānavāptaṃ kathañcana \|*  
*pūjayāmi tathāpīśaṃ jānannaitat paraṃ śivam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O Brahmana, there is nothing to be done by me, and nothing is beyond my reach. Still, knowing fully well all this, I adore Supreme lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.26.57-58 \|\|

*na vai paśyanti taṃ devaṃ māyayā mohitā janāḥ \|*  
*tato 'haṃ svātmano mūlaṃ jñāpayan pūjayāmi tam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*na ca liṅgārcanāt puṇyaṃ lokesmin bhītināśanam \|*  
*tathā liṅge hitāyaiṣāṃ lokānāṃ pūjayecchivam \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. The people who are overpowered with illusion, are unable to have an audience with Shiva. But, I adore him introducing him to be my original cause. There is nothing more auspicious than the adoration of Linga, which removes all the misfortunes. Therefore the Shiva embodied in the linga should be worshipped for the welfare of the people.

## \|\| 1.26.59 \|\|

*yo 'haṃ talliṅgamityāhurvedavādavido janāḥ \|*  
*tato 'hamātmamīśānaṃ pūjayāmyātmanaiva tu \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The linga happens to be my own form. This is what is believed by the people well-versed in the Vedic literature. Therefore, I adore Tsana who happens to be my pure Atman, by means of my own self.

## \|\| 1.26.60 \|\|

*tasyaiva paramā mūrtistanmayo 'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*nāvayordyite bhedo vedeṣvevaṃ viniścayaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. I myself am his own supreme form and am like Shiva himself. There is no doubt about it. This aspect has been testified in the Vedas. This is certain.

## \|\| 1.26.61 \|\|

*eṣa devo mahādevaḥ sadā saṃsārabhīrubhiḥ \|*  
*dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca vandyaśca jñeyo liṅge maheśvaraḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. For the terrified people because of the miseries of worldly existence, lord Shiva is always adorable. He should always be offered sacrifices, worshipped, respected and realized in the Lingo, form.

## \|\| 1.26.62 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca*  
*kiṃ talliṅgaṃ suraśreṣṭha liṅge saṃpūjyate ca kaḥ \|*  
*brūhi kṛṣṇa viśālākṣa gahanaṃ hyetaduttamam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Markandeya said, “O Excellent god what is the lingo, and who is adored in the form of lingo"} О Krisna with vast eyes, you kindly speak out on this profound and excellent mystery.

## \|\| 1.26.63 \|\|

*avyaktaṃ liṅgamityāhurānandaṃ jyotirakṣaram \|*  
*vedā mahesvaraṃ devamāhurliṅginamavyayam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Lord Krisna said, “They call the Avyakta (the unmanifest) as the Linga, which is blissful, the eternal splendour. The Vedas and the scriptures call the undecaying Mahesvara as the lingo.

## \|\| 1.26.64-65 \|\|

*purā caikārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame \|*  
*prabodhārthaṃ brahmaṇo me prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tasmāt kālāt samārabhya brahmā cāhaṃ sadaiva hi \|*  
*pūjayāvo mahādevaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. In the ancient times, when all the mobiles and the immobiles were destroyed in the vast sheet of water of the deluge, MahaShiva manifested himself in order to enlighten me and Brahma. Since that time, for the welfare of the three worlds, myself and Brahma, adore Shiva.”

## \|\| 1.26.66 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca*  
*kathaṃ liṅgamabhūt pūrvamaiśvaraṃ paramaṃ padam \|*  
*prabodhārthaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇa vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Markandeya said, “O Krisna, now you tell us as to how the linga, the highest region of Ishvara, appeared in order to enlighten you both?

## \|\| 1.26.67-68 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca*  
*āsodekārṇavaṃ ghoramavibhāgaṃ tamomayam \|*  
*madhye caikārṇave tasmin śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*sahastraśīrṣā bhūtvāhaṃ sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt sahastrabāhuryuktātmā śayito 'haṃ sanātanaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. Then lord Visnu said, “When there was a vast sheet of water of deluge filled with darkness, which was terrible and undemarcated, then I had been sleeping over the serpent bed with a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, thousand arms, and a thousand feet, holding the conch, discus and the club.

## \|\| 1.26.69-71 \|\|

*etasminnantare dūratā paśyami hyamitaprabham \|*  
*koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ bhrājamānaṃ śriyāvṛtam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*caturvaraktraṃ mahāyogaṃ puruṣaṃ kāñcanaprabham \|*  
*kṛṣṇājiradharaṃ devamṛgyajuḥ sāmabhiḥ stutam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*nimeṣamātreṇa sa māṃ prāpto yogavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*vyājahāra svayaṃ brahmā smayamāno mahādyutiḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

69-71. In the meantime, I looked from a distance lord Brahma, offering prayer, having vast resplendence, having the lustre of the crores of suns, illumining, graceful, the great yogi, fourfaced, the cause of the universe, the anceint Purusa, clad in the skin of the black antelope, being eulogized by the Vedas like the Rk, Yajuh and Sama. In a moment, Brahma, the best of the Yogins, smilingly, himself came near me and asked.

## \|\| 1.26.72 \|\|

*kastvaṃ kuto vā kiṃ ceha tiṣṭhase vaha me prabho \|*  
*ahaṃ kartā hi lokānāṃ svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Who are you? Where from have you arrived? What for are you staying here? You kindly tell me. I am the self-bom Brahma, the creator of the universe.”

## \|\| 1.26.73-75 \|\|

*evamuktastadā tena brahmaṇāhamuvāca ha \|*  
*ahaṃ kartāsmi lokānāṃ saṃhartā ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*evaṃ vivāde vitate māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*prabodhārthaṃ paraṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*kālānalasamaprakhyaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam \|*  
*kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktamādimadhyāntavarjitam \|\| 75 \|\|*

73-75. At these words of Brahma, I replied to him, “I am the one who creates the universe again and again, besides destroying the same. Because of the Maya of Paramesthi, the controversy escalated. Then in order to enlighten them about factual and truthful position, a Shivalinga appeared on the scene. The said Shivalinga had may flames emerging out of it like the fire at the time of dissolution. It was free from expansion or decay and was beyond, the beginning, middle or the end.

## \|\| 1.26.76-77 \|\|

*tato māmāha bhagavānadho gaccha tvamāśu vai \|*  
*antamasya vijānīma ūrdhvaṃ gacche 'hamityajaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*tadāśu samayaṃ kṛtvā gatāvūrdhvamadhaśca dvau \|*  
*pitāmaho 'pyahaṃ nāntaṃ jñātavantau samāḥ śatam \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. Then lord Brahma asked me, “You atonce go beneath the linga and try to find out the limit of it and I shall go up. Both of us, myself and the grandsire, were unable to find out the limit of it even after a hundred years.

## \|\| 1.26.78-79 \|\|

*tato vismayamāpannau bhītau devasya śūlinaḥ \|*  
*māyayā mohitau tasya dhyāyantau viśvamīśvaram \|\| 78 \|\|*

*proccārantau mahānādamoṅkāraṃ paramaṃ padam \|*  
*prahvāñjalipuṭopetau śaṃbhuṃ tuṣṭuvatuḥ param \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. Then influenced with the illusion of the trident-bearer, both of us were frightened and surprised and started meditating upon Ishvara. Thereafter, both of us uttering Omkara, offered our salutation to lord Shiva, and started eulogising Shiva with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 1.26.80-85 \|\|

*brahmaviṣṇū ūcatuḥ \|*  
*anādimalasaṃsārarogavaidyāya śaṃbhave \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 80 \|\|*

*pralayārṇavasaṃsthāya pralayodbhūtihetave \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 81 \|\|*

*jvālāmālāvṛtāṅgāya jvalanastambharūpiṇe \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 82 \|\|*

*ādimadhyāntahīnāya svabāvāmaladīptaye \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 83 \|\|*

*mahādevāya mahate jyotiṣe 'nantatejase \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 84 \|\|*

*pradhānapuruṣeśāya vyomarūpāya vedhase \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 85 \|\|*

80-85. Both Brahma and Visnu said, “O Lord, you are eternal having the basic form, physician for the worldly ailments, you are the root-cause of which is the beginningless Avidya (Maya), salutations to you, the quiescent Brahman of the form of linga. You are lodged in the vast ocean of the dissolution, you are Shiva, being the cause of creation and dissolution, having the form of linga, salutation to you. You are the form of fire flames, like the burning pillar, you are Shiva, calm, and having the form of Brahman. Salutation to you. You are beyond the beginning, middle or end, spotless by nature, you are infinte Brahman of the form of linga, salutation to you. О Mahadeva, you are great, form of fire flame, beyond measure, illustrious Shiva, you are peaceful, Brahman in the form of linga, salutation to you. You are Ishvara of the Pradhana and Purusa, obeisance to you, the Vedhas (Creator), of the form of firmament.

## \|\| 1.26.86-87 \|\|

*nirvikārāya satyāya nityāyāmalatejase \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 86 \|\|*

*vedāntasārarūpāya kālarūpāya dhīmate \|*  
*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. You are unblemished, truthful, everlasting, immensely illustrious, calm, Shiva in the form of linga, salutation to you as Brahman. You are the gist of Vedanta, the form of Kala, learned, form of linga. Shiva, peaceful Brahman. Salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.26.88-90 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu vyakto bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*bhāti devo mahāyogī sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*vaktrakoṭisahastreṇa grasamāna ivāmbaram \|*  
*sahastrahastacaraṇaḥ sūryasomāgnilocanaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*pinākapāṇirbhagavān kṛttivāsāstriśūlabhṛt \|*  
*vyālayajñopavītaśca meghadundubhiniḥ svanaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

88-90. At the prayer of both Brahma and Visnu, Mahesvara appeared there with the resplendence of crores of suns. He was consuming the sky with the thousands and crores of his mouths. He had thousands of hands and feet, had three eyes representing the sun, moon and fire. He held a bow in his hands, he had the elephant’s hide for his garments. He carried a trident, and used a serpent as the sacred thread. He issued sound like the cloud or the dundubhi (divine drum).

## \|\| 1.26.91-92 \|\|

*athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto 'haṃ surasattamau \|*  
*paśyetaṃ māṃ mahādevaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ pramucyatām \|\| 91 \|\|*

*yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau \|*  
*ayaṃ me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*vāmapārśve ca me viṣṇuḥ pālako hṛdaye haraḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. Mahadeva said, “O Excellent gods, I am pleased with you. I am Mahadeva, therefore you have a look at me. Shed away the entire fright. Both of you had emerged out of my body as the eternal gods. Brahma, the grandsire was bom out of my right side and Visnu emerged out of my left side. Sankara is lodged in my heart.

## \|\| 1.26.93 \|\|

*prīto 'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyak varaṃ dadmi yathepsitam \|*  
*evamuktvātha māṃ devo mahādevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*āliṅgya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prasādābhimukho 'bhavat \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. I am extremely pleased with you, therefore, I bestow on you the desired boons.” Thus speaking, Mahadeva Shiva, himself got ready to grace both of us with an embrance.

## \|\| 1.26.94-96 \|\|

*tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasau praṇipatya maheśvaram \|*  
*ūcatuḥ prekṣya tadvaktraṃ nārāyaṇapitāmahau \|\| 94 \|\|*

*yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca nau \|*  
*bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi deva maheśvare \|\| 95 \|\|*

*tataḥ sa bhagavānīśaḥ prahasan parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca māṃ mahādevaḥ prītaḥ prītena cetasā \|\| 96 \|\|*

94-96. Then both Narayana and Brahma-the grand- sire, offered their salutation to Mahesvara and looking at his face, said, О Lord, in case you have developed affection for us, and you intend to bestow boons on us, then you grace us with a boon that both of us should remain devoted to you. Then the delighted Ishvara, smilingly said to me.

## \|\| 1.26.97-100 \|\|

*deva uvāca*  
*pralayasthitisargāṇāṃ kartā tvaṃ dharaṇīpate \|*  
*vatsa vatsa hare viśvaṃ pālayaitaccarācaram \|\| 97 \|\|*

*tridhā bhinno 'smyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā \|*  
*sargarakṣālayaguṇairnirguṇo 'pi nirañjanaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*saṃmohaṃ tyaja bho viṣṇo pālayainaṃ pitāmaham \|*  
*bhaviṣyatyeṣa bhagavāṃstava putraḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*ahaṃ ca bhavato vaktrāt kalpādau ghorarūpadhṛk \|*  
*śūlapāṇirbhaviṣyāmi krodhajastava putrakaḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

97-100. Then lord Shiva, the god of gods said, “O Lord of the Earth, О Son Hari, you are responsible for the creation, sustenance and the destruction of the world. You better look after the mobile and immobile world. Inspite of my being spotless and attributeless, for the creation, sustenance and destruction of the world, I shall be known as Brahma, Visnu and Shiva-Hara, dividing myself into three forms. О Visnu, eschew your delusion and protect Brahma, the grandsire of the worlds. The eternal lord will definitely be your son. At the start of the kalpa, I shall also appear from your mouth and shall take to the divine form. Then carrying a trident in my arm, I shall be your enraged son.”

## \|\| 1.26.101-102 \|\|

*evamuktvā mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ munisattama \|*  
*anugṛhya ca māṃ devastatraivāntaradhīyata \|\| 101 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu liṅgārcā supratiṣṭhitā \|*  
*liṅga tallayanād brahman brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ vapuḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. О Excellent sages, thus speaking lord Mahadeva, showering his grace on me as well as Brahma, disappeared from that place. The worship of the lingas, started since that date and had been well-established in this world. The linga is the supreme form of Brahman.

## \|\| 1.26.103-105 \|\|

*etalliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ te mayānagha \|*  
*etad budhyanti yogajñā na devā na ca dānavāḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

*etaddhi paramaṃ jñānamavyaktaṃ śivasaṃjñitam \|*  
*yena sūkṣmamacintyaṃ tat paśyanti jñāna vakṣuṣaḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

*tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaskāraṃ prakurmahe \|*  
*mahādevāya rudrāya devadevāya liṅgine \|\| 105 \|\|*

103-105. О Sinless one, I have spoken to you about the glory of linga, which is known to the people who are well-versed in yogic exercises. The truth about the same is neither known to the Devas nor the Danavas. This is the invisible supreme knowledge designated as Shiva-lore. Those having the divine sight of knowledge, can see that Lord, subtle and incomprehensible. Therefore, we offer our salutation to Shiva, the lord of gods in the form of Rudra.

## \|\| 1.26.106-108 \|\|

*namo vedarahasyāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ \|*  
*vibhīṣaṇāya śāntāya sthāṇave hetave namaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*brahmaṇe vāmadevāya trinetrāya mahīyase \|*  
*śaṅkarāya maheśāya girīśāya śivāya ca \|\| 107 \|\|*

*namaḥ kuruṣva satataṃ dhyāyasva manasā haram \|*  
*saṃsārasāgarādasmādacirāduttariṣyasi \|\| 108 \|\|*

106-108. II Salutation to you, being the secret of the Vedas, salutation to the blue-throated one. Salutation to the one who creates terror, is peaceful standing, and the cause of the universe. О Vamadeva, the three-eyed one, the glorious one, Brahman, Sankara, Mahesa, Girls'a and Shiva, salutation to you, being cause of all.” One should always adore him. Meditate mentally on Mahesvara, and by so doing, you will be free from the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 1.26.109-110 \|\|

*evaṃ sa vāsudevena vyāhṛto munipuṅgavaḥ \|*  
*jagāma manasā devamīśānaṃ viśvatomukham \|\| 109 \|\|*

*praṇamya śirasā kṛṣṇamanujñāto mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*jagāma cepsitaṃ deśaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

109-110. At these words of Vasudeva, Markandeya, the great sage, meditated upon the universal lord Shiva (Isana). Then offering his salutation to lord Krisna with humility, getting his permission, he returned to the place of Shiva, the holder of a trident.

## \|\| 1.26.111-113 \|\|

*ya imaṃ śrāvayennityaṃ liṅgādhyāyamanuttamam \|*  
*śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 111 \|\|*

*śrutvā sakṛdapi hyetat tapaścaraṇamuttamam \|*  
*vāsudevasya viprendrāḥ pāpaṃ muñciti mānavaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

*japed vāharaharnityaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate \|*  
*evamāha mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

111-113. The one who will listen to the excellent chapter on linga, narrate it or recite the same, he, will be relieved of all the sins. After hearing even for once it becomes the performance of the penance of Vasudeva. Or otherwise, by reading it daily, he will achieve the glorious position in the Brahmaloka. This is what has been ordained by the great Yogin, the lord Krisna Dvaipayan.

## Chapter 27. Departure of Krisna to his abode

## \|\| 1.27.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*tato labdhavaraḥ kṛṣṇo jāmbavatyāṃ maheśvarāt \|*  
*ajījananmahātmānaṃ sāmbamātmajamuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pradyumnasyāpyabhūt putro hyaniruddho mahābalaḥ \|*  
*tāvubhau guṇasaṃpannau kṛṣṇasyaivāpare tanū \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said, “Then lord Krisna, having received a boon from Mahesvara, produced a son named Samba from JambavatT. Pradyumna, on the other hand also got a valorous son named Aniruddha.1 Both the virtuous sons were as if the other two bodies of Krisna himself.

## \|\| 1.27.3-4 \|\|

*hatvā ca kaṃsaṃ narakamanyāṃśca śataśo 'surān \|*  
*vijitya līlayā śakraṃ jitvā bāṇaṃ mahāsuram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sthāpayitvā jagat kṛtsnaṃ loke dharmāṃśca śāśvatān \|*  
*cakre nārāyaṇo gantuṃ svasthānaṃ buddhimuttamām \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. After killing Karhsa, Naraka and hundreds of other asuras, Indra was conquered playfully and then defeating the great demon Bana, establishing the eternal dharma in the entire world, Narayana, then thought of returning to his own abode.

## \|\| 1.27.5 \|\|

*etasminnantare viprā bhṛgvādyāḥ kṛṣṇamīśvaram \|*  
*ājagmurdvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ kṛtakāryaṃ sanātanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In the meantime, Bhrgu and other Brahmanas came to Dvaraka in order to see the eternal lord Krisna who had accomplished his mission.

## \|\| 1.27.6-7 \|\|

*sa tānuvāca viśvātmā praṇipatyābhipūjya ca \|*  
*āsaneṣūpaviṣṭān vai saha rāmeṇa dhīmatā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*gamiṣye tat paraṃ sthānaṃ svakīyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñitam \|*  
*kṛtāni sarvakāryāṇi prasīdadhvaṃ munīśvarāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. After bowing to and worshipping them and when they had been comfortably seated alongwith the intelligent Rama, Krisna, the Atman of the universe said, “O Best of the sages, all the tasks have been established by me. I shall now return to the abode of Visnu. Let all of you be pleased to permit me.

## \|\| 1.27.8-9 \|\|

*idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptamadhunāśubham \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti janāḥ sarve hyasmin pāpānuvartinaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pravartayadhvaṃ majjñānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāvaham \|*  
*yeneme kalijaiḥ pāpairmucyante hi dvijottamāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. The terrific age of Kali has arrived, when all the people would get inclined towards the committing of the sins. Therefore, О Best of the Brahmanas, you should propagate the auspicious knowledge to the ignorant people for their welfare, to get them relieved from the sins of the Kali age.

## \|\| 1.27.10-11 \|\|

*ye māṃ janāḥ saṃsmaranti kalau sakṛdapi prabhum \|*  
*teṣāṃ naśyatu tat pāpaṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yer'cayiṣyantimāṃ bhaktyā nityaṃ kaliyuge dvijāḥ \|*  
*vidhānā vedadṛṣṭena te gamiṣyanti tat padam \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The people who in the age of Kali shall remember me, even once, all their sins will be washed out. The people who, in the age of Kali, shall adore me everyday with devotion, they will surely achieve my place in accordance with the injunction prescribed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.27.12-14 \|\|

*ye brāhmaṇā vaṃśajātā yuṣmākaṃ vai sahastraśaḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ nārāyaṇe bhaktirbhaviṣyati kalau yuge \|\| 12 \|\|*

*parāt parataraṃ yānti nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*na te tatra gamiṣyanti ye dviṣanti maheśvaram \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dhyānaṃ homaṃ tapastaptaṃ jñānaṃ yajñādiko vidhiḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipraṃ ye nindanti pinākinam \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. The thousands of the Brahmanas who would be bom in your dynasties, they shall be devoted to Narayana, in the age of Kali. Those who are devoted to Narayana, achieve the highest position with Narayana, because of their devotion. But such of the people who remain envious of Mahesvara, they would not be able to achieve that supreme position. Such of the people who denounce Mahesvara, all their meditation Yogic practice, penance, knowledge and the yajnas, become infructuous.

## \|\| 1.27.15-16 \|\|

*yo māṃ samāśrayennityamekāntaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ \|*  
*vinindya devamīśānaṃ sa yāti narakāyutam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tasmāt sā parihartavyā nindā paśupatau dvijāḥ \|*  
*karmaṇā manasā vācā tadbhakteṣvapi yatnataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Those who adore me everyday with single- minded devotion, but denounces lord Shiva, they fall into ten thousand hells for ten thousand years. Therefore, О Brahmanas, one should not denounce by action, thought or behaviour, Pasupati Shiva, as well as my devotees, making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.27.17-18 \|\|

*ye tu dakṣādhvare śaptā dadhīyena dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti kalau bhaktaiḥ parihāryāḥ prayatnataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dviṣanto devamīśānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ vaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*śaptāśca gautamenorvyāṃ na saṃbhāṣyā dvijottamaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. О Best of the Brahmanas, the devotees should avail such denouncement in the age of Kali, as was done by Dadhica in the yajna of Daksha. Such of the Brahmanas who have been bom in your races but are envious of Shiva, and have been bom on earth as a curse of the sage Gautama, are not worthy of being conversed with by the excellent Brahmanas.”

## \|\| 1.27.19-20 \|\|

*ityevamuktāḥ kṛṣṇena sarva eva maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*omityuktvā yayustūrṇaṃsvāni sthānāni sattamāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tato nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo līlayaiva jaganmayaḥ \|*  
*saṃhṛtya svakulaṃ sarvaṃ yayau tat paramaṃ padam \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. At these words of lord Krisna, all the best of the Rishis declared, “This is correct.” Thus speaking, all of them left for their abodes. Thereafter, lord Krisna, the pervader of the world, sportingly dissolved his entire race, and attained that Supreme region.

## \|\| 1.27.21-22 \|\|

*ityeṣa vaḥ samāsena rājñāṃ vaṃśo 'nukīrtitaḥ \|*  
*na śakyo vistarād vaktuṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha \|\| 21 \|\|*

*yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi vaṃśānāṃ kathanaṃ śubham \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Thus, I have described the races of the kings in brief, because the exhaustive description of the same can not be done. Now what else do you want to listen from me? A person, who reads or listens to the stories of these auspicious races, he is relieved of all the sins and becomes adorable even in the heaven.

## Chapter 28. Partha's Encounter with Vyasa

## \|\| 1.28.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam \|*  
*eṣāṃ svabhāvaṃ sūtādya kathayasva samāsataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The Rishis said, “O Suta, there are four Yugas (sons) named, Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kaliyuga. You kindly speak out the influence of each one of them.”

## \|\| 1.28.2-4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*gate nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe svameva paramaṃ padam \|*  
*pārthaḥ paramadharmātmā pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kṛtvā cevottaravidhiṃ śokena mahatāvṛtaḥ \|*  
*apaśyat pathi gacchantaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyairabhitaḥ saṃvṛtaṃ brahmavādinam \|*  
*papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau tyaktvā śokaṃ tadār'junaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Suta said, “After the departure of Narayana to his abode, Partha, the son of Pandu, the highly virtuous soul, and the destroyer of his enemies, after performing the subsequent obsequies rites, was overwhelmed with great grief. He on his way found Krisna Dvaipayana surrounded by his disciples. Arjuna, then shedding away the grief, prostrated before the sage like a staff on the ground, offering his salutation to him.

## \|\| 1.28.5-7 \|\|

*uvāca paramaprītaḥ kasmād deśānmahāmune \|*  
*idānīṃ gacchasi kṣipraṃ kaṃ vā deśaṃ prati prabho \|\| 5 \|\|*

*saṃdarśanād vai bhavataḥ śoko me vipulo gataḥ \|*  
*idānīṃ mama yat kāryaṃ brūhi padmadalekṣaṇa \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tamuvāca mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam \|*  
*upaviśya nadītire śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto muniḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Arjuna lovingly said to the sage Vyasa, “O Great sage, where from are you coming? Where are you going in such a haste? With an auspicious audience with you my entire grief has vanished. О Vayasadeva, with lotus like eyes, you tell me in case I could be of any use to you?” Then the sage Krisna Dvaipayana Vyasa, who was surrounded by the pupils, sat over the river bank and said.

## Chapter 29. Description of Yugadharma

## \|\| 1.29.1-3 \|\|

*idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptaṃ pāṇḍunandana \|*  
*tato gacchāmi devasya vārāṇasīṃ mahāpurīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

*asmin kaliyuge ghore lokāḥ pāpānuvartinaḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti mahāpāpā varṇāśramavivarjitāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nānyat paśyāmi jantūnāṃmuktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm \|*  
*sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalau yuge \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Vyasa said, “О Son of Pandu, the terrific Kaliyuga has arrived and because of this, I am proceeding to Varanasi, the abode of Shiva. О mighty-armed one, in this horrible Kaliyuga, the people shall be devoid of the Varmsrama dharma (religious discipline of the four castes and stages of life), and shall indulge themselves into the grave sins. I do not find any other place, except Varanasi, where one could relieve himself of all the sins. There is no other place of repentances available on earth.

## \|\| 1.29.4-5 \|\|

*kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca sarveṣveteṣu vai narāḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tvaṃ hi lokeṣu vikhyāto dhṛtimāñ janavatsalaḥ \|*  
*pālayādya paraṃ dharmaṃ svakīyaṃ mucyase bhayāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. During Krtayuga, Treta and Dvdpara the people will be usually noble-souled, religious- minded as well as truthful in speech. You are well known the world over, as the beloved of the people besides being patient. Therefore, you should follow your own dharma and by so doing you shall be free from the fear.

## \|\| 1.29.6-7 \|\|

*evamukto bhagavatā pārthaḥ parapurañjayaḥ \|*  
*pṛṣṭavān praṇipatyāsau yugadharmān dvijottamāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tasmai provāca sakalaṃ muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya devamīśānaṃ yugadharmān sanātanān \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. О Best of the Brahmanas, at these words of the sage Vyasa, Arjuna, the conqueror of cities of enemies, offering salutation to him, asked him about the respective duties in the different Yugas. Then Vyasa, the son of Satyavatl, offering his salutation to lord Shiva, explained to Arjuna, the eternal Yugadharmas.

## \|\| 1.29.8-10 \|\|

*vakṣyāmi te samāsena yugadharmān nareśvara \|*  
*na śakyate mayā pārtha vistareṇābhibhāṣitum \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ tatastretāyugaṃ budhaiḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyaṃ dvāparaṃ pārtha caturthaṃ kalirucyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate \|*  
*dvāpare yajñamevāhurdānameva kalau yuge \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Vyasa said, О King, О Partha, I shall explain the Yugadharmas to you in brief, because I cannot narrate the same exhaustively. О Partha, the learned people call Krtayuga as the first one. The second one is Tretayuga, the third one is Dvapara, while the fourth one is Kaliyuga. The means of salvation in Krtayuga is meditation, jnana or knowledge in Tretayuga, performance of sacrifices in Dvapara, while charities are prescribed only in Kaliyuga, which are the best means of salvation.

## \|\| 1.29.11-14 \|\|

*brahmā kṛtayuge devastretāyāṃ bhagavān raviḥ \|*  
*dvāpare daivataṃ viṣṇuḥ kalau rudro maheśvaraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*brahmā viṣṇustathā sūryaḥ sarva eva kaliṣvapi \|*  
*pūjyate bhagavān rudraścaturṣvapi pinākadhṛk \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ādye kṛtayuge dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*tretāyuge tripādaḥ syād dvipādo dvāpare sthitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tripādahīnastiṣye tu sattāmātreṇa tiṣṭhati \|*  
*kṛte tu mithunotpattirvṛttiḥ sākṣād rasollasā \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. Brahma happens to be the god in Krtayuga. Similarly, Surya happens to be the god in Treta, Visnu is the god in Dvapara, while Mahesvara Rudra is the god in the age of Kali. Brahma, Visnu and Surya are adored in Kaliyuga too. But Rudra, the holder of the Pinaka bow, is adored in all the four Yugas. The Dharma had full four feet in Krtayuga. It has three feet in Tretayuga, two feet in Dvapara. But in Kaliyuga, Dharma is deprived of the three feet and it merely exists.

## \|\| 1.29.15-18 \|\|

*prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sadānandāśca bhoginaḥ \|*  
*adhamottamatvaṃ nāstyāsāṃ nirviśeṣāḥ purañjaya \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasmin kṛte yuge \|*  
*viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāntabahulāstathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dhyānaniṣṭhāstaponiṣṭhā mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*tā vai niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*parvatodadhivāsinyo hyaniketaḥ parantapa \|*  
*rasollāsā kālayogāt tretākhye naśyate tataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. During the Krtayuga, the creation was as a result of the conjugal pleasure between the man and woman. The earnings of the people were devoid of greed. The subjects were always contented and all the people enjoyed all the pleasures. There was no inferiority and superiority among them. During Krtayuga, the age, pleasure and beauty were equal. The entire people were devoid of grief and well-versed in the tattvas. They liked seclusion, engaged themselves in meditation, performed tapas, and were engaged in the worship of Mahadeva. The people performed the selfless deeds. They had the delightful hearts. О scorcher of enemies, the people stayed on mountains and in the ocean. They had no fixed abode.

## \|\| 1.29.19-21 \|\|

*tasyāṃ siddhau praṇaṣṭāyāmanyā siddhiravartata \|*  
*apāṃ saukṣmye pratihate tadā meghātmanā tu vai \|\| 19 \|\|*

*meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam \|*  
*sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃyukte pṛthivītale \|\| 20 \|\|*

*prādurāsaṃstadā tāsāṃ vṛkṣā vai gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ \|*  
*sarvapratyupayogastu tāsāṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. О Brahmanas, thereafter in due course of time, in Tretayuga the cheerfulness had disappeared. When that Siddhi perished, another type of Siddhi appeared. With the disappearing of the pleasure of the waters, the rain fall on the earth from thundering clouds and the lightening were apparent. Such a rain fell, early once only, the trees were grown for the benefit of the people. The things of daily use were procured from the trees.

## \|\| 1.29.22-23 \|\|

*vartayanti sma tebhyastāstretāyugamukhe prajāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyatāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

*rāgalobhātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko 'bhavat \|*  
*viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tu tena tatkālabhāvinā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Thus by the beginning of Tretayuga, the subjects maintained themselves through them. After the lapse of a long time, the people, due to their aberration, developed attitude of passion as well as the greed, as a result of which and due to the influence of Kala (time), all the trees that had been their habitation were destroyed.

## \|\| 1.29.24-25 \|\|

*praṇaśyanti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ \|*  
*tatasteṣu pranaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā maithunodbhavāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*abhidhyāyanti tāṃ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā \|*  
*prādurbabhūvustāsāṃ tu vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. At the destruction of the trees, the subjects bom of legal copulation became confused and perplexed. Then getting reminded of Satyayuga, all the people remembered the earlier Siddhis of Satyayuga. By so doing, the trees which had disappeared were grown again.

## \|\| 1.29.26-29 \|\|

*vastrāṇi te prasūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca \|*  
*teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu \|*  
*tena tā vartayanti sma tretāyugamukhe prijāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstayā siddhyā sarvā vai vigatajvarāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ kālāntareṇaiva punarlobhāvṛtāstadā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*vṛkṣāṃstān paryagṛhṇanta madhu cāmākṣikaṃ balāt \|*  
*tāsāṃ tenāpacāreṇa punarlobhakṛtena vai \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. Those trees then started producing the garments, ornaments and the fruits. For the people, each leaf of those trees contained fragrance, colour, juice, and the powerful honey which emerged without the use of honey-bees. In this way, the people lived on the products of the trees till Tretayuga. Because of the same Siddhi, all the people became healthy, and free from ailments. In due course of time, all of them were again overpowered with greed and they started collecting the eatables and the life-saving honey forcibly from the trees, which emerged without the bees.

## \|\| 1.29.30-33 \|\|

*praṇaṣṭāmadhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacit kvacit \|*  
*śītavarṣātapaistīvrai statastā duḥ khitā bhṛśam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*dvandvaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni ca \|*  
*kṛtvā dvandvapratīghātān vārtopāyamacintayan \|\| 31 \|\|*

*naṣṭeṣu madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣeṣu vai tadā \|*  
*tataḥ prādurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge punaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vārtāyāḥ sādhikā hyanyā vṛṣṭistāsāṃ nikāmataḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ vṛṣṭyūdakānīha yāni nimnairgatāni tu \|\| 33 \|\|*

30-33. With the display of their greedy conduct again, several of the kalpa-vrksas (wish-yielding trees) were destroyed with the honey. Then they started suffering from cold, rain and heat. Then they suffering from heat and cold, created covers and clothes for themselves. After devising means that counteracted the contradictory climatic changes, they began to think of agriculture and trade. Thereafter in the Tretayuga, as a means for their living, another Siddhi facilitating agriculture or trade cropped up and there had been the rainfall, which suited their desires.

## \|\| 1.29.34-36 \|\|

*avahan vṛṣṭisaṃtatyā strotaḥ sthānāni nimnagāḥ \|*  
*ye punastadapāṃ stokā āpannāḥ pṛthivītale \|\| 34 \|\|*

*apāṃ bhūṇeśca saṃyogādoṣadhyastāstadābhavan \|*  
*aphālakṛṣṭāścānuptā grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ṛtupuṣpaphalaiścaiva vṛkṣagulmāśca jajñire \|*  
*tataḥ prādurabhūt tāsāṃ rāgo lobhaśca sarvaśaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. The constant rains resulted into the formation of several lakes as well as the rivers. With the availability of enough of water on earth, and with the combination of the water and the earth, several types of medicinal herbs were grown. Fourteen types of cereals started growing without sowing, ploughing or irrigation besides the fruits, reeds, forest trees, creepers etc. Thereafter all the people were infested with various types of attachments and greeds.

## \|\| 1.29.37-38 \|\|

*avaśyaṃ bhāvinār'the na tretāyugavaśena vai \|*  
*tatastāḥ paryagṛhṇanta nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān \|\| 37 \|\|*

*vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam \|*  
*viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tā oṣadhyo viviśurmahīm \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. All this was inevitable due to the influence of Tretayuga. Thereafter all the people, on the basis of their strength, forcibly occupied the river regions, mountains, creepers, bushes, trees and medicinal herbs. Because of this adverse conduct, all the medicinal herbs started merging with the earth.

## \|\| 1.29.39-41 \|\|

*pitāmahaniyogena dudoha pṛthivīṃ pṛthuḥ \|*  
*tatastā jagṛhuḥ sarvā anyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vasudāradhanādyāṃstu balāt kālabalena tu \|*  
*maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ jñātvaitad bhagavānajaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sasarja kṣatriyān brahmā brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca \|*  
*varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca tretāyāṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. Then at the command of the grandsire Brahma, Prthuthe great king, milked these out of the earth. Thereafter all the people getting enraged, started grabbing the belongings of others forcibly. Because of the influence of the time, they were perforce deprived of the good conduct. Being aware of all this, Brahma, in order to safeguard the limitations, created the Ksatriyas for the establishment of disciplined behaviour and for the welfare of the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.29.42-44 \|\|

*yajñapravartanaṃ caiva paśuhiṃsāvivarjitam \|*  
*dvāpareṣvatha vidyante matibhedāḥ sadā nṛṇām \|\| 42 \|\|*

*rāgo lobhastathā yuddhaṃ tattvānāmaviniścayaḥ \|*  
*eko vedaścatuṣpādastretāsviha vidhīyate \|\| 43 \|\|*

*vedavyāsaiścaturdhā tu vyasyate dvāparādiṣu \|*  
*ṛṣiputraiḥ punarbhedād bhidyante dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. The lord established the Varnasrama during Tretayuga and changed the performance of the yajiuis without animal sacrifice. During the time of Dvapara as well, because of the difference in wisdom, there started the struggle because of attachment, jealousies, and greed. Considering the passion, covetousness, mutual fight and wrong conclusions in the mind among the people one Veda of four feet appeared as three different Vedas.

## \|\| 1.29.45-47 \|\|

*mantrabrāhmaṇavinyāsaiḥ svaravarṇaviparyayaiḥ \|*  
*saṃhitā ṛgyajuḥ sāmnāṃ saṃhanyante śrutarṣibhiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sāmānyād vaikṛtāccaivadṛṣṭibhedaiḥ kvacit kvacit \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ kalpasūtrāṇi mantrapravacanāni ca \|\| 46 \|\|*

*itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi suvrata \|*  
*avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathaiva vāyādhyupadravāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. The Vedas differ due to the difference in the visions among the sons of sages or altered visions. The Saihhitas of Rk, Yajus and Santa are being recited by the great sages by introducing Mantras and Brahmanas with due changes in accents and syllables. At places there had been difference of opinion and as such those Rishis composed, Brahmanas, Kalpasutras, Vedanta, Itihasa, Puranas, besides the Dharmasastras. Then the problems of the lack of rain fall, death and several other disturbances cropped up.

## \|\| 1.29.48-49 \|\|

*vāṅmanaḥ kāyajairduḥ sairnirvedo jāyate nṛṇām \|*  
*nirvedājjāyate teṣāṃ duḥ khamokṣavicāraṇā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*vicāraṇācca vairāgyaṃ vairāgyād doṣadarśanam \|*  
*doṣāṇāṃ darśanāccaiva dvāpare jñānasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Because of the ailments relating to the mind, speech and the body, there developed inactiveness, with the development of inactiveness, a person develops a desire to get rid of the ailment. This results into the development of detachment. Because of this, one visualises his own shortcoming. It is due to realization of defects that knowledge becomes possible in Dvapara.

## \|\| 1.29.50-51 \|\|

*eṣā rajastamoyuktā vṛttirvai dvāpare smṛtā \|*  
*ādye kṛte tu dharmo 'sti sa tretāyāṃ pravartate \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dvāpare vyākulībhūtvā praṇaśyati kalau yuge \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. О Brahmanas, this tendency in Dvapara emerged out of the mixture of rajoguna and tamoguna. During the Satyayuga, dharma had been established, which continued in the Tretayuga. During Dvapara, the dharma becomes agitated, while during the Kaliyuga, it totally disappeared.

## Chapter 30. Discussion between Arjuna and Vyasa on Yugadharma

## \|\| 1.30.1 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca*  
*tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ caiva tapasvinām \|*  
*sādhayanti narā nityaṃ tamasā vyākulīkṛtāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vyasa said, “In the Kaliyuga the people, feeling by the attribute of tamoguna, shall always remain engaged in malice, collecting of riches and the killing of the ascetics.

## \|\| 1.30.2 \|\|

*kalau pramārako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣud bhayaṃ tathā \|*  
*anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. During the Kaliyuga, epidemics of fatal disease, perpetual fear of hunger and starvation, fear of droughts and destruction of countries prevail.

## \|\| 1.30.3 \|\|

*adhārmikā anācārā mahākopālpacetasaḥ \|*  
*anṛtaṃ vadanti te lubdhāstiṣye jātāḥ suduḥ prajāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The people bom in the age of Kali shall be deprived of dharma and food, and shall be filled with anger having little lustre. They shall be greedy, indulging in falsehood and possessing the evil progeny.

## \|\| 1.30.4 \|\|

*duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. They shall have evil desires, shall engage in false studies, evil conduct, and study the fake scriptures. Because of the misconduct of the Brahmanas, blemishes shall emerge among the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.30.5 \|\|

*nādhīyate kalau vedān na yajanti dvijātayaḥ \|*  
*yajantyanyāyato vedān paṭhante cālpabuddhayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The Brahmanas shall be disinterested in the study of the Vedas in the age of Kali, nor would they be interested in the performing of the yajnas. People short of wisdom, shall engage themselves in the performing of the yajnas and the study of the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.30.6 \|\|

*śūdrāṇāṃ mantrayaunaiśca saṃbandho brāhmaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*bhaviṣyati kalau tasmiñ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. During the age of Kali, the Brahmanas and the Sudras shall sleep together, sit together, eat together, besides the reciting of the mantras together performing the yajnas.

## \|\| 1.30.7 \|\|

*rājānaḥ sūdrabhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇān bādhayanti ca \|*  
*bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā prajāyete nareśvara \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Most of the Sudras shall be mlers, who will cause pain to the Brahmanas. The practice of abortion shall be common among the rulers, besides the killing of the valorous people.

## \|\| 1.30.8 \|\|

*snānaṃ homaṃ japaṃ dānaṃ devatānāṃ tathār'canam \|*  
*anyāni caiva karmāṇi na kurvanti dvijātayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The Brahmanas, shall be averse to the taking of bath, performing of Homas, Japas, charities, adoration of the gods, and other auspicious deeds.

## \|\| 1.30.9 \|\|

*vinindanti mahādevaṃ brāhmaṇān puruṣottamam \|*  
*āmnāyadharmaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni kalau yuge \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The people in Kaliyuga shall denounce Mahadeva Shiva, Brahmana, Purusottama, Visnu, Vedas, Dharmasastras as well as the Puranas.

## \|\| 1.30.10 \|\|

*kurvantyavedadṛṣṭāni karmāṇi vividhāni tu \|*  
*svadharme 'bhirucirnaiva brāhmaṇānāṃ prijāyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The people shall indulge in many type of deeds, which are against the teaching of the Vedas. The Brahmanas shall no more remain interested in their own dharma.

## \|\| 1.30.11 \|\|

*kuśīlacaryāḥ pāṣaṇḍairvṛthārūpaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ \|*  
*bahuyācanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The people shall display evil conduct, take to useless forms, surrounded with the false people and shall be demanding mutually excessively.

## \|\| 1.30.12 \|\|

*aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ \|*  
*pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The people in Kaliyuga shall sell the cereals in the janapadas, besides the sellers of Shivalihgas at the road crossings. The youthful maidens will sell their bodies.

## \|\| 1.30.13 \|\|

*śukladantājinākhyāśca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ \|*  
*śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte samupasthite \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. At the end of the yuga, Sudras calling themselves Jinas (subduers of sense organs), with beautiful teeth, shaving off their heads, clad in ochre robes and black-antelope, shall perform holy rites.

## \|\| 1.30.14 \|\|

*śasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti tathā cailābhimarṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*caurāścaurasya hartāro harturhartā tathāparaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The people shall steal the cereals, besides the costumes of others. There would also be people who would abduct the thieves.

## \|\| 1.30.15 \|\|

*duḥ khapracuratālpāyurdehotsādaḥ sarogatā \|*  
*adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovṛttaṃ kalau smṛtam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. There would be enough of miseries and the people shall have short lives. They shall be full of lethargy, with ailments in the body. They shall be more interested in evil activities from attachement to Adharma.

## \|\| 1.30.16 \|\|

*kāṣāyiṇo 'tha nirgranthāstathā kāpālikāśca ye \|*  
*vedavikrayiṇaścānye tīrthavikrayiṇaḥ pare \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. During the age of Kali, some people shall be clad in saffron costumes, some of them shall be illiterate, devoid of sophisticated behaviour, some of them shall wear the garland of skulls, some of them will be selling the Vedas, while some of them shall be selling their sacred places.

## \|\| 1.30.17 \|\|

*āsanasthān dvijān dṛṣṭvā na calantyalpabuddhayaḥ \|*  
*tāḍayanti dvijendrāṃśca śūdrā rājopajīvinaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The people short of wisdom, shall force the seated Brahmanas to get up from their seats. The Sudras with royal protection shall punish the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.30.18 \|\|

*uccāsanasthāḥ śūdrāstu dvijamadhye parantapa \|*  
*jñātvā na hiṃsate rājā kalau kālabalena tu \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Aijuna, the Sudras, during the Kaliyuga shall occupy high seats among the Brahmanas. The rulers shall insult the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.30.19 \|\|

*puṣpaiśca hasitaiścaiva tathānyairmaṅgalairdvijāḥ \|*  
*śūdrānabhyarcayantyalpaśrutabhagyabalānvitāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The Brahmanas with the little of knowledge, having little fortunes, and strength shall offer flowers, ornaments, and other auspicious articles to the Sudras.

## \|\| 1.30.20 \|\|

*na prekṣante 'rcitāṃścāpi śūdrā dvijavarān nṛpa \|*  
*sevāvasaramālokya dvāri tiṣṭhanti ca dvijāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O King, the Sudras shall not look at the Brahmanas worthy of adoration, while the Brahmanas shall wait at the gate to avail of an opportunity to serve them.

## \|\| 1.30.21 \|\|

*vāhanasthān samāvṛtya śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ \|*  
*sevante brāhmaṇāstatra stuvanti stutibhiḥ kalau \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. During the Kaliyuga, the Brahmanas, while earning their living from the Sudras, mounting over the vehicles, shall surround the Sudras and serve them, offering several prayers and praises.

## \|\| 1.30.22 \|\|

*adhyāpayanti vai vedāñ śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ \|*  
*paṭhanti vaidikān mantrān nāstikyaṃ ghoramāśritāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In a way depending upon the total atheismuess, the Brahmanas, earning their livelihood from the Sudras, shall teach the Vedas and their commentary.

## \|\| 1.30.23 \|\|

*tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*yatayaśca bhaviṣyanti śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The best of the Brahmanas, and hundreds and thousands of ascetics, shall become the sellers of the merit of penance, sacrifice and the arts.

## \|\| 1.30.24 \|\|

*nāśayanti hyadhītāni nādhigacchanti cānagha \|*  
*gāyanti laukikairgānairdaivatāni narādhipa \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О King, (the Brahmanas) destroying their own dharma, do not attain that region. They shall adore the gods with the worldly songs.

## \|\| 1.30.25 \|\|

*vāmapāśupatācārāstathā vai pāñcarātrikāḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti kalau tasmin brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāstathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. During the Kaliyuga, all the Brahmanas and Ksatriyas shall become the followers of Vama- tantrikas, the Pas'upatas, and Pancaratrikas.

## \|\| 1.30.26 \|\|

*jñānakarmaṇyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate \|*  
*kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Distancing themselves from jnana and the karmas, the people shall become inactive and troubled by the insects, rats and the serpents.

## \|\| 1.30.27 \|\|

*kurvānti cāvatārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ kuleṣu vai \|*  
*dadhīcaśāpanirdagdhāḥ purā dakṣādhvare dvijāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The Brahmanas who had been burnt in the Daksa's sacrifice in earlier times, because of the curse of Dadhica, shall reborn in the families of Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.30.28 \|\|

*nindanti ca mahādevaṃ tamasāviṣṭacetasaḥ \|*  
*vṛthā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti kalau tasmin yugāntike \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. At the end of Kaliyuga, the Brahmanas, overshadowed with tamoguna, shall denounce Lord Shiva and shall indulge in the useless religious practices.

## \|\| 1.30.29-30 \|\|

*sarve vīrā bhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇādyāḥ svajātiṣu। \|*  
*ye cānye śāpanirdagdhā gautamasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sarve te ca bhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇādyāḥ svajātiṣu \|*  
*vinindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. The other Brahmanas who had been burnt with the curse of Gautama, shall be valorous in their own castes. All these Brahmanas shall incarnate in the same yonis. They will revile god Hrsikesa, Brahmanas and expounders of Brahman or the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.30.31-32 \|\|

*vedabāhyavratācārā durācārā vṛthāśramāḥ \|*  
*mohayanti janān sarvān darśayitvā phalāni ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tamasāviṣṭamanaso vaiḍālavṛttikādhamāḥ \|*  
*kalau rudro mahādevo lokānāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. They possessing the evil conduct shall act contrary to the provision of the Vedas, engaged in useless exercises, surrounded by tamoguna, deceitful people, showing the greed, and deluding all other people. Rudra Mahadeva is the real lord of the people during Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 1.30.33-35 \|\|

*na devatā bhavennṛṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca daivatam \|*  
*kariṣyatyavatārāṇi śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*śrautasmārtapratiṣṭhārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|*  
*upadekṣyati tajjñānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ brahmasaṃjñitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sarvavedāntasāraṃ hi dharmān vedanidarśitān \|*  
*sarvavarṇān samudiśya svadharmā ye nidarśittāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. The people should adore lord Mahadeva, who happens to be the god of gods. The brown- complexioned Shiva, for the establishment of Srattta (Vedic) and Smarta dharmas (belonging to the Smrtis), and for the welfare of the devotees shall incarnate on earth. He will enlighten his devotees on the subjects of the gist of Vedanlas, the knowledge relating to the Brahman, and all the dharmas enshrined in the Vedas, which have been narrated earlier.

## \|\| 1.30.36 \|\|

*anāyāsena sumahat puṇyamāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*anekadoṣaduṣṭasya kalereṣa mahān guṇaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A person, who shall adore Shiva by any means, he, overpowering the blemishes of the age of kali, shall achieve the supreme position.

## \|\| 1.30.37 \|\|

*tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prāpya māheśvaraṃ yugam \|*  
*viśeṣād brāhmaṇo rudramīśānaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. A person achieves the great merits without much efforts. This is the matter of greatest advantage of the Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 1.30.38 \|\|

*ye namanti virūpākṣamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam \|*  
*prasannacetaso rudraṃ te yānti paramaṃ padam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Therefore in the Age of Kali, making all the efforts, all the people, particularly the Brahmanas, should take refuge with Is'ana Rudra.

## \|\| 1.30.39 \|\|

*yathā rudranamaskāraḥ sarvakarmaphalo dhruvam \|*  
*anyadevanamaskārānna tatphalamavāpnuyāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Such of the people who bow in reverence to Virupaksa-Shiva (having terrible eyes) clad in elephant hide, they getting delighted, achieve the excellent place.

## \|\| 1.30.40 \|\|

*evaṃvidhe kaliyuge doṣāṇāmekaśodhanam \|*  
*mahādevanamaskāro dhyānaṃ dānamiti śrutiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. As by bowing in reverence to Rudra one gets all his desires fulfilled surely, the reward can not be achieved by adoring the other gods.

## \|\| 1.30.41 \|\|

*tasmādanīśvarānanyān tyaktvā devaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*samāśrayed virūpākṣaṃ yadīcchet paramaṃ padam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. In this way the blemishes are removed in Kaliyuga. The scriptures ordain that, the offering of salutation to lord Mahadeva and the giving of the charities, are the only means of purifying defects.

## \|\| 1.30.42 \|\|

*nārcayantīha ye rudraṃ śivaṃ tridaśavanditam \|*  
*teṣāṃ dānaṃ tapo yajño vṛthā jīvitameva ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Therefore, if one is desirous of salvation, then discarding the other gods, he should take refuge with Virupaksa-Shiva.

## \|\| 1.30.43 \|\|

*namo rudrāya mahate devadevāya śūline \|*  
*tryambakāya trinetrāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The one who does not adore Shiva who is worshipped by all the gods, the charities, tapas and yajha performed by him, besides his own life become of no consequence.

## \|\| 1.30.44 \|\|

*namo 'stu vāmadevāya mahādevāya vedhase \|*  
*gyambakāya triitrāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Salutation to Shiva, the holder of trident, threeeyed and the god of gods who is the preceptor of the Yogins.

## \|\| 1.30.45 \|\|

*namo'stu devadevāya mahādevāya vedhase \|*  
*śaṃbhave sthāṇave nityaṃ śivāya parameṣṭhine \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Salutation to the god of gods, Mahadeva, the one who represents Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa, Sambhu, Sthanu and Paramesthi.

## \|\| 1.30.46 \|\|

*namaḥ śomāya rudrāya mahāgrāsāya hetave \|*  
*prapadye'haṃ virūpākṣe śaraṇyaṃ brahmacāriṇam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Salutation to Soma, Rudra, the great destroyer and the cause of all, I take refuge with Virupaksa, the Brahmacari, worthy of being a refuge.

## \|\| 1.30.47-52 \|\|

*mahādevaṃ mahāyogamīśānaṃ cāmbikāpatim \|*  
*yogināṃ yogadātāraṃ yogamāyāsamāvṛtam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*yogināṃ kurumācāryaṃ yogigamyaṃ pinākinam \|*  
*saṃsāratāraṇaṃ rudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇo 'dhipam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*śāśvataṃ sarvagaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brāhmaṇapriyam \|*  
*kapardinaṃ kālamūrtimamūrti parameśvaram \|\| 49 \|\|*

*ekamūrti mahāmūrti vedavedyaṃ divaspatim \|*  
*nīlakaṇṭhaṃ viśvamūrti vyāpinaṃ viśvaretasam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*kālāgniṃ kāladahanaṃ kāmadaṃ kāmanāśanam \|*  
*namasye giriśaṃ devaṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*vilohitaṃ lelihānamāhityaṃ parameṣṭhinam \|*  
*ugraṃ paśupatiṃ bhīmaṃ bhāskaraṃ tamasaḥ param \|\| 52 \|\|*

47-52. I offer my salutation to Mahadeva, the form of Mahayoga, Isana, the lord of Ambika, bestower of Yoga on the Yogins, surrounded with Yogamaya, the preceptor of the Yogis, the teacher attainable by the Yogis, holder of the Pinaka-bow, the one who makes one to cross over the ocean of the universe, the lord of Brahma, all-pervading, protector of the scriptures as well as the Brahmanas, dear to the Brahmanas, having matted locks of hair over the head, Kalamurti (embodiment of Kala), formless one, Parames'vara, one who though multiform appears as one form, knowable through the Vedas, Lord of the heaven, Nllakantha, Visvamurti (embodiment of the universe), omniscient, seed of the universe, Kalagni (fire of death), Kaladahana (the fire at the time of dissolution), bestower of boons, destroyer of Kama, lord of mountains, having the crescent as the ornament, having special type of red complexion, who puts forth his tongue, Aditya, Paramesthin, the fierce Pasupati, the terrible deity, the refulgent sun and supreme penance, salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.30.53 \|\|

*ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yugānāṃ vai samāsataḥ \|*  
*atītānāgatānāṃ vai yāvanmanvantarakṣayaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thus, I have brought out in brief the characteristics of Yugas and also of the Yogas of the past and future until the end of the Manvantara.

## \|\| 1.30.54 \|\|

*manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi vai \|*  
*vyākhyātāni na saṃdehaḥ kalpaḥ kalpena caiva hi \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. By speaking about a single Manvantara, all the Manvantaras get explained. Similarly with the explaining of a Kalpa, all the Kalpas get defined. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.30.55 \|\|

*manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣu vai \|*  
*tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve nāmarūpairbhavantyuta \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. In each one of the past and the future Manvantaras, there are the supreme gods having the similar names and forms.”

## \|\| 1.30.56 \|\|

*evamukto bhagavatā kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ \|*  
*babhāra paramāṃ bhaktimīśāne 'vyabhicāriṇīm \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. At these words of the sage Vyasa, Arjuna, decorated with the Kirita crown, and having a white chariot, embraced the supreme devotion to Shiva.

## \|\| 1.30.57 \|\|

*namaścakāra tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum \|*  
*sarvajñaṃ sarvakartāraṃ skṣād viṣṇuṃ vyavasthitam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Then he offered his salutation to the sage Krisnadvaipayana, who was omniscient, the creator of all and the form of lord Visnu.

## \|\| 1.30.58 \|\|

*tamuvāca punarvyāsaḥ pāthaṃ parapurañjayam \|*  
*karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca saṃspṛśya praṇataṃ muniḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Then Arjuna, who conquered the cities of the enemies, was touched by Vyasa with both the hands and then said.

## \|\| 1.30.59 \|\|

*dhanyo 'syanugṛhīto 'si tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate \|*  
*trailokye śaṅkare nūnaṃ bhaktaḥ parapurañjaya \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He said, “O Conqueror of the cities, I feel graceful and indebted to you. Surely there is none else comparable with you in devotion for lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.30.60 \|\|

*dṛṣṭavānasi taṃ devaṃ viśvākṣaṃ viśvatomukham \|*  
*pratyakṣameva sarveśaṃ rudraṃ sarvajagadgurum \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. You have directly perceived lord Rudra, having universal vision, having faces all round, and the one who is embodiment of the universe.

## \|\| 1.30.61 \|\|

*jñānaṃ tadaiśvaraṃ divyaṃ yathāvad viditaṃ tvayā \|*  
*svayameva hṛṣīkeśaḥ prītyovāca sanātanaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. You have well understood the divine knowledge of Shiva. This fact has already been highlighted by none else than the eternal Hrslkesa (Vyasa, his incarnation) himself, out of delight.

## \|\| 1.30.62 \|\|

*gaccha gaccha svakaṃ sthānaṃ na śokaṃ kartumarhasi \|*  
*vrajasva parayā bhaktyā śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ śivam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Now you move on to your own place. You should not feel grieved, you take refuge with Shiva with utmost devotion.”

## \|\| 1.30.63 \|\|

*evamuktvā sa bhagavānanugṛhyārjunaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*jagāma śaṅkarapurīṃ samārādhayituṃ bhavam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Thus speaking to Arjuna, lord Vyasa, extending his grace on him for engage himself in the meditation of Shiva, reached Varanasi, the abode of the lord.

## \|\| 1.30.64 \|\|

*pāṇḍaveyo 'pi tad vākyāt saṃprāpya śaraṇaṃ śivam \|*  
*saṃtyajya sarvakarmāṇi tadbhaktiparamo 'bhavat \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Arjuna, on his part, on the advice of Vyasa, discarding all his engagements, devoted himself exclusively in the worship of Shiva through spiritual knowledge.

## \|\| 1.30.65 \|\|

*nārjunena samaḥ śaṃbhorbhaktyā bhūto bhaviṣyati \|*  
*muktvā satyavatīsūnuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā devakīsutam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. In fact, except the son of Satyavatl (Vyasa) and Krisna, the son of Devaki, neither anyone has been, nor will be bom who is equal to Arjuna in the matter of devotion to Sambhu.

## \|\| 1.30.66 \|\|

*tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaḥ satyāya dhīmate \|*  
*pārāśaryāya munaye vyāsāyāmitatejase \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Salutation to Vyasa, the son of Parasara, who had been calm, full of wisdom, extremely illustrious, always.

## \|\| 1.30.67 \|\|

*kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ sākṣād viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ \|*  
*ko hyanyastattvato rudraṃ vetti taṃ parameśvaram \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Krisnadvaipayana Vyasa is the eternal lord Visnu in reality. Who else is there except him, who knows about Shiva, so well.

## \|\| 1.30.68 \|\|

*namaḥ kurudhvaṃ tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ satyavatīsutam \|*  
*pārāśaryaṃ mahātmānaṃ yoginaṃ viṣṇumavyayam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. All of you should offer your salutation to Krisnadvaipayana, the son of Paras'ara and Satyavatl, Mahatma, the great Yogin, imperishable, form of Visnu.

## \|\| 1.30.69 \|\|

*evamuktāstu munayaḥ sarva eva samīhitāḥ \|*  
*preṇemustaṃ mahātmānaṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. At these words of the sage, all the Rishis with the concentration of mind, then adored Mahatma Vyasa, the son of Satyavatl.

## Chapter 31. The Glory of Varanasi

## \|\| 1.31.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*prāpya vārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ \|*  
*kimakārṣonmahābuddhiḥ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The Rishis said, “Reaching the divine city of VaranasT, what did the learned Krisna Dvaipayana Vyasa do there? We are quite anxious to know about the same.”

## \|\| 1.31.2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*prāpya vārāṇasī divyāmupaspṛśya mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa jāhnavyāṃ devaṃ viśveśvaraṃ śivam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Suta said, “The great sage, reaching at divine Varanasi, sipped the water of the Ganga first of all and then adored the lord Vis'ves'vara there.

## \|\| 1.31.3 \|\|

*tamāgataṃ puniṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra ye nivasanti vai \|*  
*pūjayāñcakrire vyāsaṃ munayo munipuṅgavam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Finding the arrival of the sage there, the sages, who were dwelling there, adored the excellent sage Vyasa.

## \|\| 1.31.4 \|\|

*papracchuḥ praṇatāḥ sarve kathāḥ pāpavināśanīḥ \|*  
*mahādevāśrayāḥ puṇyā mokṣadharmān sanātanān \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. All these people bowing in reverence to the sage Vyasa, then enquired from him the auspeious story relating to Mahadeva, which is remover of all sins and also about the eternal dhanna of final emancipation.

## \|\| 1.31.5 \|\|

*sa cāpi kathayāmāsa sarvajño bhagavānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*māhātmyaṃ devadevasya dharmān vedanidarśitān \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The omniscient and illustrious sage Vyasa, then started narrating the glory of God of the gods, as propounded in the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.31.6 \|\|

*teṣāṃ madhye munīndrāṇāṃ vyāsaśiṣyo mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*pṛṣṭavān jaiminirvyāsaṃ gūḍhamarthaṃ sanātanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Among those sages, .Taimini, the disciple of sage Vyasa asked him about the eternal mysterious one.

## \|\| 1.31.7 \|\|

*jaiminiruvāca*  
*bhagavan saṃśayaṃ tvekaṃ chettumarhasi tattvataḥ \|*  
*na vidyate hyaviditaṃ bhavatā paramarṣiṇā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Jaimini said, “O Bhagavan, you are all knowledgeable lord, and you are competent to remove one of my doubts. You are the great sage and nothing is unknown to you.

## \|\| 1.31.8-9 \|\|

*kecid dhyānaṃ praśaṃsanti dharmamevāpare janāḥ \|*  
*anye sāṃkhyaṃ tathā yogaṃ tapastvanye maharṣayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*brahmacaryamatho maunamanye prāharmaharṣayaḥ \|*  
*ahiṃsāṃ satyamapyanye saṃnyāsamapare viduḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Some praise the meditation, other people praise the dharma. Still other hold Samkhya and Yoga in high esteem. The other Rishis consider the performing of the tapas as the best. Some of the great sages praise the Brahmacarya. Some Rishis praise ahirnsa while others hold sannyasa as the best one.

## \|\| 1.31.10-11 \|\|

*kecid dayāṃ praśaṃsanti dānamadhyayanaṃ tathā \|*  
*tīrthayātrāṃ tathā kecidanye cendriyanigraham \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kimeteṣāṃ bhavejjyāyaḥ prabrūhi munipuṅgava \|*  
*yadi vā vidyate 'pyanyad guhyaṃ tadvaktumarhasi \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Some of the people, praise compassion, some charities, and the religious studies. Some of them praise pilgrimage, others the control of senses. Therefore, О best of the sages, which one of all these is more useful, you kindly tell us. In case there be some other secret means, you also kindly speak out the same.”

## \|\| 1.31.12 \|\|

*śrutvā sa jaiminervākyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ \|*  
*prāha gambhīrayā vācā praṇamya vṛṣaketanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Hearing the words of Jaimini, the sage Krisnadvaipayana, bowing his head in reverence to the bull-bannered Shiva, spoke in deep voice.

## \|\| 1.31.13 \|\|

*sādhu sādhu mahābhāga yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā mune \|*  
*vakṣye guhyatamād guhyaṃ śruṇvantvanye maharṣayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Vyasa said, “O Virtuous sage, whatever has been asked by you is quite correct. I shall speak out the extremely secret knowledge. All the sages should listen to the same.

## \|\| 1.31.14 \|\|

*īśvareṇa purā proktaṃ jñānametat sanātanam \|*  
*gūḍhamaprājñavidviṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. This eternal secret knowledge was imparted by Ishvara himself in ancient time. The ignorant are envious of this great knowledge, while it is embraced by those possessing subtle vision.

## \|\| 1.31.15 \|\|

*nāśraddadhāne dātavyaṃ nābhakte parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*na vedavidviṣu śubhaṃ jñānanānāṃ jñānamuttamam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. This secret knowledge is the best among all type of knowledges. This should not be imparted to the faithless person. The said knowledge should also not be imparted to a person who is not devoted to Shiva, or to a person, having no knowledge of the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.31.16 \|\|

*meruśṛṅge purā devamīśānaṃ tripuradviṣam \|*  
*devāsanagatā devī mahādevamapṛcchata \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Once the foe of Tripura, lord Shiva, was seated over the Meru mountain with goddess Parvati. At that point of time Parvati asked Shiva.

## \|\| 1.31.17 \|\|

*devyuvāca*  
*devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāmārtināśana \|*  
*kathaṃ tvāṃ puruṣo devamacirādeva paśyati \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Parvati said, “O God of gods, О Mahadeva, you are the remover of the miseries of your devotees. How can the people have an audience with you without delay?

## \|\| 1.31.18 \|\|

*sāṃkhyayogastathā dhyānaṃ karmayogo 'tha vaidikaḥ \|*  
*āyāsabahulā loke yāni cānyāni śaṅkara \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Shiva, the systems of Samkhya and the Yoga, penance, meditation, path of action of the Vedas, and several other means can be achieved with utmost labour and efforts.

## \|\| 1.31.19-20 \|\|

*yena vibrāntacittānāṃ yogināṃ karmiṇāmapi \|*  
*dṛśyo hi bhagavān sūkṣmaḥ sarveṣāmatha dehinām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*etad guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ gūḍhaṃ brahmādisevitama \|*  
*hitāya sarvabhaktānāṃ brūhi kāmāṅganāśana \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Therefore, the method by which the people with confused minds, the Yogins, learned people and all living beings, could have an audience with the lord without much effort, the same knowledge, which is beyond the reach of Brahma, which is extremely secret, the same may kindly be revealed for the benefit of the devotees.”

## \|\| 1.31.21 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca*  
*avācyametad vijñānaṃ jñānamajñairbahiṣkṛtam \|*  
*vakṣye tava yathā tattvaṃ yaduktaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Ishvara said, “This secret knowledge is beyond description, which had been discarded by the ignorant people, but I shall speak out the factual position to you, which had been narrated by the great Rishis.

## \|\| 1.31.22 \|\|

*paraṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ mama vārāṇasī purī \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī \|\| 22 \|\|*
