6\. By having sex with the wife of a friend or the wife’s sister, after fasting for a day and night he should also perform rite known as Krcchra.

## \|\| 2.33.7 \|\|

*udakyāgamane viprastrirātreṇa viśudhyati \|*  
*cāṇḍālīgamane caiva taptakṛcchratrayaṃ viduḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. In case a Brahmana, has sex with a woman in period, then he gets purified after three nights. By having a sex with a Candala woman, the purification has been prescribed after performing Taptakrchhra vrata three times and once the Santapana-vrata. Otherwise, no expiation is there as per Smrtis.

## \|\| 2.33.8-9 \|\|

*saha sāṃtapanenāsya nānyathā niṣkṛtiḥ smṛtā \|*  
*mātṛgotrāṃ samāsādya samānapravarāṃ tathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*cādrāyaṇena śudhyeta prayatātmā samāhitaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā gṛcchramekaṃ samācaret \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. By having sex with a woman of his maternal gotra or one belonging to his own lineage, one gets purified with the performing of the great Candrayana-vrata with self-control. In case a Brahmana has sexual intercourse with a Brahmana woman, then he has to perform Krchhra expiation.

In case one \[ПW4\] shatters the virginity of a girl, then he also has to perform the Candrayana expiation.

## \|\| 2.33.10-11 \|\|

*kanyakāṃ dūṣayitvā tu careccāndrāyaṇavratam \|*  
*amānuṣīṣu puruṣa udakyāyāmayoniṣu \|\| 10 \|\|*

*retaḥ siktvā jale caiva kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret \|*  
*bandhakīgamane viprastrirātreṇa viśuddhyati \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. In case a person has sex with a barbarious woman, or a woman in period, or drops his semen in the water, lower animals, in a man, and in non-vaginal parts, then he should perform the Krchhra-vrata. In case, one enjoys sex with an old woman, then a Brahmana can be purified after three nights.

## \|\| 2.33.12 \|\|

*gavi bhathunamāsevya careccāndrāyaṇavratam \|*  
*ajāvī maithunaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyaṃ cared dvijaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In case, one has sex with a cow, one should perform Candrayana-vrata. For the purpose of purification, a Brahmana, after having sex with a prostitue, should perform the Prajapatya vow.

## \|\| 2.33.13 \|\|

*patitāṃ ca striyaṃ gatvā tribhiḥ kṛcchrai rviśuddhyati \|*  
*pulkasīgamane caiva kracchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. By having union with a fallen woman, one can be purified after performing three Krchha rites. By having sex with a Candala woman, one should perform the Krchhra and Candrayana vrata.

## \|\| 2.33.14 \|\|

*naṭīṃ śailūṣakīṃ caiva rajakīṃ veṇujīvinīm \|*  
*gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tathā carmopajīvinīm \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. By having sex with a female dancer, an actress, the washer woman, seller of bamboos, and the woman trading in leather, one should perform the Candrayana rite.

## \|\| 2.33.15 \|\|

*brahāmacārī striyaṃ gacchet kathañcitkāmamohitaḥ \|*  
*saptagāraṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ vasitvā gardabhājinam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In case a celibate Brahmana getting infested with passion somehow indulges in sex with a woman, then he should wearing the skin of a donkey beg alms in seven homes.

## \|\| 2.33.16 \|\|

*upaspṛśet triṣavaṇaṃ svapāpaṃ parikīrtayan \|*  
*saṃvatsareṇa caikena tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. He should bathe himself thrice a day and remain untouched. He should be released from that sin in the course of a year.

## \|\| 2.33.17 \|\|

*brahmahatyāvrataṃ vāpi ṣaṇmāsānācared yamī \|*  
*mucyate hyavakīrṇo tu brāhmaṇānumate sthitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. In case of his being a Avakirnin (a religious student violating the rules of chastity), then by performing the expiatory rite for Brahmahatya for six months, he is relieved of the sin. This has been ordained by the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 2.33.18 \|\|

*saptarātramakṛtvā tu bhaikṣacaryāgnipūjanam \|*  
*retasaśca samutsarge prāyaścittaṃ samācaret \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. In case, a Brahmacarin falls his semen virile, he should perform repentance. He should not beg for alms for seven days nor should he worship the fire.

## \|\| 2.33.19 \|\|

*oṅkārapūrvikābhistu mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sadā \|*  
*saṃvatsaraṃ tu bhuñjāno naktaṃ bhikṣāśanaḥ śuciḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He should recite Oriikara with the seven vyahrtis for the period of a year. He should take food only at night. He should not be pure and should partake of the alms received after begging.

## \|\| 2.33.20 \|\|

*sāvitrīṃ ca japeccaiva nityaṃ krodhavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*nadītīreṣu tīrtheṣu tasmāt pāpād vimucyate \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He should recite the Gayatri-mantra. He should discard anger, and should live over the river banks or the sacred places and by so doing he can get relieved of the sin.

## \|\| 2.33.21 \|\|

*hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vipraḥ kuryād brahmahaṇo vratam \|*  
*akāmato vai ṣaṇmāsān dadyān pañcaśataṃ gavām \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In case a Brahmana kills a Ksatriya unintentionally, then he also should perform the expiatory rite of brahmahatya for six months and should give away five hundred cows in charity.

## \|\| 2.33.22 \|\|

*abdaṃ careta niyato vanavāsī samāhitaḥ \|*  
*prājāpatyaṃ sāntapanaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ tu vā svayam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Otherwise, he should spend one year in forest performing meditation with great concentration and perform the Prajapatya, Santapana or Taptakrcchra rite.

## \|\| 2.33.23 \|\|

*pramāpyākāmato vaiśyaṃ kuryāt saṃvatsaradvayam \|*  
*gosahasraṃ sapādaṃ ca dadyād brahmahaṇo vratam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Due to arrogance or otherwise, in case a Vaisya is killed, then he should give away a thousand cows in charity and a fourth of it, besides performing the expiatory rite of brahmahatya.

## \|\| 2.33.24 \|\|

*kṛcchrātikṛcchrau vā kuryāccāndrāyaṇamathāvi vā \|*  
*saṃvatsaraṃ vrataṃ kuryācchūdraṃ hatvā pramādataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. After killing a Sudra by mistake, one should perform expiatory rites for a year. Or, he should perform Krchhra and Atikrchhra rites besides the Candrayana.

## \|\| 2.33.25 \|\|

*gosahasrārdhapādaṃ ca dadyāt tatpāpaśāntaye \|*  
*aṣṭau varṣāṇi ṣaṭ trīṇi kuryād brahmahaṇo vratam \|*  
*hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ caiva yathākramam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In case a Brahmana kills a Ksatriya, a Vaisya, or a Sudra, the expiatory rite in order is the gift of a thousand or five hundred, or two hundred and fifty cows. He should perform brahmahatya-vrata for eight years or three years.

## \|\| 2.33.26 \|\|

*nihatya brāhmaṇīṃ viprastvaṣṭavarṣaṃ vrataṃ caret \|*  
*rājanyāṃ varṣaṣaṭkaṃ tu vaiśyāṃ saṃvatsaratrayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In case a Brahmana kills a Brahmana woman, then he should perform vrata for eight years. By killing a Ksatriya woman, he should perform vrata for six years, for killing a Vaisya woman, the expiatory rite would be for three years.

## \|\| 2.33.27 \|\|

*vatsareṇa viśuddhyeta śūdrāṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*vaiśyāṃ hatvā pramādena kiñcid dadyād dvijātaye \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. And by killing a Siidra woman by a Brahmana, he could be purified after a year. A tw ice-born should give something as a gift for a twice-born to wipe off the sin of killing Vais'ya woman.

## \|\| 2.33.28 \|\|

*antyajānāṃ vadhe caiva kuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam \|*  
*parākeṇāthavā śuddhirityāha bhagavānajaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. At the killing of the low caste people, one can be purified with the performing of the Candrayana-vrata. It has also stated by the lord Brahma, that one can be purified with the performing of the Paraka rite.

## \|\| 2.33.29 \|\|

*maṇḍūkaṃ nakulaṃ kākaṃ dandaśūkaṃ ca mūṣikam \|*  
*śvānaṃ hatvā dvijaḥ kuryāt ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ vrataṃ tataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. In case a person of high caste kills a frog, mungoose, crow, cat, a rabbit, a rat and even a dog, then he has to perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata for purification.

## \|\| 2.33.30 \|\|

*payaḥ pibet trirātraṃ tu śvānaṃ hatvā suyantritaḥ \|*  
*mārjāraṃ vātha nakulaṃ yojanaṃ vādhvano vrajet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. By killing a dog, he should fast for three nights taking milk only. After killing a cat or a mungoose, one should walk the distance of a yojana (12 km) atleast.

## \|\| 2.33.31 \|\|

*kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ tu kuryādaśvavadhe dvijaḥ \|*  
*abhrīṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ dadyāt sarpaṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. After killing a horse, a Brahmana should perform Krchhra-vrata for twelve nights. A Brahmana, after killing a serpent, should make a gift of an image made of iron.

## \|\| 2.33.32 \|\|

*palālabhāraṃ ṣaṇḍaṃ ca saisakaṃ caikamāṣakam \|*  
*dhṛtakumbhaṃ varāhaṃ ca tiladroṇaṃ ca tittirim \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. By killing a eunuch, one should give away in charity a palala (weight) of straw and a Masa weight of lead. With the killing of a boar, a pot filled with ghee should be given away and after killing of a patridge bird, a drona measure of sesamum should be given away in charity.

## \|\| 2.33.33-34 \|\|

*śukaṃ dvihāyanaṃ vatsaṃ krauñcaṃ hatvā trihāyanam \|*  
*hatvā haṃsaṃ balākāṃ ca bakaṃ barhiṇameva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vānaraṃ śyenabhāsau ca sparśayed brāhmaṇāya gām \|*  
*kravyādāṃstu mṛgān hatvā dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. By killing a parrot, a calf of two years, and by killing a Kraunca bird , a calf of three years old should be given in charity. At the killing of a swan, a crane, a stork, a peacock, a monkey, a vulture, or the bird Bhasa, one should gift a cow in charity to a Brahmana. Similarly, after the killing of the beasts of prey, a milch cow should be given in charity.

## \|\| 2.33.35 \|\|

*akravyādān vatsatarīmuṣṭraṃ hatvā tu kṛṣṇalam \|*  
*kiñcideva tu viprāya dadyādasthimatāṃ vadhe \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By killing the animals and birds which do not consume meat, one should give away a heifer in charity. On killing a camel, one should give away in charity gold weighing a Gunja seed. When an animal with bones is killed, some charity to the Brahmanas should be given.

## \|\| 2.33.36 \|\|

*anasthnāṃ caiva hiṃsāyāṃ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati \|*  
*phaladānāṃ tu vṛkṣāṇāṃ chedane japyamṛkśatam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A Brahmana, when injures an animals without bones, then he gets purified of the sin, with the mere performing of pranayama. But in case the fruit bearing tree is cut off, a hundred Reas of Rgveda should be recited.

## \|\| 2.33.37 \|\|

*gulmavallīlatānāṃ tu puṣpitānāṃ ca vīrudhām \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ sarasānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. In case the flowering trees, the shrubs or the creepers are shattered, and with the killing of all those bom of the eggs or the sweat, or by destroying plants of fruits and flowers, the expiatory rite for the sin is drinking of ghee.

## \|\| 2.33.38-39 \|\|

*phalapuṣpodbhavānāṃ ca ghṛtaprāśo viśodhanam \|*  
*hastināṃ ca vadhe dṛṣṭaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ viśodhanam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ vā gāṃ hatvā tu pramādataḥ \|*  
*matipūrvaṃ vadhe cāsyāḥ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. The killer of elephants can be purified with the performing of Taptakrchhra-vrata. In case a cow is accidently killed, one should perform the Candrayana or the Par aka vrata. But there is no expiatory rite prescribed for the intentional killing of a cow.

## Chapter 34. Rules for repentance

## \|\| 2.34.1 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca*  
*manuṣyāṇāṃ tu haraṇaṃ kṛtvā strīṇāṃ gṛhasya ca \|*  
*vāpīkūpajalānāṃ ca śudhyeccāndrāyaṇena tu \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vyasa said, A person who abducts a man, a woman, of seizing a house, well, tank or a water reservoid, he can be purified with the performing of the Candrayana-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.2 \|\|

*dravyāṇāmalpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvānyaveśmataḥ \|*  
*caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ tanniryātyātmaśuddhaye \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. A person who steals cheap things from the house of others, he can be purified with the performing of Santapana-vrata and Krcchra rite. By this method he can be relieved of all the sins completely.

## \|\| 2.34.3 \|\|

*dhānyānnadhanacauryaṃ tu kṛtvā kāmād dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*svajātīyagṛhādeva kṛcchrārdhena viśuddhyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In case, a Brahmana steals from the house of another Brahmana, belonging to the same line, the cereals, cash, or cooked food, then he can be purified with the performing of the Krcchrardha (half a Krcchra) vow.

## \|\| 2.34.4 \|\|

*bhakṣabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca \|*  
*puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. A person who steals the eatables, the vehicles, the bed, seat, flowers, roots and fruit, he can be purified by consuming the pahcagavya (urine of cow, cowdung, cow’s milk, curd and ghee).

## \|\| 2.34.5 \|\|

*tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāṃ ca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca \|*  
*cailacarmāmiṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syādabhojanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In case anyone steals the items like hay, wood, fuel, raw rice, jaggery, robes, hides and meat, then he can be freed of the sin by fasting for three nights.

## \|\| 2.34.6 \|\|

*maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca \|*  
*ayaḥ kāṃsyopalānāṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇāśanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In case anything like gem, pearl, coral, copper, silver, iron, bronze and stone, is stolen, then the relative sin can be removed by consuming a little of the cereals for twelve days.

## \|\| 2.34.7 \|\|

*kārpāsakīṭajorṇānāṃ dviśaphaikaśaphasya ca \|*  
*pakṣigandhauṣadhīnāṃ ca rajvāścaiva tryahaṃ payaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. In case a person steals cotton, or the clothes made of it, eleven-hoofed or single-hoofed animals, the flowers, scents and the medicines, the related sin can be removed by living on milk or water for three days.

## \|\| 2.34.8 \|\|

*naramāṃsāśanaṃ kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇamathācaret \|*  
*kākaṃ caiva tathā śvānaṃ jagdhvā hastinameva ca \|*  
*varāhaṃ kukkuṭaṃ cātha taptakṛcchreṇa śudhyati \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In case one eats human flesh,he should perform the Candrayana-vrata. By eating meat of a crow, a dog, an elephant, village pig, or a cock, one should perform the Taptakrchhra- vrata for purification.

## \|\| 2.34.9-11 \|\|

*kravyādānāṃ ca māṃsāni purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca \|*  
*gogomāyukapīnāṃ ca tadeva vratamācaret \|*  
*upoṣya dvādaśāhaṃ tu kūṣmāṇḍairjuhuyād ghṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nakulolūkamārjāraṃ jagdhvā sāṃtapanaṃ caret \|*  
*śvāpadoṣṭrakharāñjagdhvā taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati \|*  
*vratavaccaiva saṃskāraṃ pūrveṇa vidhinaiva tu \|\| 10 \|\|*

*bakaṃ caiva balākaṃ ca haṃsaṃ kāraṇḍavaṃ tathā \|*  
*cakravākaṃ plavaṃ jagghvā dvādaśāhamabhojanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. The consuming of the flesh of carnivorous animals or birds, their faeces or the urine, cow, jackal, and of the monkey, besides the aquatic animal, blue jay, and by eating the fish, (one attracts sin), which could be removed by the performing of the Taptakrchhra fast. Or alternatively, the concerned person should remain without food for twelve days and offerings should be made in the fire with white gourd together with ghee. By eating the flesh of a mungoose, an owl and a cat, the Santapana vrata should be performed.

## \|\| 2.34.12 \|\|

*kapotaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ caiva śukaṃ sārasameva ca \|*  
*ulūkaṃ jālapādaṃ ca jagdhvāpyetad vrataṃ caret \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The flesh of the beast of prey, camel, or a mule, when taken by a person, he can be purified with the performing of the Taptakrccha vrata. All rites in accordance with the procedure mentioned before should be performed.

## \|\| 2.34.13 \|\|

*śiśumāraṃ tathā cāṣaṃ matsyamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*jagdhvā caiva kaṭāhārametadeva cared vratam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. In case one eats the flesh of a skylark, duck, swan, ducks with long necks and the rudy bird, then he should fast for twelve days.

## \|\| 2.34.14 \|\|

*kokilaṃ caiva matsyāṃśca maṇḍukaṃ bhujagaṃ tathā \|*  
*gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsenaikena śuddhyati \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. By eating the flesh of a pigeon, lapwing, parrot, crane, owl, and web-foot, one has to fast for twelve days.

## \|\| 2.34.15 \|\|

*jalecarāṃśca jalajān prattudānnakhaviṣkirān \|*  
*raktapādāṃstathā jagdhvā saptāhaṃ caitadācaret \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The aquatic animal known as porpoise (dolphin), blue jay, and fish or the animals without horns, when consumed as food, then one has to perform same rites.

## \|\| 2.34.16 \|\|

*śuno māṃsaṃ śuṣkamāṃsamātmārthaṃ ca tathā kṛtam \|*  
*bhuktvā māsaṃ caredetat tatpāpasyāpanuttaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. By eating the flesh of cuckoo, aquatic cat, frog, and snake, one has to consume for a month the barley boiled in the cow’s urine, to get himself purified.

## \|\| 2.34.17 \|\|

*vārtākaṃ bhustṛṇaṃ śigruṃ khukhuṇḍaṃ karakaṃ tathā \|*  
*prājāpatyaṃ carejjagdhvā śaṅkhaṃ kumbhīkameva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The flesh of aquatic creatures, or the animals bom in water, wood pecker, or the porridge, footed parots, (when consumed also attracts sin and for its removal, one should) observe this vow for seven days.

## \|\| 2.34.18 \|\|

*palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ caiva bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret \|*  
*nālikāṃ taṇḍulīyaṃ ca prājāpatyena śuddhyati \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. In case one has prepared the dog’s flesh or dried meat for eating, then for the removal of the related sin, one has to consume for a month the barley boiled in the cow’s urine.

## \|\| 2.34.19 \|\|

*aśmāntakaṃ tathā potaṃ taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati \|*  
*prājāpatyena śuddhiḥ syāt kakkubhāṇḍasya bhakṣaṇe \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. By consuming the brinjals, the roots growing below the earth, the mushrooms, a tree called Kutaka, Cataka (sparrow), Khadga (rhinoceros) and Kumbhlra plant, one should perform the Prajdpatya-vrata to get himself relieved of the related sin.

## \|\| 2.34.20 \|\|

*alābuṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva bhuktvā caitad vrataṃ caret \|*  
*udumbaraṃ ca kāmena taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. After eating out onion or garlic, one should perform Candrayana-vrata. After consuming lotus-stalk and Tandulla, one should perfom the Prajapatya-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.21 \|\|

*vṛthā kṛsarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpasaṃkulam \|*  
*bhuktvā caivaṃ vidhaṃ tvannaṃ trirātreṇa viśuddhyati \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. On eating the As'mantaka plant and the young shoot of any plant, one becomes pure by means of Taptab'chha-vrata. And after consuming safflower, one should perform the Prajapatya- vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.22 \|\|

*pītvā kṣīrāṇyapeyāni brahmacārī samāhitaḥ \|*  
*gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsenaikena śuddhyati \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. By consuming bottle-gourd, kimsuka (Butea frondosa), one has to perform the Prajdpatya- vrata. In case, one out of ignorance consumes the squashes and decoctions, he gets purified by consuming the barley cooked in cow’s urine for seven nights. In case of the fruits of the wild fig tree, one gets purified with the performing of Taptakrchhra-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.23 \|\|

*anirdaśāhaṃ gokṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ cājameva ca \|*  
*saṃdhinyāśca vivatsāyāḥ piban kṣīramidaṃ caret \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The one who takes food in a sraddha at the end of the first year or during the period of impurity of birth or death, then the Brahmana gets purified with the performing of the Candrayana-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.24-25 \|\|

*eteṣāṃ ca vikārāṇi pītvā mohena mānavaḥ \|*  
*gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ saptarātreṇa śuddhyati \|\| 24 \|\|*

*bhuktvā caiva navaśrāddhe mṛtake sūtake tathā \|*  
*cāndrāyaṇena śuddhyeta brāhmaṇastu samāhitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. A Brahmana who performs yajna daily but does not donate the first part of the food, and in case a Brahmana takes food with such a person he get purified with the performing of Candrayana-vrata. With the consuming of the prohibited food of the low-castes, the concerned person can be purified with the performing of the Taptakrchhra-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.26-27 \|\|

*yasyāgnau hūyate nityaṃ na yasyāgraṃ na dīyate \|*  
*cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret samyak tasyānnaprāśane dvijaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*abhojyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ bhuktvā cānnamupaskṛtam \|*  
*antāvasāyināṃ caiva taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. When a Brahmana consumes the food of a Candala, then he should perform the Candrayana-vrata, appropriately. But a person who deliberately takes such a food, he can be purified with the performing of Krcchra-vrata for a year. Thereafter, he has to undergo consecration rites once again. A person who might have consumed the intoxicating drink other than the wine, he should perform the Candrayana-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.28 \|\|

*cāṇḍālānnaṃ dvijo bhuktvā samyak cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret \|*  
*buddhipūrvaṃ tu kṛcchrābdaṃ punaḥ saṃskārameva ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. By consuming the discarded food, one gets purified with the performing of the Prajapatya- vrata. In case, someone consumes the faeces, urine or the semen virile, he should perform Prajapatya-vrata for purification.

## \|\| 2.34.29 \|\|

*asurāmadyapānena kuryāccāndrāyaṇavratam \|*  
*abhojyānnaṃ tu bhuktvā ca prājāpatyena śuddhyati \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. With the earning of a sin by performing of the prohibited tasks, one should appropriately fast for a day. With the consuming of the faeces and urine of the filthy pig, donkey, camel, jackal, monkey, or a crow, a Brahmana should purify himself with the performing of Candrayana expiatory rite.

## \|\| 2.34.30 \|\|

*viṇmūtrapāśanaṃ kṛtvā retasaścaitadācaret \|*  
*anādiṣṭeṣu caikāhaṃ sarvatra tu yathārthataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. In case, the three twice-born castes (i.e., the Brahmana, the Ksatriya and the Vaisya) unknowingly consumes urine and faeces in contact with urine, then they deserve to be consecrated once again.

## \|\| 2.34.31-32 \|\|

*viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ \|*  
*prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ajñānāt prāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca \|*  
*punaḥ saṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. When a person unknowingly consumes the faeces or the urine of the carnivorous birds, then he should perform the expiatory rite of Mahasantapana. By consuming the urine and faeces of vultures, frogs, sparrow, or domestic fowls, one should perform the Krchhra-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.33-34 \|\|

*kravyādāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva prāśya mūtrapurīṣakam \|*  
*mahāsāṃtapanaṃ mohāt tathā kuryād dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*bhāsamaṇḍūkakurare viṣkire kṛcchramācaret \|\| 33 \|\|*

*prājāpatyena śuddhyeta brāhāmaṇocchiṣṭabhojane \|*  
*kṣatriye taptakṛcchraṃ syād vaiśye caivātikṛcchrakam \|*  
*śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ dvijo bhuktvā kuryāccāndrāyaṇavratam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. By consuming of the Ucchista (left over) of a Brahmana, one should perform the Pmjapatya- vrata, by consuming the left over of a Ksatriya, one should perform the Taptakrchhra-vrata and by consuming the left over a Vais'ya, one should perform the Atikrccha-vrata. By consuming the left over of a Sudra and drinking water in the pot of wine, a Brahmana should perform the Candrayana-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.35 \|\|

*surābhāṇḍodare vāri pītvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret \|*  
*śunocchiṣṭaṃ dvijo bhuktvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati \|*  
*gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ pītaśeṣaṃ ca rāgavān \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. In case a Brahmana takes the left over of others, then he gets purified by drinking cow’s urine, eating barley cooked in cow’s urine or by drinking water that remains after cows have drunk.

## \|\| 2.34.36 \|\|

*apo mūtrapurīṣādyairdūṣitāḥ prāśayed yadā \|*  
*tadā sāṃtapanaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ pāpaviśodhanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. In case some one drinks the water which has been defiled by faeces or the urine, then he can regain purity with the performing of the Krchhra-vrata or Santapana-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.37 \|\|

*cāṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu yadi jñānāt pibejjalam \|*  
*caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pāpaśodhanam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. In case a Brahmana knowingly drinks water from the well or the vase of a Candala, then he should perform Santapana or Krchhra-vrata to get rid of the sin atonce.

## \|\| 2.34.38 \|\|

*cāṇḍālena tu saṃspṛṣṭaṃ pītvā vāri dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*trirātreṇa viśuddhyeta pañcagavyena caiva hi \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. In case one takes water touched by a Cand a la, an excellent Brahmana can be purified with the consuming of Pahcagavya and fasting for three nights.

## \|\| 2.34.39 \|\|

*mahāpātakisaṃsparśe bhuṅkte 'snātvā dvijo yadi \|*  
*buddhipūrvaṃ tu mūḍhātmā taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. In case a Brahmana, knowingly or unknowingly, touches a grave sinner, or takes food with him, then he should take bath and perform the Taptakrchhra-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.40 \|\|

*spṛṣṭvā mahāpātakinaṃ cāṇḍālaṃ vā rajasvalām \|*  
*pramādād bhojanaṃ kṛtvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In case a person, takes his food even after touching a grave sinner, a Candala or a woman in her monthly courses, then he can be purified by fasting for three nights.

## \|\| 2.34.41 \|\|

*snānārhe yadi bhuñjīta ahorātreṇa śuddhyati \|*  
*buddhipūrvaṃ tu kṛcchreṇa bhagavānāha padmajaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. A person who is required to take bath, but out of arrogance, he takes food in unclean condition, then he can regain his purity after observing fast in the course of a day and a night. If he does so wilfidly, he should perform Krcchra rite according to the lotus-bom lord.

## \|\| 2.34.42 \|\|

*śuṣkaparyuṣitādīni gavādipratidūṣitam \|*  
*bhuktvopavāsaṃ kurvota kṛcchrapādamathāpi vā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. In case one consumes the stale food or the food polluted by a cow or other animals, then he should perform a fast or fourth of the Krchhra- vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.43 \|\|

*saṃvatsarānte kṛcchraṃ tu cared vipraḥ punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. At the end of every year, a Brahmana should observe the Krcchra vow again for the purification of the sin due to the eating of forbidden things willingly or unwillingly.

## \|\| 2.34.44 \|\|

*vrātyānāṃ yajanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāmantyakarma ca \|*  
*abhicāramahīnaṃ ca tribhiḥ kṛcchrairviśuddhyati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The one who performs yajnas with the uncultured people, or enters into evil deeds or makes the people of the lower castes to perform the best of deeds, then he can be purified with the performing of three Krchhra-vratas.

## \|\| 2.34.45 \|\|

*brāhmaṇādihatānāṃ tu kṛtvā dāhādikāḥ kriyāḥ \|*  
*gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ prājāpatyena śuddhyati \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. On performing the cremation and other rites for Brahmanas and others who are killed, a Brahmana can be purified with the consuming of the barley mixed with the urine of the cow and the performing of the Prajapatya-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.46 \|\|

*tailābhyakto 'thavā kuryād yadi mūtrapurīṣake \|*  
*ahorātreṇa śuddhyeta śmaśrukarma ca maithunam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. A person who has besmeared himself with oil or vomitted, passes urine or discharges faeces, or shaves himself or indulges in sexual intercourse, he gets purified by fasting for a day and a night.

## \|\| 2.34.47 \|\|

*ekāhena vivāhāgniṃ parihārya dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*trirātreṇa viśaddhyeta trirātrāt ṣaḍahaṃ punaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. In case a person discards the fire in a day out of ignorance, then he can be purified by fasting for three nights. In case he neglects fire-worship for three night, he should observe fasting for six days.

## \|\| 2.34.48 \|\|

*daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā parihārya pramādataḥ \|*  
*kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tatpāpasyāpanuttaye \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. But when a person discards the fire out of arrogance, for ten or twelve days, he shall have to perform the Krcchra and Candrayana-vrata to relieve himself of the related sin.

## \|\| 2.34.49 \|\|

*patitād dravyamādāya tadutsargeṇa śuddhyati \|*  
*caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchramityāha bhagavān prabhuḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. By accepting wealth from a fallen person, one get purified by discarding the same. Thereafter one should perform the Krchhra-vrata appropriately. This has been ordained by Manu.

## \|\| 2.34.50 \|\|

*anāśakanivṛttāstu pravrajyāvasitāstathā \|*  
*careyustrīṇi kṛcchrāṇi trīṇi cāndrāyaṇāni ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. When a person takes a vow or fasting and then abondons the same, such a person can earn purification with the performing of three Candrayana-vratas and three Krchhra-vratas.

## \|\| 2.34.51 \|\|

*punaśca jātakarmādisaṃkāraiḥ saṃskṛtā dvijāḥ \|*  
*śuddhyeyustad vrataṃ samyak careyurdharmavardhanāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thereafter, Jdtakarma should also be performed in order to earn purity. Sanctified thus the Brahmanas become purified. Persons knowing Dharma should observe that vow properly.

## \|\| 2.34.52 \|\|

*anupāsitasaṃdhyastu tadaharyāpako vaset \|*  
*anaśnan saṃyatamanā rātrau ced rātrimeva hi \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. A Brahmacarin, when fails to perform sandhya worship, he should observe fast on that particular day and concentrate his mind performing the japam.

## \|\| 2.34.53 \|\|

*akṛtvā samidādhānaṃ śuciḥ snātvā samāhitaḥ \|*  
*gāyatryaṣṭasahasrasya japyaṃ kuryād viśuddhaye \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. In case a person, taking a bath, getting purified, and controlling his mind, does not offer wood sticks in the fire, then he should recite the Gayatrl mantra for a thousand and eight times.

## \|\| 2.34.54 \|\|

*upāsīta na cet saṃdhyāṃ gṛhastho 'pi pramādataḥ \|*  
*snātvā viśuddhyate sadyaḥ pariśrāntastu saṃyamāt \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. In case a Brahmacarin, out of arrogance, forgets to perform the sandhya prayer, then he, after taking the bath, should observe the fast. He shall become pure instantly. In case he feeling extremely tired, and is unable to perform the sandhya, then he should remain perfectly self- controlled.

## \|\| 2.34.55 \|\|

*vedoditāni nityāni karmāṇi ca vilopya tu \|*  
*snātakavratalopaṃ tu kṛtvā copavased dinam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. When a graduate (who has already completed the period of brahmacarya) reglccts the daily routine as prescribed in the Vedas or forgets to perform the vratas, then he can be purified after performing a day’s fast.

## \|\| 2.34.56 \|\|

*saṃvatsaraṃ caret kṛcchramagnyutsādī dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*cāndrāyaṇaṃ cared vrātyo gopradānena śuddhyati \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. A Brahmana, who destroys the fife, is required to perform Krchha-wata for a year. A Vratya could be purified with the performing of the Candrayana-vrata or by giving a cow in charity.

## \|\| 2.34.57 \|\|

*nāstikyaṃ yadi kurvota prājāpatyaṃ cared dvijaḥ \|*  
*devadrohaṃ gurudrohaṃ taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. In case a Brahmana, behaves like an atheist, then he should perform the Prajdpatya-vrata. A person who betrays the gods or the preceptor, then he could be purified with the performing of Taptakrchhra-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.58 \|\|

*uṣṭrayānaṃ samāruhya kharayānaṃ ca kāmataḥ \|*  
*trirātreṇa viśuddhyet tu nagno vā praviśejjalam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. One who willingly mounts over a camel-cart or a donkey-cart, or enters the water without robes, he gets purified after observing the fast for three nights.

## \|\| 2.34.59 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhānnakālatāmāsaṃ saṃhitājapa eva ca \|*  
*homāśca śākalā nityamapāṅktānāṃ viśodhanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. In case a person is Apankta (outcaste not eligible to sit in the same row for meals with others), he should miss five meals and take meal only on the sixth occasion, for one month, besides, recking the sukta of the Veda for a month, performing the sakala-homa daily.

## \|\| 2.34.60 \|\|

*nīlaṃ raktaṃ vasitvā ca brāhmaṇo vastrameva hi \|*  
*ahorātroṣitaḥ snātaḥ pañcagavyena śuddhyati \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. On wearing a blue or red cloth, a Brahmana should observe fast for a day and a night. He should get purified by drinking Pahcagavya.

## \|\| 2.34.61 \|\|

*vedadharmapurāṇānāṃ caṇḍālasya tu bhāṣaṇe \|*  
*cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syānna hyanyā tasya niṣkṛtiḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. When one explains the discourse on the Vedas, Dharmasastras and the Puranas to a Candala, he gets purified with the performing of the Candrayana-vrata. There is no other repentance except this.

## \|\| 2.34.62 \|\|

*udbandhanādinihataṃ saṃspṛśya brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit \|*  
*cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syāt prājāpatyena vā punaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. By touching a Brahmana’s body who has coimnitted suicide, one gets purified by performing the Candrayana or the Prdjdpatya- vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.63 \|\|

*ucchiṣṭo yadyanācāntaścāṇḍālādīn spṛśed dvijaḥ \|*  
*pramādād vai japet snātvā gāyatryaṣṭasahasrakam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. In case a Brahmana, defiled by Ucchista, without performing acamana, touches a Candala, he should recite the Gayatrl mantra a thousand and eight times, after taking bath.

## \|\| 2.34.64 \|\|

*drupadānāṃ śataṃ vāpi brahmacārī samāhitaḥ \|*  
*trirātropoṣitaḥ samyak pañcagavyena śuddhyati \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. A Brahmacarin controlling his sense organs, should also recite the Drupadd mantra a hundred times and fasting for three nights, he get purified by means of Pancagavya.

## \|\| 2.34.65 \|\|

*caṇḍālapatitādīṃstu kāmād yaḥ saṃspṛśed dvijaḥ \|*  
*ucchiṣṭastatra kurvota prājāpatyaṃ viśuddhaye \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. A Brahmana, who soon after eating something, touches deliberately a fallen person or a Candala, then, he should perform the Prajdpatya vrata for his own purification.

## \|\| 2.34.66 \|\|

*cāṇḍālasūtakaśavāṃstathā nārīṃ rajasvalām \|*  
*spṛṣṭvā snāyād viśuddhyarthaṃ tatspṛṣṭaṃ patitiṃ tathā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Even otherwise by touching a Candala, or a person having attracted impurity due to birth or death, or a dead body, or a woman in her period, or a fallen person, he should take bath for his purification.

## \|\| 2.34.67 \|\|

*cāṇḍālasūtakaśavaiḥ saṃspṛṣṭaṃ saṃspṛśed yadi \|*  
*pramādāt tata ācamya japaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. In case a person who touches the one who has touched a Candala, or a person with the impurity of birth or death, or a corpse, he should perform japam and acamana for his own purification.

## \|\| 2.34.68 \|\|

*tat spṛṣṭasparśinaṃ spṛṣṭvā buddhipūrvaṃ dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*ācamet tad viśuddhyarthaṃ prāha devaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. In case a person deliberately touches a person who has already touched a Candala, then he should take bath and sip the water. This has been ordained by the Grandsire.

## \|\| 2.34.69 \|\|

*bhuñjānasya tu viprasya kadācit saṃstraved gudam \|*  
*kṛtvā śaucaṃ tataḥ snāyādupoṣya juhuyād ghṛtam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. If a Brahmana, taking food is accidentally touched, he should perform sauca and then observe the fast. He should take a bath and perform Нота. This is the holy rite.

## \|\| 2.34.70 \|\|

*cāṇḍālāntyaśavaṃ spṛṣṭvā kṛcchraṃ kuryād viśuddhaye \|*  
*spṛṣṭvābhyaktastvasaṃspṛśyamahorātreṇa śuddhyati \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. In case a Brahman touches the dead body of a Candala, then he gets purified with the performing of the krchhra-vrata. On touching a person who has anointed his body, he should purity himself by fasting for a day and a night.

## \|\| 2.34.71 \|\|

*surāṃ spṛṣṭvā dvijaḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ śuciḥ \|*  
*palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ caiva ghṛtaṃ prāśya tataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. In case a Brahmana touches the wine, then he should perform the prandyama thrice and in case he touches the onion or garlic, he can get himself purified with the consuming of the ghee.

## \|\| 2.34.72 \|\|

*brāhmaṇastu śunā daṣṭastryahaṃ sāyaṃ payaḥ pibet \|*  
*nābherūrdhvaṃ tu daṣṭasya tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. In case a Brahmana is bitten by a dog, then he should take milk for three days in the evening. In case, he is bitten above the umbilical region, he should increase the quantity of milk twofold.

## \|\| 2.34.73 \|\|

*syādetat triguṇaṃ bāhvormūrdhni ca syāccaturguṇam \|*  
*snātvā japed vā sāvitrīṃ śvabhirdaṣṭo dvijottamaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. And in case he is bitten on the arms, he should increase the quantity of milk threefold, and when bitten over the head, the milk should be fourfold. Or otherwise, a Brahmana bitten by a dog, should perform the japam of the Gayatrl mantra after taking a bath.

## \|\| 2.34.74 \|\|

*anirvartya mahāyajñān yo bhuṅkte tu dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*anāturaḥ sati dhane kṛcchrārdhena sa śuddhyati \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. A healthy Brahmana, inspite his being wealthy, when takes food without performing the Pahca-mahdyajhas then he can be purified with the performing of half of the Krchhra- vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.75 \|\|

*āhitāgnirupasthānaṃ na kuryād yastu parvaṇi \|*  
*ṛtau na gacched bhāryāṃ vā so 'pi kṛcchrārdhamācaret \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. In case a Brahmana priest, does not maintain the sacred fires on the festive occasion, and does not cohabit with his wife during the period, then he can be purified with the performing of the half Krchhra-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.76 \|\|

*vinādbhirapsu nāpyārtaḥ śarīraṃ sanniveśya ca \|*  
*sacailo jalamāplutya gāmālabhya viśuddhyati \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. When a healthy person, does not clean himself with water after putting his body into the water, then he should take a dip putting on the clothes, and thereafter touch the cow for purification.

## \|\| 2.34.77 \|\|

*buddhipūrvaṃ tvabhyudito japedantarjale dvijaḥ \|*  
*gāyatryaṣṭasahasraṃ tu tryahaṃ copavased vratī \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. In case, a sin is deliberately performed, then the concerned Brahmana should recite the Gayatri-mantra for a thousand and eight times, standing in the water after the sun has risen, besides observing fast for three days.

## \|\| 2.34.78 \|\|

*anugamyecchayā śūdraṃ pretībhūtaṃ dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*gāyatryaṣṭasahasraṃ ca japyaṃ kuryānnadīṣu ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. In case a Brahmana, joins the funeral procession of a Siidra out of his own accord, then he should perform bath and recite the Gayatrl mantra over a holy river bank for a thousand and eight times.

## \|\| 2.34.79 \|\|

*kṛtvā tu śapathaṃ vipro viprasya vadhasaṃyutam \|*  
*mṛṣaiva yāvakānnena kuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. In case a Brahmana, takes an oath with the delimitation of another Brahmana, and breaks it thereafter, then he should perform the Cdndrayana-vrata by means of cooked barley food.

## \|\| 2.34.80 \|\|

*paṅktyāṃ viṣamadānaṃ tu kṛtvā kṛcchreṇa śuddhyati \|*  
*chāyāṃ śvapākasyāruhya snātvā saṃprāśayed ghṛtam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. In case a person differentiates in giving charities to the Brahmanas seated in same row, he can get himself purified with the performing of the Krchhra-vrata. On treading the shadow of a Candala, one shall take bath and drink ghee.

## \|\| 2.34.81 \|\|

*īkṣedādityamaśucirdṛṣṭvāgniṃ candrameva vā \|*  
*mānuṣaṃ cāsthi saṃspṛśya snānaṃ kṛtvā viśuddhyati \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. One should have a look at the sun, inspite of being impure. Otherwise one should ignite the fire, or should look at the moon. By touching the human bones, a person gets purified by taking a bath.

## \|\| 2.34.82 \|\|

*kṛtvā tu mithyādhyayanaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ tu vatsaram \|*  
*kṛtaghno brāhmaṇagṛhe pañca saṃvatsaraṃ vratī \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. By doing false studies, as a repentance, one has to beg alms, for a year. An ungrateful person should live in the house of a Brahmana, and perform sacred rites for five years.

## \|\| 2.34.83 \|\|

*huṅkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṅkāraṃ ca garīyasaḥ \|*  
*snātvānaśnannahaḥ śeṣaṃ praṇipatya prasādayet \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. In case a person insults a Brahmana producing Hutit, or addresses a respectable person disgracefully using Tvam instead of Bhavan, then he, taking bath, should not take food during the rest of the day. At the same time the person who is insulted should be pleased by falling on his feet and begging forgiveness.

## \|\| 2.34.84 \|\|

*tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhaṃ baddhvāpi vāsasā \|*  
*vivāde vāpi nirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. After striking elders with the blade of a grass, if one binds their neck with a piece of cloth and if conquers them in argument, one should please the other one by offering salutation to him.

## \|\| 2.34.85 \|\|

*avagūrya caret kṛcchramatikṛcchraṃ nipātane \|*  
*kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kurvota viprasyotpādya śoṇitam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. In case one lifts a rod for beating a Brahmana, then the Krchhra-vrata should be performed. In case a Brahmana is made to fall down on the ground, then, as a repentance, Atikrchhra-vrata has to be performed. In case a person makes the blood to flow from his body, then he should perform both Krchhra and Atikrchhra vows.

## \|\| 2.34.86 \|\|

*gurorākrośamanṛtaṃ kṛtvā kuryād viśodhanam \|*  
*ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā tatpāpasyāpanuttaye \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. At the annoyance of the preceptor, in case some one speaks evil words, then such a person should fast for a day in repentance.

## \|\| 2.34.87 \|\|

*devarṣoṇāmabhimukhaṃ ṣṭhīvanākrośane kṛte \|*  
*ulmukena dahejjihvāṃ dātavyaṃ ca hiraṇyakam \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. A person who spits in front of the Brahmanas, the gods and the Rishis, his tongue should be burnt out by means of fireband, besides giving away gold in charity.

## \|\| 2.34.88 \|\|

*devodyāne tu yaḥ kuryānmūtroccāraṃ sakṛd dvijaḥ \|*  
*chindyācchiśnaṃ tu śuddhyarthaṃ careccāndrāyaṇaṃ tu vā \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. A Brahmana who passes urine in the auspicious garden or shrines of the gods, he should perform Candrayana-vrata, and his penis should be cut off atonce.

## \|\| 2.34.89 \|\|

*devatāyatane mūtraṃ kṛtvā mohād dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*śiśnasyotkartanaṃ kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇamathācaret \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. In case a Brahmana, passes urine himself in the temple of the god, his penis should be cut off and he should perform the Candrayana- vrata as expiation.

## \|\| 2.34.90 \|\|

*devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca devānāṃ caiva kutsanam \|*  
*kṛtvā samyak prakurvota prājāpatyaṃ dvijottamaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. By denouncing the gods, the Rishis and the person who are adorable like the gods, a Brahmana gets purified with the performing of the Prajapatya-vrata.

## \|\| 2.34.91 \|\|

*taistu saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātvā devān samarcayet \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā vīkṣeta bhāsvantaṃ smvatvā viśeśvaraṃ smaret \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. By having a conversation with such a type of person, one should adore the family deity after taking bath. On seeing them, one should cast a glance at the sun and on remembering them he should devote his mind to Vis'ves'vara for wiping off the sins.

## \|\| 2.34.92 \|\|

*yaḥ sarvabhūtādhipatiṃ viśveśānaṃ vinindati \|*  
*na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatairapi \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. But a person who deliberately denounces Visvesvara-lord Shiva, the ruler of the universe, he cannot be purified even after performing of the repentance for hundreds of years.

## \|\| 2.34.93 \|\|

*cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret pūrvaṃ kṛcchraṃ caivātikṛcchrakam \|*  
*prapannaḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ tasmāt pāpād vimucyate \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. At the outset, he should perform the Candrayana, Krchhra and Atikrchhra-vratas, taking refuge with lord Mahadeva, for redemption.

## \|\| 2.34.94 \|\|

*sarvasvadānaṃ vidhivat sarvapāpaviśodhanam \|*  
*cāndrāyaṇaṃ cavidhinā kṛcchraṃ caivātikṛcchrakam \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Besides this, he should give away all his belongings appropriately, performing Candrayana, Krchhra and Atikrchhra-vrata, by which one is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 2.34.95-96 \|\|

*puṇyakṣetrābhigamanaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam \|*  
*devatābhyarcanaṃ nṝṇāmaśeṣāghavināśanam \|\| 95 \|\|*

*amāvasyāṃ tithiṃ prāpya yaḥ samārādhayecchivam \|*  
*brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 96 \|\|*

95-96. Similarly, by going on pilgrimage to the holy places, all the sins are washed out. On the new moon day, the peopple who adores lord Bhava (Shiva), they are relieved of all the sins on worshipping the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 2.34.97 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mahādevaṃ tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm \|*  
*saṃpūjya brāhmaṇamukhe sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. On the eighth or the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, Brahmanas should be served with the food, and lord Mahadeva should be worshipped. By so doing, a person is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 2.34.98 \|\|

*trayodaśyāṃ tathā rātrau sopahāraṃ trilocanam \|*  
*dṛṣṭveśaṃ prathame yāme mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Similarly during the first Yama (period of three hours) of the thirteenth day of the fortnight, in case one adores three-eyed lord Shiva offering presents, then he is relieved of all his sins.

## \|\| 2.34.99-100 \|\|

*upoṣitaścaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe samāhitaḥ \|*  
*yamāca dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca \|\| 99 \|\|*

*vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca \|*  
*pratyekaṃ tilasaṃyuktān dadyāt saptodakāñjalīn \|*  
*snātvā nadyāṃ tu pūrvāhne mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, a person concentrating his mind, while fasting, should adore Yama, Dharmaraja, Mrtyu, An taka, Vaivasvata, Kala and Sarvapranakara, offering water with sesamum.

## \|\| 2.34.101-102 \|\|

*brahmacaryamadhaḥ śayyāmupavāsaṃ dvijārcanam \|*  
*vrateṣveteṣu kurvota śāntaḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*amāvasyāyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ samuddiśya pitāmaham \|*  
*brāhmaṇāṃstrīn samabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. Taking bath in the forenoon, when the water is so offered in oblation, a person is relieved of all the sins. By observing of Brahmacarya, sleeping on the ground, adoring the Brahmana, while fasting, one should concentrate his mind in these vratas. On the amavasya day or the moonless day, addressing Brahma-the Grand Sire, in case a person adores three Brahmanas appropriately, he is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 2.34.103-104 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣito devaṃ śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ \|*  
*saptamyāmarcayed bhānuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

*bharaṇyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca śanaiścaradine yamam \|*  
*pūjayet saptajanmotthairmucyate pātakairnaraḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. On the sixth day of the bright fortnight, while fasting, in case a person adores the sun-god, he is relieved of all the sins. During the BharanI constellation, or on Saturday when there is the caturthi-tithi, one who adores Yama, is relieved of the sins of the past seven births.

## \|\| 2.34.105-107 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 105 \|\|*

*tapo japastīrthasevā devabrāhmaṇapūjanam \|*  
*grahaṇādiṣu kāleṣu mahāpātakaśodhanam \|\| 106 \|\|*

*yaḥ sarvapāpayukto 'pi puṇyatīrtheṣu mānavaḥ \|*  
*niyamena tyajet prāṇān sa mucyet sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

105-107. One who refrain from taking food on the bright Ekadasl, adores lord Janardana (Visnu) on the day of Dvadasi or the twelfth day of the bright half, he is relieved of the grave sins. During the time of solar or lunar eclipse and during other auspicious occasions, one who performs tapas, japam, pilgrimage, besides adoring the gods and the Brahmanas, all the serious sins are washed with the same.

## \|\| 2.34.108-109 \|\|

*brahmaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ vā mahāpātakadūṣitam \|*  
*bhartāramuddharennārī praviṣṭā saha pāvakam \|\| 108 \|\|*

*etadeva paraṃ strīṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpasamudbhūtau nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. A person who inspite of his being free from all the sins, meets with his end at a holy place, he is relieved of all the sins. In case the husband is the killer of a Brahmana, ungrateful, besides being a grave sinner, but when a wife enters in the fire with him after his death, she infact redeems him. This is the supreme repentance for the women as per the opinion of the learned people.

## \|\| 2.34.110 \|\|

*pativratā tu yā nārī bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇotsukā \|*  
*na tasyā vidyate pāpamiha loke paratra ca \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. A chaste woman, and the one who is engaged in service of her husband, she gets free from the sins during this as well as the future birth.

## \|\| 2.34.111 \|\|

*pativratā dharmaratā rudrāṇyeva na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*nāsyāḥ parābhavaṃ kartuṃ śaknotīha janaḥ kvacit \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. A chaste woman who is always anxious to serve her husband, she is relieved of all the sins. No one should think otherwise about it. She does not attract impurity in this as well as the future world. The chaste woman devoted to piety, meets with all types of welfare and no one on earth can create discomfiture for her.

## \|\| 2.34.112 \|\|

*yathā rāmasya subhagā sītā trailokyaviśrutā \|*  
*patnī dāśaratherdevī vijigye rākṣaseśvaram \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. As an instance in the case of Slta, well- known in the three worlds, the chaste wife of Rama, the son of Dasaratha, has conquered the king of Raksasas, because of her chastity.

## \|\| 2.34.113 \|\|

*rāmasya bhāryāṃ vimalāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ \|*  
*sītāṃ viśālanayanāṃ cakame kālacoditaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Once the Raksasa king Ravana, under the influence of Kala, desired for the chaste Slta, with vast eyes, and the wife of Rama.

## \|\| 2.34.114 \|\|

*gṛhītvā māyayā veṣaṃ carantīṃ vijane vane \|*  
*samāhartuṃ matiṃ cakre tāpasaḥ kila kāminīm \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. He by means of his illusion took to the form of an ascetic, mentally decided to abduct that beautiful lady Slta, who was lonely in the tenantless forest.

## \|\| 2.34.115 \|\|

*vijñāya sā ca tadbhāvaṃ smṛtvā dāśarathiṃ patim \|*  
*jagāma śaraṇaṃ vahnimāvasathyaṃ śucismitā \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Sita possessing the serene smile, understood .the feelings of Ravana, remembered her husband Rama, the son of Dasaratha, and she took refuge in the great fire known as Avasathya.

## \|\| 2.34.116 \|\|

*upatasthe mahāyogaṃ sarvadoṣavināśanam \|*  
*kṛtāñjalī rāmapatnī śākṣāt patimivācyutam \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. Treating the great fire, the fire-god, the great Yogin, the destroyer of the entire universe, as her own husband in the form of Rama, she stood there with folded hands.

## \|\| 2.34.117 \|\|

*namasyāmi mahāyogaṃ kṛtāntaṃ gahanaṃ param \|*  
*dāhakaṃ sarvabhūtānāmīśānaṃ kālarūpiṇam \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Salutation to Agni, the Mahayogin, an excellent form of Kala, the destroyer of all the living beings, lord of all the bhutas, and the destroyer of all.

## \|\| 2.34.118-119 \|\|

*namasye pāvakaṃ devaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ viśvatomukham \|*  
*ātmānaṃ dīptavapuṣaṃ sarvabhūtahṛdī sthitam \|\| 118 \|\|*

*prapadye śaraṇaṃ vahniṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brahmarūpiṇam \|*  
*bhūteśaṃ kṛttivasanaṃ śaraṇyaṃ paramaṃ padam \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. She then said, “I take refuge with everlasting Yogin of the world, clad in elephant-hide, lord of all goblins, the Supreme god, lord Pavaka (the purifying deity), the form of salvation, known as Agni. He is the form of his own self, having the resplendent body, lodged in the hearts of all the living beings, the form of the universe, and the source of the origin of all the lustres, I therefore take refuge to the fire-god, the Lord of great Yogins, the sun, the supreme god.

## \|\| 2.34.120 \|\|

*oṃ prapadye jaganmūrtiṃ prabhavaṃ sarvatejasām \|*  
*mahāyogeśvaraṃ vahnimādityaṃ parameṣṭhinam \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. I take refuge with the terrific destroyer, carrier of a trident, the lord of all the Yogins, the fire of the universal destruction, the one who bestows the pleasures and the liberation, Kalagni Rudra.

## \|\| 2.34.121 \|\|

*prapadye śaraṇaṃ rudraṃ mahāgrāsaṃ triśūlinam \|*  
*kālāgniṃ yogināmīśaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradam \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. O Agni, I take refuge with you, you are Virupaksa with the forms of Bhilh, Bhiivah, Svah, you are lodged in a golden house secretly, and you are immensely illustrious.

## \|\| 2.34.122 \|\|

*prapadye tvāṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ svarūpiṇam \|*  
*hiraṇyamaye gṛhe guptaṃ mahāntamamitaujasam \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. You remain present in the bodies of all the living beings as the fire of digestion. I take refuge with Vaisvanara. I take refuge with the carrier of havya and kavya for the manes, and Agnideva-the form of Ishvara.

## \|\| 2.34.123 \|\|

*vaiśvānaraṃ prapadye 'haṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam \|*  
*havyakavyavahaṃ devaṃ prapadye vahnimīśvaram \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. I take refuge with Agni-the supreme Reality, who bestows welfare even on the sun, who is lodged in the sky, is extremely resplendent, О Lord Agni, the carrier of havya to gods, you kindly protect me.”

## \|\| 2.34.124 \|\|

*prapadye tatparaṃ tattvaṃ vareṇyaṃ savituḥ svayam \|*  
*bhargamagniparaṃ jyotī rakṣa māṃ havyavāhana \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. Thus reciting the prayer of eight verses on Vahni, the glorious Sita, the wife of Rama, closed her eyes, devoted her mind to Rama and kept on adoring him.

## \|\| 2.34.125 \|\|

*iti vahnyaṣṭakaṃ japtvā rāmapatnī yaśasvinī \|*  
*dhyāyantī manasā tasthau rāmamunmīlitekṣaṇā \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. Thereafter, from the domestic fire of the house, lord Mahes'vara, the bearer of sacrificial oblations, of resplendent soul manifested himself as if burning with his own effulgence. Igr prsnmqf ж тг indmidra тгчш

## \|\| 2.34.126 \|\|

*athāvasathyād bhagavān havyavāho maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*āvirāsīt sudīptātmā tejasā pradahanniva \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. The lord, then with the sole intention of the killing of Ravana, created an illusory Sita and leaving her there, he disappeared in the burning flames.

## \|\| 2.34.127 \|\|

*svaṣṭvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ sa rāvaṇavadhepsayā \|*  
*sītāmādāya dharmiṣṭhāṃ pāvako 'ntaradhīyata \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. Finding the illusory Sita, Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, kidnapped her and carried her to Lanka situated in the mid-ocean.

## \|\| 2.34.128 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṃ sītāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ \|*  
*samādāya yayau laṅkāṃ sāgarāntarasaṃsthitām \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. Thereafter Rama, after killing Ravana, brought the illusory Sita with Laksmana. But his mind was filled with doubt.

## \|\| 2.34.129 \|\|

*kṛtvātha rāvaṇavadhaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*masādāyābhavat sītāṃ śaṅkākulitamānasaḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. Observing the mood of Rama, the illusory Sita, in order to convince the people, entered the fire, which in turn at once burnt out that Sita.

## \|\| 2.34.130 \|\|

*sā pratyayāya bhūtānāṃ sītā māyāmīya punaḥ \|*  
*viveśa pāvakaṃ dīptaṃ dadāha jvalano 'pi tām \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Thus, burning the illusory Sita, lord Agni produced the real Sita before Rama. Because of this, Agnideva is quite dear to the gods.

## \|\| 2.34.131 \|\|

*dagdhvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ bhagavānugradīdhitiḥ \|*  
*rāmāyādarśayat sītāṃ pāvako 'bhūt surapriyaḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. Then Sita, the daughter of Janaka, having the slender waist, touched the feet of Rama with both the hands and offered her salutation to Rama, bowing on the ground.

## \|\| 2.34.132 \|\|

*pragṛhya bhartuścaraṇau karābhyāṃ sā sumadhyamā \|*  
*cakāra praṇatiṃ bhūmau rāmāya janakātmajā \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. Thus finding Sita, in this way, Rama felt surprised as well as delighted. Then Rama, lowering his head, offered his salutation to Agnideva.

## \|\| 2.34.133 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanā rāmo vismayākulalocanaḥ \|*  
*nanāma vahniṃ sirasā toṣayāmāsa rāghavaḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. Then he said to Vahn! (Agnideva), “O Lord, why did you bum out Slta with fair complexion earlier? And how is it that I find her seated to my left?”

## \|\| 2.34.134 \|\|

*uvāca vahnerbhagavān kimeṣā varavarṇinī \|*  
*dagdhā bhagavatā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā matpārśvamāgatā \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. Then Agnideva, the destroyer of the lokas, narrated the factual position before Rama, the son of Dasaratha, in the presence of all those who were present there.

## \|\| 2.34.135 \|\|

*tamāha devo lokānāṃ dāhako havyavāhanaḥ \|*  
*yathāvṛttaṃ dāśarathiṃ bhūtānāmeva sannidhau \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. He said, “The goddess Slta is as chaste as goddess Parvati and is extremely noble. The king Janaka had got her after praying to the goddess Parvati.

## \|\| 2.34.136 \|\|

*iyaṃ sā mithileśena pārvatīṃ rudravallabhām \|*  
*ārādhya labdhā tapasā devyāścātyantavallabhā \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. Sita is devoted to her husband like BhavanI in regard to Ishvara, besides being noble and chaste. But Ravana, desired for Slta, then I protected her.

## \|\| 2.34.137 \|\|

*bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇopetā suśīleyaṃ pativratā \|*  
*bhavānīpārśvamānītā mayā rāvaṇakāmitā \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. Sita who had been carried by the king of Raksasas, she was illusory one, who had been created by for the killing of the Ravana.

## \|\| 2.34.138 \|\|

*yā nītā rākṣaseśena sītā bhagavatāhṛtā \|*  
*mayā māyāmayī sṛṣṭā rāvaṇasya vadhāya sā \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. On that account, Ravana, the wicked king of the Raksasas and the destroyer of the worlds, had been killed. The Maya has been withdrawn.

## \|\| 2.34.139 \|\|

*tadarthaṃ bhavatā duṣṭo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ \|*  
*mayopasaṃhṛtā caiva hato lokavināśanaḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. Therefore, you, at my words, should accept this chaste JanakI and you consider yourself to be, the everlasting lord Narayana.

## \|\| 2.34.140 \|\|

*gṛhāṇa vimalāmenāṃ jānakīṃ vacanānmama \|*  
*paśya nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svātmānaṃ prabhavāvyayam \|\| 140 \|\|*

140.Thus speaking, lord Agni, the form of flames, having faces on all sides, duly honoured by Raghava and others, disappeared from the place.

## \|\| 2.34.141 \|\|

*ityuktvā bhagavāṃścaṇḍo viścārcirviśvatomukhaḥ \|*  
*mānito rāghaveṇāgnirbhūtaiścāntaradhīyata \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. Thus, I have spoken the glory of the chastity of the woman. It removes all the sins of the women and is also considered as the expiatory rite for them.

## \|\| 2.34.142 \|\|

*etate pativratānāṃ vaiṃ māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā \|*  
*strīṇāṃ sarvāghaśamanaṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. In case a person is immensely sinful, but if he controls himself well and meets with his end at some auspicious tirtha, then he is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 2.34.143 \|\|

*aśeṣapāpayuktastu puruṣo 'pi susaṃyataḥ \|*  
*svadehaṃ puṇyatīrtheṣu tyaktvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. A Brahmana or anyone else, gets purified from all his sins after taking bath at all the holy places in the world.

## \|\| 2.34.144-145 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā puṇyeṣu vā dvijaḥ \|*  
*mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ samastairapi pūruṣaḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

*vyāsa uvāca*  
*ityeṣa mānavo dharmo yuṣmākaṃ kathito mayā \|*  
*maheśārādhanārthāya jñānayogaṃ ca śāśvatam \|\| 145 \|\|*

144-145. Then Vyasa said, A person, who follows the jnanayoga appropriately, he surely gets an audiene with lord Mahadeva, which the other people cannot do so in even a hundreds of kalpas. Thus, the Dharma propounded by Manu has been propounded to you by me.

## \|\| 2.34.146 \|\|

*yo 'nena vidhinā yuktaṃ jñānayogaṃ samācaret \|*  
*sa paśyati mahādevaṃ nānyaḥ kalpaśatairapi \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. A persons who establishes the great Dharma and that Jnana (knowledge) pertaining to Parames'vara, he is considered as the best of the Yogins and there is no one in the world superior to him.

## \|\| 2.34.147 \|\|

*sthāpayed yaḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ jñānaṃ tatpārameśvaram \|*  
*na tasmādadhiko loke sa yogī paramo mataḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. A person, who inspite of being fully competent, does not establish Dharma and Jnana out of delusion, such a person can never be dear to the lord inspite of his possessing the sacred Yogic powers.

## \|\| 2.34.148 \|\|

*ya saṃsthāpayituṃ śakto na kuryānmohito janaḥ \|*  
*sa yogayukto 'pi munirnātyarthaṃ bhagavatpriyaḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Therefore, the gifts should be distributed to Brahmanas, who are calm and religious minded, besides having been fully devoted.

## \|\| 2.34.149 \|\|

*tasmāt sadaiva dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*dharmayukteṣu śānteṣu śraddhayā cānviteṣu vai \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. A person who reads and narrates the conversation between us, daily, he getting relieved of all the sins, achieves the greatest goal.

## \|\| 2.34.150 \|\|

*yaḥ paṭhed bhavatāṃ nityaṃ saṃvādaṃ mama caiva hi \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmukto gaccheta paramāṃ gatim \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. This should be recited at the time of the performing of the sraddha by the wise ones, in presence of the Brahmanas, and during rites concerned with gods. It should be listened to by all twice-born ones.

## \|\| 2.34.151 \|\|

*śrāddhe vā daivike kārye brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau \|*  
*paṭheta nityaṃ sumanāḥ śrotavyaṃ ca dvijātibhiḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. A person with a concentrated mind, thinking about its interpretation, recites the same to the auspicious Brahmanas, then he getting free from all the blemishes, reaches the abode of Lord Mahesvara.”

## \|\| 2.34.152 \|\|

*yor'thaṃ vicārya yuktātmā śrāvayed brāhmaṇān śucīn \|*  
*sa doṣakañcukaṃ tyaktvā yāti devaṃ maheśvaram \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. Thus speaking, Vyasa, the holy son of Satyavati, reassuring all the sages, left the place in the same way as he had arrived.

## Chapter 35. About the holy places

## \|\| 2.35.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*tīrthāni yāni loke 'smin viśrutāni māhanti ca \|*  
*tāni tvaṃ kathayāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa sāṃpratam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The Rishis requested, “O Romaharsana, you kindly describe the well-known holy places of the present times to us.”

## \|\| 2.35.2 \|\|

*romaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*śṛṇudhvaṃ kathayiṣye 'haṃ tīrthāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*kathitāni purāṇeṣu munibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Romaharsana said, “O Rishis, you please listen, I shall now speak before you about many af the sacred places, which have been described in the Puranas by the sages, the expounders of Brahman.

## \|\| 2.35.3 \|\|

*yatra snānaṃ japo homaḥ śrāddhadānādikaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*ekaikaśo muniśreṣṭhāḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О Best of the sages, They are glorious tirthas, where, by performing holy rites such as, smddha, homa, japam, charities etc., a person purifies his seven generations.

## \|\| 2.35.4 \|\|

*pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*prayāgaṃ prathitaṃ tīrthaṃ tasya māhātmyamīritam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Prayaga-the well known llrlha of Brahma, the Supreme god Paramesthin, is spread in an area of five yojanas and its glory has been described.

## \|\| 2.35.5 \|\|

*anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ kurūṇāṃ devavanditam \|*  
*ṛṣīṇāmāśramairjuṣṭaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. There are other tirthas as well, such as Kuruksetra, which is adored even by the gods. It has several hermitages of the sages, and relieve the people of all the sins.

## \|\| 2.35.6 \|\|

*tatra snātvā viśuddhātmā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ \|*  
*dadāti yatkiñcidapi punātyubhayataḥ kulam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. By taking bath therein, a person becomes pure-souled, free from deceitfulness and jealousy, and whatever charities are offered by him according to his means, it purifies the several generations of the concerned person from the paternal and the maternal sides.

## \|\| 2.35.7 \|\|

*gayātīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāti vallabham \|*  
*kṛtvā piṇḍapradānaṃ tu na bhūyo jāyate naraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Gaya tirtha is quite a secret place, which is difficult to be achieved for the rites of the manes. A person who offers pindas at Gaya for his Pitrs, he is never reborn in this world.

## \|\| 2.35.8 \|\|

*sakṛd gayābhigamanaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍaṃ dadāti yaḥ \|*  
*tāritāḥ pitarastena yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A person, who reaching Gaya, if performs pindadana, he redeems all his manes, who achieve deliverance.

## \|\| 2.35.9 \|\|

*tatra lokahitārthāya rudreṇa paramātmanā \|*  
*śilātale padaṃ nyastaṃ tatra pitṝn prasādayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Lord Rudra, the great Atman, for the welfare of the people, had placed his foot over a slab there. The Pitrs should be pleased by offering oblation there.

## \|\| 2.35.10 \|\|

*gayābhigamanaṃ kartuṃ yaḥ śakto nābhigacchati \|*  
*śocanti pitarastaṃ vai vṛthā tasya pariśramaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A person who is competent enough to visit Gaya, but does not do so, then Pitrs bewail him. His efforts become useless.

## \|\| 2.35.11 \|\|

*gāyanti pitaro gāthāḥ kīrtayanti maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*gayāṃyāsyatiyaḥ kaścit so 'smān saṃtārayiṣyati \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The Pitrs sing the songs and the great Rishis perform Kirtana there, that whosoever from our races might visit Gaya, he would be able to redeem us.

## \|\| 2.35.12 \|\|

*yadi syāt pātakopetaḥ svadharmarativarjitaḥ \|*  
*gayāṃ yāsyati vaṃśyo yaḥ so 'smān saṃtārayiṣyati \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In case a person with impurity or the one who has been excommunicated from the Dharrna reaches Gaya, then also he shall redeem us.

## \|\| 2.35.13 \|\|

*eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ yadyeko 'pi gayāṃ vrajet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Therefore, one should pray for many noble and virtuous sons. Just possible, any one of them might visit this holy place.

## \|\| 2.35.14 \|\|

*tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇastu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pradadyād vidhivat piṇḍān gayāṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Therefore, making all the efforts, atleast a Brahmana should go to Gaya and should perform pindadana for the Pitrs there appropriately.

## \|\| 2.35.15 \|\|

*dhanyāstu khalu te martyā gayāyāṃ piṇḍadāyinaḥ \|*  
*kulānyubhayataḥ sapta samuddhṛtyāpnuyāt param \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Graceful are the people and are quite fortunate who perfonn pindadana at Gaya. They redeem the past as well as the future seven generations of both the families and themselves achieve the heaven.

## \|\| 2.35.16 \|\|

*anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ siddhāvāsamudāhṛtam \|*  
*prabhāsamiti vikhyātaṃ yatrāste bhagavān bhavaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. There is another excellent tirtha, which is called the residence of Siddhas. This place is known as Prabhasa, where lord Shiva always resides.

## \|\| 2.35.17 \|\|

*tatra snānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam \|*  
*kṛtvā lokamavāpnoti brahmaṇo 'kṣayyamuttamam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Taking a bath there one should perform sraddha and give charities to the Brahmanas, and by so doing, one achieves the eternal place of Brahma.

## \|\| 2.35.18 \|\|

*tīrthaṃ traiyambakaṃ nāma sarvadevanamaskṛtam \|*  
*pūjayitvā tatra rudraṃ jyotiṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. There is an excellent tirtha known as Traiyambaka, which is adored by all the gods. By adoring lord Rudradeva there, one achieves the merit of performing the Jyotistoma sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.35.19 \|\|

*suvarṇākṣaṃ mahādevaṃ samabhyarcya kapardinam \|*  
*brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā tu gāṇapatyaṃ labhed dhruvam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. One should adore lord golden-eyes Mahadeva, with locks of hair over the head, should also adore the Brahmanas of the place and by so doing, a person achieves the chieftainship of the attendants of Shiva.

## \|\| 2.35.20 \|\|

*someśvaraṃ tīrthavaraṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*sarvavyādhiharaṃ puṇyaṃ rudrasālokyakāraṇam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Somes'vara is the excellent holy tirtha of Rudra, the Paramesthin, which removes all the ailments. It is here that a devotee can have face to face with Rudra.

## \|\| 2.35.21 \|\|

*tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ vijayaṃ nāma śobhanam \|*  
*tatra liṅgaṃ maheśasya vijayaṃ nāma viśrutam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The Vijaya-tirtha is also one of the best among all holy places. A Shivalinga named Vijaya, has been well known there.

## \|\| 2.35.22 \|\|

*ṣaṇmāsān niyatāhāro brahmacārī samāhitaḥ \|*  
*uṣitvā tatra viprendrā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In case a Brahmacarin controlling himself, consuming the limited food, if remains there for six months, he surely achieves the supreme position.

## \|\| 2.35.23 \|\|

*anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ pūrvadeśe suśobhanam \|*  
*ekāmraṃ devadevasya gāṇapatyaphalapradam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Another excellent tirtha is located in the eastern region. It is the solitary (Ekamra) holy centre of the Devas. It bestows the benefit of chieftainship of Shiva’s attendants.

## \|\| 2.35.24 \|\|

*dattvātra śivabhaktānāṃ kiñcicchaśvanmahīṃ śubhām \|*  
*sārvabhaumo bhaved rājā mumukṣurmokṣamāpnuyāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A devotee of Shiva, in case, gives away in charity, a small piece of land at this place, he surely becomes an all powerful Cakravartin king, while the one desirous of liberation receives the same.

## \|\| 2.35.25 \|\|

*mahānadījalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam \|*  
*grahaṇe samupaspṛśya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The water of the river Mahanadi is quite auspicious and removes all the sins. By plunging therein at the time of eclipse, one is relieved of all his sins.

## \|\| 2.35.26 \|\|

*anyā ca virajā nāma nadī trailokyaviśrutā \|*  
*tasyāṃ snātvā naro viprā brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Besides the above, there is a river known as Viraja, which is well known in the three worlds. By taking a bath in that river, a Brahmana or a man, is adored in the Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 2.35.27 \|\|

*tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇasyānyannāmnā tu puruṣottamam \|*  
*tatra nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānāste paramapūruṣaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Purusottama is the name of another holy place dedicated to Narayana. Lord Narayana, the glorious and great Purusa resides there.

## \|\| 2.35.28 \|\|

*pūjayitvā paraṃ viṣṇuṃ snātvā tatra dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā tu viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. By taking a bath there and adoring lord Visnu, as well as the the Brahmanas, one achieves the excellent Visnuloka.

## \|\| 2.35.29 \|\|

*tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ gokarṇaṃ nāma viśrutam \|*  
*sarvapāpaharaṃ śaṃbhornivāsaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Gokarna also is one of the holiest place of pilgrimage, where lord Paramesthin Shiva is lodged. The place removes all the sins.

## \|\| 2.35.30 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā liṃṅgaṃ tu devasya gokarṇeśvaramuttamam \|*  
*īpsitāṃllabhate kāmān rudrasya dayito bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The excellent Gokarna linga of Shiva stands consecrated there which is adored by the people, who gel their desires fulfilled. He also becomes the dearest devotee of lord Shiva.

## \|\| 2.35.31 \|\|

*uttaraṃ cāpi gokarṇaṃ liṅgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ \|*  
*mahādevasyārcayitvā śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Similarly there is another Gokarna-tirtha to the north, where there is the Shivalinga of the trident-bearing lord. There also a person, by adoring Shiva, achieves the Sayujya (identity) with Shiva.

## \|\| 2.35.32 \|\|

*tatra devo mahādevaḥ sthāṇurityabhiviśrutaḥ \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate tatkṣaṇānnaraḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Lord Mahadeva at that place is known by the name of Sthanu. By having a look at the same, a person is relieved of all the sins instantaneously.

## \|\| 2.35.33 \|\|

*anyat kubjāmramatulaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ śvetadvīpe mahīyate \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Besides the above, there is another holy place known as Kubjasrama, which is devoted to lord Visnu. By adoring lord Visnu there, the great people become glorious in the Svetadvipa.

## \|\| 2.35.34 \|\|

*yatra nārāyaṇo devo rudreṇa tripurāriṇā \|*  
*kṛtvā yajñasya mathanaṃ dakṣasya tu visarjitaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. It was here that Lord Narayana was let off by Rudra, the enemy of the Tripuras, after destroying the sacrifice of Daksa.

## \|\| 2.35.35 \|\|

*samantād yojanaṃ kṣetraṃ siddharṣigaṇavanditam \|*  
*puṇyamāyatanaṃ viṣṇostatrāste puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The surrounding area of a yojana around it, is served by the great Rs is and the Siddhas. There is a auspicious shrine of lord Visnu where lord Purusottama himself resides.

## \|\| 2.35.36 \|\|

*anyat kokāmukhaṃ viṣṇostīrthamadbhutakarmaṇaḥ \|*  
*mṛto 'tra pātakairmukto viṣṇusārūpyamāpnuyāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. There is another place known as Koka- mukha, which is also sacred to lord Visnu who performs astonishing deeds. If a person dies here, he is relieved of all the sins and achieves the form of Visnu.

## \|\| 2.35.37 \|\|

*śālagrāmaṃ mahātīrthaṃ viṣṇoḥ prītivivardhanam \|*  
*prāṇāṃstatra narastyaktvā hṛṣīkeṣaṃ prapaśyati \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. There is a tirtha known by the name of Saligrama, which increases devotion in Visnu. When a person dies here, he becomes face to face with lord Hrslkesa.

## \|\| 2.35.38 \|\|

*aśvatīrthamiti khyātaṃ siddhāvāsaṃ supāvanam \|*  
*āste hayaśirā nityaṃ tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svayam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. There is another place known as tlie As'vatirtha. This is the dwelling place for the Siddhas and looks quite graceful. The image of Narayana here has the head of a horse, who always remains there.

## \|\| 2.35.39 \|\|

*tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*puṣkaraṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ mṛtānāṃ brahmalokadam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Another tirtha is known by the name of Trailokya. This place too is quite graceful being the dwelling place of the Siddhas. There is a tirtha dedicated to the Paramesthin-Brahma.

## \|\| 2.35.40 \|\|

*manasā saṃsmared yastu puṣkaraṃ vai dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*pūyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ śakreṇa saha modate \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The holy place of Puskara, destroys all the sins, which bestows Brahmaloka to the dead. In case a Brahmana, recalls in his mind the holy place of Puskara, he getting relieved of all the sins, becomes blissful with Indra.

## \|\| 2.35.41-42 \|\|

*tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ \|*  
*upāsate siddhasaṅghā brahmaṇaṃ padmasaṃbhavam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tatra strātvā bhavecchuddho brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam \|*  
*pūjayitvā dvijavarān brahmāṇaṃ saṃprapaṣyati \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. All the Gods, the serpents, Gandharvas, Yaksas, and the Raksasas, besides the groups of the Siddhas, adore lord Brahma who was bom out of the lotus. Taking a bath there appropriately, a person getting purified, achieves the vicinity of Brahma. A person who adores a Brahmana there, he gets face to face with Lord Brahma.

## \|\| 2.35.43 \|\|

*tatrābhigamya deveśaṃ puruhūtamaninditam \|*  
*surūpo jāyate martyaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Indra, the lord of the gods, also lives here. By adoring him here, one becomes like him and has all his desires fulfilled.

## \|\| 2.35.44 \|\|

*saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevitaṃ param \|*  
*pūjayitvā tatra rudramaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. There is also a place known as Sapta- sarasvata, which is served by Brahma and other gods. By adoring lord Rudra there, a person achieves the merit of performing Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.35.45-46 \|\|

*yatra maṅkaṇako rudraṃ prapannaḥ parameśvaram \|*  
*ārādhayāmāsa haraṃ pañcakṣaraparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*namaḥ śivāyeti muniḥ japan pañcākṣaraṃ param \|*  
*ārādhayāmāsa śivaṃ tapasā govṛṣadhvajam \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. The place, where the sage Mankanaka had taken refuge with lord Rudra, the Supreme Lord, by means of penance and had also adored the bull-bannered Shiva. Thereafter, he was blazed by his penance.

## \|\| 2.35.47 \|\|

*prajajvālātha tapasā munirmaṅkaṇakastadā \|*  
*nanarta harṣavegena jñātvā rudraṃ samāgatam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Realising about the arrival of Rudra, he started dancing in great ecstasy. Then lord Rudra said to him, “Whey have you danced like this?” But without giving any reply he kept on dancing again and again.

## \|\| 2.35.48-49 \|\|

*taṃ prāha bhagavān rudraḥ kimarthaṃ nartitaṃ tvayā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvāpi devamīśānaṃ nṛtyati sma punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*so 'nvīkṣya bhagavānīśaḥ sagarvaṃ garvaśāntaye \|*  
*svakaṃ dehaṃ vidāryāsmai bhasmarāśimadarśayat \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Finding this, lord Shiva, in order to subside the pride of the sage, slit open his own body and displayed to him the heap of ashes.

## \|\| 2.35.50 \|\|

*paśyemaṃ maccharīrotthaṃ bhasmarāśiṃ dvijottama \|*  
*māhātmyametat tapasastvādṛśo 'nyo 'pi vidyate \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Then he said, “O Excellent sage, you look at the heap of ashes emerging out of my body. This is the greatness of penance, there is also another person like you, wherefore did you dance?

## \|\| 2.35.51-53 \|\|

*yat sagarvaṃ hi bhavatā nartitaṃ munipuṅgava \|*  
*na yuktaṃ tāpasasyaitat tvattopyatrādhiko hyaham \|\| 51 \|\|*

*ityābhāṣya muniśreṣṭhaṃ sa rudraḥ kila viśvadṛk \|*  
*āsthāya paramaṃ bhāvaṃ nanarta jagato haraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*sahasraśīrṣā bhūtvā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt \|*  
*daṃṣṭrākarālavadano jvālāmālī bhayaṅkaraḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. It is not proper for an ascetic to dance like this. Actually, I happen to be a bigger dancer than you.” Thus speaking, the seer of the entire universe, narrated him the great reality of the universe. At that point of time, lord Shiva danced, appeared with a thousand heads, besides a thousand eyes, and a thousand feet. He had a terrific face with curved fangs, he was wearing the garland of flames, and he looked awful. Thus, standing close to such a terrific trident-bearing lord, the sage looked at such a form of Shiva.

## \|\| 2.35.54-55 \|\|

*so 'nvapaśyadaśeṣasya pārśve tasya triśūlinaḥ \|*  
*viśālalocanamekāṃ devīṃ cāruvilāsinīm \|*  
*sūryāyutasamaprakhyāṃ prasannavadanāṃ śivām \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sasmitaṃ prekṣya viśveśaṃ tiṣṭhantīmamitadyutim \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā saṃtrastahṛdayo vepamāno munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*nanāma śirasā rudraṃ rudrādhyāyaṃ japan vaśī \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. At that point of time, the sage also witnessed the beautiful goddess, well decorated, standing by the side of the lord. The goddess Shiva had the lustre of thousands of suns, had a smile on her face. With a serene smile over her face, she was looking at the face of lord Shiva. Finding lord Shiva in such a terrific form, the heart of the great sage started shaking.

## \|\| 2.35.56 \|\|

*prasanno bhagavānīśastryambako bhaktavatsalaḥ \|*  
*pūrvaveṣaṃ sa jagrāha devī cāntarhitābhavat \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. He somehow controlled his senses, and started reciting Rudradhyaya and he offered his salutation to the lord, lowering his head. The three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards his devotees, became delighted.

## \|\| 2.35.57 \|\|

*āliṅgya bhaktaṃ praṇataṃ devadevaḥ svayaṃśivaḥ \|*  
*na bhetavyaṃ tvayā vatsa prāha kiṃ te dadāmyaham \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Then, He took to his original form and the goddess disappeared from that place. Shiva, then lifted his devotee from his feet and embraced him.

## \|\| 2.35.58-59 \|\|

*praṇamya mūrdhnā giriśaṃ haraṃ tripurasūdanam \|*  
*vijñāpayāmāsa tadā hṛṣṭaḥ praṣṭumanā muniḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*namo 'stu te mahādeva maheśvara namo 'stu te \|*  
*kimetad bhagavadrūpaṃ sughoraṃ viśvatomukham \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Не said, “О dear one, you should not be fearful any more. You tell me, what shall I give unto you?” Then the sage offered his salutation to the destroyer of Tripuras, and the lord of the mountains. Then he addressed to the lord, “O Mahadeva, О Mahesvara, salutation to you.

## \|\| 2.35.60-61 \|\|

*kā ca sā bhagavatpārśve rājamānā vyavasthitā \|*  
*antarhiteva sahasā sarvamicchāmi veditum \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ityukte vyājahāramaṃ tathā maṅkaṇakaṃ haraḥ \|*  
*maheśaḥ svātmano yogaṃ devīṃ ca tripurānalaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. О Lord, what is your lordly form with faces all round, yet very terrible, and who was the goddess standing by your side? Where has she suddenly disappeared? I am anxious to know about her.” When this was enquired, Нага spoke to Mankanaka.

## \|\| 2.35.62-63 \|\|

*ahaṃ sahasranayanaḥ sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ \|*  
*dāhakaḥ sarvapāpānāṃ kālaḥ kālakaro haraḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*mayaiva preryate kṛtsnaṃ cetanācetanātmakam \|*  
*so 'ntaryāmī sa puruṣo hyahaṃ vai puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. When so asked by the sage, lord Mahesvara, the destroyer of Tripuras-the form of fire, then enlightened the sage Mankanaka, about his own influence and path of Yoga, besides the goddess. He said, “I am a thousand-eyed god, the universal soul, the universal face, the destroyer of all the bondages, the form of Kala, besides being the cause of Kala, known as Нага. It is under my influence that all the mobiles and immobiles get inspired.

## \|\| 2.35.64 \|\|

*tasya sā paramā māyā prakṛtistriguṇātmikā \|*  
*procyate munirbhiśaktirjagadyoniḥ sanātanī \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. I am Purusottama living in all the people. The Mulaprakrti, the goddess having three gunas is my Maya alone.

## \|\| 2.35.65 \|\|

*sa eṣa māyayā viśvaṃ vyāmohayati viśvavit \|*  
*nārāyaṇaḥ paro 'vyakto māyārūpa iti śrutiḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. She has been called as the eternal Shakti by the sages, who is the eternal source of origin of the world. The entire world is deluded with this Maya of the lord.

## \|\| 2.35.66 \|\|

*evametajjagat sarvaṃ sarvadā sthāpayāmyaham \|*  
*yojayāmi prakṛtyāhaṃ puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The unmanifest Narayana, is of the form or Maya, as has been proclaimed by the Srutis. Thus, I establish the entire world in this way.

## \|\| 2.35.67-68 \|\|

*tathā vai saṃgato devaḥ kūṭasthaḥ sarvago 'malaḥ \|*  
*sṛjatyaśeṣamevedaṃ svamūrteḥ prakṛterajaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*sa devo bhagavān brahmā viśvarūpaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tavaitat kathitaṃ samyak straṣṭvatvaṃ paramātmanaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*
